tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 13 gsung 'bum/_tA ra nA tha/ （dpe bsdur ma/）

tei:div.tei:p: spyi khyab bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur ba gtso bo/ gzan dkar thub bstan nyi ma/bsdu sgrig 'gan 'khur gzhon pa dang / gtso sgrig pa/ karma bde legs/gtso sgrig gzhon pa/ 'gro snyul rdo rje/bsdu sgrig pa/ mun sel/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan 'dzin blo gros/zla ba bstan 'dzin/ shes rab bzang po/zhu dag dang dkar chag sgrig mkhan/ dpal ldan rgya mtsho/ phur pa phrin las/dkon mchog bsam gtan/ thub bstan nyi ma/ bstan pa dar rgyas/par sgrig lag rtsal pa/ tshe ring chos sgron/ shes rab dpal g.yang /bsod nams 'brug rgyas/

〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 ces pa'i dpe tshogs 'di ni dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs shing 'di ga dpe skrun khang dang mnyam 'brel gyis bskrun pa'i dpe rnying dpe tshogs shig yin la/de yang mkhas dbang gzan dkar rin po che thub bstan ti ma mchog gis spyi'i gtso skyong gnang ste/dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis nye ba'i lo bcu tsam gyi ring la 'bad brtson chen pos bod kyi sa gnas gang sar bzhugs pa'i bod yig dpe rnying po ti khrir longs pa rang byung dang mi'i gnod 'tshes 'jig la nye ba'i nyen kha las bskyabs te legs par bsgrigs shing dkar chag tu btab/dpe thum gsol/dpe sgrom bzhengs te srung skyob mdzad gnang ba dang gnang mus su yod pa ni/rang re'i mes po'i shul nor srung skyob rgyun 'dzin dang bod rig pa'i gal che'i dpyad gzhi mkho 'don gyi dgos pa che ba ma zad/rang rgyal mi rigs rig gnas nor mdzod dar rgyas dang srung skyob bgyi ba'i 'phrin las gal chen zhig red/nye char dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang dang 'di ga dpe skrun khang gnyis zhib gros byas mthar/srol rgyun rig gnas srung skyob dang bod rig pa'i dpyad yig myur skyob dang cha tshang du gtong ba'i dmigs yul ngos 'dzin gcig gyur thog 〈bka' gdams dpe dkon gces btus〉 zhes pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gyi dpe tshogs chen mo zhig mu mthud nas legs sgrig dang dpe skrun byed bzhin yod pa dang /da char yang dmigs yul dgos pa gcig gyur thog 〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉ces pa'i dpe rnying dpe dkon gal chen gyi dpe tshogs chen mo 'di nyid par skrun bya rgyu yin la/de yang sngon byon mes po mkhas dbang dam pa du mas shul du bzhag pa'i gsung 'bum dpe dkon gal chen rnams dang /'thar 'thor du bzhugs pa'i dpe dkon gal chen dag phyogs gcig tu bsdus te bsgrigs pa 'di'i nang don thad la/nang don rig pa dang /gso ba rig pa/tshad ma rig pa/sgra rig pa/bzo rig pa/lo rgyus/rtsis rig snrogs bcu phrag rig pa'i gnas kun 'dus pa'i dpe dkon nor bu dgos 'dod kun 'byung lta bu zhig yan/ —1

'ad 'dra' dpe skrun mnyam las kya go skabs legs po nged cag dpe skrun khang la thob pa na shan tu skal ba bzang zhing gzi brjid kyi 'os 'gan zhig tu brtsis te lo 'ga'i dpe skrun 'char gzhi gtso bo'i nang du bkod zin cing / las gzhi 'di la krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid dang rgyal khab phyi nang gi bod rig pa'i mkhas dbang du mas gdeng 'jog dang mthong chen gyis skul ma yang thob/〈mes po'i shul bzhag〉 gi ma phyi phal cher ni dbu med bris rnying sha stag yin pas/ ma dpe gsal mi gsal dang skung yig mang zhing bris tshugs 'dra min gyi dbang gis klog dka' ba'ang shin tu mang po 'dug 'on kyang dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis lo mang ring nyams myong bsdu len dang mkhas dbang du mar bka' 'dri zhus par brten yig gzugs gsar rgyag dang phyogs sgrig thub pa byung / par shing du 'khod yod pa rnams kyang dpe rnying g.yin pa dang bsdur te gtan la phab yod pa bcas te zhib cha deb so so'i bsdu sgrig gsal bshad du gzigs par zhu/dpe rnying srung skyob dang phyogs sgrig dpe skrun gyi las ka 'di la rgyab skyor dang thugs khur gnang mkhan gyi mkhas dbang rnams dang / lhag par du krung go'i bod rig pa zhib 'jug lte gnas kyi dbu khrid lhan rgyas dang / mkhas dbang thub bstan nyi ma rin po che mchog sogs kyis rgyab skyor dang mdzub ston gyi bka' drin bskyangs pa la snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / dpal brtsegs zhib 'jug khang gi 'gan 'dzin pa lhan rgyas dang / zhu dag pa/ yig rgyag pa sogs mdor na las gzhi 'di la lhag bsam dang 'bad brtson chen pos zhabs phyi zhu mkhan rnams la snying thag pa nas bka' drin che zhes zhu rgyu dang /dpe tshogs 'di'i dpe sgrig dang zhu dag thad la ha cang nan tan dang zhib tshags bgyi khul byas mod/'on kyang nga tshor shes tshad dman pa'i dbang gis nor 'chug mi nyung ba yod srid pas dpyod ldan dag gis nor bcos yo bsrang gi dgongs 'char lhug stsol gnang bar zhu zhu/zhes krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas/spyi lo 2007lo'i zla ba dang po'i tshes 10la/

de la 'dir rang cag kha ba can gyi zhing 'dir chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / sa dge bka' rnying sogs kyi mkhas shing grub pa brnyes pa'i dam pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis/ bshad sgrub kyi shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i chos brgyud dang bka' srol mtha' dag dang / de dang rjes su 'brel ba'i thun mong gi rig gnas sum rtags snyan ngag mngon brjod sdeb sbyor/ skar rtsis 'gyung rtsis / sgra tshad bzo gso sogs mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs zab cing rgya che ba tshang la ma nor ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig 'chad nyan 'gyur gsum dang / bshad sgrub las gsum gyi sgo nas thog mar srol gtod/bar du gtan la phab/ rim bzhin dar rgyas btang ba sogs 'dzin skyong spel bar mdzad pa'i bka' drin bdag rkyen la brten nas/ dbus gtsang khams gsum du bzhugs so cog gi glegs bam thams cad gcig tu skrungs na ri rab lhun po'i gtos dang mnyam zhing / chos tshan gyi rnam dbye ji snyed yod pa grangs su bgrangs na nam mkha'i gza' skar tshogs kyang skyengs par byed pa zhig mchis pa tsam du ma zad / rgya bal hor sogs kyi yul gru kun tu'ang dar khyab che/da lta'i char bod rig pa'am bod kyi shes rig ces su grags pa 'di nyid 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru dag tu'ang mched de/ dper na/ o ka si phor dhi dang / har wid lta bu yo rob dang / a— rdo digs su grags chen gyi slob grwa chen mo

rnams su bod yig gi dpe mdzod chen po yod par ma zad/ bod kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed sa'i sde tshan dang slob ma yang mi nyung ba yod/da ni gong du smras pa'i bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad ces pa de gang dang gang yin pa'i ngo sprod mdo tsam zhu na/ de yang ji skad du/ 'jam mgon kong sprul rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos blon thon mi be+e ro ska cog zhung / /gnubs chen rin bzang rngog lo sa skya pa/ /bu ston bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu// zhes dang / bod yul sgrub brgyud shing rta chen po brgyad/ /rnying ma bka' gdams lam 'bras bka' brgyud pa/ /shangs pa zhi byed sbyor drug bsnyen sgrub bo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ shes bya'i gzhung lugs sna tshogs kyi 'gyur khyad dang 'chad tshul gyi dbye bas bshad rgyun 'degs pa'i ka chen bcu dang / sgrub pa nyams su len tshul la brgyud pa'i khyad par dang man ngag gi dbye bas sgrub brgyud 'dren pa'i shing rta brgyad de/ bshad sgrub shing rta chen po bco brgyad rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bdag cag gi yab mes gong ma rnams kyis gces pa'i lus srog longs spyod thams cad phangs pa med par btang ste/ phyi rabs rang re'i brgyud 'dzin rnams la 'phran yun phan bde'i dpal la dmigs nas bzhag pa'i nor bu rin po che yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal po mtha' yas pa zhig mchis/de dag las mang che ba rig gsar lo bcu'i god chag chen po sogs dus kyi rgud pa'i dbang gis sems med 'gyung bzhi'i 'jig pa dang / sems ldan mi dang mi min gyi gnod pas nyams nyes chen por gyur pa ni rgya bod yongs grags ltar lags/—2—

rig gnas gsar brje'i mjug sgril ba dang myongs cig tang gi yang dag pa'i srid jus kyi nyi 'od slar yang 'phros te/ tang dang rgyal khab kyis 'go khrid dang rtsa 'dzugs gnang nas/ dpe rnying 'thor bsdu dang / legs sgrig dpe skrun/ sgyur spel sogs kyi sgo nas rang rigs kyi rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang / mi nyams gong 'phel gyi bya bar so so'i 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu sgrub pa'i skal ba bzang po'i dpal la longs su sbyad du yod pa'i skabs 'dir/ rang re'i yab mes rnams kyis bzhag pa'i pha nor mang po zhig da dung yang nged cag gi bsod nams kyi bgo skal du lhag yod pa rnams la gces spras chen pos srung skyob dang dar spel byed rgyu ni mes rgyal gyis gnang ba'i las 'gan yin par ma zad/ 'u cag bod kyi rig gnas slob gso'i bya bar legs skyes 'bul mkhan gyi rgan dar 'bring gsum gyi shes yon can la mtshon na/ rang re'i phrag par bab pa'i g.yin dring mi 'jog pa'i gzi 'od bla na 'bar ba'i 'os 'gan mchog tu gyur pa zhig kyang yin par sems/der brten/ phyogs dang ris su ma chad pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis ljags rtsom gnang ba'i gsung rab/ bshad sgrub shing rta bco brgyad las grub pa'i mdo sngags kyi gzhung bshad dang / chos 'byung dang gdan rabs/ rnam thar dang gsan yig brda sprod dang snyan ngag /rtsis dang gso rig sogs dpe dkon 'thor ba rnams bsdus/ chad pa rnams bsab/ nyam/sa pa rnams gsos/ 'khru / gas pa rnams bsgrigs te dpe tshogs 'ga' rim pa bstar chags su par du bskrun pa dang bskrun rtsis las/—3 —

da lan 'dir jo nang rje bcun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma 'di rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/'byung char nga tsho'i dpe tshogs dpar skrun zhu rgyu'i skor la lhag bsam ldan zhing mkhyen spyan yangs pa'i mkhas dbang rnams kyis dgongs 'char gyi bka' slob stsol gnang dang / dpe dkon gyi ma phyi g.yar gnang gi skyabs 'jug yong ba mkhye/na mkhye/na/ /zhor 'phros gsal 'debs zhu ba/ lhag par du da lta lus kyi lang tsho rgyas shing / sems kyi blo gros bkra ba'i gzhon skyes rnams la mtshon na/ snying pos dben pa'i kha pho 'don pa las/ zol med kyi lhag bsam dkar po snying la 'chang / don ldan gyi rnam dkar bya ba dang du len/ lhad med kyi chos dang rig gzhung slob gnyer byed/ 'khos bstun gyi sri zhu ri las ka cung zad re sgrub nus na/mes rgyal la zhabs |zhe 'grub/ rang rigs la legs skyes 'bul/ rang nyid kyi la rgya mngon thub pa zhig kyang 'ong ba ni mthong chos mngon gyur lags pas/ de bzhin dgongs dbyings su chub par zhu kho/ /phran 'brog rgan 'khyams po thub bstan nyi mas/spyi lo 2007pa'i zla tshes la gus phul/—4—

bsdu sgrag gsal bshad/bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/da lam nga tsho'i jo nang rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs te par skrun zhus pa 'di ni/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi ma'i bka' slob dang bdag rkyen 'og byung ba zhig yin/de yang spyir khong la gsung 'bum pod bzhi bcu tsam zhig yod tshul phyis su bris pa'i rnam thar 'ga' las gsal yang / dngos su pod bzhi bcu'i dkar chag kha gsal zhig da sngon nga tsho'i mjal rgyu ma byung / da lam dngos su mjal rgyu byung ba'i pod bco lnga ni/ deng sang yongs grags su rtag brtan par ma zhes 'bod pa 'di ni/ bod rab byung bcu pa'i me 'brug (spyi lo1616) la/ mnga' ris smad kyi gung thang gi rgyal rabs nyi shu rtsa gsum pa'am/ yang lugs gcig la dmar po sde bsgrangs na nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa bsod nams dbang phyug sdes yon bdag byas/ tā ra nā tha'i dngos slob gnya' yi ban+di dkon mchog legs pas/ thog ma'i mtshams sbyor dang par byang 'bri ba sogs byas te/ dus 'khor sngags phreng dang skad gnyis shan sbyar sogs chos tshan bcu bzhi shing par du bekos pa/ rtag brtan dam chos gling du spyan drangs te bzhugs su gsol/ de'i steng du rtag brtan rang nas brkos pa bcas pod 1 —

bco lnga tsam zhig yod pa de'i bu dpe par ma tshar gcig /rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos 'bras skrungs dpe mdzod khang du gdan drangs ba/ phyis dus 'gyur skabs su pe cing mi rigs pho brang du bzhugs kyang / deng seng bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du spyan drangs te bzhugs pa de yin/yang gangs can mkhas grub rim byon gyi ming mdzod las/ khong la gsung rtsom shin tu mang po yod par grags kyang rgyal dbang lnga pa chen pos/gsung 'bum shing par rnams bka' rgya btab ste par mi chog pa mdzad pas da lta khong gi gsung rtsom rnams kha tshang ba ha cang dka'/ rgyal dbang lnga pa zhing du gshegs rjes/ blo gros brtan pas khong gi gsung 'bum la dkar chag bsdus pa zhig mdzad 'dug /de'i rjes zha lu ri phug sprul skus mdzad pa'i tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa'i nang du/ pod ka nas tsa bar bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don gnyis dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong brgyad brgya lnga bcu bzhugs/da lta pe cing mi rigs pho brang du pod bcu bdun la chos tshan nyis brgya don brgyad dang / ldeb grangs bdun stong dgu brgya lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bzhugs zhes gsal yang nga tsho'i gong gi dkar chag gnyis po da sngon mjal rgyu ma rnyed/ de yang zha lu ri phug sprul skus dkar chag dwangs gsal me long zhes pa ljags rtsom gnang ste/ sngar rtag brtan gyi shing par dus zing dbang —2—

gis nyams chag shor ba rnams/ kha gso mdzad tshul thos kyang chib phra'i lo rgyus kha gsal mjal rgyu ma byung / da lta dgen 'jam dbyangs rnams rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa'i par rnying pod bcu bdun 'di/ zha lu ri phug sprul skus nyams gso mdzad pa de yin nam snyams ste/ da lta rtag brtan gyi par rnying bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa pod bco lnga dang / pod grangs dang chos tshan mang nyung tshig mtshams sogs cung mi 'dra ba yod pa'i phyir/da lam nga tshos khong gi gsung 'bum glog klad nang du bcug skabs kyi thog ma'i ma dpe ni/ nye char bla ma yon to bzang pos 'dzam thang du shing par la brkos pa'i glegs bam nyer bzhi can de la byas te zhu dag thengs gsum byas/ de rjes sngar jo nang rtag brtan du bzhugs pa rtsom pa po tā ra nā tha rang nyid kyi phyag dpe skabs 'gar phyag mchan yod pa/ da lta 'bras sbungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs bris ma pod chung bcu la chos tshan43la bsdur gzhi dang / jo nang rtag brtan gyi par rnying pod bco lnga bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang du bzhugs pa dang / a ri ba dgen 'jam dbyangs rnam rgyal gyi dpe mdzod du bzhugs pa par rnying pod bcu bdun yod pa gnyis phyogs bsdoms kyis/ par rnying pod nyi shu tsam la chos tshan 314byung ba la sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur thengs dang po zhus/—3—

de nas rtag brtan gyi par pod nyi shu la bsdur gzhi dang / 'dzam thang gi par mas sdur byed byas te dpe bsdur theng gnyis pa zhus pa yin/ 'on kyang par ma snga phyi gnyis dang bris ma gcig bcas dpe gsum po rtsa ba'i cha nas gcig mtshungs su bzhugs pa las khyad par chen po mi 'dug /cho ga'i skor la mi 'dra ba cung zad yod pa ni mchan dkyus su shor ba yin 'dug pa rnams kyang / gug rtags nang du bcug te gsal po byas yod/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras skrungs bris ma gnyis su dpe ma bzhugs pa/ 'dzam thang par ma'i nang bzhugs gsung thor bu'i skor wa rtags can dang / zha rtags can gnyis dang / za rtags can dbu ma theg mchog gi zin bris rab byed drug pa yan chad/ tā ra nā tha'i zhal gsung slob ma ye shes rgya mtshos zin bris su bkod pa dang / rab byed bdun pa brgyad pa gnyis dza 'go'i dge bshes mchog grub rgya mtshos gsar du bsnan pa/ 'a rtags can nyang yul gyi lo rgyus tā ra nā thas zhabs btags mdzad par grags pa bcas chos tshan121la 'dzam thang gi par ma'i dpe gcig pu las/ rtag brtan par rnying dang 'bras skrungs bris ma gnyis kyi bsdur gzhi ma rnyed/ rtag brtan par rnying gcig pu las gzhan gnyis la med pa chos tshan4/ yang rtag brtan dang 'dzam thang par ma gnyis char med pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang du bzhugs pa'i gral nas chos tshan bco brgyad la ldeb193gsar rnyed byung —4—

ba bcas la/ zhu dag byas te kha skong gi tshul du bzhag yod pa bcas khyon bsdoms deb bzhi bcu zhe lnga la chos tshan900yod/ da lta nga tsho'i ma dpe g.yar rgyu ma rnyed pa sngon rtsom pa po'i phyag dpe'i gral nas yin pa/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang / dpe rtags phyi298nang bzhugs gtam du bya ba nor bu'i 'gyung gnas ldeb6/ yang phyi508nang bzhugs 'khor lo gsum gyi rnam bzhag chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i rgyan rnam par bkod pa ldeb92/ ste lag bris kyi chos tshan gnyis po ma 'ongs par dpe g.yar thabs bya dgos/da lta nga tshos dpe bsdur dang zhu dag gi skabs su ma dpe rtsa 'dzin byas te/ dpe gsum mi 'dra ba'i tshe rtag brtan la〈〈rta〉〉rtags 'di dang /'dzam thang la rtags〈〈rjo 〉〉'di/ dag cha nor bcos la gug rtag 'di/ 1dang / mchan rnams gug rtag〈 〉'di'i nang du blug yod/gsal bshad zhu rgyu zhig la deb bzhi pa'i nang du/ kun mkhyen dol po pa'i gsung chos tshan bzhi/ rig 'dzin tshe dbang kun khyab kyi gsung lho sgo'i cho ga zhes pa'i chos tshan gcig bcas 'dzam thang par mar bzhag yod pa dang / yang sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen gyi gsung dus 'khor phyag rgya'i skor chos tshan gcig rtag brtan par rnying du yod pa rnams rang 'jag bzhag yod pa dang / khong gi rang rnam gtso bor gyur pa'i lo rgyus zhal gdams rnams su/gtsang gi yul skad yin nam snyam pa'i tha snyad go dka' ba mang po zhig —5 —

bed spyad gnang ba dag kyang rang sor bzhag yod/da lam bka' 'bum 'di rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas zhus shing / par skrun tshar lnga brgya'i 'gro song bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas bgyis/ tshar brgyad brgya'i 'gro song hrin krin sogs kyi rgya'i spyin bdag rnams kyis gnang zhing / tshar nyis brgya'i 'gro song tsā 'dra tshogs pa nas bgyis pa bcas kyi mthun rkyen las/ da lam dngos su par du bskrun thub pa byung ste rgya che'i klog pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du phul ba yin/las gzhi 'dir bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang nas ma dpe pod bco lnga g.yar gnang byung ba dang / 'dzam thang bla ma mun sel mchog nas kyang ma dpe btsal rogs dang / go rim sgrig rgyu/ zhu dag bcas la rogs ram gang mang gnang ba dang / khams sprul bsod nams don grub mchog nas nyang yul chos 'byung zhu dag gi rogs ram gnang ba dang / bla ma dpal ldan rgya mtshos zhu dag gi las ka spyi'i thugs 'gan che bzhes gnang ba bcas la thugs rje che zhu rgyu ba'o/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/—6—

khong ni slob dpon chen tshu pa / sge hūṃ༈tsang gnas dang / paṇ+ḍi ta gha ya dha ra/gnyos lo tsā ba/ kha rag sgom chung sogs skyes chen mang pos byin gyis brlabs shing / bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis kyi nang tshan kha rag khyung btsun gyi gnas jo mo kha rag ces pa'i 'dabs/ chu bo chen po lo hi ta'i nye 'gram du rwa lo tsā ba chen po'i brgyud pa bar ma chad par byon pa la/ shar nub gnyis su gyes pa las shar ba kun dga' seng ge'i gdung brgyud/ sngags 'chang tshul khrims rgya mtsho'i sras rnam rgyal phun tshogs dgung lo bzhi bcu zhe dgu pa rje 'di'i yab dang /yum rdo rje bu dga' dgung lo bcu dgu pa gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bcu pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1575) la/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang bcas sku 'khrungs te mes pos pad+ma sri gcod rdo rje zhes mtshan gsol/sku bltams te zla ba brgyad song rjes bzhengs nas gom pa spo thub pa dang / dgung lo gcig tsam nas gsung byon te nga bla ma kun dga' grol mchog yin zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / gzhan yang sku gong ma'i rten gsum dang sbyin bdag / nye gnas sogs kyi lo rgyus gsal bar gsungs pa sogs kyis/jo nang bla ma kun dga' grol mchog gi yang srid 'khrul med du shes te/ dgung lo bzhi par jo nang mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho dang / zhabs drung bkra shis — 1 —

stobs rgyas dbang po sogs rta pa brgya dang drug cu rtsa lnga tsam gdan 'dren du byung nas/ gtsang phyogs su gdan drangs te sku gong ma'i slob ma rdo ring kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ lha dbang grags pa/ mkhan chen lung rigs rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang sogs kyis chos lung byang rtser khri ston mdzad/ rdo ring pa chen po 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi drung du/ thog ma'i rten 'brel du sgrol dkar gyi rjes gnang dang / gshed dmar lha lnga'i dbang / lam 'bras gtso bor gyur pa'i dbang dang gdams pa mang po gsan/de nas dgung lo drug pa nas yi ge sbyor klog phul du phyin pa mkhyen te/dbang dang rjes gnang sogs yig thog nas gnang ba la dka' tshegs med pa byung /dgung lo brgyad par rje gong ma'i dngos slob mkhas dbang byams pa lhun grub yongs 'dzin du bsten nas/ tshad ma rigs gter sbyangs pas gzhung don la go ba rnyed rung blo 'dzin la zla ba lnga tsam 'gor/ gas yang mdo rgyud kyi gzhung lugs mang por gsan bsam mdzad pas mkhyen rtogs rgyas/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs stag lung kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan gdan drangs te thog mar bka' gdams glegs bam gyi lung zhus te/ de nas bod rab byung bcu pa'i chu rta khrums stod zla ba'i tshes lnga (spyi lo1582)la/ chos lung byang rtse'i mchod khang gi yang thog tu/ dpal stag lung pa chen po rje btsun kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas kyi —2—

mkhan po dang / 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos slob dpon dang / rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang pos dus go ba/chos rje mchod gnas pas grogs dan bgyis te yongs rdzogs dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes te/ mtshan kun dga' snying po bkra shis rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ dag pa'i gzigs snang du rgya gar gyi paṇa chen dz+wa la nā thas tā ra nā tha zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/chos rje brag stod pa lha dbang grags pa'i drung nas chos drug dang phyag chen sogs/ zab chos mang po gsan pas nang zab lam gyi rtogs pa mngon du gyur/ rje drung kun dga' dpal bzang las dus 'khor gtso bor gyur pa'i zab chos mang po gsan/ mkhan po lung rigs rgya mtsho'i mdun dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rgyud bshad/ dpal rgyal ba jo nang pa'i lugs kyi sbyor drug gi zab khrid mtha' dag gsan te nyams len mdzad/ bu lugs kyi sbyor drug gi khrid kyang rdzogs par gsan/ gzhan yang jo zhal bla ma mang po'i gdams khrid dang bka' bstan sogs rgya gzhung gi man ngag mang po dang / kun mkhyen dol bo pa'i gsung 'bum sogs lung mang po gsan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas ye shes/rdo rje 'dzin pa ye shes dbang po sogs las/ sa skya jo nang shangs pa zhwa lu 'brug pa kaX tshang / stag lung sogs kyi chos skor bcas rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang khrid man ngag mtha' dag ma lus par gsan/ gzhan yang rgya gar gyi grub chen gu ru lho phyogs pa sangs rgyas sbas pa'i mgon po/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga'i mtshan can sogs bshes gnyen mang po'i zhabs la gshugs te/ zhang tshal pa'i chos —3—

skor dang / yang dgon pa'i bka' 'bum/ dwags po lha rje'i bka' 'bum/ ri chos ma drug gi khrid/ mai tri bcu gsum ma'i dbang / sangs rgyas thod pa'i dbang /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub skor gyi khrid lung yongs rdzogs/ mar pa nas brgyud rngog pa'i bka' babs dgyes rdor yab yum/ gur rigs bsdus/ gdan bzhi yab yum/ ma hā mā ya ste drug smri ti nas brgyud pa 'jam dpal gsang ldan bcas rngog dkyil bdun/ rngog ṭīka rin chen rgyan 'dra'i mdzub khrid/brtag gnyis sa rngog gnyis ka'i bshad srol/ stag lung thang pa'i bka' 'bum/sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang /ni gu chos drug 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang /'grel chen dri med 'od dang / rdo rje snying 'grel dang / dgyes pa rdo rje'i rgya gzhung / dgyes rdor skor la gtso che'i chos sna sum cu so dgu dang / gdan bzhi'i khrid tshul rgyas pa/ ār+ya de wa'i chos lnga sogs rgya gzhung bcu/ sa ra he'i chos lnga/ nag po'i gzhung drug ྅ hi smad lnga/dril bu skor gsum/ gshed dmar bi rū pa'i gzhung brgyad/ ku ku ri pa'i chos bdun/ sgrub thabs mtsho skyes sogs dgyes rdor gyi gzhung shin tu mang po dang / dpe med 'tsho'i spyor drug rtsa 'grel/dza lan+ta ri'i do ha/ sems kyi phyag rgya sogs mdo sngags spyi dang / khyad par du gsang sngags rgyud sde'i dbang bskyed rdzogs mtha' yas pa gsan/de nas dgung lo bcu bdun pa rab byung bcu pa'i lcags yos hor zla bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu bdun (spyi lo1591 )la/ 'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis mkhan po/ bla ma byams pa lhun grub kyis las kyi slob dpon/dge ba'i bshes gnyen blo bzang pa dang / rje drung kun dga' bsod nams —4—

sogs kyis kha skong gnang ste bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes te/ phyi ltar ngur smrig gi rgyal mtshan 'chang ba'i dge slong 'dul ba 'dzin pa/nang ltar gzhan phan snying rje chen pos thugs rgyud yongs su brlan pa'i rgyal sras sems pa chen po/ gsang ba bskyed rdzogs kyi zab gnad la mnga' brnyes pa'i sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin pa zhig tu gyur/de nas bsam sdings su dpal ldan bla ma dam pa byams pa'i mtshan can gyi drung du rdo rje phreng ba'i dbang yongs rdzogs dang / dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dbang bcas zhus/ bla ma dpal ldan chos kyi bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag po chen po'i mthar thug pa dang / gsang bdag 'khor lo chen po/ dril bu lha lnga/ gzungs grwa lnga/ dril bu lus dkyil sogs dbang mang po gsan/ g.yin yang dge ba'i bshe/sa gnyen rnams las/ gsang 'dus 'phags lugs dang / zhabs lugs/ gzhan rje gshed dgra gdong 'jigs gsum/gshed dmar bram ze dpal 'dzin gyi lugs/ gdan bzhi'i gzhus bdun/sangs rgyas thod pa phyogs kyi rgya gzhung mang po dang / rgyud sde 'og ma ci rigs pa dang / grub pa sde bdun/ snying po skor drug yid la mi byed pa'i chos skor rnams dang / phreng ba skor gsum/ rgyud 'grel grags can phal che ba dang /bslab btus dang / byang sa sogs gzhung mang por thos bsam gnang bas blo gros kyi lus stobs ches cher rgyas te gzhung lugs rab 'byams smra ba'i mkhas pa chen por gyur/—5—

de nas bla ma kun dga'i mtshan can dang slob dpon rin po ches bka' bzhin/ rje 'di nyid dgung lo nyer gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing lug hor zla brgyad pa'i tshes lnga(spyi lo1595)la/ ri khrod chen po jo mo nang gi gdan sa par bskos pa bzhin bla brang gi rtsis sprod rtsis len gnang rjes/ skyid phug tu zla gcig lhag tsam bcad mtshams la bzhugs te phag mo'i ljags bsnyen gnang skabs/ rmi lam du ngo bo slob dpon pad+ma yin pa'i rnal 'byor pa gzi brjid che ba zhig gi drung du/ dwags po rnyi ba rin po che dge bzhes bgres song gi rnam par bzhugs 'dug pa las/ rnal 'byor pa'i zhal nas nga dang dol po pa ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa dang / bod kyi dge bshes bgres song des kyang nga yang ngo bo gcig yin gsung pa rmis pas/ dang po pad 'byung gi rten 'brel de sad de sgom gyi sa bon thebs/ bar skabs su dwags po rin po ches chos kyis rtogs pa brnyes/ phyis kun mkhyen chen po'i bzhed dgongs ltar nyams su myong ba'i brda ru go /de nas rgya gar gyi paṇ+ḍi ta sdi rta nan+da dang pra yā mā nan+da gnyis dang mjal 'phrad mdzad de gsung gleng gnang bas/ khong gnyis grub mtha' nang par 'dug kyang pha mes kyi chos rig byed la yang zhen che bas/ phyi rol pa'i lha gcig gnyis bsten gyin 'dug pas dbang chos sogs ni ma zhus/ rig pa'i gnas thams cad la shin tu mkhas par 'dug pas dogs gcod mang du bgyis shing bstan bcos kyang than thun bsgyur/ bha ra ta dang rā ma ya ṇa la sogs pa'i lo rgyus kyang mang du thos/ de skabs rā ma ya ṇa'i srung ma ha nu ma tha'i cho 'phrul lus —6—

byang chen gyi ri dang mnyam pa'i spre'u dang / bha ra ta'i srung ma rgyal po sgyi ma dngos su mthong bas paṇ+ḍi ta na re/ khyod la 'go bar 'dug mthu dang snyan grags longs spyod chen po yong gsungs na yang / chos la mi dad pa'i lha 'dre bsten pas ci bya snyam nas yal bar dor ba yin zhes gsungs/lo dus chag med jo nang du sbyor drug gi khrid gsungs pas ngo ma 'phrod pa gcig kyang ma byung / rgya gar gyi slob dpon su ni rbu ṇa shrī dang puṇ+ḍa badz+ra sogs las zab khrid kyi gdams pa mang po gsan/ jo nang du sgrub mchod la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs te/ 'dus pa bdun brgya tsam la dbang bcu gcig pa rdzogs par gnang / dgung grangs nyer drug skor rwa sgreng du phebs te tshogs su chos 'brel tsam dang / rje tsong kha pa'i bzhugs khri'i steng nas lam rim gsungs/dgung lo nyer dgu par jo nang du bzhugs skabs tho rengs shig la rje btsun byams pas zhal gzigs te/ khong rang la thim pa'i gzigs snang byung bas gzhan stong dbu ma'i grub mtha' la nges shes gting nas rnyed/ kun mkhyen dol po pas zhal yang yang gzigs nas lung bstan gnang ba dang /gzim lam du sham+bha lar phyin nas rigs ldan sprul pa'i sku dang mjal te chos gsan pa'i snang ba sogs gzigs snang mang po byung /dgung lo so dgu par chos 'khor lha sar phebs nas dar chen mang po bslangs te jo bo'i mdun thugs smon zab rgyas gnang / de nas kun mkhyen dol po pa'i sku brnyan gsung byon ma dang / thugs rje chen po/ tshe dpag med bcas —7—

byin rlabs can gyi rten gsum po'i mdun du mchod 'bul dang thugs smon rgya chen gnang ste smon lam rgyal ba rgya mtsho yang brtsams/dgung lo zhe gcig pa rab byung bcu pa'i shing yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu gcig (spyi lo1615)la/ gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyis chos gzhis dang / lha 'bangs sogs rgya cher phul nas mthun rkyen sbyar ba las/dpal rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gnas gzhi'i las grwa btsugs te/ phyi gtsug lag khang dang grwa khang brgya phrag tsam lcags ri dang bcas pa/ nang gi rten sangs rgyas rabs bdun dang / tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma/yum chen mo/ dzam bha la sogs gser zangs las grub pa mang po dang / dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku zhal phyag yongs rdzogs gser zangs las grub pa dang /bde gshegs mchod rten cha brgyad sogs rten gsum dpag tu med pa bzhengs/jo nang du yang lha khang gsar bzhengs dang nang rten byams chen thog tshad gnyis tsam gser zangs las grub pa sogs mang po bzhengs/ gzhan yang lha bzo sogs lag rtsal pa rnams dang po rgya bal sogs nas gdan drangs/ de nas bris pa dang / spar brko shing bzo sogs lag rtsal pa gso skyong gnang bas/las rigs lag rtsal pa rnams kyang gzhan la re mi dgos pa byung ste/ bka' bstan 'gyur ro cog tshar mang po dang / bka' 'bum skor po ti bzhi bcu shing par du brkos pa sogs rten gsum mang po gsar bzhengs gnang /skabs shig ri bo che nas rgya dpe pod bcu tsam zhig 'byor byung ba'i nang / yar klung lo tsā ba'i phyag dpe ngo ma dus 'khor 'grel chen pod gnyis —8—

'dug dus 'khor rgyud kyi dpe de dbus phyogs nas snga mo zhig tu lag son byung ba dang / 'grel pa 'di skabs su rnyed pa la ya mtshan chen po byung ste thengs mang bklags pas zung sbyor la yang blo skyed chen po byung / gzhan yang dbang mdor bstan gyi 'grel pa don dam bsdus pa'i mdzad byang la nā ro pa'i mtshan yod pa dang / kyai rdo rje'i 'grel pa rdo rje'i tshig bsdus kyi mdzad byang du byang chub bzang po'i skad dod bo dhi bha dra zhes yod pa sogs mang po byung /yang skabs shig gtsang pa sde srid kyis sog po'i steng du dmag dpung chas rtsis la srung 'khor dang sku rim gnang ba'i tshe/ khong ni rje tsong kha pa chen por lhag tu dad pa che ba dang / khyad par du chos sde chen po 'bras spungs la nye sems kyi bag chags shin tu che ba zhig yod pas/ chos sde chen po de nyid dar zhing rgyas pa dang rtsod pa 'jam po'i sgo nas zhi ba'i smon lam btab kyang / nus pa ma thon pa ni phyogs gnyis ka las ngan gyi dbang gis ded pa la g.yol thabs bral zhes gsungs/ de nas dpal 'khor bde chen/ rtse chen chos sde/'jag bsam gnyis/ thar pa gling / rtag brtan chos 'phel sogs dbus gtsang gi chos sde mang por chos dang longs spyod kyi bsnyen bkur rgya chen gnang ste bskyangs/de nas dgung grangs re gcig bzhes pa rab byung bcu gcig pa'i shing phag (spyi lo1635)la/ rtag brtan dam chos gling nges don dga' ba'i tshal gyi gdan sa 'jam dbyangs sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho la gtad de/ chos lung rtse dang jo mo nang du dus khrid phyag len rgyas pa gnang nas/ da res ma gtogs —9—

'dir chos mi 'chad gsungs te bu slob rnams la zhal ta mang po gnang ste/ lo de'i nag pa zla ba'i tshes nyer brgyad la zhi bar gshegs so//slob ma/ sprul sku sangs rgyas rgya mtsho/ mkhas dbang ye shes rgya mtsho/mkhan chen rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhas grub blo gros rnam rgyal rnams dang / sgam po sprul sku/ chos rje ngag dbang pa/ bla ma chu bo chung ba'i sku skye/ mkhan po kun dga' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ sprul sku ngag gi dbang po/ tre bo sprul sku/chos rje rin stengs pa/ dus 'khor shar chen pa/ chos rje lha bo pa/ dge slong snying po mtha' yas/ byams pa yon tan mgon po/ ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ mi pham dkon mchog legs pa/ kun dga' 'phrin las dbang mo/gtsang gi rgyal sras kun dga' bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan sogs mang po byung /gzhan yang bstan pa'i spyin bdag gtsang pa sde srid phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ byang bdag bkra shis stobs rgyal/ yar 'brog bstan 'dzin mi 'gyur dbang gi rgyal po sogs mang ngo/ /dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas karma bde legs kyis/

bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga skal ba bzang po'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/ 1dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i brgyud 'debs bzhugs/ 30'khor lo sdom pa nag po zhabs lugs kyi sgrub thabs bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 37dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil chog nag po lugs kyi gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs bzhugs/ 77'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs lha yi pa'i lugs bde chen 'jug ngogs bzhugs/ 159— 1 —

'o5rgya/ga lnga(gas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ — 200dpal 'bor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes sbyo/ rnga spro rnga spro ( nu / /spro5/ 257bde mchog lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po bzhugs/ 280dpal mkha' 'askre|'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ 300dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil snyen ra gyi bdag 'jug gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ 338

zhen/ bya ba bsdo kyi gan//oṃ na mo badz+ra dha rā ya/ bla ma rdo rje slob dpon mchod pa'i cho ga skal bzang 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dbyer ma mchis pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyis byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rab rgyas in+d+ra nī la'i lhun po gang / /nyin byed 'bum phrag brgya yis 'phyud pa'i dpal/ /rnam kun rig mar kha spyor ye shes sku/ /bde chen rol pa rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal gus pas mchod pa 'bul/ /dang ba'i yid kyis dang bas mchod cing bstod/ /rab 'byams mchod sprin rab 'byams zhing gi tshogs/ /yongs su gang bas yongs su mchod par bgyi/ /rab mdzes mchog ldan bde dpal mchog mdzes rab/ /phul phyin mchog gi mchog gyur phul phyin phul/ /mkhyen pas shes bya stong pa'i shes pas mkhyen/ /gus pas 'dud cing 'dud cing 'dud pas gus/ /ye shes shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mchog rnam kun/ /rnam kun kun nas mngon gyur kun shes rab/ khes rab rab mchog de nyid dngos kun mkhyen/ /kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i gter la rab btud de/ /dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas ni/ /bla ma rdo rje slob dpon la/ /mchod pa'i tshul zhig 'dir 'bri ste/ /rnal 'byor can rnams rangs par gyis/ /'dir he ru ka dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i phyi rol mchod pa las brtsams te/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dbyer med par mchod pa'i cho ga ngag 'don lag tu blang ba ni 'di yin te/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po la/ sdom ni/ rdor dril byin rlabs sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / /byin dbab zhu 'bul skyabs sems rdor sems bsgom/ nang mchod byin gyis brlab dang bdag bskyed bsgom/ /dang po ni/ thal / sbyar/ oṃ a ā i yī u ā ṛ grwa '-i lī

e i tse( e( aX aX ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa zla ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūX hūX phaṭa snyu hā/ lag mthil g.yas su nyi ma/g.yon du zla ba/ rnam lnga 'dod skor byas la/ rdo rje 'di nyid rdo rje sems dpa'/ dril bu 'di nyid rdo rje snyems ma'i ngo bo gnyis ka'ang stong pa dang snying rje dbyer med pa'i byang chub kyi sems/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa twaX dha ra ya mi badz+ra rdo rje mthe bong dang ming med kyis bzung satwa hāXhi hi hi hi hūX phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ 〈dril bu snyems pa dang bcas pas sta zur g.yon du bzung /〉badz+ra gas hūX/ rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa mnyes par bya'o/ /huX sems can rmongs pa las sgrol ba/ /rnam thar chos kyi bya ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje gsor pa mdzes pas te/ spro dang bcas pas dril bu bzung / /huX hūX hūX/ hoXhoXhoX oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saX pra ra ṇi ta sarba brnya slo tra pra tsa lwa ni pradz+nyā pā ra mi ta na da saX bhā we badz+ra dharma hri da ya ṇi sa sto ṣa ṇi/ huX huX huX/ hoXhoXhoX ā khaX swāhā/gnyis pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gsum pa gnas yo byin rlabs ni spyi dang mthun pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/maṇ+ḍal bskyed bsdu dang thal mo sbyar nas/ sems can don du sems dge bas/ /rnal 'byor pa yi tshogs rnams kun/ /tshul bzhin cho gar ldan pa yi/ /rnal 'byor la ni nye gnas mdzod/ /gal te cho ga'i slob dpon yod na zhu ba'i ma rdzo 'bul lo/ /lnga pa skyabs 'gro/ drug pa sems bskyed/ bdun pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas rnams ni bde mchog nyid kyi chog rim bzhin no/ /brgyad pa ni/ oṃ nga/ sogs kyis bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud raX las me kaX las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum a las thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa'i nang du huX bhuX aX dzi khaX las sha lnga/ baX maX taX paX laX las bdud rtsi lnga/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas bcu zhu zhing bskol bas ye shes kyi —2—

bdud rtsi kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oṃ āXhūX ha hoXhiX.oṃ āXhuX/ dgu pa ni/ mngon rtogs rgyas par bsgom par bya la/ de tsam mi nus na bsnyen sgrub bzhi tsam bsgom/ de yang mi nus na 'di ltar/shrī he ru ko3 haX/ shri yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /gsum/ rang bde mchog he ru ka phyag gnyis pa/ oṃ a āX.i yīsogs lan gsum/ lte bar zla ba la ā li kā li lan gsum du g.yon du bskor ba/de las 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs dpag tu med pa ba sbu'i khung bu nas spros/ 'gro ba thams cad rnam par sbyangs/ 'khor lo lnga'i go 'phang la bkod/ bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/ slar 'dus ste ba la thim/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sogs 3 med bzhi bsgom/ su bhā wa sogs/lkoX hūṃ n+ya tā dz+nya na badz+ra swa bha lwat+pa ko3 haX/ oX āXhuX/ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya nywa t+ta badz+ra swa bhā nywa t+pa ko3 haX/ gsum/ oṃ badz+ra shudha sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3 haX/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog 'khor lo sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ pad nyi'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma mnan pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / spyi bo'i nor bu dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang /phyag rgya drug dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan pa/ yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas yab la 'khyud pa/gcer mo phyag rgya lnga dang ldan ma/ dbu skra grol ba/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus —3—

na bzhugs pa'o/ /h+pha/ ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa gnyis su med par thim/dzaXhuX baX hoX oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shurnyo3haX/ yi ge bdun pa'am/ nyer gnyisapa ci rigs par bzla'o// skabs 'dir rjes gzhig gi tshul bsgoms la ldang ngo / /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bsrung 'khor maṇ+ḍal lhar skyed dang / /thugs bskul mchod gtong dbang bskur blang / bdun las/dang po ni/ oX nga ni nga hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya/ huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga bān badz+ra huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX las pad+ma/ raX las nyi ma/ hūX las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba la hūX gis mtshan pa las sngags kyi 'od zer 'phros/ nga lan gnyis/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar khyab pa'i sngags kyi gzugs las/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba gur bla bre mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ oṃ me dhi ni badz+re bha wa bhan+ta huX/ gsum/ oX badz+ra pra kā ra huX baX huX/ oX badz+ra pañtsa ra hūX paX huX/ oṃ badz+ra wi ta na huX khaX huX/ oX badz+ra sa ra dza la traX saX traX/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa lwa na lwarka hūX hūX hūX/ gnyis pa ni/ maṇ+ḍal dngos su sngar mug mas grub na 'dir yid kyis dmigs pa dang tshig cha rnams brjod/ sngar ma bshams na 'di nyid du dngos su maṇ+ḍal bya'o/ /skad cig gis rtsa ba'i bla ma mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ oṃ badzo da ke chu byin rlabs huX swāhā/ oX dung chos len hriXswāhā/ oṃ waX kha khrus swahā/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs/ oX sarba ta thā ga tā bhi ṣe gdong bkru'o ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūṃX/ /oṃ gnas gsum du reg āXhūX/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha gdan la me tog bzhag badz+ra ā sa na huX/ oṃ badz+ra pa ba na ba na ya swāhā/ oṃ kha t+ta ro he me tog rna ltag tu gzer rak+ṣa maX/ sarba bi lhan khyuX oṃ badzo chu byin brlabs da ke huX swāhā/ oṃ purdze/ ke tu rā dza ya ta thā ga tā ya/ arnya te sa mya ka sam bu —4—

dha ya/ ta bya thā/ oṃ pu po pu po ma hā pulge me sto byin mas gu pur+sha puṣ+ṭha saX bhā we pu tho ra we put+pa ki rje swāhā/ oṃ go ma ba lci sogs byin rlabs ye swāhā/ oX badz+ra satwa bgegs sbyang ba ni bighāX nu spyo ra ya huX phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra re kha su re re kha bris khe swāhā/ ba lci chur bcas sbyin pa ste/ byi dor byas pa tshul khrims yin/ /grog sbur bsal ba bzod pa ste/ /brtson 'grus bya ba byed la brtson/ /bsam gtan der sems skad cig ma/ /ri mo legs 'bar shes rab bo/ /pha rol phyin pa drug rnams kyi/ /thub pa'i maṇ+ḍal legs byas pa'o/ /'dir ni lus kyi las byas nas/ kha dog gser ltar 'gyur ba dang / /nad rnams kun las rnam par grol/ /lha dang mi las ches lhag cing / /zla ba lta bu'i gzi brjid can/ /nor dang gser ni phun sum tshogs/ /rgyal po'i rigs dang sangs rgyas pa/ /mchog gi khyim du skye ba nyid/ /oṃ badz+ra re khe sarba bud+dhā a dhi slar yang re kha bya spyin swāhā/ oṃ waXb po si swāhā/ oṃ tsan+d+ra arka bi ma phyi'o la swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma me tog bkram ya/ sogs/ haX su me so 0 i bu bya ru na maX yaX bi de ha di pa na maX raX dzam bu dī pa na maX laX go da ni dī pa na maX waX ku dra mi dī pa na maX yaXya snga sna pa dī pa na maX raXraX u pa dī pa na maXlaX laX u pa di pa na maX waXwaX2sku pa dī pa na maX laXrga she ra tho / rat+na ya na maXraX ma rnyi rat+na ya na maX ya ga dza rat+na ya na maX waXsdi rat+na ya na maX yaXkhat+pa rat+na ya na maX ra ma ṇi rat+na ya na maX waXni dhi rat+na ya na maX laXtsakra rat+na ya na maX.oṃ a tsan+d+ra/ oṃ aXsu rla/ oṃ oṃ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i zhing 'byor ba tshad med pa kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul las byung ba lta bu mchod pa'i sprin rab 'byams kyi ngo bo nyid na maX bdag gzhan lus ngag yid gsum —5—

dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs/ /rin chen kun bzang maṇ+ḍal bzang po'i mchod pa 'di/ /blo yi blangs nas dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla mar 'bul/ /thugs rje'i dbang gis bzhes nas byin gyis rlab tu gsol/ gsum pa ni/ oX su thos bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las chos 'byung dkar po bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ de'i nang du yaX raX baX laX shu las 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i steng du/ bhuX las gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa/ dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa/ nang gi lha snam phyogs kyi mdog can gyi dbus su seng khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma'i gdan/ de'i steng du/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma huX gi rnam par byon pa/ de las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka zhal bzhi/phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa zhal dang sku lus in+d+ra nī la 'bar ba'i 'od can/ dus mtha'i sprin gnag ltar 'jigs pa/ g.yas zhal ston zla ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal dzam+bu chu bo'i gser sbyangs ba ltar lham me ba/ zhal re re la spyan gsum gsum dang / mche ba'i myu gu bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ ral pa'i cod pan la sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / spyi bo'i nor bu dang / mi bskyod pas rnam par brgyan pa/ thod skam lnga lnga'i cod pan za ra tshags dang bcas pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa/ g.yas lhag mas ḍā ma sa dgra sta/ mdung rtse gsum/ gri gug g.yon lhag mas kha ṭāX ga zhags pa/thod pa/ tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan —6—

mo dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed mnan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang / mgo 'phreng dang / thal ba dang / nyams dgus brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs grol ba/ yum rdo rje phag mo/ thun mtshams dang li khri'i mdangs can/ rdo rje dang man chad gong bzhin/ gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i nas pa'o/ /h+pha/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang he ru ka dbyer med pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs/ nga sogs/ oṃ gu ru tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal le khyu/ ar+ghaX/ pā r+yaX/ pulpe nas/ sha lta āXskyoX/ oX āXhuX dkon mchog gsum la sogs bya/ dzaXhūX baX ho~X oṃ yo ga sko khri spu sogs/ yab kyi gnas su/ tseX( oX ha/ na ma ti/ swāhā hūX/ po ṣa ṭa he/ huX ho/ phaṭa haX/ yum gyi gnas su/ oX lkoX baX/ haX yoX/hri/ moX/ hre hre/ huX huX/ phaṭa phaṭa/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /lpo shes kyi phung po la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la ni/ rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shri he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni lhung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlud gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ /rtsa sum cu rtsa drug rnal 'byor ma sum cu rtsa drug rkyang ma ro ma dbu ma bdud 'bral ma gtum mo rnams rdo rje —7—

chu kha ṣa cha tshe ṭhaṭhaḍa kya ḍa thuḍa /ṇa ba ra khye to ṭhaṭhaḍa khya ṣa ba rak+ṣ-i 〉chag /cho khaṭha chu kha ṇ+ḍi kha thu sprin kha rtsa ḍa a tshi khya khye/ /sh+lauka ḍā ṭo khyaṭhaḍa ṇa e kha tha ba ṭha ḍa yo ḍā ṭha kho kha ṭha r+ṇa ḍā rba chu /ṭāXrdzo tsheX / /mo bya /cha po /rā 〉cho raṇ+ḍa rngoḍa sko r+ṇa skyo cha rngoḍa /spra ḍa yo rngo yo /〉kha e khya ḍasmyurngo ra/rā da ta lnga ṭāX ṭāX kaX ḍā ḍā ṭo ṭo lngab khyi toX /khya /rā khib /a kha cho rnye 〉 lngab //cha rdzokha chu kha cho kha cho /rta spyo taṭha ṭāX bye ye ṇi rnam khrib ye ṇi kha dra rnye tshe rba chu tsheX /zhung r+ṇa rdza chu khya ḍi khya k+ṣ-i ḍa ḍā kho 7 to rnge lnga toX rngo ye ṇi ṭha ḍā :ṭo phra nag bye yo yu /ta kha ṭāX ṭāX ye ṇa kho da r+sā kha tshi rdzo rtsi khyu yi /taṭha ṭāX ṭāX tshi ṭha ḍā ṇa tshi yo khu khru /my-i ka khya ka ta sto to ṣa /ṭha ṭha u ya rngo rna lte teX ṭha ya /yi ṭa ḍā ṭha ya :dha da ṭha ya /myu rnge khu rdzi /khyu ṇa zla /phya bkra kha ḍa ra kha cha r+ṇa chub za lta༅ : ḍa teb kha chu kha to ra bya ba khaṇ+ḍa :ṇi ṭha ba ṭha rdzoḍa ṭhaṭha cha rje /spro cing ḍa khu ba ḍā mi lta ṭha ༅na kha lnga khya ༅ṇa kha/ /༅kharta na ṇa kho ca zan mi sprirkyu ḍa rkang zhe thang zan ba skya lha lnga ḍa kya chu ṇa kha ṇa tshi khyaṭhaḍa/ / za tshikha lha r+ṣa ༅r+ṇa ḍa/ /ba khyab kha thu ra ṭha kha ṭi ḍi ḍarta ba ༅tse khe cha khya kha che cha khri bla/ kha chaṣā ṇa skye ba ṭhaṭha sil ṭha rdzo ye zan pe/ / za kha /spro ra khyu ra ṭha stong chu khaṇ+ḍa ṇa ḍarta/ /chu zhe/ ka khang ṭha khaṣ+ṭha che ṭha ṇa za ya kau ṭhaṭha ṇa chub chub za khrung cho yu/ /ḍi ḍa skyu tha khya cho kha ṭha ṇ+ḍi 'o/ /cho ṭha kya 〉ṇa kha yo ra to sheg/ /༅stong ṭā kha ṭi ༅ya ṭha kha sti zaṭhaḍa (lo khyaṭhaḍa ṇa tshi ༅tshi kha thu kha ṭi ṇa khya tse za'i ra bya tha kha'i ṭhaṭha ṭhaho/ /༅skyo kha myo ṇa yu ḍa yo ḍi yo ṇa khoṭha ṭha ṭhaḍa ṇa ༅ban+t+ra spre'u ba rak+ṣa ༅ṇa kha bab ma bo kyi za : ba ṭha cha r+ṇa kha ya a/ /mi chetra ḍa myo ༅ṭhaṭha nga kha she ra ni rta yi ṭha ṭhaḍa cho za ḍa ṭhaṭha ༅skyo tshi ༅khyaḍa ya ḍi/ /ṣ+ṭi chu ṇ+ḍa ca cho tshi ṭo ༅ṇa kha ba ṭha kha ḍa zaṭha lo rje ṭā ṇa ṣa chu khyo ༅za chu ṇa bye ca ṇa yi/ khaḍa kha thu kha deb ṇa khya ṭha ṇa ṇ+ḍa ba ṇa ba khyu ṭhaṭha ༅skye kha myo ṇa yu ḍa yo ḍi/ /khri kha baṭha—8—

'tshal/ /skye ba dang ni 'jig pa dang bral mchog gi lus can ma/ /dmar ba'i 'od chags rnam par rgyal ma khams gsum gzugs can ma/ /yon tan tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i sku mnga' rdo rje'i yan lag ma/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bskyed mdzad ma la rtag tu mngon par phyag bgyi'o/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo bsgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum brnyes/ /'gro ba skyob la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya bar rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la rtag phyag 'tshal/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /rnam par rtog med yang dag rtog /yid ni rab tu mi gnas pa/ /yid la med cing dmigs pa med/ /dmigs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skabs 'dir ar+gha sogs mchod pa dang / rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa lta bu mchod bstod bsdus pa zhig byas/ dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu dbyangs bya ste/ spro na/ spel mar sbyar ba bdag gi zur du bkod pa bzhin dang / bsdu na/ rgyud tshig kho na bya ste/ hu khro bo bde ba dgyes pa yi/ /bde ba'i longs spyod las byung ba/ /bde ba dbab pa'i sbyor ba yis/ /rab tu rmongs pas sten par byed/ /a la la la la ho/a i ā ā ra li ho/ bde chen bde ba'i gar gyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma mchog pad+ma'i bde/ /a la la la la ho/ dgyes pa rnams kyis bde ba mchog /rnal 'byor ma mchog mchod par mdzod/ /a i ā ā ra li ho/ rab dgyes mgon po khyod bzhugs mdzod/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde ba stsol/ /dgyes ma'i bde ba gsol bar mdzod/ /zhi ba'i gar gyi gar mdzad pa/ /bdag la bde chen bde ba —9—

stsole/ /thar ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa khyod/ /a la la la la ho/ a i ā ā ra li ho/ bde ba spangs pas grol mi 'gyur/ /bde med sdug bsngal gyis mi grol/ /bde de chu skyes dbus na gnas/ /chags pa'i dngos por khyod ma gyur/ /bde ba che yis grol bar mdzod/ /pad+ma dgyes pa'i ro nyid kyis/ /bung ba lta bur tshim par mdzod/ /de yis mgon po bskul na ni/ /dkyil 'khor du ni nges par 'grub/ /snyan zhing 'jebs pa'i dbyangs kyis ni/ /dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glu blangs pas/ /dri med mkha' 'gro dra ba yi/ /gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ zhes gsol ba btab pas mnyes nas dngos su mchod pa bdag gir mdzad par bsams la lnga pa mchod pa dngos ni/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od 'phros/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma gsang sngags grub pa rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs dang mchod par 'os pa thams cad badz+ra sa mā dzaX su lhas bsangs/ swa bhas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du huX zhu ba las mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas rol mo rnams rang bzhin bde stong / rnam pa mchod rdzas 'byams klas par ga gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā sogs/ snying ga nas mchod pa'i lha mo nam mkha' gang ba spros nas mchod/ sdom ni/ 1 chu dang 2nyer spyod 3 gnyis dang 4'dod yon 5gnyis/ /6rin chen 7nye ba'i rin chen 8bkra shis rtags/ /9sgeg sogs 10rig ma 11bla med 12na bza' 13zas/ /14maṇ+ḍal 15khrus dang 16nyer mkho 17nang dang 18gsang / /19de nyid 20bstod pa 21rgyun bshags 22sdom bzung dang / /23lag mchod ces bya mchod pa nyer gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ mchod yon phal cher sogs dang / rab 'byams rgya mtsho —10—

sogs sam/ yang na 'di ltar/ rnam dag yid 'ong lha yi rdzas/ /yan lag bdun ldan a rgyu'i rgyun/ /mchog tu dad pas bdag 'bul na/ /ci bde bar yang bzhes su gsol/ oṃ u hri pra wa ra sa t+pa ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ rnam dag yid 'ong ngu zhabs kyi pad+ma'i rnyogs sel spos kyi chu/ mchog tu sogs/ o lha yi me tog shin tu 'bar/ /dri zhim shin tu mdzes pa yi/ /me tog de ring bzhes nas su/ /'di la byin gyis brlabs tu gsol/ /oṃ gu ru shrī he ru ka maṇ+ḍa le khyu pukhre pra titsā hū/ o tsan+dan ga bur sbyar ba yi/ /dri zhim bdug spos dge ba yi/ /mthu dang ldan par bya ba 'di/ /bzhes nas byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ dhu pe/ o mar me 'od zer 'bar ba 'di/ /ngan 'gro'i 'jigs pa 'joms par byed/ /lha yi mig 'byed bkra shis pa/ /mar me khyed kyi bzhes su gsol/ ā lo ke o sna tshogs lha yi dri zhim pa/ /sna tshogs ga pur sogs brgyan pa/ /sna tshogs yi ge hū las byung / /dri 'di 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol/ ga rnye/ kha dog dri dang ror ldan pa'i/ /bza' ba mchog dang yang dag ldan/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bshos 'di dag /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ nai wi du/ pa ṭa ha dang cang te'u sogs/ /dung dang rnga sogs sgra dbyangs dang / /yid 'phrog sil snyan sna tshogs pa/ /'bul gyi yang dag bzhes su gsol/ sha lta/ dkyil 'khor kun tu rgyal ba mnyes byed pa/ /mdzes ldan dkar mo rdo rje dril bu dang / /me tog sbungs pa'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /oṃ badz+ra puspro ā hu/ tshig thog mtha' gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' 'gre yid 'ong dud ka rdo rje dril bu dang / /bdug spos 'thul ba'i rin chen snod 'dzin ma/ dhu pe/ kun snang dmar —11—

ser: mar mes gang ba'i: ā lo ke gdung sel ljang khu: dri mchog byug pa'i:ga rnye/ zhal zas sna tshogs: bdud rtsis gang ba'i: nai li du: chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /srid pa'i mtsho las rnam par rgyal/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bur ni/ /sems can kun la bstan par bgyi/ /o ā badz+ra ā da rnye hu/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yis/ /gang gis 'jig rten thams cad du/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bgyi/lī ni/ gang gi sangs rgyas zhing kun dang / /'jig rten pa yi khams kun du/ /bla med bsam mi khyab pa'i dri/ /rang gi lus la spro bar bya/ ga rnye/ gang gis sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /srog chags gyur pa thams cad la/ /lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni spyin par bya/ /rwa sa/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun dang yang / /byang chub sems dpa' sogs kun la/ /yang dag sbyor ba reg bya'i bde/ /nges par sbyar ba bya ba yin/ sparnye/ rgyal ba rnams kyi 'dod 'byung lha mo'i tshul/ /gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bde ster ma/ /me long pi wang skros khang bza' btung snod/ /ras phran bzang dang pad+ma bhañdza na/ /cang te'i sgra sgrogs kha khyu la brten ma/ /dkar sngo ser dang dmar dang ljang ba'i gzugs/ /gzugs mdzes dbyangs snyan dri ldan bcud ldan dang / /bde ldan lang tshos dregs pa'i smin legs ma/ /nam mkha' gang bas dkyil 'khore lha tshogs mchod/ pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa: 'dod yon gyi tshigs bcad/ kha dog dbyibs legs sogs kyang bya'o/ /dri med dzam+bu chu bo'i gser bzang las/ /bsod nams bzo bos mchog tu rnam 'phrul ba/ /lha mi'i mdzes pa kun las phul byung zhing / /blta bas mi ngom rdzu 'phrul —12—

shugs nyid las/ /rang byung rtsibs stong ta la bdun srid du/ /byung tshe phyogs las rgyal ba mchog thob pa/ /'khor lo rin chen dam pa 'di 'bul bas/ /rgyal byed dran pa'i 'khor lo thob par shog /o sa du ru shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī nā tsakra rat+na pra tisnro hū swāhā/ chu zheng phun tshogs thal kar zla 'od can/ /mche ba drug ldan dul ba'i spyod pas mdzes/ /sngon chad legs par byas pa'i mthu nyid las/ /rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis mkha' la rab 'gro zhing / /mkha' lding sa srungs bu ltar mgyogs pa yis/ /sa chen rgya mtsho 'khor bcas kun tu bskor/ /glang po rin chen phul bas mtshan ma rnams/ /'joms byed shes rab glang po thob par shog /hasti rat+na/ rab mdzes rma bya'i mgrin 'dra'i sbu sdug can/ /yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'dod pa yi/ /don kun rdzogs par sgrub byed nam mkha'i lam/ /gus par spyod pa gser gyi rgyal mtshan can/ /cang shes rlung las rgyal ba sprin gyi shugs/ /yid ltar mgyog pa'i rta mchog 'di phul bas/ /ma lus chos la mngon shes bgrod pa can/ /brtson 'grus bzhon pa mchog gi 'gro bar shog /a shwa rat+na/ kun tu sngo ba mtshungs med bi rje r+ya/ /legs par sbyangs pa'i rin chen cha brgyad pa/ /byed po med cing phun tshogs 'od zer gyis/ /me dang nyi ma'i 'od kyang rnam par gnon/ /dga' mgur 'gro shing dgos pa mchog ster la/ /'khor kun khyab pa'i 'od zer dpag yas can/ /bsam pa rdzogs byed nor bu 'di 'bul bas/ /chos kyi snang ba'i dga' bas tshim par shog /ma ṇi rat+na/ dga' tshal lha yi bu mo'i gzugs mdzes can/ /'dul ba'i cho ga phun tshogs bstan bcos dang / /bzo dang snyan —13—

ngag sgyu rtsal kun shes shing / /'dzum zhing snyan par smra mkhas mtshungs pa'i gzugs/ /reg pa mchog ldan lus sems bde ba'i rgyu/ /ha cang che chung gzugs min dri bzang ster/ /phul bas sgrib pa kun las rnam thar ba'i/ khen tu sbyangs pa'i bde ba'i 'tsho bar shog /sdi rat+na/ lag na rdo rje sred med bu yi stobs/ /'jam shing yid 'ong snyan pa'i tshig kyang 'byin/ /'dzangs shing gsal la yid gzhung lha mig ldan/ khor yug gter gyi bdag po'i don kun byed/ /byams dang snying rje mnga' ba dge ba'i bdag /'dod dgur 'dzud pa'i mi mchog 'di phul bas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs don/ /kun 'byor ting 'dzin mchog la dbang thob shog /kṛ skra ti rat+na/dpa' zhing brtul phod yan lag mchog gi gzugs/ /pha rol dpung 'joms mi mthun med byed pa/ /sngar ldang bsam pa dge zhing lta bas go /ma smad rgyas shing rdzogs pa'i legs byas can/ /'dod dgur 'gro ba'i blon po rin chen 'di/ /phul bas ji lta ji snyed chos rnams la/ /rnam par mi rtog ye shes dam pa yis/ /rtsol med gnas pa'i btang snyoms thob par shog pu ru ṣa rat+na/ de i mi nus na/ lha rdzas las grub sogs sam/ bde bar gshe/gas pa sogs bya/ ral gri lpags pa skyed tshal khang khyim dang / /gzims cha gos dang mchil lham rin po che/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor ra lha tshogs bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ khan twa ka ba na kṛ ha sha sa su bsta mo tsa u parat+na pad+ma can dkar dpal be'u 'dzin/ /'jigs byed ma dkar 'khor lo bsnams/ /'od ldan sngon mo pad+ma thogs/ /rnam rgyal ma sngon rgyal mtshan —14—

can/ /mdangs ldan dmar mo gdugs dkar 'dzin/ /dkar sham dmar skya gter gyi bum/ /dri med ljang khu dung dkar bsnams/ /yid gzhung ljang khu gser nya thogs/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad po yis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma mchod par bgyi/ /bde legs phun tshogs stsal nas kyang / /kun tu zhi zhing dge gyur ciga'adir spro na/ deng nas brtsam ste rdzogs sangs/ rgyas/ sogs/ sgegs sogs brgyad dang /gdan bzhi las 'byung mchod pa nyi shu dang sgyu ma bde mchog gi lha mo nyi shu'i mchod pa bya ste shin tu legs so/ /'dir ni re zhig bldan go/ rang gi snying ga nas ā li bcu drug spros/ lha mo bcu drug tu gyur/ oX swe ni badz+re ṇi hūX aX rdo rje lha mo pi waX ma/ sogs sam/ mthon mthing lang tshos dregs pa'i yid 'phrog ma/ sogs gang wo bya/ de tsam mi nus na/ bde mchog sgyu ma'i longs spyod rdzogs gsal ba/ /pi waX gling bur rnga zlum rdza rnga can/ /rgod dang sgeg dang glu len bro gar mkhan/ /me tog bdug pa snang gsal dri mchog ma/ /gzugs ma ro ma reg ma chos 'byung ma/ /bcu drug dga' ba'i cha shas yongs rdzogs ma/ /rdo rje rig ma dga' ba'i rol pa 'dis/ /he ru ka khyod rdo rje yid dges mdzod/ lkoX lī ni badz+re ṇi huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ oX waX se badz+re ṇi huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhi du/ mri taX gi mu ra dze ha se lā se gī ti nirti purmye rnyu pe dī peg rnye ra sa sparnye dharmā dh+wa tu/ 'di dag rgyas pa la dga' na kho bos zur du dgod par bya'o/ khen tu yi 0 ni tshigs bcad med kyang chog go/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs/ /rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan/ /sems can gdung ba tshim byed pa'i/ /sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang / /mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la/ /rin chen me tog la sogs char/ /rgyun —15—

mi chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas/ /rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa/ /de bzhin bdag gi de bzhin gshegs/ /mgon po sras dang bcas pa mchod/ /yon tan rgya mtsho khyed rnams la/ /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod/ /bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag las/ /nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig oṃ las byung ba'i gos zung chos kyi dbyings kyi rab 'byams mtha' klas par gyur/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu/ sogs/ mgon khyod bkres skyems mi mnga' yang / /'o thug bur khu bdud rtsi'i chu/ /bza' dang bca' ba rgya chen po/ kha dog dri dang ro ldan pa/ /thams cad sbyar ba'i bgos kyi mchog /kun bzang bde chen bzhes su gsol/ a kā ro/ sogs/ maṇ+ḍal rgyas pa 'bul ba dang bsdus pa lan mang du bya/ ri mchog gser gyi ri dang rol mtsho rgya ldan khor yug bcas/ /gling rnams lha dang mi yi 'byor pa kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gzugs mdzes yan lag mchog ldan zag med bde ster lha mos spras/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rnam dag zhing du yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ ji ltar ltams pa sogs kyi khrus gsol/ sku phyis dang / dri dang na bza' 'bul ba ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang / /reg na bde ba lha yis gos/ /mkha' lding khyu mchog rma bya dang / /glang po rta sogs theg pa'i mchog /dgos 'dod 'byung ba 'dod 'jo'i ba/ /ma rmos zhabrungs pa'i lo thog dang / /dpag bsam shing dang 'bras bu'i tshogs/ /bum bzang nam mkha' gang bas mchod/ /bdag gis lus dang longs spyod dang / /dus gsum dge ba kun yang 'bul/ /gser dngul mu tig lbu rje r+ya/ /rin chen zhing rnams bkang nas 'bul/ /dbang sngon rdo rje pad+ma dmar/ /ma rkata byu ru dzaskru'i gser/ /zla shel —16—

rin chen bdun gyi ri/ /zhing gi rdul snyed dbul bar bgyi/ /ut+pal pad+ma kha dog lnga/ /dzā ti kha dog rnam pa gsum/ /me tog kaṇ+ḍi ka ra dang / /mā li ka dang yu thig ka /me tog kā ra bī ra yang / /bsam gtan stobs kyis khyed la 'bul/ /mi 'jigs seng ge rin chen khri/ /pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan mchog dang / /rna rgyan dang ni gdub bu dang / /mgul rgyan sor gdub dam pa dang / /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /dbu rgyan dar dpyangs do shal bcas/ /rgyal mtshan dmar dang de bzhin ser/ /dkar dang nag dang ser skya dang / /de bzhin gos ni sna tshogs dang / /me tog phreng ba du ma dang / /bla bre dag dang dar dpyangs pa'i/ /mda' dang yol bas shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin bza' bya btung ba yis/ /rab mnyam bzhag pas mchod par bya/ /gser ni brgya stong du ma dang / /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /ras ni zung gyur brgya nyid dang / /glang po rta dang yul 'khor dang / /chung ma bzang dang bu mo nyid/ /bran pho bran mo sring mo dang / /blo ldan kun nas dang ba yis/ /bdag nyid kyang ni dbul bar bgyi/o badz+ra u pa s+tha na nir+ya tu mi/ de nas nang mchod sngar bzhi byin bas bya/ bla ma dang dkyil gyi 'khor lo rab 'byams kyi chos bdud rtsi bde ba chen pos mnyes par gyur cig o ā hu/ bdud rtsi lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /dngos grub kun gyi de nyid mchog /sgron ma lnga yi bza' ba ni/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig gtso/ /nyes bral zhi ba'i btung ba mchog /sbrang rtsi bu ram 'bru dang shing / /bcos pa'i myos byed rnam pa lnga/ khres rab rang bzhin dbul bar bgyi/ o ā hū/ o sarba badz+ra gwa mi ni sarba bha k+ṣa shodha ya gu phya badz+re ṇi hū/ rang gi snying ga —17—

nas rig ma'i tshogs spros te/ bde stong gis mchod par gyur/ sa khams dag pa'i dpa' mo che/ /ltung byed rdo rje sangs rgyas spyan/ /rtag pa'i sangs rgyas shes rab yum/ /gti mug dga' mas dges par mdzod/ oṃ ā mo ha ra ti hū/ chu khams: gsod byed/ mā ma gī rdo rje nyi ma'i zhe sdang dga' mas/ dre ṣa ra ti me khams: 'gugs byed gos dkar mo/ pad+ma gar gyi 'dod chags dga' mas/rā ga ra ti/ rlung khams: gar dbang sgrol ma ste/ rta yi rgyal po'i/ rdo rje dga' mas/ badz+ra ra ti/ mkha' dbyings pad can dbyings phyug ma khrag 'thung rdo rje/ rdo rje sems mas: oṃ ā satwa badzi ṇi hū/ rig lnga las byung phyag rgya mchog /gar ma chos ma rdo rje ma/ /gdol ma de bzhin bram ze mo/ /lhan skyes gnas skyes rigs skyes dang / /mthar skyes ma yis mchod par bgyi/ /go rī la sogs lha mo brgyad/ khwa gdong ma sogs ma mo'i tshogs/ /gzugs can ma dang tsu zhi ka /lā ma yongs gyur byis bcas mo/ /mi ldog e hi ka lha mo/ /mkha' 'gro ma rnams bdun gyis mchod/ /rdo rje pad+ma byin brlab nas/ /snyoms 'jug 'pho med bde chen thob/ /rang bzhin snang ba yongs dag pa/ /zhu bdes khams gsum kun khyab pa/ /gsang ba'i ma sna te pas mnyes par bgyi/ o hri ha ha hū hū phaṭa/ lan bdun/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swabha shwat+pa ko3ha/ yang dag dga' ba'i me tog gis/ /rdo rje nyi ma pad+ma ra phyung / /me tog bdag nyid la mchod pa/ /rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid mchog /rnam rtog tshogs kyi yul min zhing / /lte bar gtum mo 'bar ba yis/ /nges par sregs pa de yi spos/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la ni dbul/ /yi ge hū las yang dag byung / /sngags kyi 'od zer shin tu —18—

gsal/ /mar me 'bar ba'i yang dag 'od/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya//bde chen po'i nam mkhar gnas/ /byang chub sems ni sad pa dang / /de nyid kyis kyang byugs pa ni/ /thugs kyi rdo rje la dbul bya/ /'dir ni gang dag gang longs spyod/ /dbang po thams cad yang dag bsten/ /de dag thams cad thugs rdo rje/ /bza' ba'i mchod pas mchod par bya/ /'gog pa'i rdo rjer zhugs pa'i sems/ /rang nyams dpyid kyi dpa' bo glu/ /gzhom med na da'i sgra dbyangs kyis/ /thugs kyi rdo rje mchod par bgyi/ /sngags ni spyi dang 'dra'o/ /bstod pa ni spro wo long yod na/ rgyun chags dang / sgyu 'phru/la spyin pa la sogs pa bya/ de tsam mi shes na/ bskal pa'i me 'bar sogs sam/ rgyal ba sprul pa sogs dang / mtshan brgya bya/ de yang mi nus na/ rkang brgyad/ rkang brgyad gnyis dang rol mo dkrol ba'am yang na dril bu tsam dkrol/ tho/ gang gi drin gyis sogs dang / dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / sogs bya/ chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma g.yos kyang / /thabs kyi khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul/ /che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa/ /kun bzang khrag 'thung bla mar phyag 'tshal lo/ /bdag med dbang phyug sku dang dbyer med cing / /bde chen 'od gsal dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas la sogs sprin spro ba/ /rdo rje phag mo'i sku la: dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku/ /'khor 'das stong par mdzad pa'i thugs rje can/ /gdul bya kun mkhyen sa la 'god mdzad pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la: /nam mkha' lta bur thams cad thogs med cing / /'dod dgur bsgyur ba'i rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /thugs dam dbang gis sgrub la rtser dgongs pa'i/ /gnas gsum mkha' 19—

'gro'i tshogs la /nyon mongs rnam dag ye shes sku brnyes te/ /srid pa'i snyen ra lo ma lus bcad pa'i phyir/ /thabs mkhas thugs rjes 'gro ba 'dren mdzad pa'i/ /rgyal gnyis rdo rje'i rdzos kyi pa khror 'dud/ /de nas bla ma spyi dang sgos kyi bstod pa rnams 'di la dril bu sogs mi byed/ ci rigs par bya'o/ /de nas yan lag bdun pa ni shes na bhu ba ri pa'i rgyun bshags bya/ de mi shes na dwa ri ka'i rgyun bshags sam/ yang na 'di ltar/ tseX( āXdapal ldan rdo rje bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi pad mo yang dag pa'i ye shes gsal bar byed pa de la phyag 'tshal lo/ /huX/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /bla ma sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal/ /skyob pa cho se la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dge 'dun rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyag 'os sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rgyal bas gsung ba'i chos rnams dang / /tshul khrims bzang ldan dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /byas dang byed du bcug dang yid rangs pa'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun 'jig byed pa'i/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa blang bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyi dge ba gang mdzad pa/ /de dag kun la yang dag yid rangs shing / /byang chub tu ni yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyi bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems skyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ /bdag gi dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa myur thob shog/bsdu na de tsam bya/ spro na/ skye ṣ+ka skye ba sogs—20—

kyang gdon no/ /de nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas sogs dang / spro na/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la sogs dang / nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ sogs kyang bya/bsdu na rigs lnga'i sdom par ma 'dus pa med do/ /bsangs sbyangs/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang lag mthil gyi sna tshogs pad+ma'i 'dab ma gnyis par zla ba/ sor mo dang sen mo rnams dang 'dab ma gzhan dang nye bar nyi ma/ lkoX āXhūX/ bcu gnyis/ oX ha na ma hi sogs dang / oṃ baX haX yoX sogs/rdo rje sems dpa' rnam snang mdzad/ /pad+ma gar dbang he ru ka /rdo rje nyi ma rta mchog dang / /rdo rje phag mo shin rje ma/ /rmongs byed sbyong byed skrag byed ma/ /chu ka yi ngo bor gnas/ spro/ mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs thams cad las lha tshogs gnyis pa rnams lag pa'i mkhrig mar byon ste dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ huX baX maX taX paX laX puX dzaX oX aX goX raX do maX kaX eX ༷/ koX kaX laX kaX hi/ pre gro sau suX naX saX maX kuX huX/ brgyad brjod/ lag pa'i sa'i khams la ni lhung byed ma'o/ /sogs dra ba can no/ /de nas/ oX ha sogs dang hūX baX sogs kyi mthar/ tseX( āXhūX zhes dang por nang mchod/ de nas khu ba'i rdzas gzhan/ de nas gong bu'i rdzas/ mthar me tog 'bul te/ oX baX/ sogs dang / hūX baX/ sogs kyi mthar/ tseX( badz+ra pukhrel titsā swāhā/ zhes so/ /ar+ghaX sogs dang / lī ni badz+re sogs dang / rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa brjod/ ma 'byo ra ba dang sogs/ oX yo ga shudha sogs/ oṃ āXhuX/ oX āXhuX/ de nas mdun bskyed bla ma he ru ka la me tog dbul te/ oX mchog tu bde ba'i sems ni rol par ldan/ /sgeg pa'i phyag gis bcom ldan 'das la 'dud/ dzaXhuX baX hoXrab tu grub par mdzod/ /mgon po snyim pa'i me tog bzhes shig ho/ oX shri badz+ra hai he sogs la/ sngags re re'i mthar/ tsho( āXhūX/ put+paXr+sha pra titsā na maX zhes pa btags so/ /drug pa ni/—21—

bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlung nas/ bdud rtsi lnga'i bar gong bzhi/rlung g.yos me sbar/ rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol/ nyi ma 'char ka'i kha dog ltar gyur pa'i rlangs pa las grub pa huX las kha ṭāX ga huX gis mtshan pa mgo bo thur du blta ba bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin la bdud rtsi babs/ de nyid zhu ste 'dres/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ oṃ a ā nas/ k+ṣa huX hūX phaṭa swāhā yongs su gyur pas/ oṃ dkar po/ ā dmar po/ hū ཾ ༷ sngon po/ de'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs te yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ de rnams bdud rtsir zhu ste gtor ma la thim pas kha dog dang dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs par gyur/ oX āXhūX ha ho hriX h+pha/ oX badz+ra ā ra snyi ho dzaXhūX baX hoXs ma ya staX dri khyo ho/lan lnga/ ar+ghaX sogs dang rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/ khyod kyi dngos po mtha' dag nam mkha' dang ni 'dra bar gzigs/ /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rlan sems la ni/ /mdzod cig ma ljadi cig lha mo bdag la dges par mdzode/ oṃ kha kha sogs dang / oṃ ḍā ki ni ar+ghaX sogs/ gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du oṃ āXhuX/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / sogs sam/ oṃ 'jig rten kun gtso mnga' mdzad pa'i/ /'jigs byed drag po stobs ldan pa/ /bde gshegs sras sogs bran mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems dpa' snying rje can/ /dbang phyug chen po chung mar bcas/ /de bzhin khyab 'jug tshangs pa dang / /brgya byin 'dod dga' chung mar bcas//lha chen 'khor bcas tshogs rnams dang / /phyogs skyong brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /mkha' 'gro drag mo bsus —22—

'dzin ma/ /dur khrod ma mo'i tshogs dang bcas/ /gzhan yang lha srin sde brgyad dang / /'gro ba drug po 'khor bcas rnams/ /lus ngag yid gsum sbyangs byas nas/ /rang gi lha yi gzugs 'dzin rnams/ /gnas 'dir 'dus pa'i dam tshig can/ /mchod gtor rgyan dang bcas pa bzhes/ /dam tshig srungs shig dam tshig can/ /las la brtson pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams/ /rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i grogs ma ljadi cig /las mdzad rdo rje bran bcas pas/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las sgrub cing / /theg chen gsang sngags bsrung ba dang / /nad dang gdon sogs zhi ba dang / /tshe dbang bkra shis 'phel ba dang / /dge legs 'bras bu grub par mdzod/ 'dir ni lag mchod gtor chog shin tu bsdus pa ste/ rgyas 'bring gzhan du btsal bar bya'o/ /sgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma gtong na'ang / 'dir gtong bzlas pa'ang skabs 'dir bya ste/ thun mongs ma yin pa'i gnad zhal las shes so/ /bdun pa ni/ chos 'di nyid kyi rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma'i bstod pa dang / gsol 'debs rnams bya/ sngar bzhin dpyid kyi rgyal po'i glus gsol ba btab/ maṇ+ḍal phul te/dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la dbang bskur ba zhu ba'i yon du dbul bar bgyi'o//sogs bya/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs gsum/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ lan gsum/rdo rje 'di nyid rdo rje sems dpa' zhes pa dang / hi hi hi hu phaṭa/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyem tshul bdag po'i bdag /o badz+ra ga rnye ra ṇi nas/ a kha swāhā/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi dag /ngo bo spyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' —23—

chog /srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ /dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba spyin par bya/ oX badz+ra u da ka a bhi khiñtsa huX su ra ta staX ā haX/ dbang bskur te spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung shig rdo rje byin gyis rlobs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/oX su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rdul phra rab tu gyur pa lhan cig skyes pa brtan pa'i mthar bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /byang chub sems ni bzang po yis/ /de ring bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ oX āXhuX/ ye shes las sprul pa'i rig ma'i lha mo bdag la gnang / lha mo dga' sbyin gnas spyin ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ /khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ oṃ shī shī shi ta ha ha ha swāhā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā ut+pa ko3haX/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / rdo rje snying po nam mkha' mtshungs/ /rdul bral thar spyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste/ /phyi rol yul ni sdangs pa'o/ /rig 'di bor nas 'di las ni/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyi sangs rgyas med/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu/ /brtul zhugs kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ /der cung zad mkho par bzhug—24—

deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi 'drar sems can thams cad kyi/ /don ni bdag nyid kun gyis kyai/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ lan gsum/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ sogs bya/ gal te tshogs kyi bya ba dang 'brel na/ skabs 'dir tshogs mchod bzhin bya ste/ lhag gtor rdzogs kyi bar du btang ngo / /gsum pa rjes la/ sngar bzhin mchod pa byin rlabs dang / sngar ye shes pa'i mchod pa bzhin mchod pa bya/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ he ru ka'i yig brgya mang du brjod/ bdag ni mi shes nas/ bdag skyabs mchi/ ma 'byor pa dang: lhag ma dang ni sogs/ tshul khrims —tsan+dan gyis lus byugs/ /bsam gtan gyi ni gos dag gyon/ /byang chub yan lag me tog bkram/ /ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ /so so'i skye bor gyur gang dang / /rnal 'byor ma thob dbang gis dang / /nye bar mkho ba ma yin dang / /brjed ngad shes bzhin ma yin pas/ /cung zad cho ga nyer ma tshang de dag bkru zhing bzod mdzad rigs/ /cho ga'i bya ba ma tshang ba/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang lha rnams dang / /de sras rnams dang tshangs la sogs/ /'jig rten skyong rnams bzod mdzad rigs/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing / /'du dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ lha mo tshad ma sogs/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa: sogs rnam lnga 'dod skor dang 'byud rgya bya/ yo ga skospri snye sogs/ ga tsā ga tsā swa bhā wa na/ badz+ra mudakyil 'khor la reg gtor mgron rnams gshegs/ dpal ldan bla ma dam —25—

pas bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma rang gi spyi bor byon 'od du zhu/ dpral ba yan chad gang / bum dbang thob/ mgrin pa yan chad gang / gsang dbang thob/ snying ga yan chad gang / shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ lus thams cad gang / dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma'i bag chags thams cad sbyangs/ bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang / rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med mnyam pa nyid la 'jog rang he ru kar gsal ba'i gnas rnams su/ oṃ oṃ ha sogs/ yum gyi gnas rnams su/ oṃ oṃ baX sogs/ra ḍā gnyis kyis ma sgos rngam bya/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sogs/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig dran rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i cho 'phrul du rnam par dag go/bdag gis dus gsum dge bze sogs/ skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du nas/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig la gnas shog rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang nas/ mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su 'khrid par shog shes shing spro na/'khor lo ma lus 'dren pa'i dpal du shog /gi bar yang bya/ gal te tshogs snyen ra dang 'brel ba dang / yon bdag yod na/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang / dpa' bo rnams la bza' dang bco ba khyod kyis drangs/ khyod la rtag tu bsrung ba mchog gi spyor ba dang / yang na/ yid la 'dod pa phun sum tshogs par shog ces pa'ang bya'o/ sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med cing / gang gi lam nas grol ba yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid du grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug —26—

lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par shog /srid pa gsum 'bar sku sogs dang / /bde ba phun tshogs yang dag ldan/ /nad med dge ba'i sems dang ni/ /'dod dang thar sogs yang dag thob/ /phun sum tshogs pa 'grub gyur cig de nas/ dpa' bo gnyis med mchod pas skye ba 'di la ni/ /sgrib pa zad dang phyag rgya'i dngos grub 'gyur bar shog /skye ba kun tu mchog tu bde bar gshegs pa yi/ /grub pa'i 'jig rten dbus su 'gro ba nyid gyur cig /zhing dad nye ba'i zhing sogs bcu gnyis su/ /dam tshig brda dang bde spyod rol ba yis/ /bu bzhin dgongs pas bdag sgrib dag gyur te/ /bde ba mchog gi sa la 'god par shog /bla ma'i zhabs la rtag tu 'dud byed cing / /rdo rje dbang mo'i zhabs dran gyur nas kyang / /btsun mo'i shu kra'i tshogs la rtag spyod cing / /gsang ba'i pa khror rol zhing mchod byed shog /dpal ldan dpa' bo dpa' mo nyi shu bzhi'i/ /zhal mthong de yi ngo bor bdag gyur te/ /'gro ba bde ba dam pas 'phongs rnams kyi/ /nyer 'tsho rin chen lta bur bdag gyur cig /rnam pa mang po'i bsod nams 'di dag kyang / /bdag gzhan dge ba mchog ni bskyed pa'i gzhi/ /de nyid gsal byed rmongs pa rab 'joms pa/ /'gro la mi 'jigs ster ba'i mnga' bdag shog /rnam par rtog pa kun las 'das pa yi/ /bde chen 'khor lo zag pa med pa'i dbyings/ /ā li kā li rtog med snyoms 'jug mar/ /bsags pa'i dge rnams yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gi bsod nams 'di yis yang yang skye ba'i rim pa rnams su yang / /yun ring 'gro ba'i don bsgrub don la 'jigs pa med par dga' ba dang / /gtso bo sku yi 'od zer —27—

nam mkha' khyab par 'gro bas dbang bskur ba/ /srid gsum rdo rje rol par lhan cig de yi go 'phang thob par shog /rnam rtog gti mug grong khyer mtha' dag bsal nas he ru ka gtso mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /'khor los yongs bskor rgyal ba bla med ye shes 'byung gnas thar pa dam pa'i grong / /sbyin pa la sogs rnams kyis 'gro ba'i yid la re ba yang dag rdzogs pa'i mchog /'dir ni shin tu brtse ba che ldan 'phags pa'i dpal 'byor rtag par myong bar shog /de nas bkra shis ni bla ma'i rim pa rnams kyang spro na bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i bkra shis dang / bdag gis kyang 'bri bar 'gyur bas de ltar yang bya la/ de tsam mi nus na/rgyal mtshan rtse mo1 sogs dang / phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba: sogs ci rigs byas la/mthar/ nyin mo bde legs: sogs/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis deng 'dir stsol/ de bzhi du 'don pa spros la/ dam chos tshogs kyis: dge 'dun rnams kyis: mes po yis kyang: dbang po yis kyang: 'jig rten skyong bas: dkar phyogs skyong bas deng 'dir stsole// zhes bya'o/ /gang ltar bkra shis dang smon lam yang rgyal ba'i bka' las byung ba zhig gis thog drangs nas byin chags par bya'o/ /yi dam sgrub mchod las gzhan du bla ma dang / bla ma mchod pa las gzhan du yi dam mchod par sems na gnad las gol bar 'gyur ba'i phyir bla ma dang lhan cig tu shes pas mchod do/ /'di ltar nyams su blangs pas bla ma'i bsgrub par 'gyur ba dang / pho nya lhan cig skyes grub ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste/ /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa yi ni dngos grub bya/ zhes gsungs te/ bde mchog gi rgyud/ gzhung mnyam pa'am mthong bas lhag par yid ches dang ngo mtshar skye'o/ /slob dpon ston pa rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /mchod pa'i cho ga yi ger bris pa las/ /dpag yas bsod nams thob pa gang yin des/ /phan bdes sa dang bar snang gang bar shog /de ltar 'di ni —28—

'khor lo sdom pa'i rgyud thams cad dang rgya gzhung yid ches pa mang po dang / khyad par nā ro ta pa'i sras kyi thu bo pradz+nyā rak+ṣi ti'i gzhung gzhir byas/ da ri ka dang / a bha ya dang / mai tri pa/ shu bhā ka ra gup+ta sogs dang /bod kyi snga phyi'i bla ma mang po'i gsung gis brgyan/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / bla ma'i sgrub thabs thun mong ma yin pa dag gis gnad nas bzung ste/ rgyu mtshan yid ches can du bris/ de yang dang por/ sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan sgreng ba la lhod pa mi mnga' ba rin po che ka bzhi pas bde mchog gi bla mchod bsdus pa zhig gyis zhes bskul bas mchod brjod tsam 'phral du bris pa las/ gzhan du le los phyir shol ba la/ bar du yang dad ldan mang po bdag gis bskul ba dang / phyis bla ma'i bkas 'phral du bskul bas 'dus shing 'phyer bde bar thun gnyis la myur bar sbyar te/ tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum gyi dang por nag pa'i zla ba'i tshes bcu bdun la'o// ma ṅga la ku ru ban+tu shu bha ma stu sarba dzā ga ta/ zhus dag/ //—29—

bzhu / gas/na mo gu ru we badz+ra ā tsar+ya tsa ra ṇa na mo na ma/ rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa/ bla ma'i yon tan dran pa'i gsol 'debs ces bya ba/ bla ma dang dbyer med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo/ /lha dang bcas pa'i 'byung po kun gyis rab tu gus pas bshud nas gang gi zhabs sen spyi bos bsten/ /ye shes snang bas khams gsum thams cad dus rnams kun tu phyogs kyi 'khor lo gsal bar mdzad pa'i mgon/ /gnyis bral ris med mi 'gyur bde bas thugs rgyud gtams shing brtan g.yo srid zhi kun gyi rang bzhin mkhyen/ /rdo rje slob dpon stobs bcu mnga' ba yon tan rgya mtsho rigs kyi bdag por gus pas phyag 'tshal byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje rnam gsum dbyer med bde chen sku/ /kun tu chad med legs sbyar gzhom med gsung / /g.yo med lhun 'grub zung 'jug rdo rje'i thugs/ /rgyal dbang rdo rje 'chang la gsol ba 'debs/ /rgyal ba kun gyi zag med bde bskyed ma/ /spros bral mkha' la ye shes 'od stong shar/ /mtshan dpes rab spras dpag yas dkyil 'khor can/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor ma langurgyal ba sras bcas kun gyi sgra 'dzin dngos/ /rgyud dang mdo sde mtha' dag sdud pa'o/ /sa bcu'i dbang phyug rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag /phyag na rdo rje'i 'dzin la 'dod pa'i lha dang grub pas rjes bzung bas/ /snying po'i don —30—
