gzigs gdod ma'i mgon por gyur/ /grub brnyes kun gyi gtso bo zla med pa/ /sa ra ha pa'i zhabs la: spros bral rig pa'i rdo rjes mtha' gnyis bcom/ /rab dga' legs grub bde ba can du gshegs/ /dbang phyug brgyad kyi yon tan mchog brnyes pa/ /'phags pa klu sgrub zhabs la: de yis rjes bzung blo gros rin chen gyis/ /lung bstan rngon pa'i spyod pas 'gro ba 'dul/ /skye 'jig bral bas khyab bdag go 'phang brnyes/ /ri khrod dbang phyug zhabs la: mkha' 'gros dngos su byin rlabs dka' ba spyad/ /spros med spyod pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /rig 'dzin kun gyi gtso bo pū yi pa/ /kun tu dge ba'i zhabs la: 'khore ba'i gnas tshul mkhyen nas rgyal srid spangs/ /a wa dhu tware spyod pas don mchog grub/ khri dang drug stong snyen ra bcas mkha' la gshegs/ /dā ri ka pa'i zhabs la: gnas lnga rig pa'i mthar thug rgol ba 'joms/ /rim lnga'i lam las mgon khyod mngon byang chub/ /ngo mtshar cho 'phrul bstan pas 'gro kun tu/ /rdo rje dril bu pa la: in+d+ra bhu ti la k+ṣi la sogs pas/ /rjes su bzung nas tshe gcig grub pa brnyes/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rol pa mtha' yas ston/ /ka tsā li pa'i zhabs la nges med spyod pas zung 'jug chen po brnyes/ /dpag yas grub pa'i dbang pos khyod zhabs bsten/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yis tshogs kyis mgon/ /dza lan dā ra'i zhabs ting 'dzin brtan pas gzung 'dzin spros pa bcad/ /spros bcas spyod pas bdud dang mu stegs btul/ /rgyal ba'i lung bstan bar dor rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /nag po spyod pa'i zhabs la: rgyal srid mchil ma'i thal ba bzhin bor —31—

nas/ /rim gnyis bsgoms pas mchog gi dngos grub thob/ /mi srun gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro ma yang btul/ /grub chen gu phya pa la de yis zhabs bsten rgyud sde bzhi la mkhas/ /rim bzhin mthar phyin spyod pa gsum la slob/ /sdig spyod rgyal po 'dul mdzad rnam rgyal zhabs/ /bar ma'i slob dpon mchog la:gnyis snang sprin tshogs 'od gsal nam mkhar thim/ /rnam dag sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis/ /mtha' gnyis kun spang rig ngan tshul 'dzin pa/ /rje btsun ti snyi pa la: smra ba'i dbang phyug rig pa'i gnas kun mkhyen/ /bla ma dges phyir dka' ba dpag med spyad/ /las 'phro sad pas lhan skyes ye shes brnyes/ /na ro ta pa'i zhabs la: srog rlung dbu mar thim zhing rdzu 'phrul dang / /lta stangs thogs med grub pas gzhan don mdzod/ /gsang sngags 'dzin pa'i gtso bor kun gyis bkur/ /pha na thing gu pa la: he ru ka dpal mchog gis rjes su gzung / /mkhas pa'i phul phyin bde mchog smra ba yis/ /phyogs kun khyab mdzad jo bo su mā ti/ /bha ran+ta pa'i zhabs la: bla ma gus par bsten pas gdams ngag thob/ /brtson par bsgrub pas nus mthu mngon du gyur/ /lhag bsam rin chen mchog ldan shes rab brtsegs/ /klog skya lo rme re zhabs la: bsod nams mthu yis bla ma dam pa mjal/ /mos gus dbang gis chos kun ji bzhin mkhyen/ /skad gnyis smra ba mal gyo lo tsā ba/ /blo gros grags pa'i zhabs la:mkhyen rab 'gran zla bral ba'i chos kyi rje/ /'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dngos su byin gyis rlobs/ /bsam yas ting 'dzin brnyes pa'i sa skya ba/ /kun dga' snying po'i zhabs la sngon bsags bsod nams ye shes rgya che bas/ /rdo rje —32—

'dzin pa kun gyi rtse mor son/ /bde ba can gyi zhing du gshegs pa yi/ /bsod nams rtse mo'i zhabs la: phyogs 'dir sngags par grags pa kun gyi mchog /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan legs par 'dzin/ /mngon shes mthu stobs zad pa mi mnga' ba'i/ /rje btsun chen po'i zhabs la: gzhon nu'i dus nas 'jam dpal gnyis par grags/ /lha dang bla mas byin rlabs lung bstan thob/ /rig pa'i gnas lnga mkhyen pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta/ /kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la: gsung rab thams cad gzigs pa tsam gyis mkhyen/ /smon lam mthu chen rgyal ba'i sras po ni/ /'gro la snying nas brtse bas gzhan don mdzad/ /chos rgyal 'phags pa'i zhabs la gzhung lugs dpag med mkhyen pa'i rin po che/ /'gro kun phan bde mdzad pa'i thugs rje can/ /bstan pa rin chen sgron me phyogs bcur sbar/ /mang mkhar lo rnye'i zhabs la skyes bu dam pa du ma'i zhabs bsten pas/ /dbang lung man ngag thams cad thugs su chud/ /dam chos gsal mdzad bshes gnyen dam pa ste/ /dpal ldan seng ge'i zhabs la shes bya kun la mi mkhyen gang yang med/ /gangs can bstan 'dzin dus gsum byung rnams kyis/ /rab mchog gtso bo skal bzang sems dpa' mchog /bu ston chos rjes zhabs la: skye rgu'i gtsug rgyan bsam pa ye shes che/ /ma lus chos rnams thams cad mkhyen par chud/ /bslab gsum dri med ye shes mu mtha' yas/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan zhabs la: rnam thar gsum la nyes skyon thams cad spangs/ /dad dang brtson 'grus shes rab thos pa sogs/ /gang gi thugs la 'gran pa bzhin du gnas/ /byang chub seng ge'i —33—

zhabs la: rigs rus cho 'brang skyon med rigs su 'khrungs/ /thos pa rgya mtsho'i pha rol son nas kyang / /brtse ba'i phyag gis 'gro rnams skyong mdzad pa/ /ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs la: rdo rje theg pa'i chos kun gsan zhing mkhyen/ /lhag pa'i tshul khrims gsang gsum nyes kun bral/ /byin rlabs stobs kyis rgya chen 'phrin las can/ /kun dga' bzang po'i zhabs la rtsod dus kun mkhyen rin chen grub kyi gsung / /dri med chos la thos bsam rgyud sbyangs shing / /rdo rje slob dpon gnas thob dus 'khor ba/ /rin wo bkra shis zhabs la bden gnyis rnam par dbye ba 'gran zla bral/ /so so yang dag rig pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /'gro phan bsam gyi mi khyab spyod yul can/ khwakya mchog ldan zhabs la: thogs med dus nas tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i mthus/ /thugs rje'i dri bsung phyogs bcu ma lus khyab/ /nga rgyal mi mnga' mkhyen pa'i gter chen po/ /brag dkar sems dpa'i zhabs la: rang byung lhan skyes 'od gsal mngon du gyur/ /gnas lugs mkhyen pas snang grags sgyu mar gzigs/ /rlabs chen spyod pas rang gzhan phan bde bsgrubs/ /bkra shis rnam rgyal zhabs la: /bla ma lhag pa'i lha yis byin gyis rlabs/ /brtul bzhugs dbang phyug ngur smrig 'dzin pa'i mchog /ye shes thugs rjes zol med mnga' ba yis/ /kun dga' grol mchog zhabs la: gang snang thams cad bde chen rol par gzigs/ /mtha' bral rtogs pas sgrib gnyis rang sar grol/ /rgyal ba rgyal sras thams cad 'dus pa'i dngos/ /lha dbang grags pa'i zhabs: yang na/ bgrang yas mdo rgyud kun la mkhyen pa rgyas/ /lhan skyes dga' ba'i rol pa —34—

dam chos kyi/ /rgyal mtshan sgreng mdzad rje btsun rdo rje 'chang / /kun dga' rgyal mtshan zhabs la: phyin chad brgyud pa'i bla ma 'dir 'jug /'og ma rnams phyin chad kyang rtsa ba'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs su bya'o/ /rigs kun bdag po ma lus 'khor lo'i mgon/ /gsang gsum zung 'jug bde chen rdo rje'i dngos/ /skyabs gnas thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa'i rje/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhabs la dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gsum dngos/ /brgyad khri bzhi stong chos kyi phung po'i mdzod/ /rig grol gnyis ldan 'dus pa kun gyi rje/ /skyabs gnas kun 'dus khyed la pa srid dang zhi ba'i phun sum tshogs pa kun/ /mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje'i stobs las byung / /mtho ris thar pa'i lam ston mkhyen brtse'i gter/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs la sangs rgyas byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos dang / /lha dang rab byung khyim pa mu stegs byed/ /brtan g.ye'i dngos po kun gyi tshul bzung nas/ /gang 'dul 'gro don mdzad la: 'dus byas thams cad glog ltar mi rtag cing / /srid pa mtha' dag sdug bsngal gsum rang bzhin/ /dal 'byor shin tu rnyed dka' bstan pa yis/ /dang por 'dren mdzad khyod la:bde sdug kun gyi rgyur gyur dge sdig gi /blang dor 'khrul pa med par ston pa po/ /nges par 'byung ba'i tshul khrims lam mkhan gyis/ /thar par 'khrid mkhas khyod la: rin chen byang chub sems kyi nor sbyin nas/ /theg mchog rab tu yangs pa'i grong khyer du/ /stong nyid snying rje'i dga' ston stsol mdzad pa/ /rgyal ba'i lam ston khyod la: /dri med dbang skur rnams kyis byin rlabs shing / /bskyed pa'i rim pas skye 'chi bar do yi/ /bag chags sbyong zhing tha mal —35—

snang zhen zlog /smin byed lam ston chos rjer: /a wa si tir gnad du bsnun pa las/ /rlung dang khams kyi bgrod pa kun thim pas/༄/gtum mo rnam gsum 'bar bas zhu bde thob/ /bde stong ston mdzad khyod la: /bde ba'i rang bzhin mtha' bzhi spros dang bral/ /sems nyid bde ba'i ngo bor rnam gnas pa/ /ris med ngo bor snang gsum rang bzhin thim/ /bde chen lam bzang gsal la:thog mtha' med pa'i sems nyid bde ba'i dngos/ /zhu bde'i rkyen gyis dri ma sbyangs pa las/ /zung 'jug dkyil 'khor yan lag bdun ldan pa/ /rdzogs rim mthar thug ston la gdod nas mtha' bral bde chen mtshan dpes spras/ /thugs rje chen pos 'khor ba ma stong par/ /'gro la phan bde'i mthar thug 'bras rab stsol/ /sku gsum mngon gyur khyod la gsol ba 'debs/ /de ltar rtse gcig gsol ba btab pa yis/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad kyis/ /tshe 'dir bla med byang chub thob pa dang / /'phrin las lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad par lha dag/ // 'di la gzhi byas la gang mos kyi sgo nas brgyud pa gzhan yang 'dor len shes par bya'o/ /zhes pa'ang tā ra nā thas rang lo nyer gsum snron gyi tshes lnga la bsam gtan sdings su sbyar ba'o/ /ma ṅga laX/ /zhus dag—36—

ba chen po li/ char yangs zhes bya ba bzhugs/oṃ khyu sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs slob dpon chen po spyod pa pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid gsum gtso bo bdud bzhi'i dgra 'joms drag po che/ /phyugs bdag go ris mnyam par bdud pa he ru ka /khyod ni rtag dang chad mtha' las grol dbu ma ste/ /mkha' 'gro drwa ba'i sdom pa mchog la gus pas 'dud/ /rig 'dzin 'khor los sgyur ba brtul zhugs kyi/ /spyod pa'i rol sgeg 'chang ba nag po'i gsung / 'un tu rtogs dka' rtogs na don che ba/ /'di don 'khrul med rab tu gsal bar bya/ /byin rlabs dal 'bab chu bo'i rgyun/ /dngos grub rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba can/ /sngags rig bye ba'i 'bab stegs 'dir/ /skal ldan gegs med 'du bar shog /de la 'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams sngon du 'gro bar bya ste/ de yang 'di ltar/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon to 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdagarje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su —37—

mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum mam bdun sogs brjod nas/bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ lan gsum/ kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing / /kun rtog la ni mngon par zhen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan he ru kar bsgom bya/ lan gsum/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas 'khor lo bde mchog gi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o// lan gsum/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hu dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hū la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ /lko shri badz+ra he ru ka /sa mā ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra he ru ka te —38—

no pa la ḍi rnyo me bha wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po stso me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi sme pra rte sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+ta shri ya ku ru hu/ ha ha ha ha ho bha ga wān/ badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa/ he ru ko3 bha wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa ā hu phaṭa/ ces ci ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyob mdzod cig /gtso bor rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes lhung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam mo// sgrub thabs dngos la gnyis/mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor dang mnyam lang gi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la gnyis te/ sngon du bya ba 'jug ldog gi sbyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dngos gzhi sgom pa'o/ /dang po la mthun rkyen sgrub pa dang /'gal rkyen spong ba gnyis so/ /dang po la rkyen bsod nams tshogs sogs dang / rgyu lam khyer gnyis so/ /de'i dang po rkyen bsod nams tshogs bsag ni/rang nyid gang du gnas pa'i phyogs de khor ra khor yug tu mi bzad cing 'jigs su rung ba'i dur khrod chen po bdag med pa'i ngo bos khyab cing / dbus su chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid gro'i gdan la yang dag par gnas pa'i sgrub pa po rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i rig ma g.yon gyi cha nas nye bar bsten par mos te/ bdud rtsi ril bu khar sten pa'am/ nang mchod byin gyi 7sa te myangs la/ shrī he ru ko3 ha/—39—

snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor steng du/ hu sngon po ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid can/ hū las 'od 'phros lus thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad sbyangs te/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum du gyur/ slar hu las 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi nam mkha' steng gi cha la rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can la brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyis bskor ba/ 'og gi cha la 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru khyo zhes dang /na ma4ni tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal khyu zhes pa'i phyag bya/ o sarba ta tha ga ta shri tsakra sa sbar maṇ+ḍal la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī/ zhes pa re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i/ badz+ra ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ badz+ra pā py-i pra tī ts+tsha swāhā/ o badz+ra ngu khye ā hū/ de bzhin du/dhu pe/ a lo keg rnye ni wi du/ o badz+ra sha lta ā hū/ gi bar du sbyar ba'i mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas rgyun bshags ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod pa'o// de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cigasdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang —40—

snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig ces3 med bzhi yang sgom mo/ /gnyis pa rgyu lam khyer gnyis ni/ oX su bha wa shudha sarba dharmaXsu bhā wa shurnyo ྅ haX/ oṃ shu rgyu ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ zhes brjod cing don sgom pa ni chos sku lam khyer ro/ /stong pa'i ngang las rang gi bar do'i rnam shes kyi ngo bo nā da dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa rtsa sngags kyi sgra sgrog pa'o/ /zhes pa ni longs sku lam khyer te/ yang na hūX cha lnga pa bsgoms kyang legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa 'gal rkyen 'gog pa bsrung ba'i 'khor lo ni/de las 'og tu baX 'phros pa las sna tshogs pad ma raX 'phros pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ huX 'phros pa las sna tshogs rdo rje'i rwa rnams shar sngo/ byang ljang nub dmar lho ser/ lte ba huX gis mtshan par bsam/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i huX las sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ kha gdong ma las steng du khwa gdong ma dang khyi gdong ma las 'og tu khyi gdong ma rnams dmar mo zhags pa dang lcags kyu thogs pa phyogs bcur spros/ oX sum+bha ni nga hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX gro hā gro hā hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX grihā pā ya gro hā pā ya hūX huX phaṭa/ oX ā na ya ho bha ga wān du rā dza huX hūX phaṭa/ phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor du te lan gnyis brjod/ g.yon pa'i sdigs 'dzub phyogs bcur bstan zhing / se gol gdab pa'o// yang sum+bha/ tshar gcig brjod nas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig ces bka' bsgos pas/ pho nya rnams kyis bgegs kha cig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang /byang chub kyi sems la bkod/ nag po'i rig can kha cig ni bsgral te bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing du gnas spar/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu ni bkug ste 'ongs pa phyogs bcur 'khod pa/ huX bcu las byung ba'i khron pa gru —41—

gsum zab cing rgya che ba bcu'i nang du bcug yang hūX las phur bu bcu spros pho nya rnams kyi lag par gtad/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi bor btsugs/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya sarba du giX phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ huX hūX hūX/ badz+ra gī la/badz+ra dha ro adz+nyā pā ya ti sarba bighāX kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa/ ces brjod/yang huX las thod pa bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad/ phur bu'i spyi bor brdungs/ oṃ badz+ra na zhi ra badz+ra gī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūX phaṭa/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal phyung nas de dag gi lus g.yo ba med/ ngag rlud rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtogs pa thams cad bcom nas 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur zhing / smon lam gyi mthu las rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ sna tshogs rdo rje las 'og tu sna tshogs rdo rje dpag tu med pa spros/ de las rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam la/ oṃ me dhi ni badzi bha ba ban+ta huX/ de las phyogs mtshams su 'phros pa las rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'greng bur gyur pa'i rwa ba dang / rdo rje 'phreng la song ba'i rwa bar bsam la oX badz+ra pra ka ra huX baX hūX/ steng du 'phros pa las rdo rje rwa ba dang drwa ba'i gur du bsam la/ oX badz+ra pañdza ra hūX paX hūX/ de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i bla rer bsam la/ oX badz+ra bi ta na huX khaX huX/ de'i phyir rol du 'obs dang bcas pa'i mda'i drwa ba mde'u bsnol ba phyir bstan pa srid pa'i rtse mo la thug par bsam la/ oX badz+ra sa ra dzā la traX saX traX/de thams cad kyi phyi rol tu bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me ri 'bar ba/ oX badz+ra dz+wa la a na la rka huX hūX hūX/ zhes pa ste/ sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /pho nya rnams las rang 'dra ba dpag tu med pa sprul te mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs/ rdo rje dra mig —42—

nas phar ro stod thon nas/ bsgrub pa pos ji srid byang chub ma thob kyi bar du/bar du gcod pa thams cad bsrung bar mdzad/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dngos gzhi sgom pa la rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgoms pa dang / brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'o// dang po ni/bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i dbus su/ la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse mo gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ya las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/de'i steng du su las ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi pa/ shar shel/ byang gser/nub pad+ma rā ga lho bi rje bya las grub pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/lcogs brgyad dang ldan pa/ thig le ser po dang bcas pa/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las 'og tu rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/de'i steng du sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi grwa bzhir rdo rje rtse mo gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du ri'i rgyal po ri rab zur bzhi pa/ shar shel/ byang gser/nub pad+ma rā ga /lho biḍar+ya las grub pa rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/lcog brgyad dang ldan pa/ thig le ser po dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar rin po che sna tshogs las grub —43—

pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa/ sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po/ dkar ba'i brtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po la rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa dang / dril bu g.yer kha'i phreng ba dang / dar gyi chun 'phyang dang /zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i ba ku li dang / de'i steng du rin po che'i dra ba gser ma'i mda' yab kyis brgyan pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus na in+t+ra ni la'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhi/ mchod rten zlum pa'i bang rim gyi dbyibs ltar cung zad je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ gtso bo'i gdan sna tshogs pad+mas dbus su brgyan pa'i chu skyes ser po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i phyi rol du rdo rje'am gri gug gis mtshan pa'i rwa ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de las cung zad kyis dma' bar thugs kyi 'khor lo sngo nag rtsibs brgyad pa/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de las cung zad kyis dma' bar gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ pad+mas mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ de las cung zad kyis dma' bar sku'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa/ 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang /thog phub kyis mdzes par byas pa/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i lha snam shar sngo/byang ljang nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ mtshams rnams su bum pa gnyis gnyis te —44—

brgyad dang ldan pa/ dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje dang nor bu'i tog gis spras pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng na mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/ sgo khang bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang / g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang / snam bu so so la rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan la sogs pas brgyan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu dur khrod brgyad ni/ shar du drag tu gtum pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ bden bral du mun pa mi zad pa/ rlud du ki li ki li'i sgra rab tu sgrog pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha dgod pa'o/ /shing brgyad ni/shar du shi ri sha /byang du a sho tha/ nub tu ka ko la/ lho ru tsu ta/ mer ka ralgabaden bral du la ta pa rka ti/ rlung du par ti pa ta/ dbang ldan du bha ṭa'o/ /phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ shar du dbang po/ byang du gnod spyin/ nub tu chu lha/ lhor gshin rje/ mer byin za/ bden bral du srin po/ rlung du rlung bdag dbang ldan du 'byung po'o/ /klu brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas/ byang du 'jog po/ nub tu stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor pad+ma/ mer hu lun ta/ bden bral du rig ldan/ rlung du dung skyong / dbang ldan du pad+ma chen po'o/ /sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ shar du sgra sgrogs pa/ byang du rmugs pa/ nub tu mun pa can/ ltor kun tu 'khyi/la/ mer gang ba/ bden bral du 'bab pa/ rlung du drag po/ dbang ldan du 'khrigs pa'o/ khreng rnams la brten pa'i zhing skyong rnams ni sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi —45—

gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ /dur khrod de dag tu chu chen po brgyad dang / me chen po brgyad dang / mchod rten brgyad la sogs pas yongs su gang ba ste/ gzhan yang ro dang keng rus dang / gsal shing gis phug pa dang / dpyangs pa dang / dum bu dang / 'thor ba la sogs pas gang ba/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pa lang long rgyu zhing / lce spyang gi sgras khyab pa/ grub chen rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob dpon dang dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / 'jigs pa'i gzugs can dang ro langs dang 'byung po dang srin mo dag sha za du mas khyab pa/ dngos grub kyi rdzas dang mchod pa sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /nang gi lha'i gnas rnams su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ dbus su 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan ma/ bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir zla ba'i gdan/ 'khor rnams la mi ro'i gdan re re'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa'i dkyil stsor sgom pa la/ dang po spyor ba dang / dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang las rgyal mchog ste gsum las/ dang po la bsnyen pa dang nyer sgrub dang / bsgrub pa dang / bsgrub chen te bzhi las/ dang po la/ sngon 'gro rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa mdzad pa dang bcas pa/ dngos bzhi 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa byin rlabs dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du g.yon bskor gyi/ a ā/ i yī/ u mū/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e mai/ o au/ a a phrag gnyis 'khod/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyi/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pā pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya —46—

ra la wa ḍa lha phrag gnyis bkod/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i bar du hū dang a las rdo rje dang thod pa hu dang a gis mtshan pa/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de rnams gcig tu 'dres par bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog dkar po khro bo chen po zhal bzhi phyag bzhi/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/rgyab ser ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyu/ra ba/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba dang / bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi kha ṭā ga bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu bskyel ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu brgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / phyag gi gdu bu dang / tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang / ska rags dang / zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlone pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar gu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang —47—

na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pa'i bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu ma'i gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa'i tshul gyis stobs pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskum pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'khyud pa gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo snyan rgyan mgur chu gdub bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/khrag gsol ba la dges shing / bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje wo po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing / gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de nas yum gyi mngal gnas su skad cig gis lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa grub par gyur/gtso bo yab yum rjes su chags pas kha sbyor nang gi 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i bde ba sku nyams su star zhing rdo rje dang pad+ma'i 'khor lo'i nye ba lu gur rgyud du bcings pa'i sbyor bas 'dod chags chen po'i 'od zer thugs ka nas spros sems can gyi khams ma lus pa bkug nas nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi phye ba nas zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang bskur bas sgrib pa gsum dgaye shes yongs su rdzogs/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa yab yum gyis skur gyur nas phyir spros te skad cig de nyid la rang rang gi zhing du gshegs par gyur/ rgyu rdo rje —48—

'dzin pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ dga' ba'i sgras nam mkha'i nā da'am hūX yig dang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ bdag gi zhal nas zhugs/ snying gar 'od du zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+ma ra babs pa las yab yum gnyis 'od du zhu nas/ thig le'i rang bzhin 'od kyi phung po dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can du gyur/ gnyis pa ni/de nas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa dang /thig le las byung ba'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oX ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dza huX baX hoX su ra ta stuX draX khyo ho/ zhes bskul/ sangs rgyas rnams thig le la thim te/thig le de hūX dang aX gnyis su gyur/ de las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag ches cher khros pa drag shul chen po chags pa'i nyams dang 'dres pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal shin tu gnag pa/ g.yas zhal kun+da ltar dkar ba g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal ser po gser ltar 'bar ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ gsum pa gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga bzhi pa gnyis na dgra sta dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa dang / khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa zhabs yon —49—

bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu bskyel ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang /thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang / rna cha dang /mgul rgyan dang / phyag gi gdu bu dang / tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang / ska rags dang / zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa dang / dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ sgegs pa la sogs pa'i kar dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'byud pa'i tshul gyis stobs pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'byud pa/ /gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shel can/ 'khor lo snyan rgyan mgur chu gdu bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ khrag gsol ba la dges shing / bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing / gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sngar bzhin no/ /nga brjod pa'i zhal —50—

bzhi byin gyis rlabs pa dang / oṃ dharma dha tu su bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo / /gnyis pa nyer bsgrub ni go cha 'god pa ste/ snying khar oṃ oṃ ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' 'am/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oX swāhā huX dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su oX bo ṣaṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su oṃ hūX hūX ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ oṃ baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar oṃ haX yoX sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar oX hri moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar tseXkhwa hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oX hūX hūX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kwa'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa ste yab kyi gnas su yang yum dang / yum gyi gnas yang yab gnyis su med par gyur/ gsum pa bsgrub pa la rdo rje gsum byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ yab kyi snying khar zla ba la gnas pa'i hūX sngon po thugs rdo rje/ lkog mar lkoX hri ha ha huX huX phaṭa dmar po gsung rdo rje/ dpral par oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX huX hūX phaṭa/ ḍā gī nī dz+wa la saX pa raX swāhā/ dkar po sku rdo rje'o/ /yum gyi snying khar oṃ sarba brnya ḍā gī nī ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍa nī ye hūX huX phaṭa swāhā nag po thugs rdo rje ma lkog mar oṃ tso rī hūX huX phaṭa/dmar po gsung rdo rje ma/ dpral bar oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/dkar po sku rdo rje ma'o/ /gnas lnga byin gyis bas pa ni/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po rnam par snang mdzad/ snying gar huX sngon po mi bskyod pa/ ze'u 'bru la āXdamar po snang ba mtha' yas/ nye bar su ser po rin chen 'byung ldan/ brlar hā —51—

ljang khu don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur/ bzhi pa sgrub wo la bzhi las/ dang po ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ snying ga'i huX las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas/ 'khor lo bde mchog yab yum spyan drangs/ h+pha/ zhes brjod cing / 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral bar bzhag la g.yon du bsgyur zhing mig gyen du blta/ rkang pa g.yon pas g.yas pa gnon no// de nas/ dzaXhūX baX hoX zhes brjod de dam rdzo pa la bstim/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo ྅ haX/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang snying ga'i huX las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu'i 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad h+pha/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes brjod cing / dbang bskur bas lus thams cad byang chub sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las yab yum gnyis ka la mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ gsum pa mchod pa ni/ skye( sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saX ba ra zhes pa sngon du 'gro ba'i chu gnyis dang nyer spyod lngas mchod/ yab yum gyi snying po brjod cing nang mchod 'bul lo//bzhi pa rjes chags kyi rgyas gdab ni/ yum gyi mkha' āXlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa ze'u 'bru'i nang du yi ge phywa dmar po/ yab kyi gsang gnas huX las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa nor bu'i nang du yi ge byā dkar po'o/ /yab yum gnyis rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos rgyud —52—

gang bar gyur/ gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la/ rgyu thig le sgrub pa/ 'bras bu dkyil 'khor bskyed de spro ba/ yang dag byin gyis rlabs pa/ mchod cing bstod par bya ba ste lnga las/ dang po ni slar yang yab yum snyoms par zhugs/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra su bha wa ut+pa ko3 ha/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hū las 'od zer 'phros pas bde bar gshegs pa rnams spyan drangs/smin mtshams nas zhugs a wa dhu ti'i lam nas snying khar babs/ lte ba'i a gi 'od kyis zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ thig le dkar dmar 'dres pa de las rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor dus gcig tu grub pa ni/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang 'khor lo'i rim pa bzhi lha'i gdan dang bcas pa/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag ches cher khros pa drag shul chen po chags pa'i nyams dang 'dres pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal shin tu gnag pa/ g.yas zhal kun ltar dkar ba g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal ser po gser ltar 'bar ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ gsum pa gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭā ga bzhi pa gnyis na dgra sta dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas —53—

brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar po'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas/ 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu brgyal ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / phyag gi gdu bu dang / tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang / ska rags dang / zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa/ dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / stag gi pags pa'i sha thabs grol ba/ sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'phyud pa'i tshul gyis stob pa/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs thams cad bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'byud pa/ gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ 'khor lo snyan rgyan mgur chu gdu bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ rus pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan la/khrag gsol ba la dges shing / bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ /snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing / gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i —54—

dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ khar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang du lā ma ljang skya/nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dmar skya/ ltor gzugs can ma ser skya/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug /g.yon pa rnams bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa la rim pas/ glang po che/ ce spyang skyes pa/ ba lang rnams kyis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ /mi blo'i steng du g.yas brkyang ba'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir ma dang pha dang rgyal po dang / rgyal rigs gnyis kyi gang ba'i thod pa bzhi sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs pu li ra ma la ya ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang / rab gtum mo/byang phyogs dzā lan da rar ma hā ka ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub phyogs o ṭi ya nar ka kā la dang 'od ldan ma/ lho phyogs a rlu ta ra mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ shar lho go dā wa rer su ra be+e ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ lho nub ra skyi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ nub byang de bī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang la ske'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu/ gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar phyogs kwa ma rū par a ku ri dang e ra ba tī/ byang phyogs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed wo mo/nub phyogs dri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma lho phyogs ko sa lar rdo rje hū mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar ltor ka liskor rab tu bzang po dang shā ma de ldi/ lho nub la ba kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ /nub —55—

byang ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rnam/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na ste gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o/ /de'i phyi rol tu sku'i ge nar lo'i shar phyogs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang / 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang phyogs gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ nub phyogs so rdzo rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi nī/ lho phyogs su waṇi dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub sijur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma ru ra rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/byang shar ku lu sta ra rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la la sogs pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi thams cad dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba/ he ru ka nyid dang mtshungs pa las zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khru/da pa/ dbugs bral gyi gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rab gtum ma la sogs pa'i lha mo nyer bzhi rnams rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo nyid dang mtshungs pa las/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar du khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ lhor phag gdong ma ser skya/ shar lto gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje —56—

'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad po thams cad kyang ches cher khros pa 'od zer 'bar ba bzhin shin tu 'gyur zhing sna tshogs su rnam par bsgyur ba/stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba g.yas gri gug /g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa/ thor tshugs kyi nor bu dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / rdo rje'i ska rags dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas mgul ba brgyan pa/ rkang pa gnyis la dril bu g.yer khas spras pa/ shin tu g.yon brkyang bas ro gdan la bzhugs pa ste/dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o// gsum pa ni/ bha ga'i gtso bo yab yum rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs thugs ka nas phyir spros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchode/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas slar 'dus gcig tu 'dres yab dpal he ru ka snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbus na rtsa a ba dhu tī hū gi dbyibs can khams dpyid dang bcas pa la thim pa'i bcom ldan 'das dang / yum rdo rje phag mo lte ba'i a yig dang rtsa'i gtso mo bzhi la thims pas rdo rje phag mor gyur te/ snying gar mnyam par sbyor ba ni bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog mthing nag ches cher khros pa/ drag shul chen po chags pa'i nyams dang 'dres pa/ zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal shin tu gnag pa/ g.yas zhal kun+da ltar dkar ba/ g.yon zhal pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba/ rgyab zhal ser po gser ltar 'bar ba/ zhal thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba/ spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum —57—

la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa brgyangs te 'dzin pa/ gsum pa sna gnyis na ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭāX ga bzhi pa gnyis na dgra sta dang zhags pa/ lnga pa gnyis na mdung rtse gsum pa dang khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/drug pa gnyis kyis gri gug dang tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng na zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo'i lte ba dang skye gnas mnan pa/ zhabs g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu bsgyel ba'i mgo bo dang snying ga brdzis pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang sna tshogs rdo rje dang / zla ba phyed pa dang / thod pa skam po lngas dbu rgyan pa/ gtsug gi nor bu rin po che dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / phyag gi gdu bu dang /tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / thal r+ṣa te phyag rgya drug dang / spyi bo'i 'khor lo dang /ska rags dang / zhabs gdub g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang bcas pa dang / dpung rgyan dang sor gdub ste nye ba'i phyag rgya lngas sku la brgyan pa/ /mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal dang / stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba sgeg pa la sogs pa'i gar dgu dang ldan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ drag mo chen mo bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ phyag g.yon pas bdud dang gdug pa'i khrag dang mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis stob pa g.yas pas rdo rje dang sdig mdzub kyi phyogs thams cad du bsdigs pa/ dbu skra grol ba/zhabs g.yon brkyangs shing g.yas bskums pas bcom ldan 'das la legs par 'byud pa/ gcer bu'i mchog mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skam po lnga —58—

bcu'i do shal can 'khor lo snyan rgyan/ mgur chu gdu bu'i tshogs dang 'og pag ste/ dras pa'i rgyan lngas brgyan pa/ khrag gsol ba la dges shing / bha ga nas khrag 'dzag pa'o/ snang ba dang lhag mthong dang thugs rje chen po'i ngo bo ni yab yin la/ stong pa dang zhi gnas dang bde ba chen po'i ngo bo ni yum yin zhing /gnyis ka'ang bskal pa'i me lta bu'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de lta bu'i yab kyi thugs kar hū/ yum gyi thugs kar ba gnas pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros rnam par dag pa'i khams bzhi la bzhag ste phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir 'khod/ snying ga'i nang bskor gyi phyogs bzhi'i ma ta pa la rnams kyang rnal 'byor ma bzhir gyur te/ de yang nang dang phyi'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang du lā ma ljang skya/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar skya/ lhor gzugs can ma ser skya/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ g.yas gri gug g.yon pa rnams bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa la rim pas/ glang po che/ce spyang / skyes pa/ ba lang rnams kyis mtshan pa bsnams pa/ skra sgrol ba/ phyag rgya lnga sogs rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ mi ro'i steng du g.yas brkyang ba'i gar gyis bzhugs pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi thod pa bzhi rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros/ rnam par dag pa'i phung po lnga la bzhag ste phyi'i bde chen 'khor lo'i mtshams bzhir 'khod/ snying ga'i mtshams kyi bdud rtsi lnga 'bab pa'i rtsa rnams kyang thod pa bzhir gyur/ de yang nang dang phyi'i mtshams bzhir ma dang pha dang rgyal po dang / rgyal rig gnyis kyis —59—

gang ba'i thod pa bzhi sangs rgyas kyi gzugs kyis mtshan pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi 'khor lo gsum gyi lha rnams rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros/ rnam par dag pa'i yul dang yul can la bzhag ste phyi'i 'khor lo gsum la 'khod/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas so sor/ pu dza o a go ra de mā/ ka o tri ko la kā hi/ pre gri so sun si ma ku ste/ gnas rnams yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi dang / khams rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang / rtsa rnams dpa' mo nyer bzhir gyur/ de yang spyi bo dang thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu lī ra ma la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā dang rab gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dang byang rtsibs dzā lan+ta rar ma hā ka kā la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma rna ba g.yas dang nub rtsibs o ḍi ya nar ka ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa dang lho rtsibs a rlu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ /rna ba g.yon dang shar lho go da wa rir su ra be+e ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus dang lho nub ra smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis dang nub byang de lī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang la sko'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis dang byang shar mā la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so/ /thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po'o/ /mdzo khung gnyis dang gsung 'khor gyi shar rtsibs kā ma rū par a ku ri dang e ra ba ti/ nu ma gnyis dang byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed kho mo ste zhing ngo / /lte ba dang nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse dang lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hu mdzad dang chang 'thung ma ste nye ba'i zhing ngo / kha dang —60—

shar lto ka liskor rab tu bzang po dang shā ma de waX/ mgrin par dang lho nub laX pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo ste stso ha'o/ /snying kha dang nub byang ka zhing 'jigs byed chen po dang rta snam/ 'bras bu dang byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na na ste nye ba'i stso ha'o/ /gsung gis gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po'o/ /mtshan ma dang sku 'khor gyi shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang ‘gon ra lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam dang byang rtsibs kṛ ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi ste 'du ba'o/ /brla gnyis dang nub rtsibs so ra spyir rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi nī/ byin pa gnyis dang lho rtsibs su waṇi dī par// nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba'o/ /sor mo brgyad dang shar lho na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis dang lho nub si rgyur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma te dur khrod do/ /mthe bong gnyis dang nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang snyen ra los bsgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis dang byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po'o/ khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la la sogs pa'i dpa' bo nyer bzhi thams cad dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba/ he ru ka nyid dang mtshungs pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyu/da pa/ dbugs bral gyi gdan la gnas pa'o/ /rab gtum/ ma la sogs pa'i lha mo nyer bzhi rnams rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo nyid dang mtshungs pa las/ phyag g.yas rdo rje mtshan pa'i gri gug dang / g.yon thod pa —61—

khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying ga nas rgyud so so'i gnas nas phyir spros rnam par dag pa'i las dang byed pa la bzhag ste dam tshig 'khor lo'i sgo mtshams brgyad du 'khod/ snying kha'i phyi bskor dang 'brel ba'i bu ga brgyad kyi rtsa rnams kyang sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur/ de yang kha dang shar sgor khwa gdong ma sngo skya/ chu lam dang byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang skya/ bshang lam dang nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar skya/ sna bug gnyis kyi 'dom so dang lho sgor phag gdong ma ser skya/ rna ba g.yas dang shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ rna ba g.yon dang lho nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ mig g.yas dang nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ mig g.yon dang byang shar du skyon rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad po thams cad kyang ches cher khros pa 'od zer 'bar ba bzhin shin tu 'gyur zhing sna tshogs su rnam par bsgyur ba stag gi pags pa'i shams thabs can zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra grol ba g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa thor tshugs kyi nor bu dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / gdu bu dang / rdo rje'i ska rags dang thod pa'i 'phreng bas mgul ba brgyan pa/ rkang pa gnyis la dril bu g.yer khas spras pa/ shin tu g.yon brkyang bas ro gdan la bzhugs pa ste/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral bar thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /mkha' nang gi rten gyi dkyil 'khor rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ snying kha nas phyir spros rnam par dag pa'i zhing khams —62—

la bzhag ste phyi'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ rang lus kyi skra sen pags pa rus tshigs rnams bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad rkang mthil rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ gsum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying kha sa/ sgal tshigs ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ mgo bo ri rab kyi stod kyi cha/ lus mi mnyam pa med pa gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi lus ngag yid gsum 'khore lo gsum/ snying ga chos kyi 'bor lo ni bde ba chen po'i snyen ra lo/ 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ mig dang rna ba dang / sna dang lce dang mchu dang rgyu long la sogs pa ni gzhal yas khang gi rgyan du gyur/ bzhi pa la/ dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ ye shes spyan 'dren/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab ste gsum mo/ /dang po la gnyis las pho nya gsum bsre ni/ skye( āXhuX sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya lwastsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ zhes brjod de don bsam/rdo rje'i dag pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra shudhaXsarba dharmā badz+ra shurnyo3 haX/ zhes brjod/gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i huX las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bur 'phros pas 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs/ h+pha/ zhes brjod cing / dzaXhuX paṃ ho/ lan lnga brjod/ gnyis su med par thim/ oX yo ga shudha: sogs brjod cing / rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang 'byud rgya bya/ gsum pa ni/ slar yang snying kha'i huX las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad h+pha/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa lha mo'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin bshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bya'o/ oṃ sarba ta thā —63—

ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri huX/ zhes brjod cing / dbang bskur bas lus thams cad byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis gang ste/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs nas chu lhag ma yar lud pa las gtso bo yab yum gyi rigs bdag rdo rje sems dpar gyur zhing / bde chen 'khor lo'i lha mo bzhi la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs 'khor ba rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung 'khor ba rnams la 'do dpag med/ sku 'khor ba rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pa rnams kyis dbu rgyan par bsam/bzhi pa la dang por sngags mchod ni/ yab yum gyi snying po dang mkha' 'gro ma nas gshin rje 'joms ma'i bar gyi sngags rnams lan re brjod pa'o// phyi mchod ni/ su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a bdun las thod pa'i snod bdun gyi nang du hūX bdun las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/mar me/ dri/ zhal zas dang gzhan yang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing / thogs pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX āXhūX/ nas/shabha'i bar gyis byin gyis rlabs/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra saX ba ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi ni/ badz+ra ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhi du/ pa duX yang de ltar sbyar te/ badz+ra pur+sha āXhūX/ sogs kyis nyer spyod rol mo dang yos pa dang / oX badz+ra ga rnye ra ṇi tā pra ṇi ta/ saX pra ra ṇi ta sarba bzhi slo dra pra tsa li te/ pradz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da saX bha we ta/ badz+ra dharmā hri da ya ni sa rnyo ṣa ni hūX hūX hūX ho ho ho a khaX swāhā/ de nas nang ma rdzo ni gtor ma bzhi byin gyis brlabs la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis 'thor zhing /rdo rje 'chang chen rang bzhin sku/ /thugs rje 'gro kun gdungs sel zhing / /bdag blo'i ku mud kha —64—

'byed pa/ /rje btsun dpal ldan bla ma mchod/ oṃ ā hu/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang / /nag po spyod pa gu phya arnyar pa/ /te lo na ro pham ting sku mched mal/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /o ā hū/ sa chen bsod rtse rje btsun grags pa'i mtshan/ /sa paṇa yon tan dpal dang la ru pa/ /gangs khrod pa dang theg chen chos rgyal la/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i: ka dgon pa dang paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/ /brag dkar sems dpa' mkhan chen bkras rnam pa/ /grol mchog zhabs dang rje btsun rdo ring dbon/ /rnam dag bdud rtsi'i: yang na/ sa paṇa 'phags pa mang mkhar lo tsā ba/ dpal ldan seng ge bu ston rin chen grub/ /bsod nams rgyal mtshan byang chub seng ge dang / khar pa ye rgyal chos rje kun bzang pa/ /rin chen bkra shis paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/zhes dang / grol mchog zhabs dang rje btsun lha dbang grags/ zhes te 'don pa spo/ sa lugs kyi brgyud pa'o/ /'di la tshogs sgom pa nas brgyud pa'ang / g.yag sde lo tsā ba dang / dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal nas brgyud pa sogs sa paṇa man chad brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba snga phyir mang du yod do/yang /rdo rje 'chang dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /dza lan+ta ra nag po spyod pa ba/ dge ba'i mgon po ti snyi nā ro dang / shes rab srung ba ka na ka shri /me dza ling pa rā lo chen po dang / /chos rab ye shes seng ge 'bum seng dang / /rong pa rga lo rong pa sher seng dang / /bla chen grags rgyal dar ma bzang po dang / /chos rje ri pa gnyal pa bde legs dpal/ /rin chen rgyal mtshan grags pa rin chen dang / /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan blo gros rgya mtsho dang / /don grub legs pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ o ā hu/ rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa'o// mar do lugs kyang yod de 'dir re —65—

zhig ma bris so/ /de nas bsdu na gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa'am/ spro na lha thams cad kyi snying po'i mthar 'gru gsum btags pa'i kyang nang mchod 'bul/ oṃ sarba badz+ra gā mi ni sarba bha k+ṣaX sho dha ya gu phya badz+re ṇi swāhā/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo / /de nas gsang ba'i ma rdzo pa ni phyi nang gi lha thams cad mnyes par gyur nas rjes chags mdzad par bsam te/ oṃ hriXha ha huX hūX phaṭa/ lan lnga'i mthar/ a nu rā ga'i sngags brjod cing / rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang /mthar 'byud pa'i phyag rgya bya'o// yid mchod ni/ spyi bor nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ ngag tu ni/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang / gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang / bdag gi mos pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang / smon lam gyi dbang gis 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang / gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar ba las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung lta bur bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang / sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /ces se gol gdab/ yang phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ ā lha rta ya ā lha rta ya ho/ na maXs man+ta bzhi naX/ a dhi sma re spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX dharmā dh+wa tu ā ka sha sa man+ta maX/ sarba ta thā ga ta a pa ri rbe( dha le maṇ+ḍa le/ ma ma pri ṇi dha na/ pu khyu/dz+nyā na ba le na/ sarba ta thā ga ta ba le na sa bha swa za na ba le na tsa swāhā/ zhes brjod la se gol gdab bo// de nas bstod pa ni cang te'u brdung zhing / oṃ na mo bha ga wa te lī re shā ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ mahā ka lha sni san ni bha ya —66—

skyoX skyoX phaṭa/ oX dza ṭā mu ku ṭo rka ṭā ya huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ daXni ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu ji ya huX huX phaṭa/ oX sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya huX hūX phaṭa/ oX pa ra shu pā sho bya ta shu la kha ṭāX ga dha ri ṇi hūX huX phaṭa/ oX byā ghā dzi nā sba ra dha rā ya huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā dhu grwan+ta ka ra wa pu khyi ya huX hūX phaṭa/ ces yab kyi rkang brgyad dang / oX na mo bha wa ga te badz+ra bā rā hi waX hūX huX phaṭa/ oX na mo ār+ya a pa ra dzi te tri lo kya mā te mahā bi bya shwa re huX huX phaṭa/ oX na maX sa sgro bhu ta bha yāX wa ha mahā badz+re hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra ā sa ne a dzi de a pa ra dzi te bā shaX kā ri ni tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ na maXye/ ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li ne hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX na ma snya sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pā rā dza ye huX huX phaṭa/ lkoX na mo bi dza ye nga ni nga ni mo ha ni hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ na mo badz+ra bā rā hi mahā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge huX hūX phaṭa/ ces yum gyi rkang brgyad do// gsum pa las rgyal mchog la gnyis las/ dag pa dran pa ni/ lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang sems rjes su dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ gzugs can ma bzhi'o/ /'dun pa dang brtson 'grus dang spyod pa dang sems te/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ rab gtum ma/ gtum pa'i mig can ma/ 'od ldan ma/sna chen ma rnams so/ /dad pa dang brtson 'grus dang dran pa dang ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab kyi dbang po lnga ni brtan blo ma/ mi'u thung ma/ la sko'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma/ sa srungs ma rnams so/ /dad sogs kyi stobs lnga ni/'jigs byed ma/ rlud shugs ma/ myong 'thung ma/ ljang lha mo/ rab bzang ma rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin dang / brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyangs pa dang / rnam 'byed dang / dran pa dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub —67—

kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rta rna ma/ bya gdong ma/ 'khor shugs ma/ dum skyes ma/glang sna ma/ go cha ma/ shin tu dpa' mo rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba dang /rtog pa dang / ngag dang / las kyi mtha' dang / 'tsho ba dang / rtsol ba dang / dran pa rnams ni stobs chen ma/ 'khor sgyur ma/ brtson chen ma/ kha gdong ma/ lug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma/ phag gdong ma rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ dpal he ru ka'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa skyed pa dang / skyes pa bsrung ba dang / mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi skyed pa dang / skyes pa spong ba bzhi ni/gshen rje brtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa phra thig gi rnal 'byor ni/ rnam pa mang po zhig yod pa las skabs 'dir 'khor lo bzhi'i gtso/ mo 'bar 'dzag dmigs bcas kyi mthar dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dpag tu med pa spro ba sgyu ma lta bur shes pa'i rim pa can no/ /gnyis pa mnyam langs kyi rnal 'byor la 'dir smos pa bzhi las/ dang po bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ mchog sgrub pa'am rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa la kha dog sngon po'am/ dmar po 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba bsgom dgos la/ zhi ba la dkar po me tog 'phreng ba lta bu dal shing lhod pas 'gro ba dang / rgyas pa la ser po sgro'i chun po'i tshul dang / dbang la dmar po lcags sgrog gi tshul dang / drag po la nag po srad bu'i tshul gyis 'gro bar bsam la bzla'o/ /bzla bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba ti bī rī shā ya/ mahā kanywasno sa sno bhā ya/ dza nā mu ku sa t+pa ṭā ya/ daXg ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu sku ya/ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su ra ya/ pa ra shu pā sho du ta shu la kha ṭāX ga bhā ri ṇi/ byā ghā dzi nāX ba ra bhā rā ya/ ma hā dhu grwan+ta ka ra ba pu ༷khri ༷ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku sa ban+ta ban+ta/ bhā sa ya t+yā sa ya/ klo bha ya khyo bha ya/ ca khu(/ hraXhraX h+pha h+pha/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa/ ba sa ru dhi rwan+ta mā lā ba la zhi ni/ gro hā grihā/ sa sta pā tā la —68—

ga ta bhu dzaX ga sarbaX ba/ tardza ya tardza ya/ ā ka bye ā ka rju/hri hri/ dzhai dzhai / riX riX/ haX haX/ hi hi/ huX huX/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li hūX huX phaṭa/ yab kyi rtsa sngags dang / oX na mo bha ga ba tai badz+ra bā rā hi baX/ urnya a pa rā dzi te/tre lo kya mā te mahā bi bye shwa rī/ sarba bhu ta bha yā ma he mahā badz+re/ badz+ra a sa ne a dzi te a pa rā dzi te ba shaX ka ri nai dra bh+ra ma ṇi sho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha ni ka rā li nī/tru sa ni mā ra ṇi pra bhe da ni/ a pa rā dza ye/ bi dza ye nga ni nga ni mo ha ni/badz+ra bā rā hi mahā yo gi nī kā me shwa rī kha ge ta du thā/ pro taṅge pro taṅge/ ha na ha na/pru ṇa na/ ki ki ni/ khi khri ni/ dhu na dhu na/ badz+ra ha ste/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ badz+ra kha ṭāX ga ka pā la dh+wa ri ṇi/ mahā pi sha ta/ māX spyo sha ni/ ma nu khyu n+ta pru bṛ te/ sa ni rgyuX na ra shi ro/ mā lā gran thi ta bhā ri ṇi/ nga ni nga/ ha na ha na/ pru ṇaX/ sar+pā pā paX sa tā nāX/ sa rbu pā shu naX/ mahā māX sa ts+tsha da ni/ kroṅgā murti/ daXg ka rā li nā/mahā mu dre/ shrī he ru ka /de ba gya a gra ma hi ski sa ha sra shi re/ sa ha sra bā ha be/sha ta sa ha sra a na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa la mu khe/ skra ga la lo tsa ni/ badz+ra sha rī re/ badz+ra ā sa ni/ mi li mi li/ ti mi li ti mi li/ he he/ huX huX/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/dhu dra dh+wa sa mu ru mu sa a dwo te/ mahā yo gi ni/ pa 'i ta/ sirnyi dro dhaX dro dhaX/ graX graX/he he/ ha ha/ sgyi me/ ha sa ha sa/ bhi me/ ha sa ha sa/ bī re/ ha ha/ hoXhoX huX huX/tri lo kya bi nā sha na/ sha ta sa ha sra/ ko ṭi ta thā ga ta pa ri bā re huX huX phaṭa/si ha rū pe khaX ga dza rū pe gaX tri lo kya u da ri sa mu dra/ me kha le/ gra sa gra sa/ huX huX phaṭa/ bī rā shwe te/ huX huX/ hā hā/ ma hā pa shu mo ha ni/ mahā yo gī shwa rī tāX/ ḍā ki nī sarba lo kā nāX ban+ta naX sa juXpra r+ya kā ri ṇi hūX hūX phaṭa/ bhū ta tru sa ni/—69—

mahā bī re pa ra ma sirnyi yo gi shwa rī phaṭa/ huX hūX phaṭa huX huX phaṭa/ yum gyi rtsa sngags dang /oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX hūX hūX phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sa sba raX swāhā/ yab kyi snying po dang /oX sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra waṇ+ḍa nī ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po dang / oX hruXha ha huX huX phaṭa/ yab kyi nye snying dang / oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi nye snying dang / oṃ sum+bha ni su lha huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ gros pa ya grihā pā ya hūX huX phaṭa/ oX ā na ya ho bha ga wan badz+ra rā dzā huX huX phaṭa/ yab kyi nye ba'i snying po'i snying po dang / lkoX tso rī huX huX phaṭa/ yum gyi nye ba'i snying phi snying po dang / oX ḍā ki nī ye hūX huX phaṭa/oṃ lwa me huX huX phaṭa/ oX khaṇ+ḍa ro he huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ rū pi ṇi ye huX hūX phaṭa/ snying yi rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i sngags dang / oṃ ka ra ka ra hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ pra tsa rnye hūX huX phaṭa/ oX ku ru ku ru hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa k+ṣi ye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ bhan+ta bhan+dha hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ pra bha ba tī ye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ tra sa ya tra sa ya huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ma hāX nāX se hūX huX phaṭa/ oX khyo bha ya snyo bha ya hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ bī rā ma tī ye huX hūX phaṭa/ oX lha hro hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ kha rba ri ye hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ hraXhraXhuX hūX phaṭa/ oX la sko shwa ri ye huX hūX phaṭa/ oX phe phe huX huX phaṭa/ oX dru ma ts+tsha ye hūX huX phaṭa/ oX phaṭa phaṭa huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ e rā ba tī ye hūX huX phaṭa/ oX da ha da ha huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ mahā ba ra bī ye hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa huX hūX phaṭa/ lkoX bā pū be ge huX huX phaṭa/ oX bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba sa ru dhi na snye mā lā ba la zhi ne huX huX phaṭa/ oX su ra bha yi ye hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā sa lta pā tā la ga ta bhu dzaX ga sarba bā tardza ya tardza ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ shā mā de bī ye hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX ā ka rdzu ā ka bye hūX geX phaXṭa/ oX su bha dre hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ sbru sbru hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ha ya ka rje huX hūX phaṭa/ oX dzhai dzhai huX huX phaṭa/ oX kha gā na na huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ rna / ༷ huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ tsakra be ge hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ oX hāX —70—

hāX hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ oX khaṇ+ḍa ro he huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ khwa nywa hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ sho rnyi ni ye huX huX phaṭa/oX huX hūX huX huX phaṭa/ hūX tsakra warmi ṇi ye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li huX hūX phaṭa/ oX su bī re hūṃX hūṃX phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li hūX huX phaṭa/ oX mahā ba le huX huX phaṭa/ oX hi li hi li hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX tsakra warti nī ye hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ mahā bi bye huX hūX phaṭa/ 'khor lo gsum gyi sngags dang / oX kā kā phye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ u lu kā myi hūX huX phaṭa/ oX shwa nā phye hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX snyu kā rā sri huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dā dhī ye huX huX phaṭa/ oX ya ma du ti ye huX huX phaṭa/ oX ya ma doXrno ṇi ye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma ma tha nī ye hūX hūX phaṭa/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags dang / oṃ oX ha/ oX na ma hi/ oṃ swāhā huX/ oX bo ṣaṭa he/ oṃ huX hūX ho/ oṃ phaṭa haX/ oX oṃ baX/ oṃ hāX yoX/ glu khwa moX/ glu khwa nywa/ oṃ hūX hūX/ oX phaṭa phaṭa/ ces pa ni go cha gnyis so/ /gnyis pa nyer bsdu'i rnal ldo1ra ni/ rang gi snying kha'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros te/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad gzhal yas khang dang lha'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/ de bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de gzhal yas khang la thim/ de dam tshig gi 'khor lo la/ de yang sku'i 'khor lo la/ de yang gsung gi 'khor lo la/ de yang thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ de yang bde ba wo po'i 'khor lo la/ de rang nyid la thim/ lha rnams phyogs g.yon bskor dang / mtshams g.yas bskor gyi sna bug nas snying gar bsdu'o// gsum pa spyod lam gyi rnal wor ni/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur/ snying khar oṃ lkoX ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor oṃ na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swāhā huX dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su oṃ —71—

huX huX hoXdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lte bar oṃ oṃ baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying khar oṃ haX yoX sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar 8 ā+oṃ moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral par tso lhu hri ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ huX huX ljang khu skrag byed ma/ tshigs chen brgyad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tshwa ka'i ngo bo/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba'i gdan/ gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa ste yab kyi gnas su yang yum dang / yum gyi gnas su yang yab gnyis su med par gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku/ sdo/myu lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcings yab kyi rkang brgyad tshar gcig brjod/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba sogs dang / lha mo tshad ma sogs dang / srid pa gsum 'bar sogs/ smon lam ci rigs pa btab nas spyod lam 'jug ste dag pa rnam pa gsum dang ma bral bas so /bzhi pa gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ gtor ma gnyis sam/ gcig gis kyang rung ste/ chang chu nang mchod kyis sbyangs/ su snas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud gi dkyil 'khor zla ba phyed pa lta bu/ kha dog sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum pa/ kha dog dmar po 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du āXlas thod pa dkar po dum bu gsum pa dpral pa rang la bstan pa shin tu rgya che ba as mtshan pa/ de'i nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil —72—

'khor ro/ /de'i steng du dbus su na las mi'i sha shar du go las ba glang gi shabyang du da las glang po che'i sha nub tu ha las ta'i sha lhor ku las khyi'i shasha re re'i steng du/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ shar du bi las dri chen/ byang du ma las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du dbus su hū chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ shar du bru me long lta bu'i ye shes/ byang du kha bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ nub tu dzi so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes/ lhor a las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la o dkar po mgo bo thur du lta ba/ de'i steng du ā las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ā yis brgyan pa/ de'i steng du hu las bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi kha ṭā ga dkar po mgo bo thur du bstan pa'am rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa hu gis mtshan pa/ hu de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung gi ba dan la phog /rlung g.yos/ me sbar/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga ye shes lnga 'od du bzhu zhing bskol te tha mal pa sbyangs/de'i rlangs kyi 'od zer steng du 'phros pas o mgo bo thur du lta ba dang / zla ba dang kha ṭa ga'am rdo rje'i lte ba'i hu las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa dang 'dres pas bdud rtsir rtogs par bya/ kha ṭā ga'am rdo rje hu las 'od zer 'phros pas/phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi rang bzhin thod pa bdud rtsi bkang ba dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ mdun gyi bdud rtsi la thim ste ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang gnyis su med par gyur pas mtha' dang dri tri / dang nu pa ༵ ༵ rdo phun ༵ ༵ ༵dhi sngu sdo ༵lto/ ༵ smi rdo rdo/ —73—

gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hriX yang yang brjod do/ /'jig rten 'das pa'i gtor chog la/ mgron bskyed pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa bzhugs par gyur/ zhes pa'o/ /ye shes 'khor lo spyan drangs par bsam ste/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dang bcas la/ h+pha/ zhes brjod/ dzaXhūX baX hoXdagugs gzhug bcing dbang du bya'o/ /oX yo ga shudha sarba dharmāXyo ga shudhe3 haX/ zhes brjod/lkod rgya bya/ ljags huX las byung ba'i rdo rje dkar po 'od kyi sbu gu can huX gis mtshan pas gsol bar bsam zhing / oX ar lpa hoX dzaXhruX baX hoX sa ma ya stum dri khyo ho/ badz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha 'a hi ji hi/ i maX ba li bhu dza thā bi pa tha ma ma kwarla spyo dha ya/ tseX( āXhūX spro h+pha swāhā/ zhes lan bdun sogs brjod/ ar+ghaX la sogs pas mchod/ hūX aX maX taX paX laX/ pu dza o a/ go ra de ma/ kā o tri ko /ka la ka hi/pre gri tre du sdo/ na si ma ku/ hūX brgyad kyi mthar/ skye( āXhuX/ gis nang mchod 'bul/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzugs kyang / /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /bdag la 'phrin las dang dngos grub thams cad gegs med par stsal ba dang / myur du dpal he ru ka nyid kyi go 'phang thob par mdzad du gsol/ ces gsol ba bto pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor chog ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya sngon du 'gro ba'i pad kor dang / skra badz+ra a ra slo hoX dzaXhuX baX hoXbadz+ra ḍā ki ni sa ma ya stum dri khyo hoX rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye bas/ oX kha kha/ kha hi kha hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhū ta/ pre ta/ pi shā tsa/ gi ā dā/ a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā —74—

ki rgyu da ya/ i maX ba li gro : skye/ sa ma ya rak+ta skye/ ma ma sarba sirnyi ma pra ya sne zhe tu ya thi baX/ ya thi niX/ bhañdza thā/ pi pa tha/ dzi ghā tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sar+pā kā ra ta ya sa rlu khaX bi shudha/ ye/ sa hā yi kā bha wan+ta huX hūX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa lan gsum mo/ /rdo rje dril thabs dang bcas pas/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / gnod 'a sbyan srin po'i tshogs 'byung po'i: yi dwags:sha za'i smyo byed: brjed byed: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis 'ches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi zad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las las 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i/ /gnod spyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la rtsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la rtsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la bsrung / /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten ba de zhing lo legs —75—

dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs thams cad 'byung ba dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces brjod cing 'phrin las gzhol/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol sngon du 'gro bas/ tse( khyod kyi sogs dang mgron rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs su gsol/ tse( sku1 ga shu khres sogs/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rang gi lus la bsdu smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /lnga pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor dang / drug pa bya spyod kyi rnal 'byor dang / bdun pa rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor dang / brgyad pa gnyid kyi rnal 'byor dang / dgu pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang / bcu pa khrus kyi rnal 'byor rnams kyang phal cher spyi dang mtshungs shing / khyad chos ci rigs pa dang bcas pa yang gzhung dang man ngag gi rim pas rtogs par bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ brtul zhugs zhal snga'i bzhed don shin tu rtogs par dka'/ /de phyir blo dman bdag ltas gsal bar mi nus mod/ /bla ma'i man ngag kun rig byin rlabs zhugs gyur pas/ khri①da gzhung don la nges pa rnyed de 'di bris so/ /mngon shes med par rgyud don rgya mtsho'i spangs rnams la/ /gzhung bzang 'di don sa 'og gnas pa'i gter bzhin gyur/ /rgyud rim man ngag shes pa'i ltas na gsal 'gyur mod/ /'on kyang rdo rje theg 'di byin rlabs rjes su 'brangs/ /'di las legs byas ci yod pa/ /des ni 'gro kun don gnyis mchog/ dpal ldan he ru kar gyur nas/ /chos dbyings rgya mtshor mnyam gyur cig /ces pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa twa ra nā thas grub chen nag po spyod pa'i gzhung gi dgongs don ji lta ba bzhin du nges par brjod pa ste rang lo zhe gcig pa la ri khrod jo nang du'o/ /bkra shis/dge'o/ khri1ra/ //—76—

lugs kyi gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs bzhu/gas/oṃ swa sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon chen po spyod pa pa'i lugs kyi lag len gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan lhan cig skyes pa'i gzhal med khang na mchog tu dga' ba'i 'bar 'phreng me chen rtag tu 'khrugs/ /ma lus bdud sde'i snying khrag rgya mtsho zhal du rngubs shing drag po sder bcas rdul phran phung por bzhig /zhing gi rdul snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma tshogs kyis bskor bde chen rtse dga' byed pa'i rol pa 'dzin/ /bdag med mi zad dur khrod chen por shes rab mtshan rgyu'i tshogs pas legs bshud he ru ka dpal la phyag 'tshal/ /gang zhig sgoms na mchog dang thun mong gi /dngos grub tshe 'di nyid la 'bad med par/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la ngo mtshar cher skyes nas/ /blo rmongs bdag kyang gnas 'dir rtsol bar gyur/ /nag po spyod pa'i bzhed gzhung rdo rje'i tshig /grub pa'i gnas thob bye bas mngon sgrod pa/ /lam 'di ma nor gsal bar rtogs pa 'ga'/ /dus mthar 'byung ba 'di yang rgyal ba'i mthu/ /'grel bshad 'byam po bltas pa'i blo gros kyis/ /grub pa'i thugs bcud longs pa ga la zhig /rgya gzhung yin zhes paṇa chung 'ga' zhig gi/ gzhung la mchog 'dzin byed pa'ang byis pa'i tshul/ /blun po rang gi de nyid rton pa la/ /zab don mthar thug yin zhes skal dman 'khrul/ /grub pa'i dgongs bzhed rdo rje 'chang gi lam/ /smin byed dbang gi chu bo 'di na ko /de la 'dir de kho na nyid bcu ste/ snyen pa gsol gdabs sa chog dang / /sta gon —77—

dkyil 'khor dri ba dang / /dkyil 'khor sgrub dang mchod bdag 'jug /dbang bskur rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na sngon du bsnyen pa'i bya ba/ gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa/ sa gzhi lhag par gnas pa/ lha slob sta gon gnas pa/ gzugs brnyan 'dri ba'i rnam gzhag /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum sgrub pa mchod pa rgyas pa'i cho ga /'jug cing dbang blang ba/ gzhug cing dbang bskur ba/ nyer bsdu rjes kyi lag len no/ /dang po bsnyen pa'i bya ba ni/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob dpon du 'gyur bas dang por bdag nyid byin gyis rlabs pa'i don du rtsa ba'i bsnyen pa bya ste/ lha'i rnal 'byor la cung zad sems brtan pa dang / rnam par g.yeng ba spangs pa'i sgo nas/ ji skad du mngon brjod las/sngon du bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ /cho ga bzhin du 'bum du bzla/ /'khor lo'i gsang sngags 'bum bzlas zhing / /gzhan ni khri ru bzlas par bya/ /zhes gsungs shing / rgyud gzhan las kyang de ltar gsungs pa dang dbang po rnon pos khri phrag gis kyang 'grub par 'gyur la/ bzhi 'gyur gyi bsnyen pa lan gsum rtsom pa sogs bya zhing / ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags gnyis kyang snga ma'i bcu cha bzla ste/bzlas pa'i bcu cha sbyin sreg kyang bya'o/ /da ltar rtsod pa'i dus kyi tha ma ste/ gnas skabs 'di dag tu yang bye ba'am bye ba lnga bzlas shing / spyin sreg 'bum phrag bcu byas pas ni/ nges par byin gyis brlabs pas nus pa thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyis slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i dus na/ lha la gnang ba zhu ba'i don gyi bsnyen pa la ni/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po khri phrag gsum/ 'khor lo gsum la khri phrag gnyis te/ ma mo bcu gnyis la lnga stong lnga brgya re bzla ba rgyas pa dang / de las 'khor lo gsum gyi bzlas pa spangs pa'i 'bring po dang / gtso bo yab yum kho na bzlas pa bsdus pa'o/ /de dag tu gtor ma dang mchod pa yang nas yang du phul te/ slob ma'i don du gsol ba btab pas/ rmi lam la sogs par snang ba rnyed par 'gyur ro/ /gnang ba thob na ye shes dbab pa'i rdzas byin gyis brlab pa'i bsnyen pa yang bya'o/ /—78—

gnyis pa gsol ba gdab pa'i rim pa ni slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul te/ rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la dgongs su gsol/ yon tan thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i bstan pa legs gnas pa/ /bde mchog cho ga bshad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gsol btab/ slob dpon gyis/ 'khordo ra lo mchod pa'i rim ji bzhin/ khyod kyi thams cad 'byor gyur ram/ /rnal 'byor ma dang rnal 'byor pa/ /gus pas dga' bar byed nus sam/ zhes dris pa la/'byor gyur te/ zhes dang / byed nus so/ /zhes lan gdab bo/ yang 'di skad du/ dam tshig skyong zhing brtan byed pa/ /bu khyod kyis ni spro gyur tam/ zhes pa la/ bdag ni rab tu spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab bo/ skabs 'dir slob ma la bgegs sbyang ba dang / sdig pa sbyangs pa byas pa'i rjes su sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar srung 'bor sgom/ zhal bzhi pa bzlas pa'i srung skud mgul bar btags/ smon lam dang shis brjod bya'o/ /gsum pa sa gzhi lhag par gnas pa la/ sa gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ sa sbyang ba/ sa bslang ba/ sa bzung ba ste bzhi las/ dang po ni spyi dang 'dra zhing gzhung du'ang lta'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rko sbyang dang stegs bu bya ba yin la/ de ltar ma grub na/ o bhu ji/ zhes sogs te spyi dang 'dra'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa sngon du btang nas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed nas brtsams te/ thun mtshams dag pa gsum dran pa'i bar bdag bskyed sgrub thabs ltar rdzogs par sgom/ sa gnon gyis phyag rgyas sor mo dbus ma gsum sa la reg ste/ ḍak+ki ni hu dza oṃ ha/ lan gsum/ ha gi sgra dang hū gi 'od kyis bskul nas/sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa byung / tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyi —79—
