rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo chen khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khres rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ zhes so/ /gnyis pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum gyi thun mong gi sdom pa bzung / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge bas chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje —127—

rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /spyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ni nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa dag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma rgal ba rnams sgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis bgrol/ /dbugs ma 'byin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ ces pa lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bzung gis bar lan gsum gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ngo / /dgu pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ /khyod kyi dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhug la/rdo rje snying gar reg ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ gal te tshul 'di —128—

smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ thod pa nas bdud rtsi'i chu btungs te/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /o pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha tha tha hū/ zhes dam tshig srung ba'i phan yon dang / ma srungs pa'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag deng nas rtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spang par dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyis bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag gobacu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ rtsa a wa dhu tī chu shing gi me tog lta bu'i nang na/ dpyid dang thig le kha sbyor bar gnas pa ni/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/yum rdo rje phag mos 'phyud pa/ bde ba chen po 'bar ba'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/phyogs bzhi ma ta ba la yum bzhi/ mtshams bzhir o yig bzhi thod pa bzhi'i ngo bo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dza o a go ra de ma/ ka o tri ko la ka hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku rnams dpa' bo nyer bzhi yum dang bcas pa'i ngo bo/ bu ga brgyad la hu ring po brgyad sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ngo bo/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas —129—

dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpal he ru ka rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams dkar po'i rnam pas 'jug cing / gtso bo rigs mar bcas pa dang / de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba skru'i bu ga nas zhugs shing snying gar thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ snying ga'i dpa' bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus thams cad bde ba chen pos gang / dkyil 'khor ra gyi lha tshogs rnams las lha tshogs dpag tu med pa char babs pa bzhin tu byung ste snying gar thim/ oX tiṣ+ṭha mahā kro dh+wa ā be sha ya hūX/ oX shrī he ru kā ya bid ma he bi du rā dza ya dhī ma he swāhā/ zhes pa dang / gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags kyang bzla bzhin du/ rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dang rdzas kyi bdug spos dang bcas pas dbab bo/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du ba theg bcu gcig pa nam mkha'i kha dog bri ba ni bdag 'jug gi skabs 'dir mi dgos so/ /bcu gnyis pa me tog 'bul sbyin ni/ oX pra tismo badz+ra ho/ zhes gtso bo 'am rigs mthun pa'i lha la me tog phul/ skabs 'dir/ pra ti gro hā/ sogs kyis me tog spyi bor bcing ba/ 'di ni dkyil chog spyi dang mthun pa'i kha skong ste 'dir med kyang chog go /bcu gsum pa mig dar dbye ba ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje mig ni bla na med/ /oX badz+ra nai tra pa ṭa laX hiX bcu bzhi pa lta bar bskul ba ni/—130—

dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dang ba rab tu bskyed/ /khyed ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub kun khyod mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ zhes spro ba bskyed/ bco lnga pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing yid kyi dkyil snyen ra gsal gdab bo/ /bcu drug pa de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ gzhal med khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun yin la/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun yang de rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bzhugs/ /gnyis med gnyis med pang na gnas/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /spyod dang grol ba rab rtsol ba/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i tshogs/ /grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma lnga po/ /thod pa'i dum bu la sogs kun/ /'khor lo mkha' la spyod pas bskor/ /rab gtum la sogs yang dag 'khyud/ /gnyis po thugs kyi sprul pa yin/ /myu gu can la sogs pa kun/ /rnal 'byor ma brgyad gnyis su med/ /gsung gi rnam dag ngo bo yis mi yi 'jig rten dag tu khyab/ /stobs po che sogs pad gnas pa/ /grub pa sa 'og gnas pa yin/ /sku yi sprul par bshad pa ste/ /chags pa kun gyis rjes su chags/ /he ru ka dpal sogs 'khor lo/ /g.yon nas 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin/ /sku gsum zhes byas sprul pa ste/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma'o/ kha la sogs pa brgyad po yi/ /gzugs ni rgyu yis yang dag bstan/ /khro bo rnam rgyal —131—

la sogs brgyad/ /byang chub sum cu bdun du sprul/ /mkha' la spyod dang sa la spyod/ /sa 'og dag gi ma mo dang / /bzhi po mchod pa bzhi yin te/ /lha rnams de nyid mtshone pa yin/ zhes brjod do/ /gnyis pa dbang gi ngos bzhi la/ bum dbang / gsang dbang / shes rab ye shes/ dbang bzhi pa ste bzhi las/ dang po la rang lugs gzhung don gtsang ma zhib mor bstan pa dang / rnam grangs su bstan pa rgya bod kyi bla ma 'ga' zhig 'dod pa'i man ngag gis kha 'gengs tshul gnyis las/ dang po dbang gi sngon 'gro dang / dbang dngos gzhi dang / mtha' brten te gsum las/ dang po ni/ thog mar slob dpon gyi dbang zhes kyang bya ba bum dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas rtsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng stsol zhig /dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon gyur/ zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i sku la lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs yongs rdzogs gsal bar gyur/ gzhung las/ he ru ka dpal bdag nyid sems/dkyil 'khor lus nang chud byas la/ /pad+ma 'dab brgyad steng du ni/ /zhes sogs kyi don no/ /rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal ba'i steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan g.yon du ba dan/ mtha' bskor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su bskor ba gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor spyan drangs phe/ pur+sha sogs kyis mchod/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon —132—

tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la gnang bar mdzod/ ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ dkyil 'khore gyi lha tshogs rnams dang / dbang gi lha rnams kyi thugs ka nas/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la sogs pa khro bo dang khro mo dpag tu med pa spros nas/ bgegs bskrad cing mi shis pa sbyangs par gyur/yab kyi snying po dang / sum+bha bzlas shing rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ dbang rdzas dang gang zag la nyung dkar rdeg cing las bum gyi chus bsangs/ spos kyi bdugs te byur bsal ba'o/ /skabs 'dir gzhung las/ yang na nus pa med gyur na/ /zhes sogs kyi don ni/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dngos su sprul nus pa'am tshogs kyi dkyil dang yo byad mtha' dag tshang zhing bshams yod na dbang lha spyan 'dren mi dgos te/ rdul tshon la sogs pa'i gnas su sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor ram tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams nyid kyis byur bsal/ shis brjod/ dbang bskur rnams byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de ltar mi nus pa'am yo byad med par mos sgom tsam gyi byed pa la ni dbang lha spyan 'dren pa yang dgos shing / /dmigs pa'i rtsol ba la 'bad par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i don yin no/ /de ltar na dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang / dbang gi lha'i gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ rdo rje phag mo dang yum bzhis rdo rje'i glu blangs/dpa' bo dang dpa' mo rnams kyis mchod pa phul/ nam mkha'i dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ me tog gi char phab ste shis pa brjod par gyur/ cung zad spros pa la dga' na bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pas dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis brjod/ bsdu na de ma byas kyang chog cing de'i sho lo ka dang po tsam brjod kyang rung ngo / /mthar o phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi: zhes sogs kyi dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang / nyin mo bde legs sogs brjod —133—

cing / yab kyi snying po mang du bzlas la me tog gtor/ rol wo bya ste shis pa brjod pa'o/ /me tog 'phreng ba'i dbang bskur ba ni gzhung gi 'gyur dang dpe phal cher las/ lha yi rigs kyi mtshan ma yi/ /me tog ji bzhin gtor bar bya/ /zhes 'byung zhing rim pa gsal ba dang nas gling ma sogs cho ga sgros 'di dang mthun rung 'ga' zhig las kyang bshad pas na/ skabs 'dir me tog 'bul ba nges par dgos pas/ 'di'i 'gyur 'ga' zhig las tshig de med pa ni ma dag par snang la/ 'di dag gis sngags dbang bstan par 'dod pa ni mi legs so/ /de yang me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi lha nges pa can yod na/ der bskyed dgos pa yin kyang / de bzhin med na rigs thams cad kyang khyab bdag yin pa'i phyir/ gtso bo nyid du sgom pas chog ste/ des na/ snya bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid dpal he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ oX pra titsā badz+ra hoX zhes me tog phul/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha la phul ba'i me tog de nyid la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po lan bdun sogs mang du bzlas nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba bud+dhā ḍa ki shī sogs dang / oX dharmā kun da a bhi khri ñtsa huX/ zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/ oX pra ti gro hā staX i maX sa twa ma hā pa la/ zhes bdag gi slob ma rigs kyi lha la gtad par mos/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ gtso bo he ru ka yab yum dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ ba spru'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad rang rigs kyi lha'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ zhes so/ /skabs 'dir ba spu'i bu ga nas sangs rgyas rnams stim ste lus nang gang bar byed pa 'di/ gzhung las me tog dbang bskur la sogs pa thams cad cho ga bzhin sbyin zhing / dkyil 'khor lus nang chud par bya/ zhes gsungs pas bstan te/ bla ma gong ma —134—

rnams dang nā ro pa'i man ngag 'dzin par grags pa'i lo tsā ba rnams 'di la nang dbang gi tha snyad mdzad la/ 'on kyang spyi skad la slob ma bur bya ba la nang dbang du grags ches pa dang / 'khrul gzhi 'byung nye ba'i phyir/ lus nang byin gyis brlobs pa'i dbang bskur zhes bya yi nang dbang gi tha snyad sbyar bar mi bya'o/ /'di chu dbang sogs re re bzhin la yod par thams cad mthun la/ 'on kyang mal lugs pa dang / rwa lugs pa rnams dbang so so'i rjes la byed cing / mar do dang lo chung phyogs rnams/ de 'og rnam rgyal bum pa dang / zhes sogs gzhung tshig gi don du bsams nas/ /thog mar 'di sbyin nas de'i rkyen gyis slob ma lhar bskyed par 'dod de lugs snga ma de legs so/ /'on kyang lus nang gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ mkhas pa'i cho ga bzhin dbang bskur/ /zhes pas ni/slob ma bur bya ba'i nang dbang nyid bstan gyi cig shos min pas/ dkyil 'khor lus nang chud par bya/ /zhes pa dang don mi gcig go /de nas chu dbang ni/ /swa bha was sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i phreng ba'i cod pan can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' mi bskyod pa yab yum spyan drangs/ h+pha dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ /de zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ skabs 'dir rgyas pa la spro na dbang rdzas dbang bskur ba dang / mchod bstod bzlas pa sogs kyang bya la/ bsdu na ye shes pa —135—

spyan 'dren pa yang ma byas pas chog ste/ dkyus su bstan pa ni 'bring po'i dbang du byas pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ bkra shis kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyi nas/ khrus bgyi'o/ /oX ka ka sri/u lu kā myi/ shwa na myi/ su kā ra phye/ ya ma dan khyi/ ya ma du ti/ ya ma goXrme ri ni ya ma ma tha nī ye hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX badz+re bhā wa a bhi khiñtsa huX/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog /lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis drangs te zhal du zhugs/sku'i dbyibs rgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang du babs/ oX swa bhā wa:sogs/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma nyi ma 'jigs byed dus mtshan gyi steng du rang nyid ge rgor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas rang snang ba'i yum la 'phyud pa/ rgyan dang cha byad yongs su rdzogs pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis dang bcas pa skad cig gi grub par gyur/dpral par oX nas/ thugs kar huX gi bar gong bzhin/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis sbyan drangs pa'i/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste/rang la gnyis su med par thim pa'i tshul gyis dbang bskur/ huX zhes mkha' nang nas phyir spros te dbang stegs la 'khod par gyur/ dkyil 'khor dang dbang gi lha rnams la dmigs nas/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje phag mo la sogs pa'i lha thams cad kyis/thod par rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu blug pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po —136—

ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar o sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hū/ zhes pa'i dbang bskur/ bkra shis kyi bum pa logs su med na/ snga ma la rnam rgyal nas bum chus gtor ba tsam bya'o/ /de ltar na bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi skyod pa'i dbu brgyan/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ o badz+ra pur+sha ā hū/ sogs/ nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dgarnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas pa yin no/ /mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ /skabs 'dir gzhung las/ he ru ka dpal bdag nyid sprul/ /spyod dang brtul zhugs brtan pa dang / /de bzhin gnyis med tshangs spyod brtan/ /zhes dang / dpa' bo rnal 'byor rnams kun/ /sgoms nas thams cad dbang bskur ro/ /zhes gsungs pas dbang rdzas rigs lnga so sor dmigs pa 'pho ba yin gyi/ slob ma'am bdag 'jug la rang nyid he ru ka'i nga rgyal kho na la gnas dgos pa dang /thams cad dbang bskur zhes pas lus dkyil 'khor lha thams cad la dbang bskur ba gsal ba'i phyir/ lus dkyil gyi mos pa tsam bsgom dgos pa'ang yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/༈nga/ g.yas ri bye/sa pad+ma po ched ski dhi tī //rdo hūm̐X / 'byung lda dril bu / sku cims / / dog drug/༷/ —137—

brgyan pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug dang: nas/ 'od zer 'phros/ye shes sems dpa' rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum spyan drangs nas/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur byin par bya/zhes so/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje yang dngos su sbyin pa'am yid kyis bsam/ o sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī/ sogs yum gyi snying pos dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs bcings/ o ka ra ka ra ku ru ku sanas/ dhi li hu hū phaṭa/ kyis dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings/ o kā ka phya/sogs dang / gtso bo'i snying po brjod la/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur nas/ yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu brgyan/ de nas lus nang byin gyis brlob pa'i dbang bskur ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ pur+sha sogs kyis mchod/ de ltar na dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag /tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du gyur pa'i skal can du byas pa yin no/ /de ltar na chu cod gnyis las dpag te 'og ma gsum la rigs 'gre ba ni/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan 'dren dang / dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba dang / rigs bdag rgyas 'debs dang / lus nang byin gyis brlob pa'i dbang bskur gyi skabs rnams su/ mi bskyod pa'am rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu —138—

med pa zhes dang / mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab zhes dang / dbang gi dag pa'i skabs kyi/ mi bskyod pa'am rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags zhes pa'i gnas su/ 'od dpag med sogs kyi mtshan 'jug cing / lhag mthong go rim thams cad snga ma bzhin du bya ba yin no/ /de la rdo rje'i dbang ni 'di ltar/dbang rdzas rdo rje 'od dpag med dmar po/ pad+ma dang yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long / oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti stu/ a bhi khiñtsa hū/ tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya stu/ zhes rdo rje lag tu bzung ba'am gtod cing / slob ma dbang bskur na gzhan yang gri gug dang 'khor lo la sogs pa/ mtshan ma rnam pa du ma sbyin par bshad do/ /de nas rdo rje de nyid lan gsum du gsor nas snying gar gtod de/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag ces brjod cing / sems nyid mi 'gyur ba'i bde ba chen por shes pa ni/ rdo rje'i de kho na nyid 'dzin pa'o/ /de nas sngar bzhi brtan byed chu dbang bskur ba sogs bya/rdo rje'i dbang / 'dod chags/ 'du shes/ so sor rtog pa'i/zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ dril bu'i dbang ni 'di ltar/ dbang rdzas dril bu/ don yod grub pa ljang khu/ ral gri dang / yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ 'di ni rnal 'byordo ra ma kun gyi/ khres rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stu/ a bhi lte po rtsi hū/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stu/ zhes dril bu lag tu gtad/ lan gsum mam brgyad du dkrol/ khang —139—

nang du bstan te dku g.yon pa'i thad du bzung ba'am bzung du gzhug /srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyi srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa dam pa byed par gyur/ zhes brjod cing / ngag chos nyid don gyi sgra/ gzhom med kyi nā dar shes par byed pa ni/ dril bu'i de kho na nyid do/ /bstan byed sogs gong bzhin las/dril bu'i dbang / phrag dog 'du byed/ bya ba grub pa'i zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /de nas phyag rgya'i dbang bskur ba ni/bdag nyid dpal he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas/ rang snang bas yum rdo rje phag mo lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu la yang dag par 'khyud pa/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyag rgya chen po yongs su rdzogs pa ste/ rtsa ba'i gtso mo bzhi dang / thig le ni rdo rje phag mo/ dpyid kyi rtsa khams ni dpal he ru ka rtsa sum cu rtsa bdun ni rnal 'byor ma sum cu so bdun/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi/thams cad kyang gsal zhing dwangs la bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin/ kha sbyor dang 'byud pa dang bzhad pa las byung ba'i dga' ba'i ye shes kyi bdag nyid do/ /yid kyi lus brten de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ lte|sa rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khru/da/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung cig rdo rjer byin gyis brlob/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdud par gyis/ lus rnam pa thams cad pa rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i stong pa nyid du —140—

shes pa ni/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig go /zhes dang / gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po mang du bzlas te byin gyis brlab bo/ /'di ni dril bu'i dbang gi rjes 'brang ma yin/ dril bu'i dbang dang 'di sdom pa la bdag po'i dbang zhes bya ba dbang gcig tu byas pa yin zhing / ming gi dbang ni sku byin gyis brlab pa 'di brtan byed kyi tshul du 'gyur ba yin no/ /de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba ni 'di ltar/dbang rdzas rdo rje dang dril bu/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang /yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dkar mo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ o shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti stu/ a bhi 'a ṣañtsa ma/ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal gsang mtshan dran par bya/ sngags brjod skabs rdo rje dril bu spyi bor 'jog /de'i skabs su rnam snang spyi bor byon te/ yab yum snyom par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba'i/ ye shes chen po'i 'od zer gyis/lus thams cad gang bar mos dgos pa yin no/ /brtan byed sogs gong bzhin las/ming gi dbang / gti mug /gzugs phung / chos dbyings kyi/ sogs 'don pa spo/ de nas sngags dbang ni/ mdun bskyed kyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung / bdag gi snying gar thim/ zhes dang gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po tshar gsum bzlas te rjes bzlos byas par mos/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlo bos/ lan gsum brjod cing me tog gtor/ rang gi spyi bor me tog bzhug la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobe/ me tog gtor la/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ sngags dbang 'di gzhung las rgyas bshad kyi skabs su/ phyag rgya'i dam tshig dang / ming dbang gi bar du gsungs/ don bsdu'i skabs su ming dbang gi rjes su gsungs pas gnas skabs gnyis po gang rung byas kyang 'dra'o/ /brtul zhugs la —141—

gnyis las/ thun mong ba rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ swa bha wa/ dbang rdzas dang po'i rdo rje/rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na 'dug /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang / /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stu/ dha ra ya mi hū ha ha ha ha ho hi/ rang gi snying gar rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka bzhugs par gyur/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa brtul la rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul la zhugs shing / rdo rje lag tu gtad la snying gar gtugs/ thun mong ma yin pa'i spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ rang nyid skad cig gi 'khor lo bde mchog /zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i skur gyur/rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i he ru ka hū las byung ba'i cang tes thod pa kha ṭa ga /tshangs skud rnams su gyur/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭa cang te'u lhung bzed dag /byin pa dpa' bo'i bzung bar gyis/ kha ṭa ga dang ḍa ma sa he ru ka dpal kha ṭa ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma sa /rdo rje kha ṭa rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭa ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ ḍa ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrog pa/ kha ṭa ga ni thabs rig pa byang chub kyi sems lha'i sku/ thod pa bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin pas na/ de ltar shes par gyis la sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'o/nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad/ bdag nyid la —142—

gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ kā ka phya hu hu phaṭa/ zhes sogs kyi mthar/ dza hū ba ho.o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra snya hā/ zhes me tog gtor zhing rol mo sgrags te brtan bzhugs bya/ gong bzhin mchod pa'am/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas bdag nyid la mchod do/ /de ltar na ji skad du/ me tog chu yi dbang bskur dang / /cod pan rdo rje bdag po dang / /ming dang sngags dang brtul zhugs dang / /zhes pa ltar dbang brgyad po de dag ni/ bum dbang gi dngos gzhi yin la/'di rnams mtha' brten gyis dbang dang bcas pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ste/ dbang 'di dag las/ dam tshig gsum spyin pa bor nas/ rigs pa'i dbang lnga'i mthar/ rjes gnang gi khyad par 'ga' zhig dang / dam tshig sbyin pa ci rigs pa tsam byed pa ni/ slob ma kha cig skye ba 'di la rdo rje slob dpon gyi gnas thob par mi 'gyur ba dag la spyin par bya ste/ de ltar na de tsam zhig rdo rje slob ma'i dbang du 'gyur gyi/ bum dbang gi cho ga yongs su rdzogs pa gcig gi cho ga'i stod smad la slob ma dang slob dpon gyi dbang dum bu gnyis su dbye ba ni/ gzhung 'di'i dgongs pa ma yin zhing /'di dang cho ga sgros mthun pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga grub pa'i slob dpon gzhan gyis mdzad pa mang po las kyang mi 'byung ngo / /des na skabs 'dir slob dpon gyi dbang zhes bya ba ni/ slob dpon du 'gyur ba la bskur bar bya rgyu'i bum dbang spyi'i ming du bzhed kyi/ slob ma dang slob dpon gyis dbang zhes slob ma gcig la bskur bya la so sor phye ba'i nang gi slob dpon gyi dbang ni ma yin no/ /mtha' brten gyi dbang ni ji skad du/ gnang dang dam tshig gzengs bstod dang / /de bzhin lung bstan dbugs dbyung dang / /zhes pa ltar bzhi las/ dang po rjes gnang gi dbang la lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang de kho na nyid kyi rjes gnang / sems can gyi don gyi rgyu'i rjes gnang / chos 4zhad pa'i rjes gnang / las dang dngos grub sgrub pa'i rjes gnang dang lnga'o/ /de la lha mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ deng nas rtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' —143—

tshogs dang / khes rab thabs bcas snyems can gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis/ a/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phangs/ /sangs rgyas kun tshogs rnal 'byor ma/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ o/ /lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de'i ni rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ gī/ /de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ ho/ sangs rgyas kun la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yis/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ bhu/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur/ a/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis/ pra/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnal grol ye shes mthong ba yis/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bgos/ ga /de kho na nyid kyis rjes gnang ni/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /o badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hri/ sems can gyi don gyi rgyu'i rjes gnang ni me mong bstan la/chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung / /ngo bo nyid med —144—

gnas med pa/ /de ltar lte chas rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skyes/ chos spyod pa'i rjes su gnang ba ni/sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar gyis/ /khyed kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ las sgrub pa'i rjes gnang ni/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang / /gsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yis dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar sgrub par gyis/gnyis pa dam tshig dang sdom pa spyin pa ni/ nang par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las ni byas nas kyang / /bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid kyis bsrung ngo / /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa srung / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzlas par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re srung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis med 'khor lor gnas/ /tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod/ /chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang —145—

mi spong zhing / /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ /khyed kyis brnyes par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya gshone pa mtsho ni cha dang / /mtshan ma 'god par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig rab srung bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par 'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing / /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang / /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/bdag bu khyod ni ma yin te/ /ji srid byang chub 'byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gis 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i/ /bslab pa blangs pa sngon 'gro bas/ /sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu srung / /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid/ /spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'khru/ba 'gyu/ra/ zhes sgrags pa la/gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ zhes lan gsum brjod/ gsum pa gzengs bstod pa ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod pa rtag mnos la/ /'dod pa lnga la spyad par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brdas/ /gnyis med pa dang thogs med par/ /dam tshig spyad pa spyod par gyis/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing / /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ /khro ba med pa'i rgyun gcod pa/ /sgrub pa po ni yongs su srung / /rtag tu sgrub la gnas nas ni/ /yul kun tu ni rnam rol ba/ /gnyis med sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid bar/ /bu —146—

khyod kyis ni sgrub par bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dgar bar ni longs spyod cig /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /bsam nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi dngos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod la chags bral bar/ /khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o/ /zhes so/ 'dir bsrung ba'i dam tshig go /zhes 'byung ba'i srung ba ni skyong ba'i don te/ rig brtul gyi spyod pa'i dam tshig dang /thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig dang / gsang ba'i dam tshig gi sgo nas/ rnal 'byor chen por sngags pa yin pas 'di nyid kho na gzengs bstod kyi don ni/ bzhi pa lung bstan pa'i dbugs dbyung ba ni/he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he badz+ra a ku ri shrī he ru ka nā ma sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa mā ya stu lhur bhu ba su/ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la/ mchog tu grub pa'i tshogs rnams mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba thams cad kyi lung bstan par mdzad do/khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang / /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /der ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tsho med pa yin/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis ni/ /slob ma yon to bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ zhes pa'o/ de rnams kyis ni —147—

dkyil 'khor las rdul tsho ni nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob pas lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin ce sto/ /zhes dag pa dran par bya'o/ /gnyis pa bla ma'i man ngag gis kha 'geng ba'i lugs ltar na/rig pa'i dbang gi skabs su dam tshig gsum mi sbyin/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs kyi mthar/ brtan bzhugs mchod pa rnams spang / slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje hū las byung ba'i rdor sems kyi ngo bor mos/ 'di ste sangs rgyas sogs dang / thog mtha' med pa'i: sogs kyis rdo rje thugs kyi dam tshig bzung / dril bu a las byung ba'i snyems ma'i ngo bo/ mos/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun5 sogs brjod/ rang nyid rdor sems yab yum du bsgom nas/ yid kyi lus brtan/ sogs chu dbang bskur/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu brgyan/ dbang lha stim/ mchod cing brtan bzhugs byas nas/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ zhes sogs bka'i gnang ba spyin pa ste/ ྅ yi pa'i dkyil chog tu rnam par phye zin pa bzhin no/ /'on kyang 'di ni gzhung don dang cung zad mi 'grig pas dkyus su bshad pa nyid bya'o/ /g.yin yang pham thing ba dang rwa lo'i man ngag la/ rig pa'i dbang gi lus nang byin gyis brlob pa'i dbang gi skabs/ sangs rgyas rnams gang la stim pa'i gzhi ni/ chu dang ming la spyi bor zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i oṃ dang / u rgyan dang dril bu la spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje dang / rdo rje'i dbang la/ mgrin par pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug pa sogs bzhed de/man ngag yin pa'i phyir de ltar yang mi 'gal mod/ gzhung gi dgongs pa ni dkyus su bstan pa nyid do/ /gnyis pa gsang ba'i dbang ni/ maṇ+ḍal phul/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te/ gsol ba btab par mos/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyi byin —148—

gyis brlab/ sngags dang phyag rgya phul nas/ kun rtog thams cad rnam spangs pa/ /stong nyid snying po khyod la 'dud/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /ye shes sku khyod phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba'i mi shes bcad nas su/ /de nyid dag pa'i don ston mdzad/ /bdag med chos las kun tu byung / /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan dag /mgon po khyod las byung ba ste/ /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkon mchog gsum dang theg pa che/ khams gsum 'di dag thams cad kyi/ /brtan dang g.yo ba khyod las byung / /'gro ba'i dpa' bo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba'i 'dod don dngos grub rnams/ /yid bzhin nor bu ltar 'byung zhing / /dpal ldan bde gshegs ye shes gnas/ /sangs rgyas sras la phyag 'tshal 'dud/ ces lan gcig gis bstod/ bdag 'jug kho na la 'di ma byas kyang chog go /de nas 'di skad ces/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyod mthu yis/ /de nyid bla med shes par 'tshal/ /rdo rje dbang bskur kun mkhyen gyis/ /bka' drin de ring bdag la gsol/ /bcom ldan khyod zhabs pad+ma ni/ /spangs nas gzhan na skyabs ma mchis/ /'khor ba'i 'gro ba spang pa'i phyir/ /de bas mgon pos brtse bar mdzod/ /sangs rgyas kun la gsang ba che/ /ji ltar dpal ldan thugs rdo rjes/ /rdo rje chos ni bstan pa bzhin/ /mgon pos bdag la bka' drin stsol/zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab bo/ mig dar bcings 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsi gtor la srung ba bya/ slob dpon rig ma dang bcas pa dpal he ru ka yab yum du gyur pas/ 'di skad ces/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmang rigs mthar skyes bud —149—

med kun/ /gus dang bcas pas mchod pa dang / /gnyis med tshul gyis tsum pa ni/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam/ zhes dris pa la/ ci gsungs dam tshig bsten par ni/ /lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ /zhes lan bto par mos/ slob dpon gyi phyag g.yas kyi rdo rje dang / rig ma'i zhabs g.yon rang gi spyi bor bzhag ste/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs dang / /dmangs rigs tha ma dag spyad cing / /pad+ma'i bha gar tsum pa dang / /bdud rtsi rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ lko bka' bgos/ bdud rtsi gtor nas srung ba bya/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs rje'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar/ oṃ ā hu/ bdud rtsi myang / yum gyi byang sems myangs par mos la/ gong bzhin brjod la bdud rtsi myang / ā ho mahā su kha/ zhes brjod/ 'bru gsum gyis gdong g.yogs bsal/ dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ khrag chen po ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan+dan dmar dang yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i chu dang bcas/ /lnga pa sems las byung bar bshad/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /dam tshig 'di ni bla na med/ /bzang po khyod kyis bskyar bar bya/zhes so/ de lta na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob pas ngag gi dri —150—

ma dag lam bzlas pa dang rlung bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ khres rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kyai/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya bsgrubs pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung / /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ ā hu/ mig dar bcings rig dang mthun pa'i phyag rgya gto/ 'di ni byang chub sgrub rnal 'byor/ khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /bdag nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang / phyag rgya rdo rje phag mor gyur/ sgrub thabs bzhin mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang / yab yum gnyis kyis gnas gsum byin rlabs dang / gnas lnga byin rlabs rnams bya/ sangs rgyas thams cad bkug nas/ bdag nyid rig mar bcas pa la thim/ yab yum snyom bar zhugs pa'i dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas/ dang po kun dga' dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/ /rab tu dga' ba ma lus nyid/ /de bde thabs las thams cad rig /o ā hu/ gdong g.yogs dkrol/ srog chags bsad par mi bya ste/ /bud med rin chen smad mi bya/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /dam tshig shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ zhes so/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas/ sems kyi dri ma dag lam dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku mngon du —151—

'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod zhabs pa khi bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/ lan gsum/de ltar yang / zab cing rgya che la mos na/ tshig gis rin chen dbang bskur bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/bzhi pa'i ye shes ni/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa las/ pho nya lhan cig skyes grub ni/ /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ste/ /yid ni nang du chud pa yis/ /'dod pa'i dngos grub sgom par bya/ ces dang / bshad pa'i rgyud las kyang / dngos dang dngos med bral ba yi/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pas sgom bya/ /dngos dang dngos med las grol ba/ /sgom na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ zhes dang / rgyud gas las kyang / ye shes 'di ni che phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/khyod kyis pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes bsam gyis mi khyab pa lhan cig skyes pa'i de kho na nyid/sku dang ye shes zung du 'jug pa ni dbang bzhi pa ste/ gnyis med ye shes dbang bskur ni/ /gsang ba kun la sogs par bshad/ /ces gzhung las gsungs shing / de mtsho ni par byed pa ni phyag rgya gtad pa'i dbang bskur shes rab ye shes so/ /dam tshig sgrags pa ni/ khyod kyis srog chags gsad par bya/ /rdzun gyi tshig kyang smra bar bya/ /ma byin par yang khyod kyis long / /pha rol bud med bsten par bya/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag sgo gsum mi phyed pa rdo rje lta bur gyur/ lam bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa sgom pa la dbang 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /dbang rnams kyi thun mong du rjes gnang sbyin pa ni/ byang —152—

chub snying po'i mthar thug par/ /chos kyi 'khor lo kun tu ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa/ /kun nas rab tu skor bar gyis/ khres rab thabs kyi rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ji bzhin du/ /skye med dgos dang bral ba yis/ /da ni sems can don rnams kyis/ zhes so/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ sogs lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul te/ deng bdag skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ /bdag gi gson pa'ang 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sangs rgyas sras su da 'gyur to/ /zhes dang / deng nas brtsam te/sogs dge ba bsngo'o/ /dgu pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ phal cher bdag 'jug gis rigs 'gre ba yin la/slob ma rnams gral du 'dus ma thag tu/ dkyil 'khor la byed pa bzhin bgegs sbyang rgyas pa de bya/dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i skabs kyi sdom pa mdor bstan dang / dam rdzas sbyin pa song mtshams su/bu tshur theg pa chen po yi sogs brjod/ phyogs bzhi phyag 'tshal gyis skabs/ mkha' 'gro ma bzhi'i sngags kyis khrid nas sgo phye ba yin te/ dang por/ o ḍā ki nī ye hu hu phaṭa/ ces phyi rol nas slob ma khrid par mos/ sngags de nyid dam badz+ra ud gha ṭa'i sngags kyi sgo phye nas/ shar sgo'i phyag 'tshal byed pa sogs te gzhan la'ang rigs 'gre/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i sbog chog ni/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas rdo rje rgya gram dmar po las 'od 'phros shangs bug g.yas nas thon slob ma'i sna bug g.yas nas zhugs/ dpral par rdo rje rgya gram dmar po 'od 'phro bar gyur/ ye shes sems dpa' ā li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs te stim pas/ lus kyi nang sngags kyi yig 'khrus gang ba la sems gtad de/ rol mo'i sgra bya/ des kyang ma phebs na spyi bor bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa'i 'od zer gyis lus kyis nang gang bar bsam pa'o/ /zhes pa bla ma —153—

rnams kyis man ngag go /ye shes phab pa brtan byed byas ma thag tu nam mkha'i kha dog dris nas/kha tog dang mthun pa'i las dang dngos grub kyang lung ston pa dgos so/ /lha ngo bstan pa la nges par mngon rtogs rgyas par ston dgos la/ byur bsal ba'i sngon du/ bgegs sbyang ba byas kyang rung zhing legs la/ 'dir byas na gong du bgegs sbyar ba mi dgos so/ /gang ltar yang bdag 'jug gi skabs su bshad pa'i byur bsal ba de song ma thag tu/ za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sdig pa sbyang ba nges par byed dgos so/ khres brjod kyi skabs su 'grub na/ sha dang / chang dang / gong bu dang khu ba'i rdzas sna tshogs pa byin gyis rlabs te/ slob ma'i mtha' yang bskor/ dbang gi lha rnams la gtor ma'i tshul du 'bul ba yang bya zhing / gang ltar yang rnam rgyal bum pa bteg cing mchod pa sna tshogs dang bcas nas bya'o/ /spro zhing nus na slob dpon dang slob ma'i lus dkyil gsal 'debs pa'i skabs kyang rgyas par brjod na legs so/ /'di dag zhib mor lag len dang ngag rgyun las shes par bya'o/ /khyad par dngos su dbang stegs 'cha' thub na shin tu legs te dkyil chog thams cad kyi dgongs pa yin la/ khyad par gzhung 'di las slob ma'ang rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa sogs chas su 'jug par bshad do/ /ming dbang skabs ming 'dogs pa la/ ba 'ad dang sgeg rol ngo mtshar zhe sdang dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' rang byung rdo rje sogs/ rdo rje'i rigs med de nyid bud med la/ /bdag med ngo mtshar bde ma sgeg sgru'o/ /ye shes rtag pa gti mug rnam snang dang / /sgyu 'phrul sku dang sangs rgyas de bzhin gshegs/ /rnam snang rigs yin de bzhin bud med la/ /rdo rje spyan ma mkha' 'gro ma sgyu ma/ /yan lag med dang dga' ba shin tu bde/ /gzi brjid snang byed rdo rje rin chen la'o/ /bud med la ni rdo rje 'bar ma dang / /mgyogs ma ro langs ma dang lcags kyu ma'o/ /pad+ma pad myug 'dod chags 'jig rten mgon/ /pad+ma gar dbang dang ni rdo rje chos/ /pad+ma'i chi rigs la'o rdo rje phreng ba ma/ /sgeg mo bzhad mo 'byud ma bud med la'o/ /nam mkha' shes rab myu gu —154—

rta mchog dang / /don yod don yod grub pa las kyi ste/ /rdo rje sgrol ma gar ma kong ka na/ /do shal ma ste las rigs bud med do/ /rnam rgyal dpe med ro mnyam bde chen dang / /dam pa dang po phyag na rdo rje ni/ /rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi skyes pa'i ming / /rdo rje snyems ma rdo rje mtshon cha ma/ khres rab pha rol phyin ma sogs bud med/ g.yin yang me tog gang la phog pa yi/ /mtshan yang ji ltar 'os pa gdags su rung / /rgyas par rdo rje gur las shes par bya/ /zhes bya'o/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bcu pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ spyin sreg dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa sogs byas nas/ yang dkyil 'khor la mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ byin gyis brlabs/ mchod yon sogs sngags tsam mam tshigs bcad dang bcas pas kyang rung ste phyi mchod phul/ rig ma bcu drug dang nang mchod dang gsang mchod rnams sngags tsam gyis bya/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyis thugs dgongs rdzogs shing / zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang / khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu sbyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ lho phyogs nas yi ge brgya pa bzlas/ ma 'byordo ra pa dang sogs sam/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol lo/ /bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sems sgrib pa —155—

dang ldan pa dang / yo byad ma tshang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang /sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad kha skong zhing /bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi las dang dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo/ /ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin nam/ ma yin kyang rten gzhan yod na brtan bzhugs bya ste/phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la/ zhes sam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la zhes sam/ sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la/zhes gang 'os skabs dang sbyar te/ bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad/ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes me tog gtor/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor yin la gzhan rten sku sogs med cing / sgrub mchod zhag sbrel byed pa'i skabs/ nyi ma snga ma rnams la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gshegs gsol gyi cho ga ma byas kyi bar du brten par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can —156—

thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes pa tsam gyi brtan bzhugs bya/ rdul tsho ni gshegs gsol gyi nyin mo de yang mi dgos so/ /de nas gshegs gsol ni/ o khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsole/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /o ā hu badz+ra mu zhes te zhag sbrel mar byed pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la ni/ rten la ma brten pa'i mgron kho na khri de yang kagashegs su gsol ba yin zhing / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i skabs/ yin na/ de steng du bum bskyed kyang gshegs dgos la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i dus ni dkyil 'khor ba yang gshegs pa yin te/ de yang badz+ra muyan gyis mgron rnams gshegs/ bum bskyed dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha ni gtan las 'phags te nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ lko yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shudhe ྅ ha/ zhes rnam lnga 'dod skor dang / 'khyud rgya byas pas/ de rnams rang nyid la thim par mos/ de ltar lan gsum byas nas rdo rje'i rtse mos rtsig pa dang thig gi lam dbye zhing / lha mtshan rnams logs su bsdu don du gnyer ba nyid na cung zad sbyin/ rdul mtshon rnams bum pa la sogs par blugs te/ bkur bsti dang bcas pa'i chu bor sbyan 'dren/ rdul tshon klu la gtad/ bum par chu bo de nas chu blangs te/ thig rnams bsrubs/ phur bu dbyung ngo / /de dag gi cho ga gzhan ni spyi dang mthun la/ phur bu ni rang rang gi sngags kyis bton la/ shul du mar dang sbrang rtsis byug mthar smon lam mang du gdab/ bkra shis rgya cher bya'o/ /ras bris kyi phyogs la ni/ brtan bzhugs byas ma thag tu smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ spyod 'chang zhabs kyi gzhung lugs rtogs dka' te/ /phyogs 'dir 'grel brtsams pa mang yod kyang / /rnam bshad phal cher 'khyog po'i lam du 'dren/ /dkyil chog rnams —157—

kyang rang bzo'i bzlos gar sgyur/ /dgongs 'grel sgyu ma mkhan po'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /don gnyer skye bo'i blo mig lan brgyar bslangs/ /rang rang mthun phyir gzhung tshig dkrug pa dang / 'khyog bshad mang pos gzhung bzang dri mar byas/ mkhas mchog rdo rje 'dzin par grags 'gas kyang / /'di don ji bzhin gsal bar ma rtogs na/ /phrag dog can gyi blun po mkhas 'dod 'gas/ /'di don shes su re ba ha cang 'khrul/ /de slad nag po'i dgongs don ji bzhin du/ /dag cing gsal la ma 'khrugs go bde ba/ /mdor bsdus tshig gis gzhung chen shes pa 'di/ khri/ba pa'i dbang phyug gang de'i smon lam mthu/ /'di las dge ba gang zhig thob gyur pa/ /de ni 'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag kyang 'khor ba ji srid gnas kyi bar/ /srid par gnas nas sems can don sgrub shog /ces slob dpon wo po spyod pa pa'i lugs kyi/ dkyil 'khor cho ga'i lag len gsal byed bde ba chen po'i char yangs zhes bya ba 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o/ /lha yi pa'i dbang chog kyang nag po spyod pa'i dkyil chog la gzhi gdan byed phyin chad/ dkyil chog gzhan dang go bstun ma sbyar bar/ 'dir bshad pa kho na bzhin byas na yang shin tu legs pa yin no/ /dge legs 'phel// //—158—

'jug ngogs bzhugs/oṃ swa skyi/ bde chen srid zhi kun gyi khyab bdag ni/ /'gyur bral rdo rje bzhi yi rnam rol gyis/mkha' mnyam srid 'dir nam yang dag pa'i rgyun/ /rtag tu spro mdzad zung 'jug de la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje slob dpon la/ /dngos po kun gyis lan brgyar phyag 'tshal nas/ /rtags pa'i rim pa las kyang gdod ma'i tshul/ /mngon du byed pa'i thabs 'di 'chad par 'dod/ /grub pa'i dbang phyug 'bum gyis legs btud pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug ྅ yi'i bzhed don gang / /'khor lo'i dbang phyug sgrub pa'i thabs bzang po/ /rig sngags dbang phyug rnams kyis brten par 'os/ /dang por snang ba thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rjer shes pas/ dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pa dang bcas te khrus bya/ de nas rnal 'byor la 'jug pa'i thog mar/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa dang yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyang ba rnams bya ste/ de yang 'di skad ces/bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ sku gsung thugs yon tan 'phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdagarje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su —159—

mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan bdun la sogs pa bya/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i phyir du lam zab mo bsgom par bgyi'o/ /lan gsum/kye ma sems can sdug bsngal zhing / /kun rtog la ni mngon par chen/ /de yi rtog pa gzhom phyir bdag /dpal ldan he ru ka sgom bya/ /gas yang spro na skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o/ /rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ hu las rdo rje hu gis mtshan pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gi bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hu dkar po de las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsir spyan drangs nas hū la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu —160—

gsol/ o shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa mā ya ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra ru ka tī no pa sta ḍi rdo me bhā wa/ su to stso me bha wa/ a nu ra lto me bha wa/ su po khyo me bha wa/ sarba sirnyi me pra ca sarba karma su tsa me tsit+ta shri ya ku ru hū ha ha ha ha ho/ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka mā me muñtsa he ru ko bha wa mahā sa ma ya satwa ā hūṃ phaṭa/ zhes ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar/ mgon po/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyobs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ rdor sems yab yum rang la thim par bsgom mo/ /rnal 'byor dngos la dbye na/ mnyam gzhag dang / mnyam langs gnyis so/ /nga po la dgu ste/ gnas sam gzhi'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ byin gyis brlab pa'i rnal 'byor/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor/ mchod pa'i rnal 'byor/ nye bar bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la/ rang bzhin gyi gzhi dang lam gyi gzhi gnyis so/ /dang po ni dam rdzas kyi ril bu khar bcug pa'am/ nang mchod byin gyis rlabs nas lte la bzhag cing / mi bzad pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su mi ro'i gdan la 'dug par bsam nas/'di skad ces/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /yid dag pa'o/ /rang skad cig gis 'khor ra lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pa can du gyur/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka ste sems can thams cad la phan par bya'o/ /shrī he ru ko3 ha/ lan gsum/ lus —161—

dag pa'o/ /oṃ a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa '-i lī e i tse( skye( a a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hu hū phaṭa/ lan gsum/ lte bar 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa'i ā li g.yas bskor dang kā '-i g.yon bskor du lan gsum gyis bskor nas gnas pa las/'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa spros/ lko ā hu ā '-i las spros pa rnams sna bug g.yas dang / kā '-i las spros pa rnams g.yon nas mthon te/bgegs kyi tshogs rnams bcom/ oṃ ā hū/ slar yang lte ba'i sngags 'phreng la thim/ ngag dag pa'o/ /lus ngag yid gsum dag pas/ rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug tu 'gro ba'i phyir/gzhung las/ dang por re zhig rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi /zhes gsungs pas 'di bstan par lwa ba'i zhabs kyis bshad do/ /lam gyi gzhi la tshangs pa'i gnas gzhi sgom pa/ phung khams lhar dag pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa/ sbyor ba tshogs gnyis bsags pa ste bzhi las/ dang po ni/sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig /sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms tshad med pa la gnas par gyur cig gnyis pa ni/ gzugs kyi phung po la rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la rdo rje nyi ma 'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna la phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la 'dod chags rdo —162—

rje'o/ /lus la ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la lhung byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma'o/ /nam mkha'i khams la pad+ma dra ba can no/ /de thams cad kyang stong nyid ye shes rdo rje don dam pa'i lha'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes brjod/ bsdu na de tsam gyis chog ste/nga rgyal la slab pa'o/ /rgyas pa la mos na rnam pa la slab par bya ste/ /snga ma'i rjes thogs nyid du 'di skad ces/mgo bor gzugs phung bhu yig las/ /rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo/ /lte bar tshor phung a rdo rje/ /nyi ma ser po g.yas rin chen/ /mgrin par 'du shes hi dmar po/ /pad+ma gar dbang g.yas pad+ma/ /long bur 'du byed hā ljang khu/ /rgyal po sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas/ /snying gar rnam shes hu dkar las/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rdo rje g.yas/ /phung po lnga ni ro mnyam pa/ /spyi gtsug hi yig de gzhin nyid/ /he ru ka nag g.yas rdo rje/ /mig tu o las dkar po ni/ /gti mug rdo rje g.yas 'khor lo/ /rna bar hu las nag po ni/ /zhe sdang rdo rje rdo rje g.yas/ /snar ni tra las ser po ste/ /ser sna rdo rje g.yas nor bu/ /lce rtsar ā las dmar po ste/ /'dod chags rdo rje g.yas pad ma/ /dpral par kha las ljang khu ste/ /phrag dog sna tshogs rdo rje g.yas/ /snying gar ha las dkar po ste/ /dbang phyug dang po'i rdo rje 'dzin/ /phung po skye mched lha de rnams/ /kun kyang g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin/ /dbu rgyan ral pa'i cod pan 'dzin/ /sa khams ser po lte bar la/ /ltung byed 'khor lo g.yas dang po'o/ /chu khams nag —163—

po snying gar mā/ /gsol byed rdo rje g.yas dang po'o/ /me khams dmar po mgrin par pa/ /'gugs byed pad+ma g.yas dang po'o/ /rlud khams ljang khu dpral par tā/ /gar dbang ral gri g.yas dang po'o/ /de rnams phyag bzhi g.yas 'og ma'i/ /gri gug 'dzin cing g.yon gnyis na/ /thod pa dang ni kha ṭā 'dzin/ /mkha' khams dud kha gsang bar kha/ /zhal gsum phyag drug dra ba can/ /dung dkar dmar ba g.yas gsum na/ /lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug 'dzin/ /g.yon pa gsum na thod pa dang / kha ṭā ga dang zhags pa bsnams/ /lnga char dbu skra grol ba ste/ /phung khams skye mched lha bcu bdun/ spyan gsum g.yas rkyang stabs kyis bzhugs/ /o pra kri ta pa ri shudha sarba dharmā pra kri ta pa ri shu rje3 ha/'dir phung po/ skye mched kyi lha bcu gnyis las rnam snang sogs bzhi dang / gti mug rdo rje sogs lnga ste dgu po g.yas phyag mtshan 'phyar ba dang / rnam snang g.yon dkur bsten pa dang /gzhan rnams g.yon thugs kar gtod pa dang / lhag ma gsum po g.yon dkur bsten zhing / he ru ka g.yas sa gnon/ gzhan gnyis g.yas thugs kar bsten pa yin par 'grel pa'i dpe phal cher las bshad mod/ he ru ka sa gnon du byas pa ni dpe ma dag par mngon no/ /des na de yang thugs kar gtod pa'o/ /'on kyang phyag gi stangs ka gcig tu nges bzung dka' ba'i so so'i man ngag ltar bya'o/ /gsum pa la thog mar gur gyis srung ba ni/ sdig 'dzub dang se gol gtogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ phyogs bzhi g.yas bskor gyis/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha hu hū phaṭa/ oṃ grihā spo hā hū hu phaṭa/ o gro hā pā ya spo hā pā ya hu hu phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān bi du rā dza hū hu phaṭa/ 'od zer 'bar ba sngags kyi lus chen po/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa spros pas bgegs thams cad tshar bcad/—164—

'od zer phyogs kyi mdog can du 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi pa dang / hū las byung zhing hu gis mtshan pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor la thug pa dang / hu gi 'od zer las byung ba'i steng dang logs kun tu rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i mda'i dra ba dang / de'i 'og tu rdo rje'i gur dang bla bre/ phyi nang thams cad du bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo gyur/ oṃ mi dī ni badz+re bha wa badz+ra ban+ta hu/ o badz+ra pra kā ra hu pa hū/ o badz+ra pañtsa ra hu ya hu/ o badz+ra bi ta na hū kha hu/ o badz+ra sa ra dzā la tra sa tra/ o badz+ra dzā la a na lwarka hu hu hū/ sngags rnams lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /phyi nas bgegs la phur bus gdab pa ni/ yang sdig 'dzub skor zhing mtheb 'dzub kyi se gol phyogs bzhir gtogs pa'i mtshams rngam dang bcas/ sdo/nga la sogs pa zhal bzhi pas sngags lan gnyis brjod/ phyogs bzhi'i sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo ma bzhi dang / 'od zer gnyis gnyis 'dus pa las mtshams ma bzhir gyur pa ni/ shar dang steng du khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du lug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ ltor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lto nub tu gzhan rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can/ g.yas rdo rje tho ba dang / g.yon rang mtshungs kyi phur bu thogs pa rnams su gyur te/ rnam 'khrul dpag tu med pa spros nas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad phyogs skyong gi rnam par bkug hu/ ring po brgyad brjod/—165—

hūX/ las byung ba'i khron pa brgyad phyogs mtshams brgyad du gnas par gyur pa rnams su/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bcug de rnams kyi spyi bor phur bus btang/ skye rna gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya sarba du spyin/ hūX huX phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX hūX hūX phaṭa/ huX hūX huX badz+ra gī la badz+ra dha ro a dz+nyā pa ya ti bi rna badz+ra gī la ya huX phaṭa/ lan bcu'am brgyad dam bsdu na gsum mo// phur bu rnams rdo rje tho bas rdungs par gyur/oṃ badz+ra mud gā ra badz+ra gī la ā ko ṭa ya huX huX phaṭa/ grangs snga ma bzhin brjod/bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar du phug pas/ bde ba chen po de bzhin nyid dang ro gcig tu gyur zhing / lhag ma rnams kyang tshar bcad/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje ra ba la thim/ 'od zer phyir 'phros pa las/ rdo rje dang / pad+ma dang / 'khor lo'i ra ba zlum po rim pa gsum dum bu gcig tu gyur pas/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad mtshams bcings par gyur/ spros pa la dga' na/ glu( badz+ra pra kā ra skyoX/ sogs gsum dang / me sngags te sngags bzhi po brjod kyang rung ngo / /bzhi pa la gnyis las/ dang po bsod nams kyi tshogs ni/ srung 'khor gyi dbus su rang nyid he ru ka gsal ba'i thugs kar/ paX las sna tshogs pad+ma dang / aX las zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo huX sngo skya ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ 'od zer lnga rnams 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus nang thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma sbyangs ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yab yum zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad spyan drangs te/ 'od zer rnams rang gi snying gar thim/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen —166—

nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyi/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang zhing / /'dus dang dur khrod gnas pa yi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma/ /kun la bdag ni gus phyag 'tshal/ /shrī he ru ka a lhe nas/ pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā du/ de nas spro na/ 'grel pa las bshad pa ltar lha mo bcu drug gis mchod/ bsdu na/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha ā hu/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ā lo ka /ga rnye/ ni wi te/ sha lta zhes sbyar/ 'og nas 'byung ba ltar rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod/ bsgrod dka' srid pa'i rgya mtsho las/ /bdag gis 'gro rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /rang gi bdag nyid skad cig la/ /sangs rgyas rnams la dbul bar bgyi/ /zhes pa lan gcig dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du bdag skyabs mchi/ /rang bzhan don ni rab sgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum/ bar 'dir spro na thugs rgyud bskul ba'i don du yig brgya/ bzlas mi spro na mi dgos so/ /tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim/ /gnyis pa ye shes tshogs bsog ni/ snying gar he nag po/ mgrin par ru dmar po/ dpral par ka dkar po/ /yi ge gsum gyi don —167—

sgom bzhin du/ chos thams cad skye ba med pa la/ bdag dang bdag gir bzung bas sems can rnams 'khor bar gyur te/ de'i phyir bdag dpal he ru kar gyur nas/ gzung 'dzin dang bral ba'i tshul ji lta ba nyid du chos thams cad khong du chud par bgyi'o/ /oṃ su bhā ba shudha sarba dharma swa bhā wa kyo3haX/ chos la dmigs pa'o/ /sems nyid nā da tsam gyi gzugs can de/ oṃ dkar po/ āXdamar po/ huX sngon po rnams steng nas steng du rtsegs pa/ de rnams las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ gnas gsum gyi sems can thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus rjes chags kyi zhu nas 'khru gsum la thim/ oX āXl thim/ ā hūX la thim/ huX gi zhabs kyu khog pa la thim/ khog pa mgo bo la/ mgo bo zla tshes la/ zla tshes thig le la/ thig le nā da la/ nā da skra'i rtse mo brgya stong gi cha tsam mo/ /sems can thams cad chos nyid khong du ma chud pas 'khor bar gyur te/ bdag gi chos nyid rtogs pas byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur bar bya'o/ /nā da yang mi dmigs par gyur/ oṃ shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ dmigs pa med pa'o/ /gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ stong pa'i ngang las nā da dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa nam mkhar bzhag de'i snang cha las byung ba/ 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/de'i steng du baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pas mtshan pa/de'i steng du laX las sa'i dkyil snyen ra ser po gru bzhi rdo rjes mtshan pa/ de'i —168—

steng du su las ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin can/ lcog brgyad dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i nye bar/ hū las sna tshogs rdo rje/ shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus sngo ba/ de'i steng du pa las sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'o/ /gsum pa 'jug pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ pad+ma'i lte bar g.yon bskor gyi/ a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa '-i lī e i o au a a/ tshar gnyis/ mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo de yongs su gyur pa las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dang po me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i steng du g.yas bskor gyi/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa lha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ka tshar gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gnyis pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /skabs 'dir nyi zla 'am zla ba dkar dmar kha spyor dang / de yang so so'i yi ges mtshan pa dang zla ba dkar po kha spyor dang /dbyangs gsal rnams las zla ba gcig pu/ kha dog dmar po'am/ dmar skya'am/ dkar po sgom pa sogs gang ltar yang spyir ni mi 'gal la/ kha sbyor mi byed na ye shes dang po gsum gyi dag pa sbyor tshul mi 'dra ba dgos so/ /stong nyid sgom pa nas de'i bar ni rnal 'byor dang po'o/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i nā da de nyid zla ba kha sbyor gyi dbus su zhugs/ de las thig le/ de las zla tshes/ de las mgo bo/ de las ha/ de las zhabs kyu ste/ hū yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can/ mchog tu dga' ba/ rgyu rdo rje 'chang gi ngo bo ni/ so sor kun tu rtog pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs mtha' yas pa sprul/ 'gro ba thams —169—

cad 'khor lo lnga'i rang bzhin du byas/ de rnams dang gdod ma'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spyan drangs/ thams cad slar 'dus rjes chags kyis zhu ba hūX yig gi nā da la thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /de gnyis rjes su rnal wor ro/ /bzhi pa yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor la gsum te/ sprul pa'i dkyil snye bor sgom pa/lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa/ chos kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'o/ /dang po ni/ zla ba hūX yig dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa lhan cig skyes dga'/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /oX āXhuX sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wā stsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa at+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ badz+ra sko khri sdo sarba dharmaXbadz+ra shurnyo3 haX/ ri rab kyi rtse mor srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje nye bar/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du nag po ljang khu dmar po ser po dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i pha gu dmar po'am ser po la rin po che'i phra yis mdzes pa/ de'i steng du rin po che'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang dril bu g.yer kha'i 'phreng ba dang / dar gyi chun 'phyang dang / zla ba rlung gis skyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pas brgyan pa/ de'i steng du bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i ba ku li dang / steng du mda' yab pad+ma phyed pa'i rnam pas brgyan pa la/ sna tshogs pa'i gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang ba dan la sogs pas mdzes pa/ gzhal yas khang gi dbus su in+d+ra nī la'i sa gzhi zlum —170—

por grub pa la gnas pa'i/ sde bor lo rim pa bzhi mchod rten zlum po'i bang rim gyi dbyibs ltar cung zad je mtho je mthor gyur pa'i lte bar bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa rtsa ba sdong bu ge sar dang bcas pa'i phyi rol du rin po che'am/ gri gug gis mtshan pa'i/ ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phug la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyir rol du thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs brgyad pa rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po rtsibs brgyad pa pad+ma'i mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ de'i phyi rol tu sku'i ge nar lo dkar po rtsibs brgyad pa 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang / ka ba dang / gdung dang / thog phub la sogs pas mdzes par byas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi nang gi gzhi dam tshig 'khor lo dang steng thog gi mdog ni/ shar dkar/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser ba/ gtso bo'i gnas kyi dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor/ rdo rje dang rin po che tog gis brgyan pa/sgo 'byud kyi phugs dang / rtsig pa'i zur la/ zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i nor bus brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi 'gram na 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po'i steng na mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gis mchod rdzas du ma thogs nas 'khod pa/sgo khang bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs snam bu bcu gcig dang ldan pa'i rtse mor/ pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang /g.yas g.yon du ri dwags pho mo dang bcas pa/ gzhal yas khang gi phyi rol gyi —171—

khyam la mchod rdzas du mas mdzes pa/ de'i phyi rol du dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/shar du drag tu gtum pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/bden bral du mun pa mi zad pa/ rlud du ki li ki li'i sgra rab tu sgrog pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha dgod pa'o/ khreng brgyad ni shar du shi ri sha /byang du a shod tha/nub tu kang ke la/ lhor tsu ta/ mer ka ra mi bden bral du la ta par ka ti/ rlung du pa rte pa ta/ dbang ldan du bā tre'o/ phyogs skyong brgyad ni/ shar du dbang po/byang du gnod sbyin/ nub tu chu lha/ lhor gshin rje/ mer byin za/ bden bral du srin po/ /rlung du rlung bdag dbang ldan du 'byung po'o/ /klu brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas/ byang du 'jog po/ nub tu stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor pad+ma/ mer hū lun ta/bden bral du rigs ldan/ rlung du dung skyong / dbang ldan du pad+ma r+ṣa po'o/ /sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ shar du sgra grags pa/ byang du smugs pa/ nub tu mun pa can/ lhor kun tu 'khyil ba/ mer gang ba/ bden bral du 'bab pa/ rlud du drag po/ dbang ldan du 'khrigs pa'o/ khreng rnams la brten pa'i zhing skyong brgyad ni/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi gzugs 'dzin pa'o/ /gzhan yang dur khrod de dag tu chu chen po brgyad dang / me chen po brgyad dang / ri chen po brgyad dang /mchod rten brgyad la sogs pas yongs su gang ba ste/ gzhan yang ro dang keng rus dang / gsal shing gis phug pa dang / dpyangs pa dang / dum bu dang 'thor ba la sogs pas gang ba/ bya dang / gcan gzan sna tshogs lang long du rgyu zhing /lce spyang gi sgras khyab pa/ grub chen rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa'i slob dpon dang /—172—

dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang /'jigs pa'i gzugs can dang / ro langs dang / 'gyung po dang / srin po dang sha za du mas khyab pa/ dngos grub kyi rdzas dang mchod pa sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte bar 'khor lo bde mchog bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer can gyi sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa char sprin gsar pa'i mdog can cher khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/ g.yon zhal ljang gu/ rgyab zhal dmar po/ g.yas zhal ser po zhal re re la dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrug pas spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba rnon po gtsigs pa/ rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa rgyangs te 'dzin pas tshul gyis stod sa/yogs su bsnams pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍa ma sa bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa ni gri gug /drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na rdo rje mtshan pa'i kha ṭa ga /bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ zhabs g.yas rkyang bas dus mtshan dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu ma'i steng dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris grol ba/ ral pa'i cod pan thor tshugs bcings —173—

pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i nor bu dang / g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang / ral pa'i mdun ngos la sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la brgyus pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ spyi bo'i nor bu dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang / tshangs skud dang / thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang / zhabs gdub dang dpung gdub dang / 'og pag las dpyangs pa rus pa'i drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas pa'i ske rags la sogs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ / dgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/de'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yon pas bdud sogs gdug pa can gyi khrag dang / mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin zhing / yab kyi mgul nas 'khrud pas rgyab zhal du stob pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rje'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs kun rnam par gnon zhing sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can thams cad bsdigs par mdzad pa/ gcer bu ba sbu langs shing / dbu skra sil bur grol ba/ nu ma 'khrang zhing rgyas la lang tsho la bab pa/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'phyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang / thod pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang bde ba chen po dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid —174—

can/ dus mtha'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ hū dkar po las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ byā las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po rtse mor byā ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmi gas te/ stong pa'i ngang las ā dmar po las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ khyu las byung ba'i ze'u 'khru dkar po rtse mo sdi ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang yum gyi mgrin par zla ba la/ o badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi thugs ka dang yum gyi dpral par zla gdan la/ o sarba bzhi ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra brta shī ye hu hu phaṭa swāhā/yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la/ o shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka hu hu phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sa ba ra swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang yum gyi thugs kar/ nyi gdan la o hru ha ha hū hū phaṭa/ sngags rnams kha dog dmar po g.yon bskor du gnas shing 'od zer 'phro ba/ yab yum phan tshun zhal sbyor ba na/ sngags dang 'od zer sbyor bas kyang 'khyud cing / oṃ ā hū snyoms par zhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyas shing brtan par gyur/ bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/ byang du lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha dmar mo/ lhor gzugs can ma ser mo/ bzhi char yang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang ḍā ma sa g.yon gnyis kyi thod khrag dang kha ṭa ga 'dzin pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / mi ma sto do shal dang / rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer mo lang tsho la bab —175—
