cing / bha ga dang nu 'bur mtho ba/ bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir bdud rtsis lngas gang ba'i bum pa'i steng du/ ka pā la byang chub kyi sems la sogs pas gang ba dang bcas par gyur/ de'i phyi rol du thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs pu zhir ma yar/ thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo/ /byang rtsibs dza lan+ta rar keng rus chen po dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ nub rtsibs o ṭi ya ṇa ra keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ lho rtsibs arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma shar lho go da war ri lha'i dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ lho nub ri sma shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/nub byang de bi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ byang shar ma la bar rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po ste nam mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar rtsibs kā ma ru par/ myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ byang rtsibs o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen po/ nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje huX mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ shar lho ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang sngo sangs lha mo/ lho nub lam pa dkar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ nub byang ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang bya gdong ma ste/ gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po ste/ sa steng na spyod pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol sku'i ge nar lo'i shar rtsibs pre ta pu rir —176—

stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ byang rtsibs gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma/ nub rtsibs so ru༅pa rta mgrin dang chang tshong ma lho rtsibs brna dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ shar lho na ga rar khrag 'thung dang shin tu dpa' mo/ lho nub si rgyur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ nub byang ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ byang shar ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen po ste/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo/ kha dog dkar po ste sa 'og na spyod pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad/ dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba he ru ka dang mtshungs pa ste/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i cod pan dang / mgo bo'i 'phreng ba dang / phyag rgya drug dang / stag lpags gsar pa'i smad dkris can/ the ta/sa g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyi ḍa ma ru dang kha ṭā ga 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi po thams cad ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba phag mo dang mtshungs pa ste/skra grol ba/ phyag lnga rgya dang / thod skam gyi do shal dang ldan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'byud pa'o/ /dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i shar sgor khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang sgor 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho sgor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lhor gnyen rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser/ lho nub tu gzhin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang / byang shar du gzhin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang —177—

g.yon sngo ba brgyad ka'ang / drag mo chen po cher khros pa ze'i gdan la gnas pa/phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams 'joms par mdzad pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi'ijenas/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i bar snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i skabs bzhin dang / dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dpral par thod pa'i steng du rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /de nas skabs 'dir byang phyogs kyi dag dran byed pa'ang rung mod kyi/ gzhung gi dngos bstan ni zugad pa'i go rim tsam yin pas/ 'og tu byas na legs so/ /gnyis pa nang lus dkyil ni/ rkang pa gnyis rlung gi dkyil 'khor/sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshig ri rab/ skra sen pags pa nas tshigs rnams srung ba'i 'khor lo/ bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khore lo gsum/snying ga chos kyi snyen ra lo ni bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ dbang po rnams ni me long la sogs pa'i rgyan/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis ni pad+ma'i 'dab ma der rgyu ba'i rlung dang thig le ni ā '-i kā le/ klad pa ni zla ba kha sbyor/ ha yig ni rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa/ de las skyes pa'i rtsa khams ni lha rnams te/ rtsa la la na dang ra sa na'i 'khor dang bcas shing / lte ba'i a yig gi bcud dang ldan pa'i rtsa a wa dhu tī ni rdo rje phag mo dang / snying ga'i dbus kyi gzhom du med pa'i thig le hū gi rnam pa yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam kha ba 'dzag pa lta bur gnas pa ni dpal he ru ka ste/ sku mdog thing nag sngo ljang dmar ser zhal/ /rdo rje dril bu glang lpags ḍā ma —178—

sa /dgra sta gri gug rtse gsum kha ṭaX ga /thod khrag zhags pa tshangs mgo gdong bzhi 'dzin/ /g.yas brkyang pad nyir 'jigs byed dus mtshan brdzis/ /de la 'byud pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar mo rdo rje thod khrag gang 'dzin/ /gnyis ka'ang me dpung dbus na rgyan dang bcas/ /snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i nang bskor rtsa 'dab brgyad la/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba dang bcas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma/ byang du lā ma/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro ha/ lhor gzugs can ma'o/ /mtshams bzhir gnas pa bdud rtsi lnga bab pa mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi ni rab tu gang ba'i bum thod bzhir gyur/ puX dzaX oṃ aX goX ri de māX/ kāX skye'u koX kāX laX kaX hi/ pre gri soX sum nāX si maX kuX/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur/ spyi bo pu snyi ra ma la yar thod pa'i dum bu dang rab tu gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug dza lan+ta rar keng rus chen mo dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa o ṭi ya ṇa ra keng rus dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag par arbu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs ma dang sna chen ma ste gnas so/ /rna ba g.yas pa go da ba rir lha'i dgra dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ri smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang me'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de lī ko ṭar rdo rje 'od dang lang ga'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la bar rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste nye ba'i gnas so/ /thugs kyi 'khor le'o/ /mchan khung gnyis kā ma ru par myu gu can dang sa srung ma/ nu ma gnyis o trer rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed —179—

chen mo ste zhing ngo / /lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hū mdzad dang chang thung ma ste/ nye ba'i zhing ngo / kha ka li gar rab tu bzang po dang sngo sangs lha mo/ mgrin pa la pa kar rdo rje bzang mo dang shin tu bzang po ste tshan do ha'o/ /snying ka ka nyur 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'dom par hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha ga na te nye ba'i tshan do ha'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pū rir stobs po che dang ge nar lo'i shugs can ma/ bshang lam gri ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang dum skyes ma ste 'du ba'o/ /brla gnyis so ra jir rta mgrin dang chang 'tshong ma/ byin pa gnyis su pa rna dī bar nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma ste nye ba'i 'du ba'o/ /rkang sor brgyad nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis si rgyur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma ste dur khrod do/ /rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste/nye ba'i dur khrod do/ /sku'i 'khor le'o/ /bu ga rnams kyi rtsa sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur pa ni/ lce'i rtsa bar kha gdong ma/ lte bar lug gdong ma/ rtags kyi sgor khyi gdong ma/ bshang lam gyi sgor phag gdong ma/ mdzod pu'i bug par gzhin rje brtan ma/ rna ba gnyis kyi sgor gzhin rje pho nya ma/ mig gnyis kyi sgor gshin rje mche ba ma/ sna bug gnyis kyi sgor gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /gsum pa chos kyi dkyil 'khor ni bshad rgyud dag dang gzhung gi tshig rigs dngos bstan ltar/ brjod na'ang legs la/ yang na 'di ltar bya ste/ lus dang tshor ba dang chos dang —180—

sems rjes su dran pa nyer bar bzhag pa bzhi ni/ mkha' 'gro ma/ lā ma/ khaṇ+ḍaro ha/ gzugs can ma bzhi'o/ /'dun pa dang brtson 'grus dang spyod pa dang sems te rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ni/ rab gtum ma/ gtum mig ma/ 'od ldan ma/ sna chen ma bzhi'o/ /dad pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dran pa dang /tid nge 'dzin dang / shes rab ste dbang po lnga ni dpa' blo ma/ mi thung ma/ lang ka'i dbang phyug ma/ shing grib ma/ sa srung ma rnams so/ /dad sogs kyi stobs lnga ni/ /'jigs byed ma/ /rlud shugs ma/ myong thung ma/ sngo sangs lha mo/ rab bzang ma rnams so/ /ting nge 'dzin dang / brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang /shin tu sbyangs pa dang / rnam 'byed dang / dran pa dang btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag bdun ni/ rta rna ma/ bya gdong ga 'khor shugs ma/ dum skyes ma/ chang 'cha ma/ go cha ma/ shin tu dpa' mo rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / rtog pa dang / ngag dang / las kyi mtha' dang / 'tsho ba dang / rtsol ba dang /dran pa rnams ni stobs chen ma/ 'khor sgyur ma/ rtson chen ma/ khwa gdong ma/lug gdong ma/ khyi gdong ma/ phag gdong ma rnams so/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa dang / skyes pa srung ba dang / mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa dang / skyes pa spong ba bzhi ni/ gshin rje brtan ma/ pho nya ma/ mche ba ma/ 'joms ma bzhi'o/ zhan tu bsdusan/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa tsam zhig gis kyang chog mod kyi/ las dang po pa la dkyus ltar legs so/ /'dir don ni/ rjes chags lhan skyes kyis bde bas dkyil 'khor thams cad —181—

la rgyas btab cing / snang stong bde ba'i ye shes de nyid la byang phyogs so bdun tshang bar shes par byas nas/ lha rnams der dag tshul dran par byed dgos pa yin no/ /oṃ ā hu sarba bī ra yo gi ni kā ya lha kyi t+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 ha/ oṃ badz+ra shurnya sarba dharma badz+ra shurnyo3 ha/ lan gsum sogs brjod/ 'dir pha mthing pa nas brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ pho nya gsum bsre ba'i gdams pa ston pa ni/ rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di'i bskyed rim gyi gdams pa'i gnad bla na med pa yin pas/ ma chad par bsgom pa gal che'o/ /'di skad cig rnams pa'i gsang sngags yin pas/ 'di dang de 'gal bar mi bsam ste/ don de yang skad cig rnam pa'i don la rjes su zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa byin gyis rlobs pa'i rnal 'byor ni rnam pa gnyis te go cha bgo ba dang ye shes pa gzhug pa'o/ /de yang / rang gi snying gar o ha dkar po las rdo rje sems dpa'/mgo bor nā ma hi ser po las rnam par snang mdzad/ spyi gtsug tu swāhā hū dmar po las pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po las dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hu hu ho dmar ser las rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa ha ljang khu las rta mchog yum gyi lte bar oṃ bam dmar po las rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ha yo sngon po las gzhin rje ma/ mgrin par lha mo dkar mo las rmongs byed ma mgo bor hri hri ser po las skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hū hū ljang khu las skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha las ci ti kā /rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma zla ba la/ gnas shing zla ba'i 'od can/ gzhan rnams nyi ma la gnas shing nyi ma'i 'od can no/ /spro na 'di skad ces/rdor sems phag mo zhal gsum phyag drug ste/ /gzhan rnams zhal gcig phyag —182—

bzhi kun g.yas brkyang / /rdor sems phag mos 'byud cing dkar dmar nag /g.yas na rdo rje cang te'u mgo bo ste/ /g.yon na dril bu thod pa kha smo ga /rnam snang gshin rje mas 'khyud 'khor lo 'dzin/ /gar dbang rmongs byed mas 'byud pad+ma dmar/ khrag 'thung skyong byed mas 'phyud rdo rje ste/ /nyi ma skrag byed mas 'phyud rin po che/ /rta mchog tsaṇ+ḍi kas 'byud ral gri'o/ /lnga char g.yon gyi dang po dril bu bsnams/ /lhag ma cang te'u g.yas dang kha smo ga /thod par bcas pa g.yon gyi 'og mas 'dzin/ /phag mo dmar sngo ljang ba'i zhal gsum ste/ /lcags kyu tshangs mgo gri gug g.yas gsum na/ /thod pa kha ṭa zhags pa g.yon pas 'dzin/ /gshin rje ma sogs lnga ni gri thod dang / /dril bus mtshan pa'i kha ṭa cang te'u bsnams/ zhes so/ /sku'i cha byad gzhan rnams dkyil 'khor gyi lhas rigs 'gre la/ bsdu na sngags kyi yig 'bru nyid lha'i ngo bor bsgoms pas kyang chog go /de nas 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi snying ga'i hu yig gi 'od zer gyis/phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo'i dbang phyug ma thams cad ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs par gyur/ phe/ zhes brjod/ 'od zer rang gi snying gar thim/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa 'og nas 'byung ba ltar phul nas/ dza hu ba ho gnyis su med par thim/ rnam lnga 'dod skor gyi mthar 'phyud rgya byas la/ o yo ga shudha sarba dharma yo ga shu khresa3 ha/ byang phyogs kyi dag pa'i 'jug thogs sam lus dkyil gyi rjes thogs nyid la/ skad cig rnam pas sngags kyi pho nya gsum bsres byas zin na 'dir mi dgos la/ de dag tu ma byas na —183—

'dir byed de 'grel ba'i dgongs pa'ang yin no/ /slar yang snying ga'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros pas/ dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs spyan drangs spro/ chu gnyis spyod dang bcas pas tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ski nyu tu maX/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ rdo rje phag mo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rol mo bde chen po/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra dgyes bde/ /dgyes mdzad gsang ba'i bde chen po/ stsol mdzad bde ba chen po ste/ /a la la la ho/ mchog tu gyur pa'i bde chen po/ /mkha' 'gro dra ba'i bde chen po/ a la la la ho/ zhes pa'i glu dbyangs dang / ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshe/gas kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrīXhuX/ zhes gsungs shing spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byas/chu'i lhag ma yar lud so so'i spyi bor 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang / bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rnam snang / dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams rang —184—

la gnyis su med par thim/ de ltar na zla ba sa bon ro gcig tu 'dres pa nas bzung ste de yan chad shin tu rnal 'byor ro/ /bdun pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor ni lha sku la sems mnyam par bzhag cing / mthar/oṃ a ā/ nas/ ha k+ṣa hū hū phaṭa/ rang gi sna bug g.yas nas ā '-i kā le'i 'od zer dang 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros/ 'gro ba thams cad de'i rang bzhin du byas/ gdod nas grub pa rnams dang lhan cig slar 'dus nas sna bug g.yon pa nas zhugs/ nye bar ā '-i kā le las zla ba'i dkyil 'khore ā '-i kā les mtshan pa dbus su hū dang bcas par gyur/ de yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / yum rdo rje phag mo dmar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /de la cung zad mnyam par bzhag de ni rdo rje sems dpa' phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum rjes chags kyi sbyor bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba skyu ma lta bu'i sgra dang 'od zer gyi srid gsum dag pa'i 'khor lor byas pa/ srung ba'i 'khor lo la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de dam tshig gi 'khor lo la/ de yang sku'i 'khor lo la/ de yang gsung gi 'khor lo la/ de yang thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ de yang bde chen 'khor la/ de yang gtso bo'i zhal bzhi la/ de yang lte ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum la thim/ de yang snyoms 'jug bde ba chen pos rab tu zhu te hu yig dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par gyur/ hu gi zhabs kyu khog pa la/ de mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/de la cung zad sems bzung zhing mthar nā da yang 'od gsal du thim/ 'dir —185—

huX huX hūX huX phaṭa/ oX tsakra wa smi ṇi ye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ su bī re huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ si li si li huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ mahā ba le huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ hi li hi li huX huX phaṭa/ oX tsakra warti nī ye hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ dhi li dhi li huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ mahā bī ldu hūX huX phaṭa/ dang po nyer bzhi dpa' bo nyer bzhi dang / phyi ma nyer bzhi dpa' mo nyer bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ ka kā myi huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ u pū kā phye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ shwa nā phye huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ snyu ka rā myi huX huX phaṭa/ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags so/ /oṃ ya ma dā dhī huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma dū tī hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ya ma daX spyi ṇi hūX huX phaṭa/ oX ya ma ma thā nī huX huX phaṭa/ mtshams ma bzhi'i sngags so/ /phyi mchod dngos su 4gams yod na byin wos bya dgos shing / to nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig gi mchod pa la ni/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs dgos pa ma yin no/ /byin rlabs ni/sdo/nga bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las a yig las byung ba'i thod pa'i snod rnams kyi nang du/huX las 'byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs gsil/ me tog /bdug spos/ mar me/dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa bzang zhing rgya che la dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ de bzhin du pu duX/ oṃ badz+ra sdi khye āXhuX/ de bzhi du ga pe/ ā lo ke /ga n+di/ nai bi te/sha lta āXhuX/ rol mo byin rlabs kyi sngags kyang spro na thorjod/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin nam/ bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig gi lag len ltar na/ tsho( sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+bha ra maṇ+ḍal tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī/ ar+ghaX pra titsā swāhā/ de bzhin du pā duX/ punyu man ho la pra ti rdzo dod du āXhūX sbyar ro/ /de ni phyi mchod dngos yin la/ oṃ bī ni badzi ṇi huX hūX phaṭa/ de bzhin du sbyar te/ waX phya/ mṛ taX gi mu ra dze/ ha phya/ lwa phya/ girti/ dra ti/ purdze/—187—

dhu pe/ dī pe/ ga rnye/ rū pa/ rā sa/ pa rnye/ oṃ dharma dha tu badz+ra ṇi hū hū phaṭa/ zhesamachod pa'i lha mo bcu drug gi mchod de/ 'di yang phyi mchod gtso che ba'i dbang du byas so/ /de nas nang mchod gtor ma lhar byin gyis rlabs nas/ oṃ a mṛ ta ut+ta ga hū hu tha tha tra a kha hū zhes brjod/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang / /grub chen pū yi pa dang ḍa zhi pa/ /lwa ba pa dang dza lan+ta ra dang / /nag po spyod pa dge ba'i mgon po dang / /te lo nā ro ma na ka shrī/ /bha dan+da pa mar pa do pa dang / /bde mchog rdo rje bze ba blo ldan dang / /slob dpon khu ba slob dpon la tshad pa/ /lo tsā mchog ldan dpal ldan seng ge dang / /mkhan chen bu ston dharma shrī dang / /rgyal ba dpal legs 'dus pa bzang po dang / /thar pa'i mtshan can rig 'dzin rgyal po dang / /don grub rgyal mtshan bkra shis rgyal mtshan dang / /dpal ldan chos bzang (〈ju〉rtse lha dbang grags pa dang / /kun mkhyen sgrol mgon ye shes rgya mtsho dang / /snying po'i blo gros ngag dbang 'phrin las dang / /kun bzang dbang po tshe dbang nor bu'i zhabs/ /'phrin las shing rta bstan pa'i nyin mor byed/ /zur mang lo chen karma rin chen dpal/ /'od gsal 'gyur med ma ṇi bha dra dang / /chos 'phel rgya mtsho ngag dbang chos 'dzin dpal/ /mkhas grub dbang phyug tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho dang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma ) rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /oṃ ā skyo/ yang na/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /phyag na rdo rje sa ra ha pa dang / /klu sgrub shā ba ri dang lha yi pa/ /dā ri pa dang slob dpon rnam rgyal zhabs/ /ti snyi nā ro pa dang pha thing mched/ /klog skya mal lo sa skya gong ma lnga/ /dkon mchog dpal dang grub chen brag phug pa/ /chos rje bla ma'i zhabs dang dpal tshul ba/ /shar pa ngor chen —188—

paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan/ /rab gsal zla mgon rje btsun grol mchog dang / /'jam dbyangs kun dga' rgyal mtshan rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ āXhuX/ zhes so/ /sa lugs la brgyud lugs mi 'dra ba mang zhing / pu rangs lo chung dang rwa lugs kyi brgyud pa'ang yod do/ /de nas bsdu na gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags pa dang / rgyas par spro na gong sngags mchod kyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyis sngags kyi mthar 'bru gsum btags la 'bul/ oX a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ oX badz+ra kā mi nu sarba bhak+ṣa shwa dha ya/ gu hra badz+re ṇi swāhā/ nang mchod do/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga ṇa badz+ra swa bha wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ gsang ba'i mchod pa'o/ /de nas rkang pa brgyad pa'i sngags kyis bstod pa bya ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti ldi re sha ya huX huX phaṭa/ oX mahā kanywa sni sa ni bhā ya hūX huX phaṭa/ oX dza ṭā mu ku shot+na ṭā ya hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ daXsna ka rā lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu 'a ya huX huX phaṭa/ oX sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ par shu pā sho rtswa ta shu la kha ṭaX gi dha ri ṇi huX hūX phaṭa/ oX byā ghā dzi nī ba ra dha ra ya huX huX phaṭa/oX mahā dhu sru n+ta kā ra wa pu khri ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ zhes yab kyi rkang brgyad dang / oX na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra pā ra hi ba huX huX phaṭa/ oX na mo ār+ya a pa ra dzi te tri lo kya mā te mahā biṅgā shwa re hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX na maXsarba bhu ta bha yā ba he ma hā badz+re hūX hūX phaṭa/ lkoX na mo badz+ra ā sa ni a dzi te a par dzi te ba shaX kā ri ni tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūX huX phaṭa/ oṃ na maXsho ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ni kro dha ka rā li ni hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX na maXtra sa ni ma ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye huX hūX phaṭa/ lkoX na mo bi dza ye nga ni/ nga ni mo ha ni huX hūX phaṭa/oX na mo badz+ra wā rā hi mahā yo ki ni kā me shwa ri kha ge huX huX phaṭa/ zhes yum gyi rkang brgyad do/ /yang na mchod pa'i rnal 'byor bdun pa dang / ting nge 'dzin brgyad par byas nas/—189—

skabs 'dir ting nge 'dzin gyi rnal 'byor sgom pa yang yod pa/ bskyed rim gas gyi rim pa dang mthun te/ 'di ltar byed na mchod pa rjes su rnal 'byor gyi yan lag tu bsdu ba yin no/ /de nas bzlas pa la bzla bya'i sngags ni/ gong du bstan pa'i yab kyi rkang brgyad kyi rkang pa re re'i huX hūX phaṭa rnams dang / dang po'i oṃ ma gtogs pa'i oṃ rnams kyang dor ba la/ ka ra ka ra sogs btanas pa ste/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ sogs/ wa pu khri ya/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku sa ban+ta ban+ta/ tru sa ya tru sa ya/ khyo bha ya khyo bha ya/ rbeX shīXrga/ hraXhraX phe phe/ phaṭa phaṭa/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ba su ru dhi ra an+t+ra mā la ba la zhi ni gro sna grot+na sa p+ta pa ta la ga ta bhu dzāX ga sa rlaX pa tardza ya tardza ya ā ka khye ā ka khye/ hri hri/ dhīX dhīX/ riX 'iX/haX haX hi hi hūX huX/ ki li ki li/ si li si li/ hi li hi li/ dhi li dhi li huX huX phaṭa/yab kyi rtsa sngags so/ /gong du bshad pa'i yum gyi rkang brgyad la/ thog ma'i oṃ ma gtogs/ oṃ yig dang hūX phaṭa rnams dor ba la/ ta du thā pro taX gi sogs btags pa yab kyi dang 'dra bar bod gong ma rnams bzhed la/ 'dir lwa ba pa'i bzhed pa ltar rkang brgyad dang ma sbrel bar bzla ste/ skye( badz+ra bā rā hi/ pro taṅge pro taṅge/ ha na ha na pru ṇaX/ ki ki ṇi / khi khri ni/ dhu na dhu na badz+ra ha ste/sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya badz+ra/ ṣa ṭāX ga ka pā la dha ra ṇi/ mahā bi shi te/ māX sa a sha naX/ma nus shun+t+ra/ krā bri te swa ni dh+yaX na ra shi ro mā lā gra rnyi ta dha ri ṇi/ nga ni ra/ ha na ha na bhā ṇaX/ sarba pā paX sa tā naX/ sarba pā hūṃ nāX/ mahā maX sa tshe da naX/ kro dha myu rte daXni ka rā li ni/ mahā mu dre/ shrīXhe ru ka de ba phya a gra ma hi shi sa ha sra shi ri/sa ha sra wā ha we/ sha ta sa ha sra ā na ne/ dz+wa li ta te dza se/ dz+wa la mu khe/ skra ga la lo tsa ne/ badz+ra sha rī re/ badz+ra ā sa ni/ mi li te tsi li te/ he he/ ha ha/ hūṃX hūX/ kha kha/ dhu dhu/ ru sa dhu ru dhu sa mu ru mu sa muñtsa mu mi a dre te/ mahā yo gi nī/ pa —190—

'i ta sirnyi/ dro dhaX dre dhaX/ graX graX/ he he/ ha ha snri me/ ha sa ha sa/ bī re/ hā hā ho hoXhuX hūX/ tri lo kya bi nā sha ni/ sha ta/ sa ha sra ko ṭi/ ta thā ga ta pa ri wa re huX huX phaṭa/si ha rū pe khaX ga dza rū pe āX tre lo kya u da re sa mu dra me kha le gra sa gra sa hūX hūX phaṭa/ ldi rā dwo te hūX huX/ ha haX mahā pa shu mo ha ni mahā yo gi shwa ri stuX/ ṭā ka nī sa spru lo kā naX ban+ta ni/ sa duXpra t+ya ya kā ri ṇi hūX hūX phaṭa/ bhā ta t+yā sa ni/ mahā bī rī/pa ra ma sirnyi/ yo gī shwa ri phaṭa/ hūX hūX phaṭa/ hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi rtsa sngags so/ /yab yum gyi snying po ni gong du bstan zin to/ /oX hruX ha ha huX huX phaṭa/ nye snying ngo / oX sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra brje nī ye hūX huX phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi nye snying ngo / /'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs kyi sngags ni sngar bstan pa bzhin no/ /go cha'i sngags la sa bon kho na dang / sa bon la mgo bor oṃ dang huX hūX phaṭa sbyar ba dang / mtshan sngags kyang par bstan pa ste rim pa gsum yod pa las/ skabs 'dir dang po bzung ngo / /bgrang 'phreng gi rab tu dbye ba dang 'phreng ba byin rlabs dang / bzlas pa'i rab tu dbye ba rnams kyang ji skad bshad pa dang bla ma'i ngag las rtogs par byas te/ bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ do li'i bzlas pa dang / spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gtso bor byed cing ngag gi bya ba'i dbang du byas na ngag bzlas dang / yid bzlas dang / 'gog bzlas gsum ga yang bya'o/ /dgu pa nyer bsdu'i rnal wor ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ srid gsum dag pa'i 'khor lo/ zhes pa nas/ bde chen 'khor lo la lha rnams phyogs g.yon bskor dang mtshams g.yas bskor gyis sna bug nas thim/ yum yang yab la thim/ lus dkyil gyi lha drug cu yang rang gnas su thim/ gtso bo yang thugs ka'i he ru ka yab yum la thim/ de yang snyoms 'jug bde ba chen —191—

po'i/ nas/ nā da lnga 'od gsal du thim/ de la cung zad mnyam par bzhagaslar yang rang nyid dpal he ru ka'i sku'i rnam par gyur/gnyis pa mnyam langs la ༅ ste/ srung ba'i rnal 'byor dang / zhing skyong dang / spyod lam dang / kha zas dang / mchod pa dang /gtor ma dang / rjes chags dang / nyal ba dang / ldang ba dang / khrus kyi rnal 'byor rnams so/ /dang po srung ba ni/ dpa' bo'i rtsa ba'i sngags sogs gang / /tshangs pa'i skud pa sogs su rtag /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yis/ /lus kyi khams la rtag pa'o/ /dpa' bo'i go cha drug po yis/ /phyag rgya yis na ni lus mdzes pa'o rdo rje'i phag mo'i sngags gang yin/ /mgrin pa mgur chus brgyan pa'o/ /lha yi snying po'i sngags kyis ni/ /'phreng ba brgya yi phyed kyi mdzes/ /yi ge bdun pa'i gsang sngags kyis/ /gdub bskor gyis ni rna ba mdzes/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro mas/ /pags pa'i gos mchog 'dzin pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma drug gsang sngags kyis/ /ske rags byas pas brgyan pa'o/ /'khor lo kun gyi rnal 'byor ma'i/ /sngags ni ltung ba'i thod pa'o/ /rnam snang mdzad ces sngags gang yin/ /thod pas dbu la brgyan pa'o/ kha ṭā ga ni lha yi sku khres rab ḍā ma ru yi sgra /nyin mo bcom ldan dpa' bo ste/ /rnal 'byor ma ni mtshan mor brjod/ /mya ngan 'das byung dpa' bo ni/ /drug pa sems kyi sprul pa ste/ /dag pa chos kyi sprul pa ni/ /phag mo'i gzugs su bstan pa'o/ /shrī yig gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru yig bkod pa dang bral ba/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar oṃ ha dkar po/ nas/ nyi ma'i 'od can no/ /dmigs pa gsal na lus dkyil 'khor gyi lha zhe brgyad gsal gdab/ mi gsal na —192—

mos pa tsam gyis bya ste/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dza snya( a go ra de mā/ kā tse( ṭi ko ka la ka hi/ pre gri so su na si ma ku zhes so/ /rjes su sum+bha lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcing ngo / /gnyis pa zhing sbyong gi rnal 'byor ni/ yab kyi rkang brgyad brjod/ bdag dang snang ba'i 'khor lo thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ brjod pa dang grags pa'i sgra thams cad gsung gi rang bzhin/ dran rig rnam rtog thams cad thugs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin du rnam par dag go /de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba byang ra tu bsngo bar bya ste/ bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci spyad pas/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med rdo rje theg pa'i snod gyur te/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid gyur cig /skye zhing skye ba dag ni thams cad du/ /blo ldan rig bzang nga rgyal med pa dang / /snying rje che zhing bla ma la gus brtan/ /'khor lo sdom pa'i dam tshig la gnas shog /rdo rje dril bu la sogs rtag tu 'chang / /zab cing rgya che'i chos don rtogs pa dang / /go ku shu kra la sogs rtag bzang zhing / /mthar thug bde chen sgrub pa'i skal ldan shog /bde gshegs spyan sngar gnas gsum mkha' 'gro yi/ /dam bcas srung shing dngos grub mchog stsol bar/ /thugs dam bcas shing rtag srung dngos grub ni/ /rnam gsum tshe 'di nyid la thob par shog /lha mo tshad ma sogs dang / srid pa gsum 'bar sku ni rjes chags dul bar ldan/ /'od zer sngon po stong ldan nyi ma brgya stong ldan/ /rnam mang sku dang cha lugs rjes chags sems dpar ldan/ /he ru ka dpal sngags pa lhan cig gar byed sgo(ga /ces pa la sogs pa'o/ /rnal 'byor lhag ma rnams las/ kha zas —193—

kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gong nang mchod kyi skabs dang 'dra ba las/ phud phul ba'i rjes su/ oṃ sa ma ya shudha sarba dharma sa mā ya shurnyo3haX/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ba ni 'dir khyad par ro/ /spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor gyi skabs su g.yon pa'i kun spyod do/ /gtor ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ thun tha ma la'am/thun re re zhing ngam/ nam phyed kyi dus na bya ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sha chang sogs dang ldan par bshams/ oṃ sum+bha ni sum+bha huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya hūX huX phaṭa/ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra ra dza huX hūX phaṭa/ zhes pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu khyu/༷༷sarba dharma su bhā wa shu khresa3haX/ zhes pas sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oṃ āXhuX las byung ba'i mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang gi shar du oX dkar po las dri chen oX gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaX ljang khu las sha chen gyi dwangs ma khaX gis mtshan pa/ nub tu aX dmar po las byang chub kyi sems aX gis mtshan pa/ lhor t+taX ser po las rak+ta t+taX gis mtshan pa/ dbus su huX sngon po las dri chu huX gis mtshan pa/ mer laX dkar po las ba glang gi sha laX gis mtshan pa/ bden bral du māX sngon po las khyi'i sha māX gis mtshan pa/ rlung du baX dmar po las glang po'i sha baX gis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du tāX ljang khu las rta'i sha tāX gis mtshan pa/ dbus su bāX dmar po las sha chen bāX gyis mtshan pa/ rlung g.yos me 'bar bas rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser gsal la dngas par gyur pa'i —194—

steng thad du/ hu yig las byung ba'i kha smo ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ mgo bo thur du blta ba/ de las bdud rtsi dkar po babs te/ der ltung bas g.yon bskor du lan gsum dkrugs shing zhu bas dngul chu mdog can shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la o a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa '-i lī e i tse( e to a a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dz+nya nya/ṭa ṭha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hu hū phaṭa rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ o dkar po/ ā dmar po hū sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros/ rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug cing / 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas pa rnams spyan drangs/ snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu/ de thams cad yig 'khru gsum la thim/ o ā hū/ yang rim pa ltar bdud rtsir zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hū/ lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlab pa'o/ /rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hu yongs su gyur pa las/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de nas rkang pa mnan cing gyen du blta/ zhes pa'i 'dug tshul dang / 'bar ba'i phyag rgya cas te/ h+pha/ ces brjod/ rang gi snying gis hū yig gi 'od zer gyis/ ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi —195—

dkyil 'khor/ phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba sogs srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dza / ba ho yo ga shudha:lan gcig sa ma ya stu/ sa ma ya ho/ lan gsum/ mchodi yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/ g.yas su kā li las nyi ma/ dbus su hu zla nyi hu dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje thal mor gyur/ gtor snod lag gis blangs par mos la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ /bden pa de yi lha mo de dag gis/ /bdag la rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /lha rnams gtor ma gsol ba la thugs dges pa dang ldan pa las/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra a ra l+li ho/ dza / ba hobadz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya stu/ dri khyi ho oṃ ā hu/ zhes lan bdun gyi phul gong bzhin/ar+gha: nas/sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcoms/ khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzigs kyang / /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chu rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyi bdag la rjes rtser mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba btabs so/ /'jig rten pa rnams la phul bar mos te/ tse( kha kha ji hi ji hi/ sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta pi shā tsa/ tha yi da a pa sma ra/ ḍā ka ḍā gi n+ya da ya/ i ma ba li griṇ+ḍa stu/ sa ma ya rak+ta n+tu/ ma ma sarba sirnyi me pra ya rtu sko/ ya thi wa/ ya thig bhu dza tha/ pi ba tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta yā/ sa phyi kha/ bi skoskru ste ya/ sa ha yi ka bha skyi/ hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum —196—

gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /klu yi tshogs:gnod sbyin: srin po'i: ཿnga po'i yi dwags: sha za'i: smyo byed: brjed byed:mkha' 'gro'i tshogs ma mo'i: ma lus par ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa bsrung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyi mches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' bsdod yid ltar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i phyogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gnod spyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yog bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyugs dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal pa bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srung mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog yig brgya bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / sogs kyis bzod par gsol/yo ga shurnyo 'e/ sngags brgya bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ sogs kyi —197—

mthar/ skye rna badz+ra muX 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su ba/shogs/ dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor pa rang nyid la thim/ smon lam gdab/ bkra shis brjod do/ /'di ni gtor chog logs su byed pa'i dbang du byas la dkyil 'khor ma bsdus par byed na/ bzlas pa'i mthar te lugs 'di ltar na gtor ma yang mchod pa'i rnal 'byor gyi khongs su 'du'o/ /de ltar na rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar/ zhes pa nas/ grub par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar spangs shing / ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khe7ra zhes pa'i tshab tu/ ye shes kyi lha tshogs dpag tu med pa/ zhes brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ /nyal ba dang ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnal 'byor chen po'i rim pas bya zhing / gnyid sad ma thag pa dang nyal ba'i rnal 'byor la 'jug khar/ ngag byin gyis rlabs pa 'di bsgoms par bya ste/tshig gi brjod pa thams cad la ā '-i kā le'i de kho na nyid kyis rgyas btab ste/ oṃ hre hi/ mahā bī ra shudha wa kya gya de sha ka shu bya ta ni waX tsa/ sri sgyi sa da ha ra snya yaX bhu wa/ zhes pa'am/de'i bod skad/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon dpa' bo che/ /dag pa'i ngag ni ston pa po/ /stong nyid ye shes 'di kho na/ /spros dang bsdud pa rang byung ba'o/ /zhes so/ /oṃ ā nas ha k+ṣa huX huX phaṭa/ lan gsum brjod nas 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang / 'od gsal du ldang ba'i dmigs pa bya/ rnal 'byor gzhan rnams ni sgrub thabs 'di'i don dang lhan cig tu 'chad par 'dod do/ /'dir nyer mkho 'phreng ba byin rlabs ni/ rgyas pa sam bhu ṭi dang gdan bzhi dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa rnams las bshad pa ltar ram/ bsdu na bsangs sbyangs sngon du 'gro bas/sdiXlas pad+ma gar dang dbang yum dang bcas pa 'od dpag med kyi dbu rgyan can du bskyed/ gnas gsum gyi byin gyis rlabs/ ye shes pa bcug rigs bdag yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub sems kyi dbang bskur/ chu gnyis dang nyer spyod kyis mchod/ rdo rje mi 'chi 'dod chags che —198—

sogs kyis bstod/ oṃ swāhā hu pad+ma ni rte shwa ra hu hū phaṭa/ zhes sam/ a ro lika brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de zhu ba las 'phreng ba'i rnam par bsam pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ dpal ldan sdom pa'i rgyud rgyal rgya mtsho 'dra/ /dngos grub mtha' yas nor bu'i tshogs kyis bltams/ /thabs dang shes rab rlabs 'phreng g.yo ba can/ /byis blos rkyal gyis ji ltar rgal bar nus/ /de slad btang snyoms sten par rigs na yang / /lam mchog 'di la mos pa'i gzhan dbang gyur/ /'bras mchog ma thob gyur kyang 'dir stsol ba/ /dge bas rab tu rtsom pa don mchog ldan/ /'di cis legs sam nyes par gyur kyang sla/ /dam pa'i zhal lung dpang por byas te bkod/ /bdag nyid nyams su blang ba'i don slad dang / /skal mnyam re re la yang phan pa srid/ /'di las dge ba gang thob pas/ /srid lam 'khyam pa'i sems can kun/ /bde chen dam pa'i gnas mchog la/ /myur ba nyid du 'khod par shog /ces pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs/ /bde ba chen po'i 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba chen po slob dpon kū yi pa'i bzhed gzhung ltar sbyar ba 'di yang / rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su'o/ /༈ 'dir lha yi pa la rtsa rkyang gi lugs su 'dod pa dang / 'grel pa lugs gnyis yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma yin/ lugs 'di la mar pa do pa dang pu rangs pa dang / rwa lo'i lugs sogs yig rnying mang yang ngag 'don mi bde ba dang / bu ston man chad kyi yi ge phyi ma rnams ha cang tshig tshogs ches pa dang / rigs mthun rung gi gzhung thams cad nas mthun sdebs kyi kha bskang ba ha cang thal ba'i skyon yang cung zad snang bas/ 'dir dag cing 'byer bde bar bkod pa yin no//ma rgo la// //—199—

bde chen 'ju ga ngogs zhes bya ba bzhu/gas/oṃ rdza sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba/bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpal ldan khams gsum dbang phyug thugs rje'i stobs/ /bde chen rdo rje 'chang dbang he ru ka /dpag yas mkha' 'gro dra bar mnyam spyor ba/ /ye shes lhan cig skyes sku de la 'dud/ /gang zhig dkyil 'khor cho ga bdud rtsi'i sgo/ /brgya phrag phye las thar mchog khang bzang du/ /mtha' yas skye bo 'jug pa'i dga' ston can/ /grub pa'i 'bras bu sbyin 'di ya mtshan chos/ /de la slob dpon dam pa bsgom pa dang bzlas pas rang nyid byin gyis rlobs pa'i gnas thob pa dag gis slob ma dam pa theg pa mchog 'dir mos pa'i skal ba can dag dbang bskur ba yang dag par spyin nas rjes su bzung bar bya'o/ /dbang bskur ba de yang dkyil 'khor bya ba sngon du 'gro ba can yin no/ /de la 'dir de kho na nyid bcu gcig ste/ gsol gdab bsnyen pa sa chog dang / /sta gon thig gdab tshon yang dgye/ /rgyan dgod sgrub pa bdag nyid 'jug /slob bzung rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /de ltar na slob ma'i gsol ba gdab pa/ dbang gi don du kha gsos bsnyen pa/ sa'i cho ga sta gon du gnas pa/ thig gdab pa/ tshon dbye ba/ rgyan dang yo byad dgod pa/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa/bdag nyid 'jug pa/ slob ma bzung ba/ rjes kyi bya ba'o/ /dang po gsol ba gdab pa ni/ slob mas maṇ+ḍal phul ba ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa ston —200—

pa po/ /'jig rten rnams kyi 'dren mdzad lha/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slob dpon gyis/ 'khor lo'i mchod pa rim ji bzhin/ /khyod kyis thams cad 'byor gyur tam/ /gus pas rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / /rnal 'byor dga' bar byed nus sam/ zhes dris pa las/ 'byore gyur te/ zhes dang / byed nus so zhes lan btab bo/ /yang 'di skad ces/ dam tshig skyong zhing ston byed pa/ /bu khyod kyis ni spro gyur tam/ /zhes pa la/ bdag ni rab tu spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab/ skabs 'dir slob ma la bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang ba byas pa'i rjes su/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar bsrung 'khor sgom/ zhal bzhi pa bzlas pa'i srung skud mgul bar btags/ smon lam dang bkra shis brjod pa sogs bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsnyen pa la/ lha nye ba'i bsnyen pa ni/ sgrubs thabs bzhin lha'i rnal 'byor ra dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rdzogs par bsgoms nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po khri phrag gsum/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi la lnga stong lnga brgya bzla/ 'khor lo gsum la khri phrag gnyis re/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad la'ang lnga stong lnga brgya re bzla ste/ rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bzlas pa spangs pa 'bring po dang / gtso bo yab yum kho na bzla ba bsdus pa'o/ /snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi zhal bzhi pa dang spel ba dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad la yab kyi rkang brgyad dang spel ba'i lugs kyang yod de/ de ltar 'grub na shin tu legs so/ /bgegs zhi bas bsnyen pa ni/ 'og tu 'chad pa ltar las bum du las kyi lha sgrub pa ni nges pa yin la/ rgya bod kyi bla ma snga rabs pa mang po'i bzhed pas/ bum chog bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad sgrub par bshad de/ de ltar yang grub na bzang ngo / /ye shes dbab pa'i bsnyen pa ni/ thod pa'i nang du ye shes 'bebs pas rdzas rnams bzhag la/ o tiṣ+ṭha mahā krodha sogs dang / dbyangs skyong ba'i sngags bzla ba yin te/ bdag nyid —201—

gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis rdzas la sngags kyi yig 'bru 'bebs pa'i tshul gyis so/ /de ltar bsnyen pa gsum ka ma 'grub na/ dang po lha nye ba'i bsnyen pa nyid gtso bo yin pa'i de bya'o/ /bsnyen pa dang gsol gdab la snga phyi nges pa med pas ji ltar bde ba yin no/ /gsum pa sa chog la/ sa brtag pa/ sa bslang ba/ sbyang ba/ bzung ba bzhi las/ dang po ni/spyi dang 'dra zhing gzhung du'ang lta'o/ /gnyis pa la gnas kyi bdag po las bslang ba/ 'jig rten skyong ba las bslang ba/ dkyil 'khor lha las bslang ba/ sa'i lha mo las bslang ba'o/ /dang po ni/bdag nyid dpal he ru kar gyur/ gtor ma dang mchod pa/ su lhas bsangs/ swabha was sbyangs/ oṃ āXhuX/ gis byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ gnas bdag gzhi bdag grong bdag gnyug/ mar gnas pa rnams dang / sarba spu ṭa pha la sa pa ri wa re khyu/ oX a kā ro mu khaX sarba dharmā ṇaX ā t+ya ut+pa sno twa ta glu rna āXhuX phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum mam lnga sogs kyis phul/ ar+ghaX: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ gang yang 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ gnod sbyin srin po'am gzhan dag la/ /dkyil 'khor don du sa 'di ni/ /bdag zhu khyed kyis stsal du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab ste/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyir dor/ gnyis pa ni/ dur khrod brgyad na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong la sogs pa 'jig rten skyong ba thams cad spyan drangs par mos te/ oṃ a ska dha na ba sban dha na kha klu da na sarba du ni na ha na ha da ghā ta ya/ ma ma shwan ti ku ru huX huX phaṭa phaṭa dzaXswāhā/ zhes pas bkug ste/ oṃ kha kha khwa hi khwa hi nas ma mā sarba sirnyi me pra ya:skyo swāhā/ lan gsum sogs kyis phul/ ar+ghaX: la sogs pa'i mchod/ khams gsum gnas pa'i lha dang klu /gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin/ /gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan zhing / /'byung po bstan pa la dga' bas/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du —202—

gsol/ /sangs rgyas rnams la mchod pa dang / /sems can rnams la phan don du/ /sa phyogs dge ba 'di nyid du/ /dam pa'i dkyil 'khor cher 'gyung ba/ /ji ltar bsam pa'i las byed ni/ /khyed kyi bar chad ma byed par/ /dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod/ ces lan gsum/ ga smo ga tsā swa s+tha na/ zhes rol mo dang thos te gtor ma phyir dor/ gsum pa ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir skyang nul bya/ tse( ā hu/ lan bzhi bcu zhe gcig brjod la lha'i gnas su dri bzang gis thig le bya/ ma ljore steng du thod pa bzhag la/ der me tog 'bul bzhin pas/ lha thams cad kyi snying po lan gsum gsum brjod/ spro zhing dgos na/dbus kyi lte bar 'khor lo bde mchog /ces pa nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ khar du mkha' 'gro ma nag mo nas/ rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'i bar la/ mkha' gsang byin rlabs rjes chags dang bcas pa dor/ lhag ma rnams brjod do/ /bsdu na/ 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis skad cig gis grub par gyur/ zhes brjod/ sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar/ ar+ghangunas sha lta'i bar sngags kyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ dus gsum 'gyung ba'i mgon po rnams/ /bdag la brtse bas dgongs su gsol/ /mgon po rgyal ba sras mchod cing / /slobe ma rnams la sman slad du/ /dpal ldan rdo rje he ru ka'i/ /kyil 'khor dam pa 'bri 'tshal bas/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis/ /bdag la byin rlabs mchog gnang mdzod/ ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/yo ga shu khres sogs rang la stim/ yang na/ badz+ra mus gshegs su gsol/ bzhi pa ni/ sa non gyi phyag rgyas sor mo dbus ma gsum pa la reg ste/ ṭak+ki ni hu dza lan gsum/ ha gi sgra dang hu gi 'od kyis bskul nas sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa 'byung /—203—

tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni sa'i lha mo gser gyi mdog can zhi ba'i nyams dang ldan pa/ phyag gnyis kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i rin po che bum pa bsnams pa rgyan dang na bza' dkar po can/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bgyi ba bka' stsal du gsol/ zhes gsung bar gyur/ bdag bskyed ltar mchod pa byin gyis bas/ oṃ pri shrī wi de ldi khyuX ar+ghaX pra tismo swāhā/ de sngon du 'gro ba'i pā duX/pu po dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ nai wi te/ shasta/ lha rje sogs rol mo/ gtor ma sum bha swabha/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ oṃ āXhuX ha ho hiX oX pri shrī wi de snyi khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta spyo bi shwa mu khe khyuX sarba thā khaX gi yi| te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX/ gro hā daX ba li ta ye swāhā/ lan gsum/ oX tshur byon tshur byon sa yi ni/ /lha mo chen mo 'jig rten yum/ /rin chen kun gyi rab gang ma/ /bzang po'i rgyan gyi rnam brgyan ma/ /do shal rkang gdub sgra ldan ma/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma/ /mchod gtor 'di dag mchod nas su/ /dkyil 'khor las ni legs grub mdzod/ /skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo yis/ /ji ltar bdud kyi stobs bcom pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las/ /rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri/lan gsum/ sa'i lha mo'i 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mchod gtor dam pa 'dis tshim par mdzad pa/ bdag gi bsnyen pa rdzogs pa'i dpang po yang mdzad cing /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i don du sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang bar mdzad du —204—

gsol/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa sa gzhi sems med cing dag par 'tshal ba'i las ci bde bar mdzod cig o pra bī de lī khyu ar+gha pra tismo swāhā/ o badz+ra u ti la sa'i lha mo/ nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rgya bod kha cig sa lha las slangs pa mi byed pa'ang yod de byed pa legs so/ /gsum pa sbyangs pa la gsum gyi/ mes sbyangs pa ni/ zhi ba dang drag po'i sbyin bsreg gi bgegs dang mi shis pa sbyangs pa'o/ /gnyis pa chus sbyangs pa ni/ las thams cad pa 'das pa'i chus gtor ba'o/ /gsum pa sa'i bya ba sbyangs pa ni/ rko sbyangs zug rngu dbyung ba sogs yin la/ de dag dngos su byed pa med na ting nge 'dzin gyis sbyangs te/ o bhu kha nam mkha'i rang bzhin du gyur/ hu la hu rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur/ o me dhi/nas ban+ta hū/ zhes so/ /rgya bod kha cig sgrub thabs ltar/ skyabs 'gro nas tshogs zhing sogs mtshams su 'di byed cing / de rnams kyis sa byin gyis rlabs par bsam la yig brgya brjod pa sogs byed de 'gal ba med la nges par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /bzhi pa bzung ba la/ byin gyis rlabs pa dang srung ba gnyis kyi/ dang po la gsum/ lha'i rnal 'byor gyis byin gyis rlabs pa/ drag ngo/'i 'phrin las kyi byin gyis rlabs pa/ stang stabs kyi byin gyis rlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro nas bzlas pa rdzogs kyi bar/ sgrub thabs las 'byung ba ltar nyams su len pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ phyogs bzhi slob dpon so so'i/ thog mar shar nas mchod pa byin rlabs bdag bskyed ltar bya/ ar+gha sogs dang rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ maṇ+ḍal phul/rdo rje slob dpon chen po la dkyil snyen ra gyi slob dpon mdzad pa'i don du dbul bar/ sogs bya/ lho mas/ de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun zhi ba/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bsha/da du gsol/ shar mas/ mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag —205—

rdzogs/ /mtshan min thams cad yang dag spangs/ /kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ byang mas/ zhi ba'i mchog ni chos las byung / /ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong ba/ /kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ nub mas/ sems can kun gyi sems chen po/ /rang bzhin dag cing dri ma med/ /kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo sgyur/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra u nga sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ rang gtso bo'i thugs ka nas gtso bo gnyis par chad/ skabs 'dir rgya bod kyi slob dpon spros pa la dgyes pa rnams/ rang nyid khro bo hu mdzad khams gsum rnam rgyal zhal gsum phyag drug par bskyed par 'dug na'ang bsdus pa la gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis chog go /mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla bar mig 'bras hū las rdo rje nag po khro bo'i tshogs kyi 'od zer 'phro ba dang / rkang mthil gnyis su ā las sna tshogs rdo rje 'od zer 'phro ba/ o pra ṇa mi sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dri sna ma ṭa/ rdo rje lta bas g.yas g.yon du bskor te/ lta bas bgegs bskrad/ sa phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyis/ lha dang klu dang gnod spyin dang dri za dang srin po dang srin mo la sogs pa/ gang dag gnas pa'i sa'i bdag po myur du songs shig /'dir dpal he ru ka'i bka' nos la myur ba nyid du songs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de la nga'i ye shes kyi rdo rje dang kha smo ga 'dis spyi bo nas rnam pa brgyad dgas par bya'o/ /lan gsum/ re re'i mthar sum bha bzlas shing 'bud dkrol bya/yungs dkar gyis sa gzhi la gtor ro/ /gsum pa ni/ hu glur len cing dbang ldan du song la/ rdo —206—

rje rtse gcig pa dang / rtse gsum pa dang / rtse lnga pa'i 'gros kyis bskor ba dang / shar du g.yon brkyang / byang du sa ga nub tu zlum po/ lhor g.yas brkyang rnams thabs shes kyi dbye bas brgyad du 'gyur ba rnams dang / gzhan yang dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje 'bri zhing mnyam pa'i rkang stabs dang ji ltar rig par gyen du 'degs pa/ thur du bskyod pa dang / thad kar bskyod pa dang / g.yas dang g.yon du bskor ba dang / 'byed 'phyud dang ku tsa nyed pa dang / nag ga ha da na da ka/ tsu na sha dang skra grol ba/ zhes brgyad dang / rkang pa bskyod dang lag pa bskyod/ /smin ma 'degs dang rab rgyas grang / /cung zad ngo tshe'i zur mig dang / /brla rgyas lta na sdug pa dang / /mig yangs gar ni byed 'gyur zhing / kha yi pad+ma 'dzu 5 pa dang / /cung zad dmar ba'i mche ba 'phyang / /kun da ltar dkar so yi 'phreng / /zhes pa ltar gar gyi rnam par rol pa rnams bya zhing / stang stabs kyi spros pa la mi dga' na/ ji ltar rigs pa'i bskor ba gsum bya'o/ /gnyis pa bsrung ba la gnyis kyi/ dang po sa gzhi bsrung ba ni/ phur bu bcu'am gcig bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu bcu las byung ba'i steng dang shar gyi phur bu kha gdong ma nag mo/ /sogs sgo mtshams ma brgyad mngon rtog bzhi nam/ gcig las med na/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog nag po rdo rje 'phyar zhing / sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa thugs kar gtod pa ste/ gang ltar yang lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can du nas rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' h+pha/ dza hū ba ho sum+bha mang du bzlas/ 'dir yang rgya bod spros pa la dgyes pa rnams mngon brjod las 'byung ba'i khro bo bcur bskyed pa bzhed do/ /de nas/ o ngajozhes pa nas steng 'og phyogs mtshams thams cad bcings par gyur/ gyis bar bsrung 'khor bzhin/phur bu bsrung ba'i khro mo rnams sprul phur bu bsrung ba'i don du phyogs bcur bzhugs par gyur/ rme rna badz+ra ga rnye ā hu/ de bzhin du/ pukhren bsta/ sa rga pa/ tse( —207—

badz+ra dhu pe ā hū ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las ma sna de cig gnyis pa bdag nyid bsrung ba ni/ rang gi snying gar o a he nas sum+bha: lan gnyis kyis phyogs bcings pa'i bar/mnyam langs bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs dang 'dra/ smon lam dang bkra shis ci ltar 'os par bya zhing ras bris kyi phyogs la ni sa'i cho ga 'di mi dgos so/ /nyi ma dang po'i cho ga'o/ /bzhi pa sta gon du gnas pa la/ sta gon gyi snga rol du sgrub dgos pa'i cho ga dang / sta gon dngos so/ /dang po ni/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ gnas yo byin gyis rlabs/ zhu 'bul/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /de yang sngon 'gro gtor ma la su snas bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ tse( ā hu ha rdo ste hi zhes byin gyis rlabs/ h+pha zhes mgron rnams spyan drangs/ tse( kha kha ji hi ji hi nas bha wa skye hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ ar+gha nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ lha'i tshogs rnams/ nas 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyi dgongs pa khyad par can gong nas gong du yongs su rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs su gsol te/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i phyogs skyong ba'i bsrung ma rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bgegs rnams bzlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ gang dag nag pa'i —208—

phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod lta bar mi dbang ba thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shig /nga bzlas drag rol bya gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ gnas khang huX yig las byung ba'i bsrung 'khor gyi nang du/ bhāX las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa rmetshan nyid thams cad yongs rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba/ rnams kyi nang du/ oX āXhuX zhu ba las byung ba'i/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/dri chang/ zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams/ rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las byung ba/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/ yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stong gi bar du/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig /oX badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pa duX/ de bzhin du/ pu spre/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke ga rnye/ nai wi te/ shasta/āXhūX/ oX sarba bid pū ra pū ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya/ a brta ya ho/ oṃ badz+ra spa ra ṇa khaX/ oX badz+ra lha n+di ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta saX pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba budha slo tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pā ra mi ta na da sam+bha we/ badz+ra sto hri da ya ni snyo ṣa ṇi hūX hūX hūX ho ho ho a jiX swāhā/ zhes rol mo byin 'beb kyi sngags dang / gzhan yang mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs la sogs pa ci rigs pa bzlas shing byin dbab bo/ /zhu 'bul ni/ tshogs pa yod na tshogs kyi gtso bo la gsol gdab pa'i don yin pas byas na legs par 'gyur te/ byed tshul spyi dang —209—

'dra'o/ /dkyil 'khor chen po'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ mnyam langs/bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor rdzogs kyi bar ram/ zhing skyong dag pa gsum gyi bar du byas kyang rung ste/bdag bskyed kyi rnal 'byor rgyas pa nyid rdzogs par bsgom pa yin no/ /gnyis pa sta gon du gnas pa dngos la/ sa'i lha mo sta gon du gnas pa dang / lha sta gon du gnas pa dang / bum pa sta gon du gnas pa dang / slob ma sta gon du gnas pa'o/ /dang po ni dkyil 'khor gyi sa bzhir sa bla'i tshom bu bkod mchod gtor zug mas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sa'i lha mo 'khor dang bcas pa tshom bu'i steng du byon pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor 'bri'i bar gong bzhin/ kye rig pa 'dzin pa dkyil 'khor gyi las ci bde bar mdzod cig oṃ pri shrī wi de lī khyuX.ar+ghaX pra tisnro swāhā/ sa'i lha mo slar yang sa gzhi de nyid la thim bar gyur/ ras bris kyi cho ga la ni sngar nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bteg pa med pas/ sa gnon gyi phyag rgya sa la reg pa nas gzung / dkyil 'khor 'bri zhes pa'i bar sa chog gi skabs bzhin bya ba ni khyad par ro/ /gnyis pa ni/shar dang steng gi phur bu khwa gdong ma nag po sogs nas/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can du gyur/ badz+ra garnye nas bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig bar gong bzhin no/ /de nas da lta'i lag len ltar na/ thig btab la/ gtso bo'i gnas su dri bzang gis thig le gru bzhi pa dang / lha gnas gzhan rnams su zlum por byed/ de rnams su me tog gi tshom bu re bkod/ mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor/ sum bhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las/ 'byung bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i rtse mor/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang nas mchod pa sna tshogs pas gang ba'o/ /oṃ āXhuX/ lan bzhi bcu zhe gcig brjod de/ dri —210—

bzang tshom bu thig le dang bcas pa gdan du byin gyis rlobs pa'o/ /de nas lha thams cad kyi snying po sngags mchod bzhi las so sor lan gsum gsum brjod/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte bar nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la nas/ rdo rje'i 'phreng ba'i mtshan pa'o/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral par o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/ rang gi snying ga'i hū yig gi 'od zer gyis/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i nas dbang gi lha rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim gyis bar yang sgrub thabs bzhin no/ /sa chog gi skabs nam mkha' bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ ye shes pa'i zhor la spyan drangs pa yin pas/ sgos su spyan 'dren mi byed pa'i lugs yin la/ dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga gzhan mang po dag la'ang 'di lta bu yod do/ /de nas mchod pa ni/ rgyas bsdus ji ltar 'os pa bya/ 'jig rten 'das gtor skabs 'dir phul kyang chog ste mchod par 'grel ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas snyan gsan dbab pa ni bdud rtsi lnga dang sha chen sbyar ba'i spos snod thogs te/ gnyis med ye shes las byung ba/ khyab bdag dngos kun bdag nyid can/ /ston pa'i gtso bo khrag 'thung dpal/ /phag mo lhan cig yang dag ldan/ /gang zhig phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang / /rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can/ /byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun/ /ma lus bdag la dgongs su stsole// /slob ma la ni phan pa dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje can bdag 'di zhes pas/ /nang par dkyil 'khor 'bri bar bgyi/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer dgongs te/ /kun gyi byin gyis rlang/sa tu garbe 1 la/ zhes lan gsum mo/ /yang na gsang ba spyi rgyud nas 'byung ba ltar la/he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das nas zhes dang / he ru ka 'byung dkyil 'khor —211—

'di/ /zhes 'don pa spos te brjod kyang wo ngo / /nyi ma de nyid la dkyil 'khor nam mkhar mi 'degs na/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi la sogs pa'i sngags tshan drug bsrung 'khor nas 'byung ba ltar brjod la/ mtshams bcing pa yin kyang lag len mi bde'o/ /de nas gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/ sum bha'i bsangs ba nas/ o ā hū/ lan gsum gyi bar/ sa ma ya sta nas rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /sum bha'i mthar/ a kā ro/ /btags pa phur bu rnams la yang phul/ bar 'dir nag po chen po la sogs pa sgos kyi chos skyong la gtor ma 'bul bar spro na 'bul/ de nas lko kha kha 3 nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gi bar gyis 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma phul/ rjes kyi bya ba ni/ mtshams 'di nas yig brgyas kha bskang ba man chad byas kyang chog la/deng sang gi lag len ltar na bum pa sgrub pa'i rjes su byed do/ /gsum pa ni rtag pa'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i lugs la/ lha sum cu so bdun la bum pa re re/ rnam rgyal dang las bum ste zhe dgur 'dod cing / bde chen 'khor lo'i lnga dang sgo ma bzhi'i re re ste dgur yang 'chad do/ /'on kyang 'di'i gtso bum dang rnam rgyal tha dad du byas pa ni ha cang legs pa ma yin no/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lnga/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ 'khor lo gsum la phyogs mtshams phye bas drug ste/ las bum gcig nyi shu 'am/ 'khor ra lo lnga la bum pa re re dang / gtso bum las bum ste/ bdun nam/ 'khor lo lnga dang las bum ste drug kyang bzhed la/ bde chen 'khor lo'i lnga dang / 'khor lo lhag ma bzhi la re re ste dgur yang mdzad do/ /bhu ba blo ldan gyis ni/ gtso bo yab yum dang / rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang / mtshams kyi bum pa bzhi ste dgu zhes dang / dge slong dā ri ka pas bkra shis khrus kyi bum pa brgyad dang / dbang bskur rgyal ba'i bum pa/ dung chos rnam rgyal zhes 'dod pas rgyal ba rnam rgyal gyi ngos 'dzin dus 'khor dang bstun par snang la/ lhag ma grub chen nag po spyod pa'i dgongs pa yang 'di nyid yin no/ /'dod tshul tha dad pa de dag las/ bum pa —212—

dgur byed pa rnams kyi lugs thams cad dang mthun par/ bcu pa ni las bum mo/ /bsdu na gnyis su byed pa yang thams cad dgongs pa mthun pas/ skabs 'dir 'di ltar bya/ bum pa mang na lha grangs dang mnyam pa yin yang / da ltar lag len byed pa nyung la/ 'bring du na bum pa bcu ste/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang / khrus kyi bum pa brgyad dang las bum mo/ /nyung ba la gnyis te rnam rgyal bum pa dang las bum mo/ /de la rnam rgyal bum par dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yongs rdzogs bskyed dgos shing / las bum du ni hu mdzad 'jig rten gsum rgyal bskyed pa dang / he ru ka yab rkyang / shin tu khros pa zhig bskyed pa dang / dum skyes ma bskyed pa dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed pa rnams la dkyil 'khor chog so so'i khungs re thams cad la yod kyang / lag len du dum skyes ma bskyed par mdzad do/ /bum pa'i mtshan ma yang / bum pa mang ba'i phyogs la lha so so'i phyag mtshan gdan dang bcas pa 'god cing / yab yum gnyis gnyis bzhugs pa la'ang phyag mtshan gnyis kar 'god pa dang /yab kyi phyag mtshan kho na 'god pa'i lugs gnyis yod cing / dgu'i phyogs la 'dod tshul sna tshogs yod kyang / skabs 'dir rnam rgyal bum pa la rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan/ bkra shis khrus kyi bum pa brgyad la gri gug /las bum la'ang rang lha'i phyag mtshan 'god dgos pas dum skyes ma'i gri gug go /mtshan ma rnams kyang lto ba'am kha'i g.yel kha'am/ mchu 'phyang gang la bkod kyang 'dra ste dgos don mtshungs pa'i phyir ro/ /bum pa rnams gos zung gis g.yogs/ mgrin par srad bu dkar pos lan bdun du dkris/ 'bras so ba dang / mon sran dang / nas dang / gro dang / til te 'bru lnga dang /mu tig gser mu min/ byu ru dngul te rin po che lnga dang / kan+ta ka ri dang / sle tre dang / rgya mtsho'i sbu ba dang / chu srin sder mo dang / shu thag dkar po ste sman lnga dang / gur gum/ ga bur tsan+dan dkar dmar gla rtsi ste dri lnga dang / me tog kha dog sna lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga po'am/ me tog gi dod du/ 'o ma/mar/ sbrang rtsi/ bu ram/ lan tshwa ste/ snying po lnga byed pa'ang yod pa/ spyir gnyis kar drang yang skabs —213spo

'dir me tog rigs lnga gtso bor bya ste/ de rnams/ oṃ ā hu/ bzla bzhin du bum par gzhug gokha rgyan/ yal 'dab/ me tog /'bras bu sogs ldan pa'i shing dge mtshan can gyi lcugs mas bya/gu gul gyis bdugs/ zhal bzhi pas sngags bzlas pa'i yungs dkar gyis bgegs bskrad/ dri bzang gi chus dgang ngo / /dung chos sam thod pa dri bzang gi chus gang ba'i steng du gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa yang steng du bzhag /de nas mtha' mchod gtor gyis bskor la/ mchod pa byin rlabs bya/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ sna tshogs pad+ma bcu'i steng / a rnams las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du bhu rnams las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing / mgrin pa phra ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyi mgul bcing dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du 'khor lo bde mchog: nas ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i shar du mkha' 'gro nas rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng gi mtshan ma hū las mi bskyod pa sngon po/ shar gyi mtshan ma bru las rnam snang dkar po/ lho'i mtshan ma a las rin chen 'gyung ldan ser po/ nub kyi mtshan ma dzi las 'od dpag med dmar po/ byang gi mtshan ma kha las don yod grub pa ljang khu rnams rang snang ba'i yum dang bcas par gyur pa bkra shis khrus kyi bum pa brgyad po na/ khrus kyi bum pa brgyad kyi nang dang lha mtshan gyis gnas su sgo mtshams ma brgyad grub pa ni/ shar 'a gdong ma nas g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/las bum gyi nang dang mtshan ma'i dbus su/ khaṇ+ḍa ro ha sku mdog dmar po ste/ de thams cad kyang drag mo che mo cher khros pa: nas dbus na bzhugs pa bo'i bar/—214—

khrus bum med na/ bum pa brgyad du sgo mtshams ma brgyad bskyed pa'i tshigs rnams dang / de thams cad kyi zhes pa'i tshigs bor bas 'grub bo/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral bar e rna nas/ lha rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim gyi bar/lha sta gon gyi skabs bzhin las/ rgyas byed kyi gzhug tu las bum gyi khaṇ+ḍa ro ha la 'od dpag tu med pas dbu rgyan zhes lhag por brjod/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams sgrub thabs las mchod pa'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin te/ 'on kyang nang mchod byin rlabs dang / bla ma rnams kyi masno smos pa dag mi dgos so/ /rdo rje dang 'brel ba'i me tog 'phreng ba nas bzung ste/ bzlas pa bya la/ de yang rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba rnams/ kha dog dmar po'i tshul gyis spros pa gzungs thag la 'khril nas song ba/ lha rnams thugs kar reg pas thugs rgyud bskul/ sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod la/ gtso bo yab yum gyi sngags brgya rtsa brgyad las mi nyung ba bzla/ 'khor rnams la bdun las mi nyung ba bzla ba dang / las bum la khaṇ+ḍaro he'i sngags dang / yi ge bdun pa rnams kyang ci rigs par bzla zhing / khyad par sum bha lan nyi shu rtsa gcig las mi nyung ba bzla'o/ /mthar i tshe sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hū/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs pa bzlas/ dung chos la dmigs nas/ skye( badz+ra a mṛ ta u da ka hu/zhes pa nyer gcig tsam bzlas lha sta gon gyi skabs ltar 'jig rten 'das pa'i lha la gtor ma 'bul/ gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ yig brgya tshar gsum/ ma pha ye 'byarngo ra pa dang / zhes sogs nas/ bzod par gsol/ o ā hu/ zhes pas mchod yon phul/ mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ dge slong dā ri ka pas lha gzhan rnams zhu zhing / las bum gyi lha mi —215—

zhu bar 'dod kyang mtha' gcig tu de ltar mi dgos so/ /yal 'dab kyis las bum gyi chu blangs la/thams cad la bsangs shing / ji srid dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du/ bgegs thams cad bsrung ba'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod do/ /cho ga cung zad bsdus pa byed na/ bum pa'i mtshan ma rnams lhar bskyed mi dgos/ gtor ma 'bul ba dang / bzlas pa'i rjes kyi mchod bstod kyang bor bas rung ngo / /da ltar gyi lag len dang bstun nas skabs 'dir rjes chog byed na/ mchod pa gsar du'ang bsham/ rnying pa gsos mchod 'phreng bzhin byin gyis rlabs/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis phul/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum brjod/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs/ bzod par gsol/ bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ o badz+ra u la zhes pa dang rdo rje shugs kyi phyag rgyas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar bzhugs par bsam/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rkang brgyad rnams kyis mchod bstod bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams spyan ma drangs kyi bar du/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs la/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la thugs brtse ba chen po mdzad de/ nangs par dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ lko brjod/de nas bdag nyid bsrung ba dang smon lam dang bkra shis sogs bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ zhi bas sbyang ba dang zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba dang / drag po'i sbyang ba ste bgegs sbyang ba dang / til sbyang gi sdig pa sbyang ba rnams sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas sta gon gyi chos bcu gsum bya ste/ bsam pa brtan dang bu ru sgrub/ /gsol btab sngags kyi che ba brjod/ /sdom bzung lhar bskyed mchod pa 'bul/ /bsrung skud khyor chu so shing dang / /ku sha zab mo'i chos bshad cing / /rmi lam brtag ste ngan na bsrung / zhes bya —216—

ste/ de yang slob ma rnams 'dus pa la/ sems bskyed gsal btab/ slob ma rnams kyis maṇ+ḍal phul/ de nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pa brtan po bskyed pa/ slob ma bur sgrub pa/ gsol ba btab pa/ gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed pa/ sdom pa bzung ba/ lhar bskyed pa/ mchod pa 'bul ba/bsrung skud bcing ba/ khyor chu/ so shing / ku sha sbyin pa/ zab mo'i chos bshad pas spro ba bskyed pa/rmi lam brtag cing ngan na bsrung ba ste/ chos bcu gsum las/ dang po ni slob dpon gyis 'di skad ces/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang / /dkyil 'khor 'dir ni 'jug bya ste/ /bsod nams 'dod pas de las gzhan/ /gzhan dag 'jig rten pha rol gnyen/ /dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas/ /blo ldan dkyil 'khor 'jug bya ste/ /'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya/ /gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na/ /'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na/ /'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub/ ces brjod la don yang bshad do/ /gnyis pa ni/slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ khyed rang rnams kyi lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ slob dpon gyi zhal du bcug /sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang du gnas pa/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis spyan drangs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zhal du zhugs/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba/ rdo rje lam nas byung ste khyed rang rnams la dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib sbyangs te dag pa'i shel ltar gyur pa/ mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ pad+ma'i gdan la 'khod par gyur/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rdo rje phag mo'i mgrin 'phyud pa'i/ /dga' —217—

chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /zhes slob mas lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ bzhi pa ni/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la/ khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te/ /gsang sngags spyod pa'i cho ga 'di/ khyod la yang dag bshad par bya/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang 'das dang / /de bzhin gang dag ma byon dang / /da ltar byung ba rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'gro la phan phyir bzhugs pa kun/ /de dag kun gyi gsang sngags kyi/ /cho ga bzang po 'di mkhyen nas/ /dpa' bos byang chub shing drung du/ /thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan med brnyes/ /gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de/ /skyob pa dpal ldan he ru kas/ / bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa/ /dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom/ /de bas kun mkhyen thob byas phyir/bu yi blo gros 'di gyis shig ces brjod kyang don spyod/lnga pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs lan gsum rjes bzlos byar gzhug ste thun mong gi sdom pa bzung ba'o/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor gsang sngags mkha' 'gro ma/ /'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid can/ /kun la rtag tu skyabs su mchi/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ / byang chub sems dpa' bdag nyid che/ /khyad par du ni slob dpon la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dpal —218—

ldan khrag 'thung sogs dpa' bo/ /rnal 'byor ma dang snang mdzad sogs/ /byang chub sems dpa' dpag med pa/ / thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /che ge dus 'di nas gzung ste/ /ji srid gnyis med la gnas par/ /de yi myongs spyod gnyis med pe/ /nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bsrung / zhes lan gsum rjes bzlos kyi thun mongs ma yin pas sdom pa bzung ngo / /drug pa ni/ slob ma he ru ka phyag gnyis par gsal ba'i gnas gsum du bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i dri bzang gis thig le bya zhing / tsho( ā hu/snying gar hu sngon po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ dpral par oṃ dkar po/ yang dpral ba nas mar reg ste/ o ā hū/ sangs rgyas thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par spyan drangs/ slob ma'i gnas gsum du thim par mos/ bdun pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra puspro lnga hu/ sogs nyer spyod lngas slob ma la mchod/ brgyad pa bsrung skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ hū las byung ba'i rdo rje'i srad bu dmar po/rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum dang bcas pa/ bar chad thams cad bsrung ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ye shes kyi srad bu h+pha/ dza hu ba ho gnyis su med par thim/yi ge brgya pa dang sum bha/ spel bas bzla zhing / skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon dang / bud med kyi g.yas su bcing ngo / /las bum gyi chus kyang gtor ma la/ rdo rje rgya gra du reg la go skon par mos/dgu pa ni/ o hi bi shudha sa sgro dharmā sa rbu pā pa ni tsā gya lha( dha ya sarba bi ka lhan a pa nā ya hū/ zhes pas lan gsum khyor chu blud/ bcu pa ni/ hu las byung ba'i byang chub kyi shing gi rang bzhin so shing rtse la srad bu dmar po dang me tog gi 'phreng ba bcings pa dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ sum bha/bzlas bzhi du sbyin/ des kyang / oṃ badz+ra ha sa ha zhes drang por dor la/ slob dpon gyi dngos —219—

grub lung ston no/ /bcu gcig pa ni/ hu las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa rtse ma nyams pa/rmi lam mi 'khrugs pa byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ hi ha ha hu hu phaṭa/lan gsum/ dhi zhes ku sha chung ba g.yas dang / hā/ zhes che ba g.yon du gtad/wa gnyis pa ni/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wa ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rgya lam na ni re 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo / /gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba/ /de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste/ /gang gi mnyam med sems can don/ /mya ngan mi zla byed par nus/ /bskal pa bye ba du ma sa /sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang / /dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag /de dag zad par 'gyur yin na/ /grags pa mtha' yas bsngags brjod pa'i/ /tshul la gnas pas smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros brtan zhing mi g.yo na/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni/ /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ / yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen la/ /sang ni rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen por cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ /khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung bskal pa chen po la/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing don 4gad/ bcu gsum pa ni/ rmi lam dge ba'am mi dge ba/ /nangs par nga la rab tu smos/ /do —220—

nub ku sha'i sngas stan la/ /seng ge'i nyal stabs dang dge ba'i sems kyi nyol zhig /de las rmi lam gyi mtshan ma bzang ngan dag mthong bar 'gyur zho /zhes brjod/ slob ma rnams kyi lus la go cha gnyis dgos pa'i dmigs pa tsam byas te/ dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang ngo / /slob ma'am slob dpon rmi lam mi dge ba dag byung na bzlog pa'i thabs ni/zhing skyong mkha' 'gro thams cad la/ /gtor ma cho ga bzhin tu sbyin/ /yi ge brgya pas brtan byas shing / /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo kun tu spyad/ /dpa' bo zhal gyi sngags la sogs/ /thams cad kyang ni bzlas par bya/ /go chas bdag nyid srung ba dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams la/ /gsol gdab brgyan sogs nga rgyal blangs/ /me yis las la kun brtson pas/ /bgegs rnams thams cad zhi bar bya/ zhes bshad par bya'o/ /de yang gtor ma sbyin pa/ yig brgya bzla ba/bsrung 'khor sgom pa/ las thams cad pa bzla ba/ go cha gsum bsgom pa/ lha la gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyan byin gyis rlabs pa/ rang lha'i nga rgyal bsgom pa/ bdag 'jug gi dbang blang ba/ sbyin sreg byed pa ste bcu po de dag las ji ltar 'os par sbyar ro/ /lnga pa thig gdab pa la thog mar phur pa bskyed chog mchod pa gong bzhin dang / gtor ma bsangs sbyangs 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs gong bzhin 'bul/ de nas thig gi cho ga dngos ni/dkyil 'khor gyi sa la sum bha bzlas pa'i dri bzang gi chu'i gtor/ rang dang grogs gtso bo yab yum du gsal bas/ lnga lnga nyi shu rtsa lnga dang ldan pa'i thig skud 'dus byas la/ mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin gyis rlabs/ thig skud bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las dbus su hu las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum mā ma ki la —221—

'byud pa/ shar du bhuX las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma la 'khyud pa/ byang du aX las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma la 'byud pa/nub tu dzi las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum gos dkar mo la 'byud pa/ lhor khaX las don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum dam tshig sgrol ma 'khyud pa/ snam snang zla ba dang gzhan rnams nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ rigs lnga ni stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan pa'o/ /yum rnams sku mdog yab dang mtshungs shing gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dbu skra grol ba'o/ /thams cad kyang rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa'o/ /dpral par oX/ mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ rang gi snying ga'i huX yig gi 'od zer gyis nas/ ye shes sems dpa' rigs lnga yab yum gyi rnam par h+pha/ dzaXhūX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs nas/ huX bruX aX dzi khaX/ oX a kā ro sogs kyis gtor ma phul/ ar+ghaX: nas shabha'i bar gyis mchod/ de nyid lnga pa'am rigs lnga'i bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod/ de la de nyid lnga pa ni/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog 4dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa che/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje nam mkha' dri med mkha'/ /rang bzhin dag pa gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje —222—

dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog nam mkha' rdo rje 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gro phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces pa'o/ /rigs lnga yab yum zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud rnam pa lngar gyur/ o ā hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ā bhu hū phaṭa swāhā/ tsho( ā 65 hu phaṭa swāhā/ tse( u tri rdo hū phaṭa swāhā/ tse( ā kha hū phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa dang / gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po ci rigs pa'i byin gyis rlabs/ yang / tse( tra kha hu zhes pa rnams sa bon du byas te gtor sngags dang byin rlabs kyi sngags sogs la'ang de'i rigs 'gre'o/ /de nas ye shes kyi thig lnga tshan du bsgril la snying po bzla'o/ /las thig ni/ byin rlabs de dang mtshungs pa'am/ las thams cad pa'i lhar bskyed kyang rung ste/ khrag chen gyis spags la gsum sgril du bsgril/ bdud rtsi lnga dang tsan+dan gyis byugs/ 'bru gsum dang hū yig gcig pus byin gyis brlab bo/ /o badz+ra sa ma ya su tra ma ti kra ma hū/ zhes bzla zhing grogs la gtad la/ rdzordzo rdzo zhes brjod/ 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa'i dus ni 'di yin no/ /zhes bsam/ma lus 'jig rten khams bzhugs pa'i/ sangs rgyas la sogs khyed rnams kyis/ /'gro don mdzad pa'i dus 'di ni/ /lags pas de phyir 'dir byon cig /ces dang por nam mkha' dang de nas sa la gdab bo/ /de yang byang lho nub shar tshangs thig ste/ me rlung srin dbang zur thig go /rtse mo can dang 'byung pos shar/ /gtsug phud can dang mtshan rgyus lho/ /g.yo byed bsrung bas nub kyi ste/ /rta dmar drags po byang du'o/ /g.yon nas brtsams pa'i bskor ba —223—
