dang / /slob ma'i slob dpon rgyab mi phyogs/ /rdul wo gyi dkyil phrog ra la ni/ shin tu go skabs mi bde na ma gtogs/ 'jig rten lho la dkyil 'khor gyi shar bstan par bya la/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la ni nges pa med do/ /de nas phyogs thams cad rang bzhin mnyam pa nyid du shes par bya'o/ /de nas las thig gdab pa la/ dkyil 'khor spyi'i mtshan nyid gzhan du rtogs par bya la/ nang gi cha ni dge slong dā ri ka pas/ tshangs pa'i thig gi ngos rer yang re re lngar bya nyi shu gdab/ pho brang la gnyis ge sar gcig /gsum gsum gyi ni 'khor lo rnams/ /ka ba gri gug rdo rje'i 'phreng / /pad+ma 'khor lo re rer bya/ /gcig gi phyi ma'i khyams yin te/ /ces pa ltar tshangs thig nas rtsa thig gi bar la cha chen bzhi yod pa re re yang / lnga tshan lnga tshan du bkod/ pad+ma'i snying po la gnyis/ 'khore lo bzhi la gsum gsum/ ge sar dang 'phreng ba bzhi la re re/ lha rnams la gcig go /yang na ge sar gyi dod 'dab ma la snon par bshad kyang / de'i dod lha rnams la bsnan na legs te/ yang na 'jigs med 'byung gnas zhabs kyis grub chen kū yi pa'i dgongs pa bskang ba ltar btab kyang rung la/ rtsa rgyud kyi 'grel pa lā ba pas mdzad pa nas bshad pa'i thig gi rnam bzhag kyang lha yi pa'i lugs 'di dang 'brel chags pa yin pas de dag gsum po gang rung zhig dang mthun par gdab bo/ dur khrod ni bsrung 'bor gyi phyi nang gang yang rung bar te/ rdo rje'i ra ba'i nang du 'bri na cha chen gcig yin la/ phyi rol du 'bri na tshad nges pa med do/ /rta babs yang sgo'i tshad gsum 'gyur dang / sgo tshad gcig la sogs pa dang snam bu yang bzhi dang brgyad dang bcu gcig la sogs pa tshad dang ldan pa'i lugs gcig dang mthun na gang yang 'gal ba med do/ /de nas thig gi lha la mchod bstod phul/ tse( ā hu badz+ra mu zhes gshegs su gsol/ skabs 'dir mig tu hi bkod la sgo'i rtsa thig phyi/ 'on kyang 'di bskor gyi gzhung thun mong ma yin pa rnams nas/ sgo'i rtsa thig dbyibs ma gsungs pas/ ma byas kyang chog par mngon no/ /drug pa rdul tshon dbye ba ni/ rdul —224—

mtshon lnga'am nyi shu rtsa lnga 'dus byas la/ mchod gtor gyis bskor/ mchod pa byin rlabs nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying pos byin gyis rlabs pa'i bar/ thig skud byin rlabs dang 'dra ba las/ rdul mtshon rnam pa lngar gyur/ zhes 'dod pa spo/ tse( badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hu/ zhes lan brgya rtsa brgyad kyis byin gyis brlabs/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su kha lhor phyogs pas gnas te/'di ni chos dbyings dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tsho ni gyi las ni yang dag brtsam/ ces brjod/ tse( badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hū/ gi sngags bzla zhing / rtsig pa dkar po nas brtsams te/ bri bar bya'o/ /tshon gyi kha dog ni phal cher dkyil 'khor spyi'i mtshan nyid/ mtshan rtogs pas shes par 'gyur la/ lha rnams kyi phyogs mdog shar dkar lho ser sogs yin la/ thugs 'khor gyi gzhi ljang khu/ gsung 'khor gyi dkar po/ sku 'khor gyi dmar po bshad pa'ang yod la/ yang de gsum rim can du sngo dkar dmar bar mdzad pa'ang yod de/ de gnyis ka'ang rgyud so so'i dgongs pa'o/ /'dod snam yang dmar po dang ser po dang dkar po ji ltar bris kyang rung / bde chen 'khor lo'i mu khyud ser po dang / gri gug gi 'phreng ba sngon po'o/ /rdo rje ra ba yang gzhi sngon po la rdo rje ljang khu'i 'phreng bar bya'o/ /lha'i mtshan ma ni/ gtso bo'i gnas su rdo rje dang gri gug gam/ thod pa la gnas pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la'o/ /phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi dang sgo mtshams ma brgyad la yang gri gug ste brgyad po ni mi ro'i gdan la'o/ /mtshams kyi 'dab ma bzhi la ni bum thod do/ /thugs kyi rtsibs brgyad la rdo rje gri gug re'o/ /gsung gi brgyad la pad+ma dang gri gug go /sku'i brgyad la 'khor lo dang gri gug go /yang na gtso bo'i gnas dang thugs 'khor lo rdo rje/ gsung la pad+ma/ sku la 'khor lo/ rnal 'byo ra ma bcu gnyis la gri gug go /yang na 'kho1ra lo gsum la rdo rje dang gri gug 'ba' —225—

zhig go /gzhan yang gcig tu gtso bo'i gnas su rdo rje dang / lhag ma rnams la gri gug go /'ga' zhig las ni phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi la rigs bzhi'i phyag mtshan gyis mtshan pas kha ṭa ga re re'o/ /gzhan dag ni gri gug sum cu rtsa bdun zhes kyang 'dod do/ /de thams cad la mi rung ba med par mngon no/ /de bzhin du sa bon dang sngags kyi yi ge 'bri ba dang lugs su byas pa dang ri mor bris pa'i sku gzugs 'jog pa dang / rdul tshon gyi tshom bu dang gdan gyi rnam par dgod pa sogs kyang / ji ltar skabs su bab pa dag bya'o/ /de nas slob dpon gyis rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu dkrol la dkyil 'khor la g.yon nas lan gsum du bskor nas/ shar lhor yi ge brgya pa dang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags bzlas nas/ bris kyi skyon dag par bsam mo/ /rdul mtshon gyi lhag ma la mchod bstod gshegs gsol bya/ lhag ma'i thig tshon de dag dben pa'i gnas su bzhag go/bdun pa/ rgyan dang yo byad dgod pa ni/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad du dgos pa la/ de dag tu mi bde na rdo rje'i ra ba'i nang gi phyogs mtshams brgyad du'o/ /rnam rgyal bum pa la ni gtso ba'i gnas su 'god cing / 'dir yang der mi bde na shar gyi bum pa'i nang tshan du dgod par bya'o/ /las bum ni 'jig rten gyi lto dkyil 'khor wo po'i shar sgo'i g.yon logs su 'god do/ /bum pa rnams kyi steng du rin po che dang bza' ba sna tshogs kyis bkang ba'i thod pa bzhag go /gzhan yang ji skad du/ me tog spos dang mar me dang / /dri dang bza' ba rol mo dang / /gos dang ku sha rgyan la sogs/ /nye 'khor du ni dgod par bya/ /chang dang sha rlon gtor ma dang / /'du ba yi ni rdzas rnams kun/ /de yis phyi rol dag tu bzhag /dar dang bla bre gdugs dang ni/ /rgyal mtshan rnams kyis gnas brgyan te/ khrag 'thung cha lugs 'dzin pa yis/ /sgo gsum bzhi ni bzhag par bya/ zhes pa ltar/ bum pa 'bul ba'i skabs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te dkyil 'khor la bskor ba lan gcig gam gsum byas nas/ bum pa gzhan rnams so so'i gnas su 'jog rnam rgyal —226—

bum pa ni gtso 'khor thams cad kyi sngags bzlas bzhin du/ so so'i gnas su 'jog tshul tsam byas nas/ mthar dbus sam shar phyogs su 'jog pa lag len du mdzad kyin snang bas spros pa la dga' na de ltar bya la/ 'on kyang gzhung nas bshad pa ma mthong ste/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshe ma byas kyang chog go /brgyad pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni/ gong du bshad pa ltar/ sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bdag bskyed rdzogs pa'i bar bsgoms nas/ dkyil 'khor la dmigs te sbyang ba gsum byed dgos pa las/ bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma'am mtheb kyu gsum po rim gyis bskor la/ oX sarba bisnrin khyuX na maXsarba ta thā ga ta sbyo bi shwa mu khe da bh+yaX sarba thā khaX ud ga te spa ra ṇa i maX ga ga na khaX/ gro hā dam ba li te swāhā/zhes lan gsum/ 'dir bgegs kyis tshogs gang yin pa thams cad/ mchod spyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig zhi bas sbyang ba'o/ /oX sum bha sogs lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo'am chang bu skor/'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad/ gtor ma lam rngan ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shig ces pas ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyangs pa'o/ /hūX mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas nas bden stobs brjod la mthar drag po'i mtshams rngams rol chen dang bcas pas skrad pa ni/ 'di ltar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / yi dam rgyal ba dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / dpal mgon dam pa chos —227—

skyong bsrung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang /sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi bka' bden pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang / chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po sgrub cing mchod pa dang dbang gi las la 'jug pa la/ bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag /deng dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos pas sa'i phyogs 'dir gnas par myur ba nyid du songs shig /gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i/ khro bo'i rdo rje dang rdo rje kha ṭa ga 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis/ khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar gas par bya'o/ /zhes bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyar dor/ drag pos sbyangs pa'o/ /dge slong dā ri ka pas/ bgegs la gtor ma sbyin byas te/ /zhal bzhi pa'i sngags bzlas shing / myong bu dang ni mar mes sbyangs/ gu gul yung dkar gyis bgegs la/ zhes bshad bgegs sbyang ba gsum mo/ /bsdus pa la mos na/ bka' bsgo ba yid kyis byas nas sngags tsam brjod do/ /bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge ba gyi rnam par gnas pa/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od kyis ded de/ sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ bsangs sbyangs/ 'bar ba'i me nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' 'gro rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o/ /o badz+ra ḍa ka kha kha 'a —228—

hi ji hi/ sarba pā paX da ha na bhasmi ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rje til g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu dor bas rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang / rgya mtsho chen por bsgyur bar bsam/ mthar me yang chu nang du lugs so/ /sdig pa spyad pa'o/ /de nas me long bstan te/ las bum blangs nas khrus gsol bya ste/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam nas/ shri ye huX/ 'di ni khrus mchog sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs dang /sogs rol chen dang / bcas pas kyang khrus gsol/ de dag sku la nas/ tseX( huX truX hriX.aXkwa ya bi shwadha na ye swāhā/ zhes sku phyis phul/ spro na dri'i byug pa dang / gos brgyan yang 'bul te/ dri ma sbyangs pa'o/ /de nas bar 'dir phur bu gsal btab nas mchod pa 'bul ba sta gon gyi skabs bzhin/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor bsangs sbyangs/ skye( shu n+ya ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ oṃ a ni mi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra su bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ oX a pra ṇi hi ta dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ zhes rnam thar sgo gsum gyi don bsam mo/ /stong pa'i ngang las/ yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po nas/ lcog brgyad dang ldar/ pa/de'i rtse mor bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su nas gang ba'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte ba rang nyid hūX yig gi rnam par gnas par gyur/ de las 'od zer kha dog lnga 'phros/ 'khor los lnga'i: zhes pa nas/ rjes chags kyis zhu ba huX yig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa ni/ bde chen 'khor lo'i dbus kyi lte bar 'khor lo bde mchogangunas me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo'i 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma: nas rdo rje 'phreng ba'i mtshan pa'o/ /yab kyi snying gar oX ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' nas nyi ma'i 'od can —229—

no/ /lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ nas dbang gi lha thams cad rang la gnyis su med par thim gyi bar lha sta gon gyi skabs dang 'dra/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i huX yig gi 'od zer gyis/ sta gon gyi lha rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drangs par gyur h+pha/ ra/ lan gcig bzlas shing rdo rje gsor/chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rnams kyis mchod/ rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ dzaXhūX baX hoX lan mang du brjod/ oṃ yo ga shudha sarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo3 haX/ zhes brjod do/ /sgrub ma rdzo zhag sbrel ma byed na/ dngos gzhi nyi ma gnyis pa phan chad la/ sta gon gyi lha spyan 'dren 'di mi dgos so/ /de nas byin rlabs drug skor du grags pa/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor byin gyis brlabs pa'i bzlas pa ste/ kha cig mchod pa'i rjes su bzlas pa byed par 'dod pa yang yod do/ /mchod pa lan gcig las mi byed na/ mchod pa'i sngon du bzlas pa bya la/ gnyis byed na gnyis kyi bar du byas pasalegs par 'gyur ro/ /gang ltar yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las/ he ru ka gnyis pa zhig chad nas/ bzlas pa dang mchod pa byed cing bdag 'jug len pa yin la/ las kyi rdo rje lho phyogs su 'dug la/ dbyugs gu'i sna la rdo rje btags pas/ lha so so'i gnas su gnod pa med par reg cing / sngags mchod bzhin lha thams cad kyi snying po tshar gcig brjod/ bum thod kyi gnas su 'bru gsum brjod de dang po'o/ /'dir re re bzhin mang du bzlas na legs so/ /de nas lha thams cad la yum gyi nye snying bzla ste gnyis pa'o/ /skye( ka ka su/ tha/ 'u/ ka phya/ shwa na phya/ su ka rā phya huX huX phaṭa/ zhes pa'am sgo mtshams ma brgyad char gyi sngags bzla ste/ gsum pa'o/ /tseX( a ā/i yī/ u ā/ ṛ grwa/ '-i lī/ e i/ tse( e(/ aX aX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzla ste bzhi pa'o/ /oṃ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa rte ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'ang bzla ste lnga pa'o/ /lha so so'i —230—

mtshan dang spel ba'i yi ge brgya pa'am/ de ma lcogs na/ he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa nyid/ lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi gnas su sbyar bas chog ste drug pa'o/ /byin rlabs bzlas pa 'di'i thog mthar/ ar+gha:nas/ sha lta'i bar gyis mchod pa re dang rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa re bya/ mthar/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag la dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la me tog dor/bum pa la dmigs nas/ sta gon gyi skabs su bstan pa ltar so so'i sngags brgya rtsa la sogs pa'i ji ltar 'os pa bzla'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ nag po zhabs lugs kyi dkyil mchog tu bshad pa ltar/mchod pa byin rlabs nas brtsam ste mchod pa mtha' dag 'bul zhing / ci ste bsdus pa la mngon par dga' bas kyang / bstod pa ma gtogs tshigs bcad rnams dor te/ sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gsum 'dzoms pa'i sgo nas/ lhag ma mtha' dag ma tshang ba med par bya'o/ /de'i 'og tu gtor ma 'bul ba yang bya ste/ sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa bzhin no/ /phyi rol gtor ma thun mong ma yin pas gzhung rnying pa rnams nas ma bshad pas/ nges par dgos pa yang ma yin la/ lag len la yang mi mdzad pa shas che zhing / ci ste byed par spro na/ phyi rol gtor ma/ skor ba/ me tog 'bul ba/ sgo dbye ba/ gsol gdab rnams/ rdo rje 'phreng ba nas 'byung ba ltar bya'o/ /sgrub mchod zhag mang por sbrel ba'i skabs/ dngos gzhi nyi ma gnyis pa phan chad la/ skabs 'dir bum sgrub sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ cho ga rgyas par byed pa'i lag len snang ba/ 'dir bum pa sgrub pa'i nyi ma rnams la/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i skabs su bum bzlas mi dgos so/ /dgu pa bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ gzhung tha dad nas rgyas bsdus sna tshogs bshad kyang / slob ma ji tsam bskur ba de tsam rdzogs par len pa da ltar lag len byed do/ /de yang rang nyid gtso bo'i mdun zhal gyi sgo dang nye ba'i 'dug cing gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis —231—

pas las mdzad par dmigs la/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las yang dag byung / /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung / /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyi dri med mthong bar shog lan gsum/ rdo rje phag mos mgrin 'byud pa'i/ /dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ sogs lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oX tsa kur ban+ta ba ra ma na ya skyoX/ gis mig dar bcing / ā khaX bī ra hūX/ gis me tog bzung / las bum gyi chus gtor la/ sum+bha bgegs bskrad/ dpral par skye tshe/ mgrin par āX snying gar hūX gis srung bar bya/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ zhes dris pa la/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan btab/ slar yang / de yis bu la ci zhig bya/ zhes dris pa la/sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes lan btab/ rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid do/ /oX badz+ra yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ rdo rje snying gar gtad/ su ra ta sa ma ya stuX/ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su khaX/ rdo rje mgo bor bzhag la/deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlabs par 'gyur gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /dkyil 'khor khang pa'am yol ba'i nang du bcug par mos la/ huX dza huX/ zhes brjod/ de yan chad ni dkyil chog gi rtsa ba'i gzhung na mi gsal yang /—232—

dkyil chog gi gzhung phyi ma rnams las 'byung zhing / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag gis kha skangs pa'i phyag len no/ /'di man chad 'jug pa'i chos ni 'di ltar/ /sdom pa mdor bstan dam rdzas spyin//srung ba dpa' bo bskul ba dang / /gsol ba gdab cing gnang ba zhu/ /phyag 'tshal sdom pa sbyin pa dang / /dam la bzhag cing ye shes phab/ /nam mkha'i mdog dri me tog phul/ /mig dar phye la lta bar bskul/ /lha ngo bstan zhing de nyid brjod/ /ces bya'o/ /de ltar don tshan bcu drug las/ dang po sdom pa mdor bstan ni/gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ zhes so/ gnyis pa dam rdzas sgyin pa ni/o hi ha ha hū hū phaṭa/ lan gsum sogs bzla bzhin du/ bdud rtsi myang zhing lus la gtor/gsum pa bsrung ba spyin pa ni/ rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa'i skur gsal ba'i/ snying gar o ha dkar po nas/ nyi ma'i 'od can no/ /spyi bo la sogs pa'i nas na si ma ku/ khams rnams dpa' bo dang rtsa rnams dpa' mo'i bdag nyid du gyur/ bzhi pa dpa' mo bskul ba ni/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad he ru ka'i rnam par spyan drangs/ rang gi snying gar thim pas mi shigs pa dpyid kyi rtsa thig dpal he ru ka zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lko shrī he ru ka bid ma he bi rgyu rā dzā ya/dhi ma he swāhā/ zhes lan lnga'am/ bdun no/ /lnga pa gsol ba gdab pa ni/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor —233—

gnas la bdag phyag 'tshal/ /don dam smra ba'i seng ge zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur par/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs chom mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid 'grub par mdzod/ces lan gsum/ drug pa gnang ba zhu ba ni/ de bzhin spru/degs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lan gsum/bdun pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ gnas gsum du thal mo sbyor bzhin pas/ tso rna na ma ste hu/na mā me hū/ na mo na ma hu swāhā/ zhes lan gsum mo/ /brgyad pa sdom pa spyin pa la sgrags bzung gnyis las/ sgrags pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rig yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /blo r+ṣa khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khres rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rig dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pas chos ni ma lus bzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ / mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /zhes so/ /—234—

gnyis pa sdom pa bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/sogs lan gsum gyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun/ /thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su/ /byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa bdag gi bskyed par bgyi/ /tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rig mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ / slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rig mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin yang dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs can dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni bzung bar bgyi/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med pa/ /dam pa dag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma brgal ba rnams sgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba rnams —235—

bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyin la dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces pa lan gsum gyis rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'du na la/ zhes pa nas/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs par bzung gi bar na gsum/slob ma lta gon gyi skabs su zugad pa ltar gyi rgyud rgyal 'di nyid kyi thun mong ma yin pas sdom pa bzung bar bzhed do/ /de dag ni sdom bzung rgyas pa'i lugs yin la/ 'bring du na phyi ma gcig pus chog cing / bsdus pa ni/ gtso bo'i ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal/ lan gsum/ /dgu pa dam la bzhag pa ni/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi/ /ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci zhig smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhug rdo rje snying gar reg ste/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras gyur na/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /thod pa nas bdud rtsi'i chu btung la/ /'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /o pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭhaṭha ṭha hū/ zhes dam tshig bsrung ba'i phan yon dang ma bsrung ba'i nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ gang ngas 'di byos zhes bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig khyod mi bde ba —236—

ma spangs par dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes slob dpon gyi bka'/ nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag bcu pa ye shes dbab pa ni/dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shigadapal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ lan gsum/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis par gyur pa/ g.yas brkyang gi zhabs gnyis kyi 'og tu yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon mo zla gam g.yo ba'i ba dan dang bcas pa/ rkang mthil gnyis su yi ge dzhai ljang khu/ sum mdor raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ snying gar laX las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po la rdo rje dang huX gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par baX las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po la bum pa dang as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam nag po la has mtshan pa/ rkang mthil gyi 'og gi dzhai phul/ des sum mdo'i me sbar/ des snying ga'i sa bsregs/ des mgrin pa'i chu skol ba snying ga'i sa la thim pas bde bas gang / rkang mthil gyi rlung dang mes nam mkha' la bteg /spyi bo'i rlung gis mar phul bas 'dar yed yed gnas pa la/ nam mkha' nas lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams dkar po'i rnam pas 'jug cing / de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs shing snying gar thim par gyur/ yab yum gyi snying po dang / oX sarba bī ra yo gi nī badz+ra ā be sha ya staX bha ya ra ra ra ra tsa la ya tsa la ya hūX haX.aXdzhai/ ces pa'i dbab cing / oX tiṣ+ṭha mahā kro dha ā be sha —237—

ya hu/ oṃ shrī he ru kā ya bid ma he biṅgā rā dza ya dhi ma he swāhā/ zhes pa'ang bzla ste rol mo'i sgra dang bcas dbab bo/ /spyir 'khor lo sdom pa'i dbang la/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i sngags phyi ma 'di gnyis yin kyang / 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor bkod pa 'di byas phyin/ sngags snga ma yang bzlas na legs te sngags 'di dang 'brel ba'i dmigs pa yin pas so/ /tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra/ zhes spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag bcu gcig pa nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba ni 'dir mi dgos kyang / slob ma dbang bskur ba'i skabs yin na dgos te/ skabs 'dir nam mkha'i kha dog dri zhim las bzhi lung bstan/ bcu gnyis pa me tog dor ba ni/oṃ pra tisnro badz+ra ho/ zhes me tog dor/ oṃ pra ti gro hā dam i ma satwa mahā pa la/ zhes me tog spyi bor bcings/ bcu gsum pa mig dar dbye ba ni/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong bar gyur/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hri zhes mig dar bsal/ bcu bzhi pa lta bar bskul ba ni/ ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che/ /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub kun khyod dbang bskur gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/bco lnga pa lha ngo bstan pa ni/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du gsal bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing / yid kyis dkyil 'khor gsal btab/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba'i don du ni sgrub thabs ltar lha ngo rgyas pa bstan dgos so/ /bi drug pa de kho na nyid brjod pa ni/ gzhal med khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi —238—

chos sum cu rtsa bdun yin la/ lha sum cu rtsa bdun de rnams rnam par dag pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nas dpal he ru ka yab yum ni/ brtan g.yo thams cad kyi bdag nyid chos kyi dbyings yin la/ 'khor lo lnga'i lha tshogs ni ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid do/ /zhes brjod cing don bsam pa'o/ /de nas dbang gi dngos gzhi la/ thog mar rdo rje slob ma'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyobs pa'i gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas rtsal/ /de bzhin bdag la deng snor stsa'/ cig ces lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ /de nas dang por sngags kyi dbang bskur ba ni/ oX pra titsā badz+ra ho/ zhes me tog dor/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung bdag gi snying gar thim/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po tshar gsum rjes bzlos byas par mos/ spro na lha thams cad kyi snying po tshar gsum gsum dang / bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobe sa/ lan gsum/ spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobe sa/ lan gsum mo/ /de nas bdag dang dbang rdzas thams cad la/las bum gyi chus bsangs shing / sum bha brjod do/ /rig pa'i dbang lnga las chu dbang ni/ su bhā was sbyangs/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ huX las rdo rje hūX gis mtshan pa las/ gnyis ka'ang mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang /g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i cod pan can/ rbas pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ yum mā ma ki sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs rdo rje'i —239—

skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'am/ g.yas brkyang gi bzhugs pa/ dpral par skye(/mgrin par āX thugs kar hūX/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ye shes sems dpa' mi bskyod pa yab yum spyan drangs h+pha/ dza huX baX hoX slar yang mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor h+pha/ pu po sogs kyis ma rdzo/ khyed rnams kyis 'di la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzi bha wa a khiñtsa hūX/ zhes dbang rdzas la dbang bskur sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbu rgyan/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur gyur/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang / dbang gi lha gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ dbang gi lha'i 'khor gzhan rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ me tog gi char phab ste shis pa brjod par gyur/ skabs 'dir bram ze rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa'i dkyil 'bor bkra shis brjod pa'i phyag len snang zhing / bsdu na ma byas kyang chog /oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ sogs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs bcad gsum dang / nyin mo bde legs/ sogs brjod/ rol chen bya/ khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo mtshams ma brgyad sprul/ bkra shis kyi bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis: nas khrus kyi bgyi'o/ oṃ kā ka byā/ u lu kā byā shwa na sgyu/su ka ra sgyu/ ya ma ḍa dhi/ ya ma du ti/ ya ma da spyi ni/ ya ma mā tha ni ye/ oṃ badzi bha —240—

wa a bhi ski nyu skyoX/ de nas dbang gi lha rdo rje phag mo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas/ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod par rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dang bcas pa thogs nas/ dbang bskur rol mo bde chen po zhes pa nas/ sa ma ya shrī huX/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he sogs snying po'i mthar/ oX badz+ra a bhi khri thu/ zhes pas dbang bskur ro/ /bkra shis bum pa brgyad logs su med na/ cho gas rim pa sngar ltar las/ dang po la rnam rgyal nas bum chu gtor ba tsam bya zhing /gnyis pa la bum pa nyid dam bum chu thod par blug nas dbang bskur ba gang bde bya'o/ /de ltar bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer gyi/ mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra pu phye āXhūX/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chus dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags dang sa bon nus pa mthu can du byas pa yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang ni/ spyo bhā wa/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan gnyis ka mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las/ (〈pho〉 yad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du) aX las rin po che aX: rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang / g.yon de'i yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri gug: dpral par skye6 ye shes sems dpa' rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum spyan drangs h+pha/—241—

dza ྅ ba ho dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ dbang rdzas la/ oṃ badzi bha wa a bhi khiñtsa hū/ zhes dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ khyed rnams kyis bdag nas/ gsol zhes gsol btab pas/ ma mo brgyad kya ral pa'i thor tshugs kyis brgyan pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang / /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /oṃ sarba brnya ṭa ki nī/ sogs yum gyi snying po'i dbu rgyan dang dar dpyangs dang bcas pa bcings/ oṃ ka kā sgyu/ sogs dang gtso bo'i snying po brjod/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis rin chen 'byung ldan dpag tu med pa spyan drangs/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas lus thams cad rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rdul phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ mchod pa lngas mchod/ de ltar nang dbu rgyan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag /tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags sa bon nus pa mthu can du byas pa yin no/ /de bzhin du 'og ma gsum la'ang cod pan gyi dbang gis rigs 'gre ste/rdo rje'i dbang ni/dzi las pad+ma bi badzi: 'od dpag med sku mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang : yum gos dkar mo dmar mo/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu sgrub phyir rdo rje long / /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti stu/ a bhi khiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya stu/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis 'od dpag med dpag tu med pa/ lus thams cad 'od dpag tu med pa'i rdul: de ltar na rdo rje'i: 'dod gas ཿ shes so —242—

sor rtog pa'i ye shes: 'od dpag med pa'i zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /dril bu'i dbang ni/ khaX las ral gri khaX: don yod grub pa ljang khu: ral gri dang / yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ shes rab dbyangs kyis rjes 'gror bshad/ khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bshad/ byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis don yod grub pa dpag tu med pa/don yod grub pa'i rdul/ dril bu'i dbang / phrag dog: 'du byed: bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes: don yod grub pa'i/ zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /ming gi dbang ni/ 'di la dbang rdzas med pas/ bdag nyid mi dmigs te: zhes bya zhing / pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bruX las 'khor lo bruX: rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang /yum sangs rgyas sbyan ma dkar mo/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur ba dang / dbang rdzas kyi lha zhu ba mi dgos pas/ dzaXhuX baX hoX khyed rnams kyis bdag la/zhes sbrel bas chog oX shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi khi ྅ 〉 maX/ shrī he ru ka nā maX.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal gsang mtshan dran par bya/ oṃ kā ka sgyu/ sogs dang gtso lo snying po brjod/ sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis/ rnam par snang mdzad dpag tu med pa/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rdul: de ltar na ming gi dbang / gti mugagazugs phung chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /dbang de rnams thob pas bya ba spyod pa'i rgyud nyan pa dang bshad pa dang sngags sgrub la dbang ngo / /spang bya ma rig pa lnga spong zhing / rig pa ye shes lnga skye'o/ /brtul zhugs kyi dbang la gnyis las thun mong ba rdo rje'i brtul zhugs ni/ swa bha wa/ stong pa'i ngang las bdag nyid mi bskyod pa nas bzhugs pa'i bar gong bzhin/ rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i —243—

mi bskyod pa/ thugs rdo rje ngo bo rdo rje/ deng phyin chad tha mal gyi spyod pa rdul la rdo rje sems dpa'i tshul la zhugs shig 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stuX dhar ya mi huX ha ha ha ha ho/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje gnas gsum du reg la snying gar bzhag go /thun mong ma yin pa spyod pa'i brtul tsos ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ rang gi snying gar yang rang dang 'dra ba'i he ru ka huX las byung ba'i cang tes thod pa kha ṭāX ga /tshangs skud rnams su gyur/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭāX cang te'u lhung zed dag /sbyin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis/ kha ṭāX ga dang ḍā ma sa /he ru ka dpal kha ṭāX ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍā ma sa /rdo rje kha ṭāX rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing / /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭāX ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ /ḍā ma ru ni shes rab stong pa nyid kyi sgra sgrogs pa/ kha ṭāX ga ni thabs rig pa byang chub kyis sems lha'i sku/ thod pa bde ba skyong ba/ tshangs pa'i skud pa rnam par mi rtog pa'i thabs shes zung du 'brel ba yin pas na/ de ltar shes par gyis la sems can gyi don gyis shig ces pa'o/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du ma rdzo phul la/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon bgyid/ lan gsum/rdo rje 'di nyid huX las rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo dang po'i rdo rje/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad —244—

de/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ de ring khyod la dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long / /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti stu a bhi khiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha bī ra sa ma ya stu/ lan gsum du gsor la snying gar gtad/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /dril bu 'di nyid ā las snyems pa'i ngo bo dang po'i rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyis/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ lan gsum mam brgyad du dkrol la/ kha nang du bstan te dku g.yon du phyogs par bzhag la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /srid pa dam pa byed par gyur/ /rang skad cig gis rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i cod pan can/ /rdo rje dril bu snying gar bsnol/ /yid kyi lus brtan de nyid ni/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gis lus 'di thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ khres rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'phyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du brjod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zung zhig rdo rje byin gyis rlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ oṃ ka kā sgyu/ nas chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu rgyan gyi bar chad dbang gi skabs bzhin/—245—

dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang la gnyis su med par thim/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha ā hū/sogs nyer spyod lngas phul/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ me tog spyi bor bzhag ste brtan bsas bya/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur bar/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyi bzhed pa yin/ /sems can rnams ni rjes bzung phyir/ /khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /de nas mtha' rten la/ rjes su gnang ba/ dam tshig sbyin pa/ gzengs bstod pa/ dbugasadagrang ba ste bzhi las/ dang po la lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang / de kho na nyid kyi rjes gnang / gzhan don chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang / gnyis don las dang dngos grub kyi rjes gnang ste bzhi las dang po ni/ sgeg sogs brgyad kyi phyag rgya 'cha' bzhin du/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang / khres rab thabs bcas snyoms can gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i mchod pa bgyis/ /a sgeg dang bcas pa'i 'phreng ba 'phyang / /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor pa/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyi blang bar gyis/ /des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang / /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ gī/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las gyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /ho/ sangs rgyas kun la me tog gtor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa'i/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yin/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par 'gyur/ /bhū/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul bzhugs bzang —246—

pos legs tshim gyis/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par 'gyur/ /a chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs rnams la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis/ /prakhyod kyi rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la dgos/ /gha gnyis pa ni/ pra las byung ba'i mig thur du gyur/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la sgru a la byung ba'i me long du gyur/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ dag cing gsal ba rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes kyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med gyis/ /'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skyes/ /spros pa la dga' na 'dir dril bu dang mda' gzhu dang me long gnyis pa'i rjes gnang yang bya/ gsum pa ni/ dung dang / 'khor lo dang / po ti dang / dril bu rnams sbyin par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra he ru ka ma/ o badz+ra bha ga ra/ oṃ badz+ra lha rnye a/ a sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ khyed kyi the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /spros pa la dga' na 'dir rigs sprul bshad kyang bya'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang / /bsad —247—

dang skrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni sgrub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang / /mchil lham de bzhin ril bu ste/ /rnal 'byor ma yi dngos grub ni/ /de ni ci dgar sgrub par gyis/ /gnyis pa dam tshig sbyin pa ni/ nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus las 'di byas nas kyang / /bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid kun srung ngo / /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung / /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bzla bar bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis la mi gnas pa/ /tshes bcu la ni bde rab mchode/ /bsdu na de tsam gyis chog la/ spro zhing nus na/ dam tshig gsum sbyin pa nag po spyod pa'i dkyil chog bzhin du rdzogs par 'don no/ /gsum pa gzengs bstod ni/ lugs 'di la lung bstan yin te/lag pa g.yas skyabs spyin dang g.yon bla gos kyi grwa nas 'dzin pa'i tshul byed cing /he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin/ /mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te/ /he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos po mchog tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he badz+ra a ku rī shrī he ru ka na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi sa mā ya snur bhu ba spyo/ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'di don 'grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la/ mchog tu grub pa'i tshogs rnams rgyal ba thams cad kyis lung ston par mdzod do/ /bzhi pa dbugs dbyung ba ni/khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang / /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /—248—

der ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ /khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis kyang / /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yi/ /brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /de rnams kyi ni dkyil 'khor las/ /rdul tshon nam ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ lus kyi dri ma dag /dam tshig rtsa ba dang yan lag gi lhung ba rnams bsrung / lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal pa can du byas pa yin no/ gsang dbang gi don du ma rdza phul/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya chi sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor ba'i yang dag byang / /bdag nyid chen po khyod ji bzhin/ /mnga' bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab mig dar bcings/ oṃ ā hu gis bdud rtsi gtor/ bla med he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i/thabs kyi byang chub kyi sems bdag nyid lce thog tu bzhag ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gi ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /yum gyi byang chub kyis sems bdag gi khar bab/ 'di de dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig chen po rmad byung ba/ khams lnga las byung bcud kyi len/ bde ba dam pa myong bar byos/ /oṃ —249—

āXhuX/ de ltar na lus kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob pas/ ngag gi dri ma dag dam tshig sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga bsten/ lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs brjod do/ khres rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gsang dbang ltar gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings/ oṃ āXhuX/ bdud rtsi gtor/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma dngos grub kyi don tu phyag rgyar gtad/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/ /zung zhig zung zhig sems dpa' che/ /zung la mchod pa rtag tu gyis/ /rig ma des kyang 'di skad ces/ /bshang gci dag ni bza' ba dang / khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ kha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+ma ra tsum pa rnams/ /bu khyod ji ltar dga' bar smos/ lko dris pa la/ lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ khu khrag la sogs bza' ba dang / /bud med rnams la rtag gus shing / /pad+ma'i bha ga cis mi len/ zhes lan btab/ des kyang skye gnas mchog gi rtsa gsal bar byas nas/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba thams cad pad+ma ra byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /bhaX dza mo k+ṣa ho/ lko dbang du byon/rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang / rig ma rdo rje phag mor gyur yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las huX dkar por nas rgyas shing brtan par gyur/ gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ oṃ āXhuX gis gdong g.yogs dkrol/ de ltar na bha ga'i —250—

dkyil 'khor du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas sems kyi dri ma dgadam tshig tu shes rab ma'i rigs la smad par mi bya/ lam dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ khyod zhabs pad+ma'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin skyabs du gsol/ /lan gsum gyi gsol ba gdab/ de ltar yang sdom pa 'byung ba las/ /rnam pa sna tshogs dri med pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor dag ni spro bar gnang / /lhan cig skyes pa bzhi pa'i ming / /bde ba kun gyi gnas de bzhin/zhes dang / lhan cig skyes pa'i snang brnyan tsam/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba'o/ /lko dang / yul dang yul can sbyor ba yis/ /rtog pa med pa'i go 'phang 'gyur/ /zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhug /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag dam tshig tu dgongs te gsungs pa bzhi'i don sgrub/ lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyid/lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyi/ khyed kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha shas kyis spyad du gsol/ lan gsum/ dge ba bsngo/ spros pa la dga' na/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ zhes sogs dam tshig gsum gyi glu blang ngo / /—251—

bcu pa slob ma bzu nga ba ni/ bdag 'ju ga las dpag te shes par 'gyur la/ lag len gyi khyad par phra mo rnams slob dpon gyi gsung dang / mthong ba rgyud pa las shes par 'gyur zhing / slob ma la bgegs sbyangs dang / sdig pa sbyangs pa gnyis las sam/ dri ma sbyangs pa ste/ sbyang ba gsum char yang byed pa'i srol yod pa/ 'jug pa'i skabs kyi gnas skabs snga phyi ma nges pa zhig lag len so so la snang yang / 'jug pa'i gsol gdab grub ma thag tu byas na legs par mngon la/ ye shes 'bebs pa'i rdzas ni mi ro'i khar bcug pa'i gu gul dang byi la nag po'i brun/ gzhon nu ma'i rdzus gyis gos pa'i ras/ bdud rtsi lnga rnams bsres pa thod pa'i nang du dur khrod kyi me la bsreg par bshad la/ gzhan mi 'dra ba'ang ci rigs par snang ngo / khyad par phra mo 'ga' re bdag 'jug gi zhor la'ang bshad zin la/ go don rgyas pa ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /bcu gcig pa rjes kyi bya ba ni/ slob ma la dbang bskur ba yin na/ slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor khang par bzhag slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor khang pa'i phyi rol tu song nas/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma rgya cher btang nang du zhugs nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo la phyag bya'o/ /sbyin sreg dang / tshogs kyi 'khor los kyang lha rnams mnyes par bya'o/ /yongs ni dngos gzhi'i dkyil snyen ra mchod pa'i dus dang / slob ma dbang bskur zin pa'i dus dang / dkyil 'khor gshegs zin pa'i shul du yang me'i las dang 'khor lo'i mchod pa'i lha mnyes par bya ste/ rang nyid kho nas don gyi mchod pa la yang / gnas skabs gnyis po der sgrub bo/ /de nas rjes chog dngos ni/mchod pa rgya cher bshams/ byin gyis rlabs/ mchod yon sogs dang / rig ma bcu drug dang / nang mchod gsang mchod/ rkang brgyad kyi bstod pa rnams byas la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa byas pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngos/ dkyil 'khor du lan gsum bskor ba bya/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams bdag cag la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la —252—

mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rjes/ mdzad pa'i 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba lags pas/ spyir phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / sems can la bde skyid 'byung ba dang / bla ma gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs shing / zhal bzhugs pa rnams sku khams bzang ba dang / khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob rgyu spyor ba dang bcas pas thog drangs/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la tshogs rdzogs sgrib pa dag nas/ myur du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ lko gsol ba btab/ lho phyogs nas yig brgya bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs sam/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang / zhes sogs kyi/ bzod par gsol/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas/ sems sgrib pa dang ldan pa dang / yo byad ma tshang ba dang / ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / sngags ma dag pa dang / cho ga lhag pa dang chad pa thams cad lhag chad kha bskong zhing / bdag cag gi lam dang dngos grub kyi bar chad du mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ bdag gi las dang dngos grub thams cad thogs pa med par 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor yin nam// ma yin kyang rten gzhan yod na brtan bzhugs bya ste/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du/rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang / sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la zhes sam/ ras bris kyi dkyil —253—

'khor la zhes sam/ sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams dang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khotor la/ zhes pa gang 'os skabs dang sbyar te/ bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs thams cad/ ji srid 'byung ba chen po sa chu me rlung gi gnod sa'i ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas kyang bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon dang skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes me tog dor/ rdul tshon gyis dkyil 'khor yin la/ gzhan rten sku sogs med cing sgrub mchod zhag sprel byed pa'i skabs/ nyi ma snga ma rnams la rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor ba thams cad gshegs su ma gsol bar gyis brtan bzhugs kyi rdul tshon gshegs gsol gyi nyin mo de yang mi dgos so/ /de nas gshegs gsol ni/ o khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ ā hu badz+ra mu zhes te zhag sbrel mar byed pa'i nyi ma snga ma rnams la ni/ rten la ma brten pa'i mgron kho na gshegs su gsol ba yin zhing / ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bsdu pa'i skabs yin na/ de'i steng du bum bskyed kyang gshegs dgos la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i dus ni dkyil 'khor ba yang gshegs pa yin te/ de yang badz+ra mu yan gyis mgron rnams gshegs/ bum bskyed dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha nyid bstan las 'phags te nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ glu rdzo sku1 ga rgyu khri sde sarba dharmā yel ga shurnyo3 ha/ zhes rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang 'phyud rgya byas pas/ de rnams rang nyid la thim par mos so/ /gnas skabs 'di lta bu thams cad la/ slob dpon phal cher dam tshig pa rang la bsdu/ ye shes pa gshegs par mdzad/ bod kyi chen po kha cig de go bzlog par bzhed/ 'ga' zhig dam ye ma phye bar rang la stim par bzhed de/ so sor rgyu mtshan dang bcas te gsungs pa/ spyir thams —254—

cad rung ba yin kyang / phyi ma bzang bar mthong bas 'dir de ltar bya'o/ /rdul tshon gshegs su gsol ba'i tshe/ de ltar lan gsum du byas nas/ rdo rje'i rtse mo'am/ byang chub shing gi lo ma'am me tog pad+ma la sogs pas rtsig pa dang thig gi lam nas brtsam ste/ dbye zhing / lha mtshan rnams logs su bsdu/ don du gnyer ba nyid la rdul tshon nas cung zad sbyin/ bkur bsti dang bcas pas chu bor spyan 'dren/ rdul tsho ni klu la gtad/ bum par chu bo de nas chu blangs te/ thig rnams subs phur bu dbyung ngo / /de dag gi cho ga ni spyi dang mthun la/ phur bu ni rang rang gi sngags kyis bton la/shul du mar dang sbrang rtsis byug go /mthar smon lam mang du gdab/ bkra shis rgya cher bya ste/ ras bris kyi phyogs la ni/ brtan bzhugs byas ma thag tu smon lam dang bkra shis bya'o/ /'dir smras pa/ grub pa'i dbang phyug bye bas nyer bsgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs de ni dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom/ /bgrang las dngos grub sgrub pa'i lam gyi gzhi/ /rdo rje theg pa'i dam tshig sdom pa yin/ /de yang mtshan nyid ldan pa'i cho ga yis/ /dbang bskur ba la nges par rag las pas/ gsang sngags don gnyer rnams kyis dbang bskur dang / /dkyil 'khor cho ga'i gnas la mkhas par mdzode/ /'di bris pa las dge ba ni/ /cung zad thob par gang gyur pa/ /de yis skye bo ma lus kun/ /he ru ka dpal gnas thob shog /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde chen 'jug ngogs zhes bya ba 'di yang mkhan po blo gros rgyal mtshan la sogs pa don gnyer mang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo bzhi bcu pa la nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o/ /lha yi pa'i phyogs su gtogs pa la dkyil chog rgya gzhung mang du yod kyang /phal cher paṇ+ḍi ta phal pas brtsams pa dang 'ga' zhig la de nas brgyud pa'i man ngag med pa dang /jo bo nā ro pa la sogs pa'i bzhed pas kyang / nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga dang spyor bar mdzad cing / de'i man ngag 'dzin pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la/ bla ma'i man ngag gi dkyil —255—

chog gi gong 'og sgyur ba ci rigs pa dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga spyi dang mthun pa'i dbye ba cung zad tsam byas nas/ phal cher nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin tu mdzad pa'i lugs 'di legs par mthong nas/ 'dir de ltar sbyar ba yin pas/ rnam grangs mi 'dra bas mgo 'dzings par 'gyur na/ nag po pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs la yang cho ga 'di nyid sbyar bas 'grub bo/ /'on kyang nag po spyod pa'i lugs cho ga ma 'dres pa shig logs su 'chad par yang 'gyur ro/ma ṅga la/ zhu dag bdag dang 'gro ba sems can rnams dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rjes su bzung du gsol// //gshegs snying rigs 'dus sgyu 'phrul dra ba che/ /rdor dbyings gnas lugs ye shes rnam lnga'i bdag dgongs yid ro mnyam ngang nas skyabs su bsten/ glo bur sgrib kun myur nas dag gyur cig 'di 'bum phrag dad mos kyis bton na gnas lugs la rang 'tshang gyi bag chags nyams myong re yod snang bas ma tis so// //—256—

chen snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/ /oṃ khyu sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dpa' bo che/ /gdul dka' 'dul la phyag 'tshal nas/ /rab zab lus dkyil sgrub thabs ni/ /mchog tu gsal ba spro bar bya/ /'dir grub pa'i 'khor los bsgyur ba slob dpon rdo rje dril bu'i man ngag zab mo lus kyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa'i thabs ni/ 'od gsal lam khyer dang 'brel ba'i gnyid las yang dag par ldang ba na/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis cang te'u'i sgra rtsa sngags kyi dbyangs dang bcas te bskul bas/ 'od gsal las yang dag par sad de he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur langs par bsam mo/ /de nas dbang bskur ba'i dmigs pas khrus kyang bya/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang / sems bskyed pa dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams kyang ji ltar rigs par bya'o/ /de nas nyams su blang ba'i rnal 'byor dngos la/ sngon 'gro'i rnal 'byor dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor te gsum las/ dang po la yang gsum ste/ rdzas byin gyis brlab pa/ rten byin gyis brlab pa/ las byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /dang po ni dam rdzas kyi ril bu za ba'am/ dam rdzas btab pa'i chang la 'og nas 'byung ba ltar nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ tseX( āXhuX/ zhes brjod pas myang / rgyun gyi rnal 'byor la nang mchod dngos su bsham pa med na byin rlabs kyi cho ga ni brjod mi dgos la/ 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsi myangs bar bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ shrī he ru ko3 haX/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu tshogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba —257—

ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa'o/ /rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i dpal mchog dang po'i yi ge hu sngo skya/ ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin 'od zer sna lnga 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas lus nang thams cad gang / lus ngag yid gsum dbyings su sbyangs te/ 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bor gyur/ 'di la lha nag sogs dang mthun par dag pa gsum yang don tshang mod/ gzhung las des sgo gsum gyi sgrib pa sbyang ngo zhes gsungs pas na/ 'ga' zhig so sor phral nas dag pa gsum dang sbyor bar mdzad pa las/ lo chung sogs rang bzhin byin gyis rlabs pa dang / sgo gsum byin gyis rlabs pa zhes gnyis su bsdus te 'chad pa legs par snang ngo / /gsum pa ni/hu las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rnams ba sbu'i bu ga nas phyir song ste/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang dpal 'khor lo sdom pa zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa dbyer ma mchis pa lus dkyil dang bcas shing / dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba spyan drangs te 'od zer rnams rang gi snying gar thim/ gang drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang / /mkha' 'gro ma yi 'khor lo sgyur/ /ye shes lnga dang sku gsum nyid/ /'gro ba skyobs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ji snyed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /kun tu rtog pa'i 'ching gcod cing / /'jig rten bya ba rab 'jug ma/ /de snyed rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che/ /rnam dag rdo rje'i dbang phyug dang / /rjes chags chags pa che rnams kyis/ /rdo rje phag mo la 'dud do/ /snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyi mchod pa sna tshogs kyis —258—

mchod par gyur/ o badz+ra ar+gha pra titsā hu swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pu du/ oṃ badz+ra pus ā hū/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ ā lo ke gan+dhe/ nai du/ shag zhes sbyar/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ sogs rgyun bshags bya/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la bdag gi lus 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /zhes bdag nyid phul/ 'og nas 'gyung ba ltar rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod do/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ sku rdo rje bskyed rim gyi rnal 'byor/ gsung rdo rje bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor/ thugs rdo rje rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po la/ yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor/ dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /de'i dang po la yang gsum ste/ rags pa yongs rdzogs dang / phra ba yongs rdzogs dang / ye shes yongs rdzogs so/ /dang po la/ thun mong du spyong ba/snod sbyong ba/ 0rma sbyong ba ste gsum mo/ /dang bo ni/ tshogs zhing 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad 'od du zhu/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs te bdag nyid la thim/bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis rgyud gang bar gyur/ 'di i sku lam byed thun mong ba ste 'chi srid spyong byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ gdod ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig de nyid la gsal bar gyur pa ni/ rkang pa gnyis bgrad pa rlung gi dkyil 'bor/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab/ skra sen pags pa rus pa'i tshigs rnams bsrung ba'i 'khor lo/ bu ga brgyad ni dur khrod brgyad/lus 'doms gang gru bzhi ni gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ lus ngag yid gsum 'khor lo gsum/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo ni bde ba chen po/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa ni sgo bzhi/ rkang brgyad ni ka ba brgyad/ dbang po rnams ni me long la sogs brgyan rnams kyi bdag nyid do/ /gsum pa ni/ de ltar gyur pa'i bdag nyid —259—

'khor lo bde mchog bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka in+d+ra ni la ltar 'bar ba'i 'od zer can gyi sku mdog mthing nag zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sku lus dang mtshungs par char sprin gsar pa'i mdog can cher khros shing 'jigs su rung ba/ g.yon zhal ljang khu dpa' ba'i nyams can/ rgyab zhal dmar po 'dzum zhing chags pa/ g.yas zhal ser po sgeg cing ba 'ad pa/ zhal re re la dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrugs pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing /mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zhal thams cad kyang rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ phyag dang po gnyis kyi rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'phyud pa/ de'i 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa rlon pa khrag dang bcas pa rgyangs te 'dzin pa'i tshul gyis stod g.yogs su bsnams pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pa na ḍā ma snga/ bzhi pa na dgra sta/ lnga pa na gri gug drug pa na mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gsum pa na/ rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭa ga bzhi pa na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ lnga pa na rdo rje'i zhags pa/ drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa bsnams pa/ sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan gyi steng du/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu ma'i steng dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris grol ba/ ral pa'i cod pan thor tshugs bcings pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo dang bcas pa'i nor bu dang / g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang / ral pa'i mdun ngos la sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i —260—

'phreng ba la rgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ mi'i rgyu ma la rgyus pa'i mi mgo khrag 'dzag lnga bcu'i do shal can/ spyi bor nor bu dang / rna cha dang / mgul rgyan dang / phyag gdub dang /tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / thal chen te phyag rgya drug dang / zhabs gdub dang /dpung gdub dang / 'og pag las dpyangs pa dra ba dang dra ba phyed pa/ dril bu g.yer kha'i sgra dang bcas pa'i ska rags la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rjes rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar dgu'i nyams dang ldan pa nyid/ /de'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ phyag g.yon pas bdud sogs gdug pa can gyi khrag dang / mi'i rgyu mas gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin zhing / yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pas/ rgyab zhal du stob pa/ phyag g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug 'dzin pa'i sdigs 'dzub kyis phyogs kun rnam par gnon zhing sdang ba dang gdug pa'i sems can thams cad bsdigs par mdzad pa/ gcer bu ba sbu langs shing / dbu skra sil bur grol ba/ nu ma mkhrang zhing rgyas la lang tsho la bab pa/ khrag la dgyes shing khrag 'dzag pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab yum 'khyud pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu 'phreng ba dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang bde ba chen po dang thugs rje'i bdag nyid can dus mtha'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs —261—

pa'o/ /'di ni longs sku lam byed thun mong ba dang bar do sbyor byed de/ de yan chod thun mong ma yin pa'i sprul sku lam byed yin no/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hū dkar po las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa/ byā las byung ba'i nor bu dmar po rtse mor byā ser pos mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las ā dmar pos las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa/ byā las byung ba'i ze'u 'bru dkar po rtse mor rtswa ser pos mtshan pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang yum gyi mgrin par zla ba la oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hū hu phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi thugs ka dang yum gyi dpral par zla gdan la oṃ sarba budha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra wa rje nī ye hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar nyi ma la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka hū hu phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dz+wa la sa sba ra swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang yum gyi thugs kar nyi gdan la/ o hri ha ha hū hū phaṭa/ sngags rnams kha dog dmar po g.yon skor du gnas shing 'od zer 'phro ba/ yab yum phan tshun zhal sbyor ba na sngags dang 'od zer spyor bas kyang 'khyud oṃ ā hu snyoms par bzhugs pas dga' ba bzhi'i ye shes rgyas shing brtan par gyur/ de dag ni bde ba r+pā po'i sku lam du byed pa dang / bar srid chags sdang dang srid pas skye srid la phyogs pa spyong byed do/ /'di ni gzhung las/ kha sbyor phyi nyid legs shes pas/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don/ phyi dkyil gyi mngon byang lnga'i dod yin la/ lo tsā ba gzhan gyi man ngag la zhal shes su bzhugs shing / bod kyi grub thob pu rangs lo chung dang / rgya gar gyi mkhas grub chen po kha chen shākya shrī'i lugs las shin tu gsal bar 'byung ba yin te/ ma chad pa gal che'o/ /gnyis pa phra ba yongs rdzogs ni/ de ltar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan pas rkyen du gyur te/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor gnyug ma'i lha tshogs mngon du gyur —262—

par bzhengs pa ni/ rtsa la la na dang / rā sa na'i 'khor dang bcas shing / lte ba'i aX gi yi ge bcud dang ldan pa'i rtsa a wa dhu tī ni rdo rje phag mo dang / snying ga'i dbus kyi gzhom du med pa'i thig le hūX gi rnam pa yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam kha ba 'dzag pa lta bur gnas pa ni/ dpal he ru ka ste/ sku mdog mthing nag sngo ljang dmar ser zhal/ /rdo rje dril bu glang lpags ḍā ma sa /dgra sta gri gug rtse gsum kha ṭāX ga /thod khrag zhags pa tshangs mgo gdong bzhi 'dzin/ /g.yas brkyang pad nyer 'jigs byed dus mtshan brdzis/ /de la 'byud pa'i yum mchog rnal 'byor ma/ /dmar mo gri gug thod pa khrag bkang 'dzin/ /gnyis ka'ang me dpung dbus na rgyan dang bcas/ snying ga chos kyi snyen ra lo'i nang skor rtsa 'dab brgyad las/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba dang bcas pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du māX las mkha' 'gro ma nag mo/byang du tāX las lā ma ljang khu/ nub tu pāX las dum skyes ma dmar mo/ lhor laX las gzugs can ma ser mo ste bzhi char yang zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum skra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/mchan khung g.yon par rdo rje kha ṭāX ga dang bcas shing / thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang / mi mgo'i do shal dang / rus pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer mo lang tsho la bab cing bha ga dang nu 'bur mtho la bde ba rgyas pa'i nyams can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhir gnas shing bdud rtsi 'bab pa mchod pa'i rtsa bzhi ni bum pa bzhi bdud rtsi lngas gang ba'i steng ka pā la byang chub sems kyis gang ba dang bcas —263—

par gyur/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ pu dza o a go ra de ma ka o tri ko ka la ka hi pre gro so su na su ma ku ste yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ khams nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur/ spyi bo pu snyi rā ma la ya ra khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ /spyi gtsug dza lan+ta rar ma hā ka ka la dang / gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna g.yas pa o ṭi ya nar ka ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag ma a rlu tar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon pa go dha wa rar su ra bī ri dang dpa' bo'i blo can ma/ smin ma'i dbus ra smi shwa rar 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ mig gnyis de wi ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang ling ga'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa gnyis ma la bar rdo rje sku dang shing grib ma ste/ thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog nag po ste mkha' la spyod pa'o/ /mchan khung gnyis kā ma rū par a ka ri dang e ra pa tī nu ma gnyis o trer rdo rje'i ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/lte ba tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ sna rtse ko sa lar rdo rje hū mdzad dang / chang 'thung ma/ kha ka ling kar rab tu bzang po dang shu ma de ldi/ mgrin pa la pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang / shin tu bzang mo/ snying ga ka zhin 'jigs byed chen po dang rta sna ma/ 'dom par hi ma la yar mig mi bzang kha gā na na te gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dmar po ste sa la spyod pa'o/ /mtshan ma pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/spunang lam gro ha de bar rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ brla gnyis so so sgor rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi ni/ byin pa gnyis su wa rje dī par nam mkha'i snying po dang —2a—

'khor lo'i cho ga ma/ rkang sor brgyad na ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong gnyis si rgyur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/rkang pa'i mthe bong gnyis ma rur rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los bsgyur ma/pus mo gnyis ku lu tar rdo rje sems dpa' dang / brtson 'grus chen mo ste/ sku yi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo kha dog dkar po ste sa 'og tu spyod pa'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi po thams cad dpal he ru ka'i rigs las byung ba he ru ka dang mtshungs pa ste/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang thod pa'i cod pan dang mgo bo'i phreng ba dang / phyag rgya drug dang / stag lpags gsar pa'i smad dkris can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis gnas pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa'o/ /rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi po thams cad ni rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung ba/ rdo rje phag mo dang mtshungs pa ste/ gri gug dang thod rme 'dzin pa skra grol ba phyag rgya lnga dang thod skam gyi do shal dang ldan pa/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'byud pa'o/ /snying ga'i phyi skor gyi rtsa brgyad kyi rang bzhin hu brgyad sgo mtshams gnas pa'i ma mo brgyad du gyur pa ni/ shar du khwa gdong ma nag mo/ byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang khu/ nub tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lhor phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lho gzhin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lto nub tu gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar du gnyen rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ brgyad ka yang drag mo chen mo cher khros pa/ ro'i gdan la gnas pa/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams 'joms —265—

par mdzad pa mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis nas bzhugs pa skya'i bar snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i skabs bzhi las/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpral par rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o/ /de dag ni thun mong ma yin pa'i longs sku lam byed dang / thun mong pa'i sprul sku lam byed dang skye ba dngos spyong byed do/ /gsum pa ye shes yongs rdzogs ni/ rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dag pa dran pa yin te/ de yang / gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro ba/ /stso mngon du gyur pa ste/ /nye ba'i tsha rto sbyangs dka' ba/ /'du ba ring du song ba ste/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ khre he ru ka'i gzhung du spyod/ /'di ni nang gi bdag nyid can/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi brda yi skad/ /bu la sogs pa ci gsungs pa/ /phyi nang bdag nyid can du gnas/ /lus rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /tshor ba rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni lā ma'o/ /chos rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni dum skyes ma'o/ /sems rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni gzugs can ma'o/ /'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni rab tu gtum mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni gtum pa'i mig can ma'o/ /spyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni 'od ldan ma'o/ /sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni sna chen ma'o/ /dad pa'i dbang po ni dpa' bo blo gros ma'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni mi'u thung ma'o/ /dran pa'i dbang po la ske'i dbang phyug ma'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni shing grib ma'o/ khres rab kyi dbang po ni sa bsrung ma'o/ /dad pa'i stobs ni 'jigs —266—

byed chen mo'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni rlung gi shugs can ma'o/ /dran pa'i stobs ni su ra bhasti 'o/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni sngo bsangs lha mo'o/ /shes rab kyi stobs ni rab tu bzang mo'o/ /ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta'i rna ba ma'o/ /brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni bya gdong ma'o/ /dga' ba yang dag byang chub yan lag ni 'khor lo'i shugs can ma'o/ khren tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'o/ /chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni sho ṇ+ḍi ni'o/ /dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni 'khor lo'i go cha ma'o/ /btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rab tu dpa' mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni stobs chen ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni snyen ra los bsgyur ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ngag ni brtson 'grus chen mo'o/ /dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhi yang de rnams nyid kyi rnam par dag pa can no/ /yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni ji gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma'o/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa bskyed pa ni gshin rje brtan ma'o/ /dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams srung ba ni gzhin rje pho nya ma'o/ /mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa mi bskyed pa ni gshi/na rje mche ba ma'o mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa spong ba ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /zhes brjod cing bsam pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i chos sku lam du byed pa ste/ sems kyi mthu yongs su rdzogs pa spyong ngo / /mal lo nas brgyud pa'i man ngag las/ sgom mi nus pa dang brtan pa thob pa'i gang zag la yi —267—

ge dang rtsa khams tsam bsgoms pas chog par bzhed cing / lha so bdun byang phyogs so bdun du dag go zhes pa tsam las so so nas dag dran mi dgos so gsung mod/ 'on kyang las dang po pas ni sngar bshad pa kho na bya bar rigs so/ /gnyis pa byin gyis rlabs pa'i rnal 'byor la gsum ste/ skad cig rnam pa'i byin rlabs dang /go cha dgod pa dang / ye shes pa bsre ba'o/ /dang po ni pho nya gsum bsre ba dran par byas te/ o ā hū sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra snyu bha wa at+pa ko3 ha/ de kho na nyid kyi ye shes kyis rgyas btab ste/ o badz+ra shudha sarba dharma badz+ra rgyu lte dru3 ha/ sngags 'di gnyis ka lan gsum gsum brjod do/ /gnyis pa ni/ yab kyi snying gar lko ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa' mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad do/ /spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hu hu ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa ha ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum gyi lte bar o ba dmar po rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ha yo sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hri mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/dpral pa hre hre ser mo bskyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hū hu ljang khu skrag byed ma/yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha sto ka'i ngo bo ste/ rdo rje sems dpa' dang rmongs byed ma la zla ba'i gdan dang / gzhan rnams la nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas pa'o/ /de ltar go cha'i yi ge bcu gnyis grub pa na/ yab kyi gnas rnams su yum drug yum gyi gnas rnams su'ang yab drug gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar gyur/ sgrub thabs 'di ni spros pa la mngon par dga' ba ma yin pa'i don du gsungs pa gtso che bas/ go cha'i lha rnams yig 'khru'i rnam par dgod pa nyid gtso bor bzung ngo / /de dag las skad —268—

cig rnam pas ni mngal du rtsa khams rlung gsum rgyas pa dang / 'bras bu'i dus su sku gsung thugs rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po dang / go cha bkod pas ni phung khams skye mched rnams 'phel ba dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i yon tan gyi tshogs thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshon la/ de la skad cig rnam pa'i sngags ni gzhan nas kha bskang ba ste/ 'di nyid kyi sgrub thabs na med pas mdor bsdu ba'i tshe bor yang rung ba lta bur snang mod kyi/ 'di nyid kyi srol ka thams cad la yod cing / pham thing pa'i lugs kyi man ngag dang bcas na 'khor lo sdom pa'i lam 'di'i srog lta bu yin pas ma chad pa nges par gal che'o/ /gsum pa ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ rang gi snying ga'i hū yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs re re bzhin yang lus kyi dkyil snyen ra dang bcas pa'i rnam par spyan drangs par gyur/ h+pha zhes brjod/ tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod/ dza hu ba ho/ zhes dgug gzhug bcing mnyes bya/ oṃ yog ṛ’sge sarba dharma yo ga hwa spyo ( ྅ ha/ zhes nga rgyal bzung /rnam lnga 'dod bskor dang 'gyud rgya bya'o/ /des ni btsas pa nas lo bcu drug lon gyi bar spyong zhing ye shes kun tu khyab pa mngon du byed pa'o/ /gsum pa dbang bskur ba'i rnal 'byor la yang gsum ste/dbang bskur ba dang / mchod pa dang / bstod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ slar yang snying ga'i hū las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lha tshogs phyi dang nang gi dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa dang bcas pa h+pha/ tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin mchod/ tse( sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi shi pos tu ma/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams —269—

kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ rdo rje phag mo snying po rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas/ ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs kun khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gi khrus bgyi'o/ /oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī huX/ zhes gsungs shing / spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus thams cad ye shes bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis gang / lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dgabade ba chen po'i rang bzhin du byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud de so so'i spyi bor 'khyil ba yongs su gyur pa las gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la rnam snang / bde chen 'khor lo pa rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams la mi bskyod pa/ gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/sku'i snyen ra lo pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ dam tshig 'khor lo pa rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dbang gi lha rnams kyang rang la thim/ 'dis ni rang rigs kyi bya ba la gnas pa spyong zhing /sangs rgyas nas khams gsum gyi dbang phyug tu ston pa lam du byed do// gnyis pa la phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ su lhas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las thod pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ hūX zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa rnams dang / glo bur du lhags pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa byung bar gyur/ oX badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ de bzhi du pā byāX/ oṃ badz+ra pur+sha hūX sogs dang / oX badz+ra lha rnye ra ṇi sogs kyis byin phab/tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar mchod pa 'bul lo/ /snga phyi'i mchod pa 'di rnams la rgyas par na rig ma bcu drug gam/ nyer spyod 'dod yon sogs kyis mchod pa ci rigs pa mdzad pa'ang yod cing mi —270—

'thad pa'ang ma yin mod/ spros pa chung ngur mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs 'di rnams la sgrub thabs kyi yan lag rnams kyang mdor bsdus su sbyar ba nyid 'tsham zhing / gzhung dang rgya bod snga ma rnams kyis dgongs pa'ang yin no/ /gnyis pa ni nang mchod/ 'og nas 'gyung ba'i gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang / /dril bu pa dang dga' ba'i rdo rje dang / /lus med rdo rje so ri pa dang ni/ /'jigs med 'byung gnas zhal du mchod pa 'bul/ /de ba puṇ+ḍa shākya shrī dang / /spyi lhas seng ge dpal dang bya ru ba/ /byang sems 'bri lung pa dang yang rtse ba/ /bu ston chos rje rnams la: khyung lhas pa dang nor bzang rin chen dang / /bka' bzhi rin rgyal mkhyen rab mchog grub dang / /bkra shis dpal 'byor bsod nams dpal 'byor dang / /bkra shis rgyal mtshan rtsa ba'i bla ma ste/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ /zhes brgyud pa'i gtso bo kha che lugs ltar ro/ /sa lugs ni nag po pa'i lugs bzhin las/ ngor chen mus chen paṇa chen chos rjes brag dmar ba chen po/ rab gsal zla mgon/ rje grol mchog rdo ring pa rnams khyad par ro/ /'di la bla ma dam pa man chad brgyud pa sna tshogs ded pas chog go /lo chung lugs kyi brgyud pa ni/ rdo rje 'chang phag mo dril bu pa dza lan dha ri pa nag po spyod pa dge ba'i mgon po bhu ba pa rnam rgyal zhabs te lo pa nā ro pa ma na kā shrī ka na ka shrī bha dan+ta ba lo chung smar chen po kyi ston dkon 'bar khams pa shag rdor lo tsā mchog ldan dpal ldan seng ge mkhan chen shes rab rdo rje 'dzam gling paṇa chen a mo gha pa bla chen grags rin nam mkha' tshul khrims chos kyi seng ge kun dga' gzhon nu/ 'jam dbyangs blo gros don grub legs pa rnams so/ /de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum btags la 'bul lo/ /gsum pa ni mkha' gsang byin rlabs dang sngags bzhi kha spyor sogs yid kyis dran par byas te/ lha rnams rjes chags kyi bde bas —271—
