mchod par mos la/ rnam lnga 'dod skor dang bcas yi ge bdun pa lan lnga brjod/ a nu rā ga'i sngags kyis nga rgyal bzung zhing / 'byud rgya byed pa'o/ /gsum pa bstod pa ni/ cang te'u'i sgra dang bcas pa'am med kyang drang ste/ oX na mo bha ga wa te/ lī ri shā ya huX huX phaṭa/ oX ma hā kalpa sni sa ni bhā ya huX huX phaṭa/ oX dza ṭā mu ku shot+na ṭā ya huX huX phaṭa/ oX daXni kā ra lo gra bhi ṣa ṇa mu ji ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX sa ha sra bhu dza bha su rā ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX par+sha pā shi r+ya kha ṭāX ga dha ri ṇi huX huX phaṭa/ oX bya bh+ra dzi naX ba ra dha ra ya hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX ma hā dhu sbrun+ta kā ra wa pū khyi ya huX hūX phaṭa/ yab kyi rkang brgya dang / oX na mo bha ga wa tī badz+ra wā rā hi baX hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX na mo ār+ya a pa ra dzi te tri lo kya mā te ma hā bi du shwa re huX huX phaṭa/ oX na maXsarba bhu ta bha yā ba he mahā badz+re huX huX phaṭa/ oX na mo badz+ra ā sa ni a dzi te a pa ra dzi te ba shaX kā re na tra bh+ra ma ṇi hūX huX phaṭa/ oX na maXtsha rdo ṣa ṇi ro ṣa ṇi kro dha kra rā li hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX na maXtru sa ni ma ra ṇi pra bhe da ni a pa ra dza ye hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX na mo bi dza ye nga ni nga ni mo ha ni hūX hūX phaṭa/ oX na mo badz+ra bā rā hi ma hā yo gi kā me shwa ri kha ge hūX hūX phaṭa/ yum gyi rkang brgyad brjod pa ste/ mchod bstod de dag ni yul la nye ba longs spyod pa sbyong zhing / ye shes kyi 'byor pa dpag tu med pa 'thob pa'i rgyu'o/ /gzhi 'bras kyi dag sbyor 'di dag ni bskyed pa'i rim pa kho na la cha tshang ba gcig gnas dgos pa'i phyir/ de tsam gyis rdzogs pa ni lugs 'di'i dgongs pa'o/ /gnyis pa gsung rdo rje bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ khyogs kyi bzlas pa dang spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gang rung gi dmigs pa gsal btab la/ dung chen gyi 'phreng ba blangs nas bzlas pa byed pa las spro na 'phreng ba'i sngags rdzogs par bzla ste/ lha yi pa dang 'dra'o/ /'on kyang 'dir ni de gtso mi che bas snying po dang nye snying tsam gyis chog shes par bya la/ de yang nā ro pa'i man ngag las/ yab yum —272—

gyi sngags kha sbyor lugs su bzla ba dang / gzhan rnams so sor bzla ba ste lugs gnyis yod pa las snga ma bzang ngo / /de yang /o shrī badz+ra he he ru ru ka hu hu phaṭa ḍā ki ni dzā la sam+bha ra swāhā/ yab kyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ hri ha ha hū hu phaṭa/ yab kyi nye snying ngo / /lko sarba bud+dhā ṭā ki ni ye badz+ra wa rna shī ye hu hū phaṭa swāhā/yum gyi nye ba'i snying po'o/ /lte ba'i thig le las 'od zer spro ba dang / khams gsum po 'khor lo lnga'i lhar byas te slar bsdu ba/ dbugs 'gro 'ong der lhan cig gi dbu ma'i lam du 'jug pa dang /'byung ba bsgoms nas bzla ba ni dam tshig gi bzlas pa'o/ /gsum pa thugs rdo rje rdzogs rim ni/rim pa lnga las gang yang rung ba ste/ 'on kyang gzhung las/ sa bon dang bcas pa'i bdag byin rlabs sgom par bsngags so/ /gsum pa rjes kyi rnal 'byor la/ nye bar bsdu ba/ bsrung ba/ mchod pa/ spyod lam/ kha zas/rjes chags/ gtor ma ste skabs 'dir bdun las/ dang po nyid bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad 'od du zhu/rang nyid la thim lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad rang gnas su 'od du zhu/ phyi dbyibs kyi sku yang de dag dang 'dres/ byang chub sems kyi thig ler gyur/ de nyid kyang 'od gsal gyi ngang du thim/ de la cung zad mnyam par bzhag /slar yang rang dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog tu gyur/ gnyis pa bsrung ba'i rnal wor ni/yab kyi snying khar o ha nas shar ba ltar gyur gyi bar gong bzhin go cha gnyis bkod/ spyi bor la sogs pa'i gnas zhes pa nas/ dpa' bo nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur/zhes go cha chen pos bsrung / dge ba byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /gsum pa mchod pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ phyi —273—

rol mchod pa dang / lag mchod la sogs pa ste/ tshes bcu'i mchod chog khungs ma rnams su blta bar bya'o/ /bzhi pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ snang ba thams cad dpal he ru ka'i sku gsung thugs su blta ba'o/ /lnga pa kha zas kyi rnal 'byor ni/ byin gyis rlabs te lus dkyil la mchod pa'i tshul du nang gi sbyin bsreg bya'o/ /drug pa rjes chags kyi rnal 'byor ni/ rig ma dang mnyam par sgyur ba'i bde stong sgom pa'o/ /bdun pa gtor ma'i cho ga ni/ thun tha ma la'am/ thun re re zhing ngam/ nam phyed kyis dus na bya ste/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma sha chang sogs dang ldan par bshams/tseX( sum+bha ni nga hūX hūX phaṭa/ tseX( gro hā gro hā huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān badz+ra rā dza huX huX phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bha wa shudha sarba dharma su bhā wā shurnyo3 haX/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlud gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oX āXhūX las byung ba'i mi mgo'i skyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang gi shar du oX dkar po las dri chen oṃ gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaX ljang khu las sha chen gyi dwangs ma khaX gis mtshan pa/ nub tu aX dmar po las byang chub kyi sems aX gis mtshan pa/ lhor traX ser po las rak+ta t+taX gis mtshan pa/ dbus su huX sngon po las dri chu huX gis mtshan pa/ mer laX dkar po las ba lang gi sha laX gyis mtshan pa/bden bral du māX sngon po las khyi'i sha maX gyis mtshan la/ rlung du pāX dmar po las glang po'i sha paX gis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du tāX ljang khu las rta'i sha tāX gis —274—

mtshan pa/ dbus su ba dmar po las sha chen ba gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlud g.yos me 'bar bas rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba/ nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser gsal la dwangs par gyur pa'i steng thad du hū yig las byung ba'i kha ṭa ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can/ mgo bo 'thur du lta ba/ de las bdud rtsi dkar po babs te/ der lhung pa g.yon skor du lan gsum dkrugs shing zhu bas/ dngul chu'i mdog can shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ o a ā i sī u ā ṛ grwa '-i lī e i i snya( ā a ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa tha ḍa bha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha pa bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hū hu phaṭa/ rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ o dkar po/ ā dmar po/ /hū sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros/ rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug cing / 'gro ba rnams 'khor lo gsum gyi lhar byas pa rnams spyan drangs/snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu/ de thams cad yi ge 'bru gsum la thim/ oṃ ā hu yang rim pa ltar bdud rtsir zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā hū lan gsum ste byin gyis sas pa'o/ /rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar hu yongs su gyur pa las dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/ de nas rkang —275—

pa mnan zhing gyen du blta/ zhes pa'i 'dug tshul dang / 'bar ba'i phyag rgya bcas te/ h+pha ces brjod/ 'di la phe dang h+pha dang rlu dang pheṭa rnams gdam nga yin no/ /rang gi snying ga'i hu yig gi 'od zer gyis ye shes sems dpa' dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba sogs srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ dza : ba ho yo ga shudha lan gcigs ma ya stu/ sa ma ya ho/ lan gsum/ mchod yon dang zhabs bsil phul/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/g.yas su kā li las nyi ma/ dbus su hu/ zla nyi hu dang bcas yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje thal mor gyur/ gtor snod lags kyis blangs par mos la/ lha mo tshad ma dam tshig ma dang / des brjod gsung yang mchog tu tshad ma ste/ bden pa de yis lha mo de dag gis/ bdag cag rjes su 'dzin pa'i rgyur gyur cig /lha rnams gtor ma gsol ba la thugs dges pa dang ldan pa las ye shes kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus drangs te gtor ma gsol bar gyur/ lko badz+ra a ra zhi ho dza : ba ho badz+ra ḍā ki nī sa ma ya stu/ dri khyo ho lko ā hū/ zhes lan lnga'am bdun gyis phul/ gong bzhin/ ar+gha/ nas shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa chags dang kun rtog chags pa bcom/khyod kyis dngos kun rang bzhin nam mkha' dang ni 'drar gzigs kyang / /mgon po shin tu lci ba'i thugs rje'i chus rgyas sems la ni/ /mdzod cig lha mo rnams kyis bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol/ /zhes gsol ba gdab bo/ /'jig rten pa rnams la phul bar mos te/ glu( kha kha ji hi ji hi sarba yak+ṣa rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta pre ta bi —276—

shā tsa u zla/ da a pa smar ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya i ma ba li griṇ+ḍa skye/ sa ma ya rak+ta skye ma ma sarba sidhi me pra ya :yi / ya thi ba/ ya thi ni/ bhu dza tha pi wa tha/ dzi gha tha mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba kā ra ta yā/ sa phyi kha bi shurnya ye sa ha yi ka bha bskye hū hu phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum gyis phul/ gong bzhin mchod/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang / klu yi gnod spyin: srid po'i: ཿnga i yi dwags: sha za'ijospyo byed brjed byed mkha' 'gro'i: ma mo'i: ma lus pa ni thams cad dag /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bstan pa srung dang 'gro ba'i don mdzad phyir/ /thugs dam bcas shing zhal gyis mches pa rnams/ /dpal chen bka' sdod yid lhar mgyogs pa yi/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs can drag gtum mi bzad pa/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad nag po'i tshogs rnams 'joms/ /rnal 'byor las la 'bras bu ster mdzad cing / /mthu stobs byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ /gnod sbyin tshogs sogs brgyad la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sde brgyad btsun mo sras dang g.yogs bcas pas/ /dngos grub kun gyi bka' drin bdag la stsol/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /srungs mas rtag tu grogs mdzod cig /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel ba/ /dge —277—

legs thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas bstod cing 'dod don zhu/ yig brgya bzla/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ yo ga shudha'i sngags rgya bya/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra mu 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su gshegs/ dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor pa rang nyid la thim/ smon lam gdab/bkra shis brjod/ de ltar skabs 'dir rnal 'byor bdun dang / gong du bstan pa'i nyal ldang gnyis te/ thun mtshams kyi rnal 'byor dgu yin la/ mnyam bzhag gi rnal 'byor gsum ste yongs gril bcu gnyis so/ /de dag las mngon rtogs kyi rim pa rkang grangs su brjod na/ dang po rten sbyang ba/ gnyis pa tshogs zhing mchod pa/ gsum pa bdag la bsdu ba/ bzhi pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor ra bskyed pa/ lnga pa phyi'i yab yum gsal 'debs pa/ drug pa rjes su chags pa/ bdun pa brten pa'i lha tshogs sgom pa/brgyad pa dag pa dran pa/ dgu pa skad cig rnam pa/ bcu pa go cha rnam gnyis/ bcu gcig pa ye shes spyan 'dren/ bcu gnyis pa dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ bcu gsum pa mchod cing bstod pa/ bcu bzhi pa nye bar bsdu ba ste bskyed rim dngos la rim pa bcu bzhi/ bzlas pa dang rdzogs rim dang / sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum dang / thun mtshams rjes spyod lhag ma dgu ste/ yongs su gril bas don tshan nyer brgyad yin no/ /'di ni rgyud kyi rgyal po las/ gsang ba mchog gi dges pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu gnas/ /zhes gsungs pas/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor dang / mkha' 'gro kun dngos sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan dpa'/ /zhes pas/phyi nang gi gtso bo yab yum dang / mkha' 'gro dra ba'i sdom pa'i yin zhes pas lugs kyi lha tshogs mdor bstan pa dang / rtsa bshad kyi rgyud mang por lus dkyil rgyas bshad mdzad pa rnams la brten —278—

te/ grub chen gyi yang dag par bsdus pa ste/ bskyed rim sgrub thabs su gtogs so cog la 'di bas zab pa med par grags la ches zab pa'ang yin no/ /de ltar na 'di ni kha che lugs su grags pa'i sgrub thabs la rtsa bar byas/ nā ro ta pa'i man ngag lugs gnyis kyi legs cha mtha' dag tshang bar byas pa ste/ tshig don dgos nges rnams ye nas ma chad pa dang / mi dgos pa cung zad kyang ma lhag pa dang / gzhung gi dgongs pa las ma 'khyogs pa dang / ngag 'don bde zhing 'tsham pa dang / tshig nyung ngus ngag sbyor gsal por bstan pas/ go don bshad pa gzhan la mi ltos pa ste yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'o/ /tshul 'di gsal byed mang na yang / /yon tan lnga ldan gzhan med pas/ /'dir 'bad don med ma yin te/ /dge des he ru kar gyur cig /dril bu lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs bde chen snying po zhes bya ba/ 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rang lo so drug pa la sbyar ba'o/ /zhus dag /ma ṅga la// //—279—

bde chen snying po bzhugs/oṃ rdza sti/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po zhes bya ba/bla ma dang dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dpa' bo che la gus ba spyod nas/ /skal ldan kho na'i spyod yul du/ /rab zab lus kyi dkyil 'khor te/ /de yi dbang bskur cho ga bshad/ /'og tu dgos pa'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ sngon 'gro gtor ma/ su lhas bsangs/ swa bhas sbyangs/oX āXhūX ha ho hiX zhes byin gyis rlabs/ h+pha zhes mgron rnams spyan drangs/ oX kha kha ji hi 'a hi nas bha wastu hūX huX phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ ar+ghaX nas/ shabha'i bar gyis mchod/lha yi tshogs rnams nas 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub kyi go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba dang / slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ dkar po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bgegs rnams bzlog cing 'dod pa'i don thams cad sgrub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig /gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang pa thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang / nga bzlas drag rol bya gtor ma phyir dor ro/ /de nas gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs pa ni/ su lhas bsangs/—280—

swabha sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang huX yig las byung ba'i srung 'khor gyi nang du/ bhuX las byung ba'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ lkoX āXhuX zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/dri chab zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod pa rnams rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba las gyur pa/ ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba/yul nam mkha'i mthas khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du bla ma dang dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i lha tshogs rnams dang / sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig lkoX badz+ra ar+ghaX swāhā/ oX badz+ra pā duX swāhā/ oX badz+ra pu khro āXhuX/ de bzhin du/ dhu pe/ a lo keg rnye/ nai bi te/ shabha āXskyoX/ oX sarba bid pu ra pu ra su ra su ra ā brta ya ā brta ya hoX oX badz+ra spa ra ṇi khaX/ oX badz+ra staṇ+ḍi ra ṇi ti/ pra ra ṇi ha/ saX pra ra ṇi ta/sarba bsnyi slo tra pra tsa li te/ pra dz+nyā pa ra mi ta na da sam+bha we ta badz+ra dharma hri da ya ni sa rnyo ṣa ni hūX huX hūX ho ho ho a khaX swāhā/ lko pas rol mo byin dbab bo/ /de nas cho ga dngos la 'jug par bya ste/ 'di la lnga/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa bdag bskyed dang / dbang rdzas sgrub pa bum bskyed dang / dbang gi gzhi dkyil 'khor khyad par du bya ba dang / dbang bskur len zhing sbyin pa dang / rjes chog lha mnyes par byed pa'o/ /dang po ni skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bzlas pa'i mthar thug par sgrub thabs bzhin du nyams su len pa las/ mchod pa'i skabs su/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug gi tshig —281—

bcad sogs nag po lugs kyi dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar ci rigs pa blang zhing / spro na bstod pa yang / rkang brgyad gnyis kyi gzhug tu bskal pa'i me 'bar ma sogs ci rigs pa sbyar ro/ /bzlas pa grub ma thag tu sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i gtor ma yang 'bul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ bum pa bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pa las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du ā las zla ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du bhu las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing / mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba'i dbus su/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka in+d+ra nī la ltar 'bar ba'i nas me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i thugs ka'i dbus su hu las dpal he ru ka ste nas/ rgyan dang bcas thugs ka'i phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhi las shar du ma las nas/ me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /mtshams bzhi bum pa bzhi nas/ gang ba dang bcas par gyur/spyi bo pu snyi rā na la yar nas/ byin pa gnyis kyis yab la 'byud pa'o/ /thugs ka'i phyi skor gyi 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du khwa gdong ma nas/ bzhugs pa'o/ /rang gi snying ga'i hu yig gi 'od zer nas/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyang rang la thim gyi bar ye shes spyan 'dren dang dbang bskur rgyas gdab byas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug rnams sngags dang phyag rgya tsam gyis mchod nas/ gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po gnyis ci 'grub tu bzlas pa'i mthar/ o nga sogs nyer gcig tsam bzlas/ yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis bzod par gsol nas/bdag cag slob mar bcas pa la dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ oṃ —282—

ā hū mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis lha rnams 'dod chags chen po'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur zhes brjod/ gsum pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hū las 'phros pa'i 'od zer rnams zhes pa nas/ sha lta'i bar dang / rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod de tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin no/ /bdag nyid 'khor lo sdom par gsal ba lus kyi dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa/ slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor dang gnyis su med par 'dres te/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'bor gyi rang bzhin du gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byung nas phyi rol tu 'dug par mos la dbang blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni bla ma'i man ngag ste/ gzhung gi dngos bstan la mi gsal mod/ dngos grub 'gyung ba'i dgos pa chen po dang ldan zhing / gzhung gi dgongs pa la yang gnas par nges so/ /bzhi pa la gnyis kyi dang po bdag 'jug ste/ de yang dbang gi cho ga ni/ grub chen nyid kyi gzhus sgra ji bzhin pa las/ gzhan gyi kha skongs ye med kyang / rang gzhan dbang bskur gnyis ka la shin tu go chod pa skyon bral yon tan thams cad ldan pa yin no/ /'on kyang cung zad spros pa la mos pa rnams la/ rang lugs dang mi 'gal zhing skabs su bab nges pa'i sgo nas gzhan gyi kha 'gengs byed na/ lugs gnyis te/ kha 'gengs pa sdus pa tsam byed pa kha che paṇa chen shākya shrī'i man ngag dang / kha 'gengs rgyas par byed pa lo paṇa g.yin gyi lugs gnyis las/ spros pa/ nyung ja'i cho ga 'di'i rigs la snga ma legs tshabs che bas phal cher de'i lugs dang mthun par bya'o/ /de yang 'jug pa'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /thar ba chen po'i —283—

grong mchog tu/ /mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang lha mo/ /de bzhin phag mo he ru ka /gsang ba'i gnas dang nye gnas sogs/ /lus la rnam gnas bsha/da du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ bu khyod kyis ni bzung bya ste/ grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin/ /zhes sdom pa bsgrags/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs kyis thun mong gi sdom pa bzung / sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs kyi rigs lnga'i sdom pa bzung / sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ zhes pa nas nyi shu rtsa gnyis legs pa bsrung gi bar gyis thun mong ma yin pa'i sdom pa bzung ngo / /phyi ma 'di pham thing ba dang / su ma ti'i rjes 'brang rnams mdzad kyi/ shākya shrī'i lugs la mi mdzad do/ /gang ltar yang mi 'gal bas lag len 'dam kha yin mod byed pa legs so/ /skye( tsa kur ban+ta ba rā ya na ya hu/ gis mig dar bcings/ ā kha bī ra hu gis me tog bzung /rang gi snying gar zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od 'phro ba/ kun rdzob dang don dam pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid do/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta u pa da ya mi/ snying gar rdo rje btad la/ su ra te sa ma ya stu/ ho sirnyi badz+ra ya thā su kha/deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlabs par 'gyur gyi/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /hu dza hū/ zhes lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi drung du phyin par mos/ de yan chad ni kha skong ngo / /de nas dam bzhag ni/ bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhug ste/'di ni bu khyod bdud rtsi ste/ /ma bsrungs sreg par byed pas dug /bsrungs na —284—

dngos grub 'gyur ba ste/ /bdud rtsi lnga'i chus 'grub bo/ oṃ pañtsa a mri ta ud da ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hu/ rdo rje spyi bor bzhag la/ khyod kyi he ru ka dpal nga / khyod kyis brnyes par mi bya zhing / /dam tshig dang 'gal mi bya ste/ /dmyal la sogs par 'gro 'gyur ro/ /zhes dam la bzhag ste/ tshig rkang phyi ma ni/ dang por dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ zhes bcos na bde'o/ /dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab par mdzad du gsol/ rang nyid he ru ka zhal gcig phya po/ gnyis pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs par gyur/ slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpal he ru ka rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / 'khor lo gsum gyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs kyi 'khor lo pa rnams nag po'i rnam pas thim/ bar gyi cha la gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/ smad kyi cha la sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams dkar po'i rnam pa 'jug cing /gtso bo'i rig ma bcas pa dang / de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs shing snying gar thim par gyur/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya hū/ oṃ shrī he ru ka ya bid ma he bi bya rā dzā ya/ dhī ma he swāhā/ zhes bzla ste/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas nas dbab bo/ /spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhug ste/tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes brtan par bya/ oṃ pra tisnro badz+ra ho zhes lus dkyil gyi gtso bo me tog phul/ oṃ tra ti gro hā stu i ma satwa ma hā ba la/ zhes me tog rang gi spyi bor bcings/ oṃ he ru ka —285—

dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hri/ zhes mig dar bsal te/ me tog 'bul ba dang mig dar dkrol ba yang kha skong yin no/ /de nas blta bar bskul ba ni/ rang bzhin gyis ni dag pa'i bdag /lus 'di rang bzhin dri ma med/ /dpa' bo dpa' mo dbang mo'i gnas/ /dkyil 'khor la ni bu khyod ltos/ /zhes so/ /de nas lha ngo bstan pa ni/ slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa thams cad mngon sum bzhin du mthong bar gyur/ 'di thams cad kyang byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyi bdag nyid do/ /zhes pa'am/ cung zad rgyas pa la mos na/ lus rjes su dran pa nye bar gzhag pa ni nas/ gshin rje 'joms ma'o zhes pa'i bar brjod do/ /de dag ni 'jug pa'i bya ba'o/ /dbang dngos la/ bum dbang gsang dbang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang de kho na nyid kyi dbang ste bzhi las/ dang po la/ chu cod pan rdo rje bdag po/ ming dbang /sngags dbang / rdo rje'i brtul zhugs/ spyod pa'i brtul zhugs/ dbugs dbyung ba/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang ste bcu las/ dang po dgu po sdoms nas thun mong gi dbang zhes bya ste/ de ltar na thun mong gi dbang dgu zhu ba'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul la/ chos bden bdag nyid bsam mi khyab/ /bdag la dbang ni bskur du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum mo/ /bdag dang dbang rdzas su lhas bsangs shing / yungs kar dang bum chu sogs kyis gtor ro/ /bdag nyid skad cig gis rigs thams cad kyi bdag po sangs rgyas kun gyi rigs gcig pu pa/rdo rje mkha' 'gro thugs rdo rje hre ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i yum gyis —286—

'khyud cing / pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa'i skur gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i rnam par h+pha/ zhes spyan drangs/ dzaXhāX baX hoXganyis su med par thim/ zhes brjod do/ /'dir thun mong gi dbang thams rbod sgol/rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rnam pa 'di kho na la gnas shing / dbang rdzas lha so so'i rnam par 'pho ba yin la/ dbang drug po thams cad la/ dbang rdzas lhar bskyed ye shes pa stim/ lha bzhu dbang bskur brtan byed pa/ /bde gshegs bstims nas mchod pa 'bul/ /so so'i dag pa brjod pa'o/ /chu dbang la brtan byed logs pa mi dgos shing / dbang rdzas kyi lha bzhugs pa'i rjes su dbang lha spyan 'dren/ mchod pa gsol gdab rnams lhag po yin la/ brtul zhugs la brtan byed man chad mi dgos so/ /de nas chu dbang ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu'am/ lha bum mang du yod na thams cad kyi bum chu thod par bsdus/ spyo bhā was sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i 'phreng ba'i cod pan can/ rang 'od kyi yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes sems dpa' mi bskyod pa spyan drangs/ h+pha/ dzaXhuX baX hoX gnyis su med par thim/dbang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum rjes chags kyi sbyor bas zhu ste bdud rtsi'i chur gyur/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha 'khor lo bde mchog lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi dkyil 'khor h+pha zhes spyan drangs/ pur+sha sogs kyis —287—

mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/zhes gsol ba btang pas/ dkyil 'khor ba rnams dang / dbang gi lha'i gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dpa' bo rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ dpa' mo rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blangs/ rdo rje phag mo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi dang bcas pas ḍā ma ru dang bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs/ 'khor rnams kyis rol mo'i sgra bsgrags/ me tog gi char phab ste shis pa brjod par gyur/ o phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra sogs/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tshigs bcad gsum dang / nyin mo bde legs: sogs brjod/ rol wo bya/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ o tri tsakra bī ra stu/ a bhi ṣañtsa hu/ zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis mi bskyod pa dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te/ ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs pas/ lus thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rdul0phra rab kyis gang bar gyur/ o badz+ra pur+sha ā hū/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de ltar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye tsho shes mngon du byas/ /mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par sgrigs pa yin no/ /des rigs 'gres te cod pan sogs bzhi dang / rdo rje brtul zhugs kyi bar du shes par bya ba las/ 'di man chad la/ gtso bo'i thugs tsho ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha zhes pa nas rol chen bya/ zhes pa'i bar —288—

dbang lha spyan 'dren dang / shis brjod mi dgos so/ /'don pa bsgyur te cod pan gyi dbang ni/ su bha wa/ dbang rdzas rin po che'i dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las a las rin po che a gis/ rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po g.yas rin po che dang : ye shes sems dpa' rin chen 'byung ldan yab yum rjes chags kyi:rin po che'i dbu rgyan du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa khyed rnams kyis/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/ sogs kyi mthar/ o sarba bud+dhā ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra wartu nī ye hū hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes dbu rgyan dar dpyangs dang bcas pa skon spro zhing nus na 'khor lo lnga'i lha thams cad kyi sngags kyang brjod do/ /o tri tsakra bī ra nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbu rgyan/ de ltar na dbu rgyan gyi nga rgyal dang ser sna tshor ba mnyam nyid ye shes rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs so/ /rdo rje'i dbang ni/dbang rdzas rdo rje dzi las pad+ma dzi/ 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang ye shes sems dpa' 'od dpag med rdo rje gyur/ he ru ka dpal sogs kyis/ deng khyod bdag por dbang bskur ltar/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje long / /rdo rje lag pa g.yas pas bzung nas snying gar btod/ tri tsakra sogs sngar bzhin/ chu dbang bskur/ 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ rdo rje 'dod chags 'du shes so sor rtog pa'i ye shes 'od dpag tu med pa'i sogs 'don pa spo/ dril bu'i dbang ni/ dbang rdzas kyi dril bu kha las ral gri kha/ don yod grub pa ljang khu ral gri dang ye shes sems dang 'a don yod grub pa dril bur gyur/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /dril bu'i sgra kun rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /byang chub mchordo ga tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /tse( badz+ra / ṇ+ḍi ā ā rnam —289—

rje dril bu snying gar 'byud la/ thabs dang shes rab kyi rigs mtha' dag gi bdag po zung du 'jug pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje mkha' 'gro rang snang gi yum dang bcas pa lha sku bde ba chen por mos la/ 'khor lo gsum bdag dpa' bo yi/ /lag tu rdo rje dril bu bzung / /rang bzhin gyis mdzes dga' ba ni/ /phyag rgya chen por byin gyis rlabs/ /brtan byed chu dbang don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ dril bu'i dbang / phrag dog 'du byed/ bya ba sgrub pa'i don yod grub pa'i zhes 'don pa sngo'o/ /ming gi dbang ni/ gzhung las/ slob ma'i spyi bor lag pa sbyin zhes pa tsam las ma gsungs shing / nag po'i dkyil chog la jo bo rje'i man ngag sbyar ba las kyang / slob ma'i spyi bor slob dpon gyi lag pa bzhag la/ spyi bor rnam snang bskyed pa tsam ma gtogs dbang rdzas ma mdzad/ kha che lugs la dbang rdzas me tog 'phreng ba la byed/ g.yin phal cher gyi lugs la rdo rje'i dril bu bsnol ba dbang rdzas su mdzad pa/ de dag gang ltar byas kyang 'dra mod/ 'dir kha che lugs ltar bya ste/dbang rdzas me tog 'phreng ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dh+waX las 'khor lo bhuX/ rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang ye shes sermes dpa' rnam par snang mdzad me tog 'phreng bar gyur/ skye'u tsakra a dhī pa ti shrī he ru ka bī ra stuX/ a bhi tiñtsa mi/ badz+ra na maX.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye/ dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya'o/ /rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ brtan byed chu dbang / ming gi dbang / gti mugagazugs phung chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhes 'don pa spo'o/ /sngags kyi dbang ni/ me tog gtor zhing / bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung / bdag gi snying gar thim/ gtso bo yab —290—

yum gyi snying po tshar gsum rjes bzlos byas par mos/ me tog spyi bor gtor la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /rdo rje brtul as ni/ dbang rdzas rdo rje pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hu las rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa'/ dkar po rdo rje dang / ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje sems dpa'/ dang por rdo rje gyur/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /zhes lag pa g.yas pas bzung / skye( sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha e ṣa stu/ dha ra ya mi badz+ra satwa hru hi hi hi hi hu/ zhes snying gar bzung / de kho nas 'grub bo/ /spyod pa'i brtul zhugs ni/ hū las byung ba'i cang te lā thod pa/ kha ṭa gatshangs skud rnams gtso bo yab yum gyi ngo bor gyur/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭa cang te'u lhung bzed spyin/ /dpa' bo chen bo blang bar gyis/ /dbugs dbyung zhing lung bstan pa ni/ gtso bos phyag g.yas pa skyabs spyin dang / g.yon chos gos kyi grwa ri dwags kyi rna ba lta bu bzung ste lung bstan par mos/ 'khor lo gsum gyi bdag nyid khyod/ /rang nyid sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin/ /he ru ka dpal zhes bya ba'i/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid yin no/ /shrī he ru ka ḍā ki ni nā ma sarba ta thā ga tā sidha sa ma ya byur bhu wa swākhams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bdud tshogs kun las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ zhes pa'o/ /de nas phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur che/ /dpa' bo chen po bdag la stsol/ /'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa/ /—291—

de ni da 'dir mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri'i gdan gyi stengs su/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la rang nyid gnas par gyur/ steng du gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can/ g.yas su rgyal mtshan/ g.yon du ba dan mtha' skor du mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po bsam gyis mi khyab pas yongs su bskor bar gyur/ rang gi gdod ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig de nyid la gsal bar gyur pa ni/ zhes pa nas/ rnams kyi bdag nyid do/ /de ltar gyur pa'i bdag nyid he ru ka zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis par gyur/ zhes pa'am/ de tsam bsgom pa mi bde na phyag gnyis pas rung ngo / /rtsa la la na dang /ra sa na'i 'khor dang bcas shing / zhes pa nas/ rdo rje'i phreng bas mtshan pa'i bar lus dkyil rdzogs pas gsal bto ste/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo thugs ka'i hū yig gi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i zhes pa nas/ yo ga shu khro3 ha/ gi bar mngon rtogs bzhi/ dkyil 'khor pa rnams dang / dbang gi lha nas byung ba sbyin par bya/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po mang du brjod/ oṃ tri tsakra nas chu lhag ma yar lud de phyi nang lha so so'i spyi bor 'khyil pa yongs su gyur pa las mi bskyod pas dbu rgyan/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dang /phyogs bcus dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad rang nyid la gnyis su med par thim/ spyi bor me tog dor la/ o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+re swāhā/ lko rab gnas bya/ de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas bdag nyid la mchod/ rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ gzhan yang bza' bca' dang na bza' la sogs pa mchod pa sna tshogs pas mchod par gsungs pa ltar yid kyis mos/ de nas 'di ltar/ de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi —292—

bya ba ni cung zad med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyad do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun rang bzhin/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /rten zhing 'brel bar 'byung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /zhes bka'i gnang ba sbyin no/ /de ltar na rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob pas/ lus kyi dri ma dag lam bskyed pa'i rim pa sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ skyob med skyob pa skyabs med skyabs/ /dpal ni 'khor lo bde ba'i mchog /rgyu med par ni thugs rje che/ /mgon med bdag gi mgon mdzod cig /bdag nyid che khyod ji lta bar/ /gtso bo bdag kyang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs su ni/ /bying ba bdag la skyabs mjodi cig /mig dar bcings/ oṃ ā hū gis bdud rtsi gtor/dkyil 'khor gyi bdag mo'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par a dmar po/snying gar hū sngon po/ lte ba'i bar snyu ser po/ gsang bar hā ljang khu rnams su gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgra dang thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis/ sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ yab yum gyi sku la zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ gsang bar lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brtan par byas pa'i thabs kyi byang chub kyi sems bdag gi lce thog tu bzhag /'di ste dpa' bo lha mo —293—

rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga ldan par ros rtogs byed/ /bde ba gang de myang bar byos/ /o ā hū/ bdud rtsi myang / a ho ma hā su kha/ slar yang yum gyi byang chub kyi sems bdag gi khar phab/ 'das pa'i rdo rje 'chang sogs kyis/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas sras dbang bskur/ /de bzhin du ni byang chub sems/ /bzang pos bu khyod dbang bskur ro/ /o ā hū/ zhes slar yang bdud rtsi myang / de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob pas ngag gi dri ma dag lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs rim sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu longs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs brjod/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du ma rdzo phul/ gsang dbang ltar gsol ba btab/ mig dar bcings/ o ā hū gis bdud rtsi gtor/mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i rig ma dngos grub kyi don du phyag rgyar btad/ lha mo 'di ni phyag rgya che/ /mtha' yas bde ba spyin pa mo/ /rnam pa kun tu phyag rgya long / /bu yis bla med mchod par gyis/ /rig ma des kyang 'di skad du/ /dpa' bo byang chub sems bza' bar/ khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci/ /rigs lnga las ni byung ba yi/ /rig ma mchod par rtag gus sam/ /dri chen dri chu stobs dang khrag /sogs bza' da lta yid ches sam/ /rjes su mthun smros dam tshig bzang / /ji ltar dga' bar smros shig bu/ /zhes dris pa la/ ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig sogs/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rtag gus cis mi byed/ /pad+ma ra mchod pa cis mi bgyi/ /zhes lan btab/ des kyang skye gnas mchog gi rtsa gsal bar byas nas/ pad+ma bhañdza ho/ lko pang du byon/ rang nyid he ru ka phyag gnyis pa dang rig rdo rje phag mor gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las hū dkar —294—

po nas/ rgyas shing brtan par gyur gyi bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ oṃ ā hu/ gis gdong g.yogs dkrol/ gtso bo'i phyag g.yon rang gi spyi bor bzhag slob dpon dang shes rab mas gsungs par bsam te/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rmi lam 'dra bar sems can gyi/ /don kun bdag nyid kun gyis kye/ /de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil snyen ra du/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob pas sems kyi dri ma dag /lam dngos dang ye shes kyi rig ma bsten pa la dbang / 'bras bu chos sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i sogs brjod/ dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gong bzhin gsol ba 'debs pa'am/ khyod zhabs pa rje'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang / /bdag la bka' drin skyabs tu gsol/ /'di la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi gnyis las/ dang po ni/ 'di skad ces/ 'di ni rang nyid mdzes ma ste/ /phyi rol yul ni spangs pa'o/ /rig 'di bor nas 'di las ni/ /gzhan pa'i thabs kyis sangs rgyas med/ /rig ma'i brtul zhugs spyod cig bu/ /brtul zhugs kun gyi bla ma'i bla/ /zhes don dam pa'i rig ma'i brtul zhugs sbyin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bzhi pa dngos te/lhan cig skyes pa mi zad pa/ /bsam gyis mi khyab mtha' yas sogs/ /de ni brtan 'gro g.yo bdag nyid/ /bdag med nyid kyi bdag tu gnas/ /zhes pa'i don la mnyam par bzhag na/ dpa' bos bde ba chen po rtogs zhes pa'i don yang grub pa yin no/ /de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dgalam bsam gyi mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor sgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku —295—

mngon du 'gyur ba'i skal ba can du byas pa yin no/ /gtso bos ji ltar/ sogs lan gsum/ bka' drin gtang rag gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te: sogs lan gsum dang dge ba bsngo/ gnyis pa slob ma la dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma khrus byas gral du 'khod pa la/ thog mar bgegs dang sdig pa sbyang ba bya ste/ gtor ma'am mtheb kyu gsum dang / ting lo chang bu rnams kyang gsum gsum 'dus byas la/ bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs/ 'bru gsum byin gyis rlabs/ gtor ma'am mtheb kyu gsum po bskor la/ oṃ sarba bighā khyu na ma sarba ta thā ga ta smyo : bi shwa mu khe khyu sarba thā kha sdog da ga te spa ra ṇa i ma ga ga na kha grihā da ba li te swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa thams cad mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'dis tshim nas/ phan pa dang bde ba'i sems dang ldan pas gzhan du dengs shig /zhi bas sbyang ba'o/ /o sum+bha sogs lan gsum bzlas shing rdo rje gsor la/ ting lo dang chang bu bskor/ 'dir bgegs kyi tshogs gang yin pa de thams cad gtor ma lam rngan/ ting lo lam sgron/ chang bu lam rgyags kyi tshul du khyer la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song shigaces pas ni zhi drag phyed mas sbyang ba'o/ /hu mdzad kyi phyag rgya byas la bden stobs brjod te/ mthar drag po'i mtsham rngam rol wo dang bcas pas bskrad pa ni/ 'di lhar/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang rgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyis bka' bden dang / chos kyi bka' dge 'dun gyi bka' chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bden pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis 'dir dbang gi las la 'jug pa la bar du gcod par —296—

byed pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs gang yin pa de dag deng dpal he ru ka'i bka' thos pas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par myur ba nyid du song shigagang dag mi 'gro ba de dag thams cad dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes las byung ba'i khro bo'i rdo rje dang / rdo rje kha ṭa ga 'bar zhing rab tu 'bar ba 'dis khyed rnams kyi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar bags par bya sna ( /zhes bgegs bskrad cing gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ drag po sbyang ba'o/ /sdig pa sbyang ba ni/ til dang me dang chu rnams 'dus byas la/ bdag gzhan sems thams cad kyi 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad snying gar yi ge ba gyi rnam par gnas pa/ lte ba'i gtum mo 'bar ba'i 'od zer gyis ded te/sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur pa mdun gyi til la thim/ bsangs sbyangs/'bar ba'i me'i nang du khro bo rdo rje mkha' gro rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pa zhal gdangs pa'o/ /o badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha ji hi sku hi/ sarba pā pa da ha na bha smi ku ru swāhā/ lan gsum brjod/ las kyi rdo rjes til g.yas g.yon du bskor nas/ g.yas su me dang g.yon du chu dor bas/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i zhal du gsol ba dang / rgya mtsho chen por sgyur bar bsam mthar me yang chu nang du lugs so/ /de nas me tog bkye bsdu dang / sems bskyed gsal 'debs sogs byas nas/ gong du ji skad bstan pa'i bdag 'jug las/ rang nyid ces pa rnams khyed rang gi zhes 'don pa spos pas phal cher 'grub la/ lha ngo bstan pa'i skabs/ slob dpon gyi gdod ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor skad cig de nyid la zhes pa nas/ me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /rtsa la la na dang / ra sa na/ zhes pa nas/ rdo rje 'phreng bas mtshan pa'o yi bar rnams mngon rtogs bzhin sgom du 'jug dgos pa las/ 'khor gyis sa bon rnams dor ro/ /de rjes spro zhing nus na/ byang —297—

phyogs so bdun gyi dag pa rgyas pa zhig brjod na legs so/ /gzhan khyad par phra mo rnams ni slob dpon gyi gsung las rtogs par bya'o/ /lnga pa rjes kyi cho ga lha mnyes par byed pa ni/ nges par tshogs kyi 'khor los bsgrub par bya ba yin la/ rigs ldan ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang / zhing skyong la gtor ma sbyin pa sogs 'grub na'ang legs so/ /bla ma gong ma 'ga' zhig ni/ dbang bskur ba'i mdun bskyed kyi tha snyad mdzad nas/bum bskyed kyi sngon du maṇ+ḍal sgrub mchod re mdzad pas 'dug na'ang / lus dkyil 'khor gyi dbang gi don du de 'dra dgos pa ni ma yin zhing / skabs 'di dag sogs su yang nges par dgos pa min kyang / mchod pa dang bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi don du 'gyur bas byas kyang 'gal ba ni med do/ /de bzhin du sbyin bsregs la sogs pa yang ste/ dbang po dman pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyur shes par bya'o/ /dbang po mchog la ni 'dir mi bzhed de/ dbang bskur ba'i don du yang phyi rol gyi dkyil 'khor mi 'bri na/ phyi rol mchod pa dang / me mchod tsam gyi don la lta smos kyang mi dgos so/ /de la bya ba'i mthar mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis rlabs/ bdag bskyed dang bum bskyed kyi lha la dmigs nas/ phyi mchod nang mchod gsang mchod bstod pa rnams bya/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol rnams kyang byas nas/ mgron rnams tse( badz+ra mu zhes gshegs/ bum pa'i lha sku1 ga shurnyo'i sngags kyis rang la bstim/ de nas nyer bsdu'i rnal 'byor dang / bsrung ba'i rnal 'byor sgrub thabs bzhin bsgom/ de rjes smon lam dang bkra shis ci 'grub bya ste/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bsdu'o/ /'di la dang por shoms ni/ bris sku la sogs pa rten gyi mdun du bum gdan la bum pa mgul bcings kha rgyan mchod yon gyi snod gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa spyi dang 'dra bar bshams/ 'di la las bum ni mi dgos la/ lha bum drug gam bdun nam lnga'am dgu'am rnam rgyal bum pa gcig pur bsdu ba gang ltar byas kyang rung zhing / bum pa mang du byung na'ang rnam pa gcig tu —298—

bzang mod kyi/ deng sang gcig la bsdu ba la lag len gtso bor byed do/ /bum pa mang ba'i phyogs la 'khor lo so so'i lha'i snying po yang bzla dgos so/ /de'i mdun du bum pa'i sgos mchod dang /gtor mchog gi sgos mchod gnyis/ de'i mdun du spyi'i mchod pa chen mo bshams/ de tsam ma 'grub na mchod pa gcig bshams te yang yang kha gso/ de'i mdun du stegs bu la gtor ma bshams te/rten gyi g.yon du 'jig rten 'das gtor dang / g.yas su 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'o/ /slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu nang mchod kyi snod ji ltar 'os pa'i sar mig dar me tor dbu rgyan rdo rje dril bu me tog 'phreng ba khwa ṭa ga gsang dbang la dgos pa'i dam rdzas kyi snod gnyis rnams cung zad khebs kyi bkab nas bzhag go /gzhan yang rol mo sna tshogs pa dag kyang sta gon bya/ sngon 'gro gtor ma yang 'dus byas te bzhag go /kun las rab tu zab pa yi/ /dga' chen khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor gyi/ /dbang chog snying po tsam bris pas/ /'gro kun bde chen gnas thob shog /ces pa dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i lus dkyil gyi dbang chog bde chen snying po zhes bya ba 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas nags rgyal gyi dben gnas su sbyar ba'o// //ma bla la// //zhus dag /—299—

bsdo kyi gan//na ma sh+kaX wa rā ya/ gsang ba mchog gi pho brang du/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /gcig pu rab tu che ba'i lha/ /rtag tu bzhugs pa de la 'dud/ /stong nyid ye shes rdo rje yi/ /lha mo de la'ang gus btud nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyi/ /sgrub thabs rgya mtsho'i 'dir 'jug bya/ /da ni 'dir dpal mkha' 'gro'i rgyud kyi rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par 'dod pa la de bshad par bya ste/ de la dang por zhing skyong rnams la gtor ma sbyin te rang gnas su btang /oX hūX/ zhes bstan byin gyis rlabs/ 'og nas 'byung ba gtor ma ltar nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ tseX( hiXswāhā/ lan gnyis kyis kha dang lag pa byin gyis rlabs/ g.yon pa'i lag mthil dang mthe'u chung nas brtsams te/ sor mo rnams kyi rtsa ba la/ oX baX haX yoX hriX moX khyu hri huX huX phaṭa phaṭa/ sor mo lnga bsdus pa'i mdzub mo dang / mthe bong la sogs pa'i sen mo la/ lkoX ha na ma hi swāhā hūX bo ṣa ṭa hūX hūX ha phaṭa haX rnams 'khod byin gyis rlabs pa'i nang mchod lag mthil g.yas su bzhag ste/ srin lag g.yon pas chos 'byung 'bri/ 'bru gsum lan mang du brjod la/ yan lag lnga dang / mchod rdzas sogs la bsangs gtor bya/ tseX( badz+ra bhu mi hūX/ tseX( sarba bisnrun ut+pa/ ra ya hūX phaṭa/ oX āXbadz+ra re khe hūX/ oX hiXswāhā/ oX arka bi ma le swāhā/oX tsan+t+ra bi ma le swāhā/ zhes pa rnams kyi maṇ+ḍal bya/ rdo rje'i phyag rgyas reg cing / byur bhu wa swaX zhes byin gyis rlabs/ tseX( āXshrī naX me rak+ṣa huX/ tseX( āX.at+pa naX me rak+ṣa hūX/ tseX( āXyo gaX me k+ṣa hūX/ bar 'dir skyabs 'gro sems bskyed yig brgya rnams bya/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya —30()—

gnas drug tu reg la/ lko hā sogs brjod pas go cha bcings/ spro na/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro sogs sho lo ka gnyis dang / srid pa'i rgya mtshor yongs bying ba/ /yang dag yongs su sgrol mkhas pa'i/ /bla ma dam pa'i drin gang gis/ /bdag la ye shes 'di bskyed 'dud/ / ces phyag byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas la gtor ma 'bul bar bya'o/ /rang skad cig gis he ru ka phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur gyur/ snying gar pa las pad+ma dang ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hū nag po/ o a u nas ha spu hu hū ཾ phaṭa/ hū gi nā da las yi ge'i 'phreng ba spros/ lus kyi stod bar smad rnams su/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i 'phreng bas g.yon skor du dkris/ de las khams gsum du gtogs pa thams cad 'khor lo gsum gyi lha tshogs spros te srid pa gsum gyi bgegs thams cad bcom par gyur/ rang gi spyi bo dang / dpral pa dang / mgrin pa dang / snying ga rnams kyi thad ka'i nam mkha' la rim pas/ shrī he ru ka zhes pa'i yi ge bzhi kha dog sngon po'o/ /shrī he ru ko3 ha/ gzugs kyi phung po la ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /tshor ba'i phung po la ni rdo rje nyi ma'o/ /'du shes kyi phung po la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /'du byed kyi phung po la ni rdo rje rgyal po'o/ /rnam par shes pa'i phung po la ni rdo rje sems dpa'o/ /phung po lnga po thams cad kyi de bzhin nyid ni shrī he ru ka rdo rje'o/ /mig gnyis la ni gti mug rdo rje'o/ /rna ba gnyis la ni zhe sdang rdo rje'o/ /sna dag la ni phrag dog rdo rje'o/ /lce la ni 'dod chags rdo rje'o/ /lus la ni ser sna rdo rje'o/ /skye mched thams cad la ni dbang phyug rdo rje'o/ /sa'i khams la ni lhung —301—

byed ma'o/ /chu'i khams la ni gsod byed ma'o/ /me'i khams la ni 'gugs byed ma'o/ /rlung gi khams la ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug go /nam mkha'i khams la ni pad+ma dra ba can no/ /dag pa gsum dang phung khams byin gyis rlabs pa de dag ni/rten byin gyis rlabs pa zhes bya'o/ /sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i se gol gdab cing / oX sum bha ni sum bha kā yi kaX hūX hūX phaṭa/ oṃ gro hā gro hā wā tsi kaX huX hūX phaṭa/ oX gro hā pā ya spo hā pā ya tsa ra si maX huX huX phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wān/ badz+ra dz+nyā ni kaX huX hūX phaṭa/ sngags rnams nag po ljang khu/ dmar po/ ser po'i 'od kyis tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas gser gyi sa gzhi'i bar du khyab pa/ 'og tu raX las nyi ma la gnas pa'i huX las sna tshogs rdo rje huX gyis mtshan pa'i rang bzhin gyi rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ phyogs mtshams su sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i rdo rje'i ra ba gru bzhi phyogs kyi mdog can/ steng du rdo rje'i bla re dang gur/ de'i phyi rol du rdo rje rtse lnga pa ljang khu'i mda'i dra ba rnams su gyur/ mtshams rngam dang bcas pa'i sum bha tshar gnyis brjod/ sngags re re'i 'od zer las byung ba khwa gdong ma la sogs pa'i sgo ma bzhi/ gnyis gnyis 'dres pa'i 'od zer las byung ba gshin rje brtan ma la sogs pa'i mtshams ma bzhi rnams tho ba dang rang 'dra'i phur bu thogs pa spros/lkoX bisnrun ā na ya dzaXzhes bskul bas/ phyogs bcu'i bgegs rnams bkugahūX ra ba'i phyi rol du 'khrub khung mes gang ba byung ba rnams su bcug /phur bus spyi bor gdab/ oX gha gha sogs brjod/ tho bas brdungs/ oX badz+ra rjat+na ra sogs brjod/ bgegs rnams stong pa'i dbyings su sbyangs/ /pho nya mo rnams ra ba la thim/ /'od zer gyi thig le phyir 'phros pas/ 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang rdo rje dang —302—

me'i ra ba zlum po rnams su gyur/ 'og gi hu zhu bas rdo rje phra mos bar mtshams med par gtams/ bdag dang 'gro ba thams cad kun nas bgegs dang bral ba'o/ /de dag ni bsrung ba'i 'khor le'o/ /maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du tshom bu dgod cing / oṃ badz+ra ku ru swāhā/ o sun+da rī swāhā/ o pri ya ud ta ma swāhā/o da ma kā tā rā swāhā/ o bi lā sa badz+ra swāhā/ o ba khyu lo tsa ni swāhā/ o mā ma gī swāhā/ o paṇ+ḍa ra wa si swāhā/ o tā rā swāhā/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun du spyan drangs/maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus kyi me tog gi steng du lha tshogs rnams rang rang gi rnam pa dang /bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i rol pas bzhugs/ shar du kun mdzes ma sngon mo/byang du dkar mchog ma ljang khu/ nub tu shin tu rtse ma dmar mo/ lho ru rol pa'i rdo rje ma ser mo/ bzhi char yang snyim pa rin po che dang mchod pa sna tshogs kyis bkang nas/ gtso bo la stob pa/ mer spyan ma dkar mo 'khor lo/ bden bral du mā ma ki sngon mo rdo rje/ rlung du gos dkar mo dmar mo pad+ma dbang ldan du sgrol ma ljang khu ut+pal/ bzhi char yang g.yas rang rtags dang / g.yon mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pa/ lha mo brgyad po thams cad zhi zhing sgeg pa/ rol pa'i 'dug stangs can no/ /o ā hu lan gsum gyis mgron la bsang gtor bya'o/ /o pra wa ra sa t+pa ra pā du pra tisnro swāhā/ de bzhin du/ ar+gha lko ā badz+ra purmye hu sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/snying ga'i hū las byung ba'i rig ma bcu drug gis mchod par gyur/ o swe ni badz+re kyā go ru ji o re dhi o/ ༵ hā ༵ dho rdo / ༵༵ ༵/ chi rdo// /༵ je pa ༵ shi ba ༵ ༵dhi ༵ re~X —303—

bī ra bi ra shwa rā ya hū hu phaṭa zhes pa nas/ o gra sta bā ta pra bā ta hā ma te hū hū phaṭa/zhes pa'i bar ro/ /yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar 'bru gsum sbyar bas nang mchod 'bul/ rdo rje 'chang dbang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang shā bā ri pa dang / /mai tri pa dang rgya gar phyag na dang / /pad+ma rdo rje dza ya stsa na dang / /sum lo grags rgyal sa paṇa skyob pa dpal/ /rgyal tsha chos dbang mang mkhar lo tsā dang / /bag ston tshul rgyal ngag dbang byang seng ba/ /sa bzang 'phags pa mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ /byams pa gling pa rdo rje gdan pa dang / /rgya ston byang dbang rje btsun grol mchog dang / /byams pa lhun grub rnams la gus pas mchod/ /ces pa 'di rje btsun grol mchog gi gsan yig ltar bkod pa yin/ rgyal tsha chos dbang mang mkhar lo tsā ba/ /blo chen ye shes mgon dang dar ma bzang / /grags chen spang khang ba dang rin brtson pa/ /mkhan chen byang ser theg chen chos rje dang / /brag thog bsod bzang 'jigs med rdo rje gdan pa/ dpa' bo dang / rgya ston man gong bzhi no/ /yang na sum lo mkhas pa sa mu dra pa dang / /seng ge rgyal mtshan yar lungs lo tsā ba/ /rong ba shes seng skyi ston grags rgyal dang / /kun mkhyen chen po slob dpon chos grags dpal/ /mkhan chen byang seng : sogs gong bzhi/ nye brgyud ni/he ru ka dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ yā bā ri pa sems kyi rje grol mchog go mdud grol dang / /sangs rgyas kun 'dus lha dbang grags pa ste/ /yid bzhin nor bu'i bla ma rnams la mchod/ /ces so/ /kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /'gro don rab tu sgrub pa po/ /yid bzhin nor bu 'dir 'byung ba/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs ye shes chen pos g.yogs/ /thams cad bdag —304—

nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /thugs rje khro ba drag chen po/ /dpal sdom khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sa dang byed du bcug dang yi rang ba'i/ /sdig pa ma lus skyon kun bcom pa yi/ /spyan sngar so sor bshags shing slar yang ni/ /mi byed pa yi sdom pa bzung bar bgyi/ /nyan thos rang rgyal bla med rgyal ba dang / /rgyal ba'i sras kyis bsngags pa'i dge ba gang / /de dag kun la bdag gis rjes yi rang / /byang chub yang dag yongs su bsngo bar bgyi/ /rgyal ba dkon mchog la sogs gsum po la/ /dngos po kun gyis bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de bzhin du/ /bla na med pa'i lam la brten par bgyi/ /lan gsum/ oX badz+ra satwa gu ru pā de khyiX sarba sa twa u pa kā ra ṇi ya swāhā/zhes me tog gtor/ tshogs zhing gi dkyil 'khor 'khor bcas rang la thim pa'am/tseXdz+nya āXbadz+ra muXskyoX/ zhes gshegs su gsol/ de nas tshad med bzhi spyi dang mthun par bsgom ste/bsod nams tshogs gsog go /oX sarba dharmaXr n+ya swa bhā wa shā khyo3 haX/ oX swa bhā wa shudhaXsarba dharmaXswa bhā wa shurnyo tsho3 haX/ oX hūṃ n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa ut+pa ko3 haX/ oX yo ga shudhaXsarba dharmā yo ga shurnyo3 haX/ de lta bu'i sngags kyi don bsgom pa ni ye shes tshogs gsog go /stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyid nā da dmar skya nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las thig le/ de las zla byed/ de las mgo bo/ de las ha/ de las mū yig grub pa'i tshul gyis hūX yig ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de dang lhan cig grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba drwa ba gur bla re phyi rol 'khor lo dang pad+ma dang rdo rje dang me'i drwa bas bskor ba thams cad kyang dbyibs zlum po'o/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo de'i nang 'og gi char yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po zla gam yaX —305—

dang ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ ra las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum ra dang 'bar bas mtshan pa/ ba las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po ba dang bum pas mtshan pa/ la las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi la dang rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ su las ri rab rin po che sna bzhi las grub pa/ kha dog bzhi dang zur bzhi pa/ rtse mo brgyad pa la sum gyis mtshan pa/ pa las sna tshogs pad+ma la gnas pa'i hu/ de yongs su gyur pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar nag byang ljang nub dmar lho ser nye ba dkar ba 'byung ba rnams zhu zhing sla ba'i ngo bor gyur pas ri rab 'og gi cha la song la/ 'byung ba bzhi zhu ba rnams sna tshogs rdo rje'i steng du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ gzhal med khang chen po rdo rje'i rang bzhin gyi sa gzhi la gnas shing dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba/chos 'byung gi phyag rgya'i nang du chud pa kho na phyi nang du rim pa bzhi las/ pho brang nang ma gsum zlum po/ phyi ma gru bzhi'o/ /pho brang dang po lhan cig skyes pa'i sku'i 'khor lo ni/ nag po dang sngon po'i rtsig pa rim pa gnyis dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur gsum pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gnyis pa chos kyi sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ nag dmar dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa gsum dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur bzhi pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang gsum pa longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor sngo ser/ dmar ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim pa bzhi dang ldan pa/chos 'byung zur lnga pa'i nang du chud pa/ pho brang bzhi pa sprul pa'i sku'i dkyil 'khor ni/ sngo ser dmar ljang dkar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ chos 'byung zur drug pa'i nang du chud pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor dang po'i dbus su sna —306—

tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa ste/ de'i lte bar nyi ma la 'jigs byed chen po dang dus kyi mtshan ma'o/ /de'i phyir rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo sngo nag mu khyud la gri gug gi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du snying po'i 'khor lo dmar ser rin po che'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du yon to gyi 'khor lo dkar dmar rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du nam mkha'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod chen po brgyad ni/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis gtum dragatshang tshing can/ 'bar ba 'khrigs pa'i keng rus/ 'jigs sde/ dbang ldan nas g.yon skor gyis/ ha ha rgod pa/ dpal gyi nags/ mun pa drag po/ ki li ki li'i sgra sgrog pa rnams so/ /de dag na gnas pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shi ri sha.a shwat+pa/ ka ka la/ tsu ta/ n+ya gro dha/ ka ra lha la ta pa r+ṣa/ pā ra sta pa'o/ /phyogs skyong ba brgyad ni/ dbang po/ gnod sbyin/ klu'i dbang po/ gzhin rje'i bdag po/'byung po'i bdag po/ sreg za'i bdag po/ srin po'i bdag po/ rlung gi bdag pa'o/ /klu chen po brgyad ni/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po/ hu lu hu lu/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong ngo / /sprin gyi bdag po brgyad ni/ sgra sgrogs/ 'ur sgrogs/ drag po/ 'khyi/la pa/ 'thu/ga po/ gang ba/ char 'bebs/gtum po'o/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis pa'i dbus su/ nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor 'dam skyes sngon po'i mdog can pad+ma'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du rlung gi 'khor lo sngo ljang ngam sna tshogs pa'i mdog can 'khor lo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du sa'i 'khor lo ser po ral gri'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/—307—

de'i phyi rol du bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du me'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ gsod byed/ kun tu skrag byed/'jigs chen/ 'jigs byed/ skrod byed/ sdang byed/ lkugs byed/ rengs byed do/ khreng brgyad ni/ go yu/ star ka /nā ri la / se 'bru/ bil ba/ skyu ru ra/bidz+nyā/ rak+ta 'o/ /phyogs skyong ma brgyad ni/ dbang mo/ gnod spyin mo/ chu lha mo/gshin rje mo/ 'byung mo/ drang srong mo/ srin mo/ rlung gi chung ma'o/ /dkyil 'khor gsum pa'i dbus su/ me'i 'khor lo dmar po sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du chu'i 'khor lo dkar po thod pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi 'khor lo ljang khu'am khra bo mgo bo'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /sgo'i phyi rol du chu'i khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ byis pa shi ba/ lhag ma za ba/ mi bzad pa'i g.yul/ mche ba kun/ du ba mun nag nang gi me/ ha he'i sgra/ sgra chen po'o/ khreng brgyad ni/ tsan dan/ ga pur/ dzā ti/ e la/ nā ga ge sa ra/ tsam pa ka kun tu sa lha'i shing ngo / 'jig rten skyong ba brgyad ni/ nyi ma me 'bar ba 'dzin pa/ bsil pa ral gri 'dzin pa/ sa'i bu chu gri 'dzin pa/ ri bong can skyes mdung ring 'dzin pa/ bla ma sbu gri 'dzin pa/ ngan spong gi bu brag ri 'dzin pa/ nyi ma'i bu glog 'dzin pa/ lha min mgo bo mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'bebs pa ste thams cad kyang bzhin shin tu khros pa'o/ /grub pa'i skyes bu brgyad ni/ ral gri/ mig sman/ ril bu/ rkang byug bcu/da len/ mchil lham/dngul chu/ sa 'og thob pa rnams so/ /dkyil 'khor bzhi pa'i dbus su thugs —308—

kyi 'khor lo nag po keng rus kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po zhags pa'i 'phreng bas bskor ba/ de'i phyi rol du sku'i 'khor lo dkar dmar sngo ba'i mdog can mu khyud la lcags kyu'i 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol du bskal pa bzang po'i lha'i snam bu'o/ /bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi rol du rlung gi khor yug la gnas pa'i dur khrod brgyad ni/ tshig pa/ ma tshig pa/ dum bur gyur pa/ ma gtubs pa/ 'jigs su dra5 ba/'jigs par byed pa/ gsal shing gis phug pa/ steng nas btags pa'o/ khreng brgyad ni/ sha sma li/ mya ngan med pa/ yongs 'du/ u du sba ra/ to sba ri/ gam+bha ri/rgya shug ba ru ra'o/ /'jig rten skyong ba ni/ dmyal srung chen po brgyad do/ /de la gzhal med khang rim pa re re'i nang du chud pa'i 'khor lo rim pa gsum gsum ste/ bcu gnyis po thams cad kyang so sor rtsibs sum cu rtsa drug rtsa drug dang bcas pa/ gzhal med khang rnams kyang pha gu dang / ka thung dang / gser gyis snam bu dang / dra phyed dang / shar bu dang / mda' yab dang / gzungs ma rnams dang bcas pa'i kha khyer te/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ sgo bzhi'i steng na ka bas btegs pa'i rta babs kyis mdzes pa/ chos kyi 'khor lo dang / ri dwags kyis rtse mo brgyan pa/ nang gi lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang / nub dmar/ lho ser/ dbus dkar ba/ steng thog rim par phub pas dbus phyur bur gyur pa/ rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mdzes pa/ gzhal med khang phyi ma'i nang gi grwa bzhir bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad dang bcas pa/ dur khrod rim pa bzhi po rnams kyang re re bzhin/ zhing skyong ba dang / me dang / sprin dang / chu dang / ri —309—

dang / mchod rten brgyad brgyad rnams dang / dpa' bo dang / rnal 'byor ma/ ro dang ro langs dang / bya dang gcan gzan dang / 'jig rten skyong ba rnams kyi 'khor gyis yongs su gang ba/ mchod pa'i yo byad rnams dang / grub pa'i rdzas kyis nye bar brgyan pa/ phyi rol na rdo rje'i 'phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'o/ /de ltar dkyil 'khor chen po dwangs shing sgrib pa med pa phyi nang kun tu 'od gsal ba mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa rgyan gyi rnam pa mchog tu bkra ba du mas mdzes par gyur/ nang gi lha'i gnas rnams las/ gtso bo'i pad+ma'i 'dab ma nyer bzhi dang / 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams dang / dkyil 'khor so so'i sgo mtshams rnams su ro'i gdan/ bskal bzang gi snam bu la zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /de dag ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa'o/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/a ā nas a a nyis 'gyu/ra g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbyangs so gnyis kyis mtshan pa me long lta bu'i ye shes/de'i steng du ka kha nas ha k+ṣa ya ra la wa ḍa lhe nyis 'gyur g.yon skor du gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal byed brgyad cus mtshan pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de gnyis kyi dbus su nam mkha'i hu yig zhugs/ de las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams spros te/ 'gro ba thams cad de'i bdag nyid du byas nas slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hū gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ yang 'od 'phros thog ma med pa nas grub pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad phyogs bcu nas spyan drangs te hū la thim pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes/ de rnams yongs su —310—

gyur pa las sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang rang nyid rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa sku mdog dkar po/ dkar ljang dmar ser ba'i zhal bzhi/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas rang 'dra'i yum la 'phyud pa/ gnyis pa gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa 'dzin pa/ lhag ma g.yas bzhi cang te lā gri gug dgra sta/ rtse gsum/ g.yon bzhi kha ṭāX ga thod pa zhags pa tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ byis pa'i rgyan gyi brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis g.yon pa bskum pas 'jigs byed dang / g.yas brkyang bas dus mtshan ma mnan pa/smad g.yogs stag gi pags pa'i sha thabs grol ba: nas 'phro ba dang bcas pa'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin no/ /thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūX yig go /de yan chad ni bsnyen pa'o/ /yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las huX las rdo rje nag po rtse lnga pa byāX las byung ba'i nor bu'i rtse mor byāX dmar ser gyis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' khams mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las āXlas pad ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa byāX las byung ba'i ze 'bru'i rtser mor hūṃ dkar ser gyis mtshan pa/ gnyis ka'i bu ga phaṭa ser pos bkag pa/ yab kyi lte ba dang / yum gyi mgrin par/ oX be+e ro tsa ni ye hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/yab kyi thugs ka dang / yum gyi dpral par/ oX sarba brnya ḍā ki nī ye/ badz+ra waṇi nī ye huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ yab kyi mgrin pa dang yum gyi lte bar/ oX shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX hūX huX phaṭa/ ḍā ki ni dzā la sa sba raX swāhā/ yab kyi dpral pa dang yum gyi thugs kar/ lkoX hri ha ha huX huX phaṭa/ oX āXhūX sngags rnams phan tshun reg cing / yab yum gyi rjes su chags pa'i snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ de bzhin —311—

gshegs pa thams cad bskul te yab kyi zhal du zhugs lha mo'i pad+ma son pa na/yab yum gnyis ka bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo/ 'od kyi thig le'i gong bur zhu bar gyur/ nye ba'i bsnyen pa'o/ /de nas snying rje dang byams pa dang dga' ba dang / btang snyoms kyi rang bzhin thig le las byung ba'i mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa lha mo drug tshan bzhi rnams rang rang gi gnas kyi pad+ma'i 'dab ma la 'dug nas bzhengs par bskul ba ni/ mnga' bdas nyi ma re rer 'gro ba mgron 'bod na/ khyod ni ci yi phyir na stong pa nyid la bzhugs/ / bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag ni snying rje'i rang bzhin te/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bde chen bdag la 'dod pa mdzod/ /gson zhig gson zhig gzhan gyi dgongs pa nub/ /'jig rten phyugs gang shi ba bzhin du gyur/ /bdag gi pad+ma rgyas pa la 'dod mdzod/ /de ltar 'jig rten kun bder 'gyur bar byos/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa bdag la rol zhig rol/ /lhan skyes rang bzhin brjod du med pa thob/ /'jig rten sems can gzhan ni rmongs gyur pas/ /ji ltar khyod ni stong pa don med 'gyur/ /khyod ni chos rnams kun gyi byed po ste/ /ci phyir lhan skyes rang bzhin 'gro med bzhugs/ /bdag la mchog gi don gyi 'dod pa mjodi/ /ji ltar khyod ni 'jig rten rnams mthun bzhud/ /ces bskul nas/ lha mo rnams thig le la thim/thig le de nyid hū sngon po las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa lte bar hu ljang sngon gyis mtshan par gyur/ o ā kā ya lha ka tsit+ta badz+ra hū phaṭa ho de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sngags 'di 'don bzhin par bzhengs pa na/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i dkyil 'khor pa —312—

thams cad kyang skad cig gis rdzogs par blta'o/ /de yang dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la zla ba dang nyi ma dang dus me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ 'jigs byed chen po dang dus mtshan mo'i gdan la/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog g.yon nag g.yas ljang ba'i phyed gzugs la nyi ma bye ba'i 'od ltar 'bar ba'i gzi brjid kyi phung po can zhal bcu bdun phyag bdun cu rtsa drug pa/ rtsa zhal sku lus dang mtshungs pa'i mdog can/ rtsa zhal gyi steng gi zhal gsum dang / kun gyi steng gi zhal gcig ste bzhi ni bung ba ltar gnag cing ches khros pa/ g.yon zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ljang khu/ rgyab zhal brtsegs ma bzhi dmar po/ g.yas zhal brtsegs ma bzhi ser po/ zhal re re zhing dmar zhing bkra la rab tu 'khrug pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan zhing / mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/zhal thams cad kyang rnam par 'gyur ba'i khro gnyer can/ kun gyi mdun ma'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ thams cad kyi tha ma'i phyag gnyis kyis glang po che'i pags pa stod g.yogs su bsnams pa ste rtsa ba'i phyag bzhi'o/ /lhag ma sprul phyag bdun cu rtsa gnyis ni/ /dang po g.yas g.yon ral gri phub chen bsnams/ /gnyis pa dag gis mdung ring mche ba 'dzin/ /gsum pa mdung rtse gsum dang gshun shing ngo / /bzhi pa dgra sta zhags pa ste/ lnga pa gri gug thod khrag go /drug pa mda' bo che dang gzhu/ /bdun pa gsal zhing kha ṭāX ga /brgyad po tho ba po ti dang / /dgu pa 'khor lo phub chung dang / /bcu pa cang te'u sdigs mdzub can/ /bcu gcig chu gri g.yer kha'i phreng / /bcu gnyis dbyug gu rtse gcig lu gu brgyud/ /bcu gsum mtshon cha rtse —313—

gcig brag ri'o/ /bcu bzhi dung dkar dur khrod rdul/ /bco lnga zangs dung bho ka dang / /bcu drug dbyug rtse gsum dang bha ka ste/ /bcu bdun rma bya'i mjug sgro pags rlon no/ /bco brgyad bya rog gshog sgro skra thag dang / /bcu dgu skra'i pir ro bsreg bskul ba'i shing / /nyi shu me thab ga da'i dbyug /nyer gcig ri bo phug rings dang / /nyer gnyis dbyug to mi mgo dang / /nyer gsum me long keng rus dang / /nyer bzhi pi wang zor ba'o/ /nyer lnga rkang pa'i mgo dang mig /nyer drug lag mgo mkhal ma ste/ /nyer bdun glo ba snye ma dang / /nyer brgyad rgyu ma spen pa dang / /nyer dgu sgra gcan phur bu'o/ /sum cu lcags sgrog bi dza pur/ /so gcig gdos dang sog le ste/ /so gnyis du bhu sa dang khab/ /so gsum nya dol pags pa slud bu bshus/ /so bzhi mgo med ro dang char 'bebs sprin/ /so lnga 'bar ba'i mar nag ljon shing ste/ /so drug 'jigs byed che gzugs lcags kyu bsnams/ /zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rkyal du gnas pa'i nu steng dang / g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa'i steng nas brdzis pa/ zhes pa tsam mam/ yang na/ zhabs bco brgyad kyi g.yas dgu brkyang pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo gan rkyal du mnan pa'i steng dang / g.yon dgu brkyang bas 'jigs byed nag po kha bub tu gnas pa'i rna ba g.yon pa mnan pa'i steng du/ g.yas pas khyab 'jug drag po dang / tshangs pa nyi ma me dang ni/ /dbang po rlung dang bden bral dang / /gnod sbyin ji lta'i rim pas so/ /g.yon pas gshin rje 'dod lha dang / /zla ba chu lha nor rgyas dang / /sa dang tshogs kyi bdag po dang / /smin drug bu dang 'khor sgyur —314—

rnams/ /gnon zhing 'jigs par mdzad pa yin/ /zhes so/ /smad g.yogs stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ dbu skra ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa'i rtse mor 'khor lo la gnas pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon ngos su zla ba phyed pa dang / ral pa'i mdun ngos su sna tshogs rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dbu re re la rdo rje nag po'i 'phreng ba la brgyus pa'i mi mgo skam po lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang / dpa' bo'i dar dpyangs bcings pa/ /mi mgo khrag 'dzag brgya'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug dag dpung rgyan dang / zhabs gdub dang / 'og pag la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing / sku lus ba spru'i 'phreng ba can/ sku'i tshigs thams cad la bde bas brlan pa/ sprul pa'i he ru ka sna tshogs pa rnam par 'phro ba dang bcas pa'o/ /de ni sgrub pa'o/ /de la 'byud pa'i yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar mo/ bskal pa'i me ltar gzi brjid 'bar ba/ drag mo chen mo zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yab la khyud pa/lhag ma g.yas bzhis zangs gri/ sta re ḍā ma ru tri shu la/ g.yon bzhis ka pā la/'ching byed/ mkha' dbyug tshangs mgo rnams 'dzin pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis spyi bo'i steng du skye gnas kyi phyag rgya yongs su bskor ba/ dmar ser sngo ljang ba'i zhal bzhi dang ldan pa/ gcer bu ba spu langs shing rdul dang ldan pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ yan lag thams cad la lha rdzas kyi dris nyer bar byugs shing / lha rdzas kyi me tog phreng bas klubs pa/ dbu rgyan la zla phyed rdo rjes mdzes pa/zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis yab dpal he ru ka dang —315—

mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyag rgya lnga dang thod pa'i cod pan can/ mi mgo skam po lnga bcu'i phreng ba dang ldan pa/ sprul pa'i rnal 'byor pa dpag tu med pa 'phro ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de ni sgrub pa chen po'o/ /de yan chad kyis dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin rdzogs so// //sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo'i pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad las/bar bar du 'dab ma re re bor ba'i 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi la rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ shar nas byang gi bar la/ mkha' 'gro ma dang gzugs can nyid/ /'o byed ma dang gzhan sgyur ma/ /byis bcas ma dang rjes 'jug ma/ /de rnams g.yon nag g.yas ljang khu/ /byang nas nub kyi bar la/ lwa ma rnal sne 'bya ra dbang phyug ma/ /bzang mo thod pa can ma dang / /nag po rgyal pos bskor ma rnams/ /g.yon ljang g.yas dmar rim pas so/ /nub nas lho'i bar la/ dum skyes ma dang dur khrod ma/ /rnam par zhu ma rig byed ma/ /du byed ma dang gar ma rnams/ /g.yon dmar g.yas ni ser ba'o/ /lco nas shar gyi bar la/ gzugs can ma dang 'jigs byed ma/ /gtsud phud ma dang thor tshugs ma/ /ral pa can ma drag mo rnams/ /g.yon ser g.yas ni sngo ba'o/ /thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag bzhi spyan gsum ma/ sgra grol ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang ḍā ma sa g.yon thod khrag dang kha ṭa ga 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pa'i stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs shing / /lhag ma gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de ༵kyā ༵ bkyi rmi snro rlo dhi snra thod pad / sdu rti nyer bzhi~X /'i/ /༵ phyi —316—

rol du rdo rje'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ mkha' 'gre/ ma gzhan lā ma gzhan/ dum skyes ma gzhan gzugs can gzhan/ /rab gtum ma dang gtum mig ma/ /'od ldan ma dang sna chen ma/ /dpa' bo'i blo ma mi'u thung ma/ /lang ka'i mdag mo shing grib ma/ /sa srung 'jigs byed chen mo dang / /rlung shugs ma dang chang 'thung ma/ /sngo sangs lha mo rab bzang ma/ /rta sna ma dang bya gdong ma/ /'khor lo'i shugs ma dum skyes ma/ /chang 'tshong 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ /shin tu dpa' mo stobs chen ma/ /'khor los bsgyur ma brtson chen ma/ /gzhin rje'i bu mo gzhan rje ma/ /skyod byed ma dang skrag byed ma/ /gtum mo dang ni dbyangs can ma/ /'dod grub ma dang 'bar chen mo/ de thams cad kyang sngo nag phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /'di dag gi yab rnams mtshan tha dad pa la mos na/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro la sogs pa bzhi dang / khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la la sogs pa nyer bzhi dang / stobs po che/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ blo brtan brtan pa thar pa ye shes thabs thugs kyi rdo rje zhes pa rnams su bshad la / /'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi skabs 'dir/ /'og ma rnams kyis rigs 'gre ba'i phyir mtshan tha dad pa ma smos kyang chog go /snying po'o 'khor lo shar nas g.yon skor gyis/rdo rje 'chang ma mi bskyod ma/ /rin chen gtsug ma rnam snang ma/ /pad+ma gar dbang ma dang don yod ma/ /spyan ma bdag ma gos dkar sgrol ma dang / /gzugs kyi rdo rje ma dang de bzhin du/ /sgra dri ro reg chos dbyings rdo rje ma/ /sa snying mo dang nam mkha'i snying po ma/ /phyag rdor ma dang 'jig rten mgon po dang / /sgrib pa kun sel kun tu bzang mo dang / /rin chen sgrol ma bdag med khro gnyer can/ /ri khrod lo ma can de bzhin du/ /gzhin rje mthar byed ma dang shes mthar ma/ /pad mthar ma dang bgegs mthar byed ma dang / /mi g.yo ma dang dbyug —317—

sngon 'dod rgyal ma/ /stobs chen ma dang gtsug tor gnod mdzes ma thams cad kyang dmar ser phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /yon tan 'khor lo la/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje rigs mo/ /dmangs mo gtum mo khyi 'tshed ma/ /g.yung mo gar ma thod pa can/ /nya pa mo dang spyig ma mkhan/ dung bzo mkhan ma thag ga ma/ /'khur ba mkhan mo shing bzo ma/ /phreng ba mkhan mo til mar mkhan/ /de bzhin tshos mkhan mo dang ni/ /srin bal byed mo pho nya mo/ /bshang 'phyag mo dang rtsis mkhan mo/ /chang 'tshong ldum ra'i gnyer ba mo/ /rgyal pos bkrabs ma bshan pa mo/ /so rtsi tshong bar byed ma dang / /gser mgar mo dang lcags mgar mo/ /nor bu mkhan ma nags pa mo/ /kla klo o ḍi tshong ba mo/ /rdo bzo ma dang zhing las mo/ /ko pags ma ste rnal 'byor ma'o/ /thams cad kyang dkar dmar phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /de'i phyi rol skal pa bzang po'i snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa byams pa dang seng ge nas brtsams te/ sangs rgyas glog gi tog gi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ khar sgor khwa gdong ma/byang sgor ga gdong ma/ nub sgor khyi gdong ma/ lho sgor phag gdong ma/ shar lhor gzhin rje brtan ma/ lto nub tu gshin rje pho nya ma/ nub byang du gshin rje mche ba ma/ byang shar du gshin rje 'joms ma rnams so/ /nam mkha'i 'khor lo la/ mi 'am ci mo dri za mo/ khu ḍū ka ma pa ṭa ha/ /pi waX gling bu mu kun+da/ /rdza rnga gag ri ma dang / /cha lang she le sgri ka ma/ /glu ma ka raṇ+ḍa ma ta ma ḍa/ /gar ma sgeg ma khyu ka ma dang ni/ /tru li sha ra ṇa mo rnga chen mo/ /mo dri rgyud can ma dang mā ru ma/ /na la bā lo rnyeX ba ka ma dang / /ḍā ma ru dang byu ṇa bug ma dang / /zangs dung ma dang rwa dung ma de bzhin/ /bhu ki dril bu ma dang dril chung ma/ /g.yer kha ma dang —318—

ko li ka ma dang / dung dkar ma dang dbyangs ldan ma de bzhin/ /'khor ma zhes bya sum cu rtsa drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po'o/ /yang na sna tshogs par bkra ba'o/ /rlung gi 'khor lo la/ mkha' lding ngang mo bkra ba mo/ /bya rog bya gar sreg pa mo/ /rma bya zangs kyi gtsug phud ma/ /gu da bu li 'jam pa mo/ /phug ron bya rog chen mo dang / /ga ṭi ni dang gong ma sreg /ne tso sngags ma bzhad ma dang / /bya rgod 'ug pa tsā ṭa ki/ khreng byi'u ma dang ngur pa ma/ /prak+ṣa ra ni ka ska bi/ /so bya mo dang bi lwa ḍi/ /lcug ma'i mgrin dang sha ri gī/ /byi'u rang tun gum lce ma dang / /ba ṭi ri kā dzaX gha mo/ /hor ba kaX ka mo de bzhin/ /dat+ta ri mo ri dwags dgra/ /thams cad kyang sngo ljang phyed pa'i sna tshogs pa'i kha dog bkra ba can no/ /sa'i 'khor lo la/ seng ge mo dang stag mo dang / /bhi pa mo dang ri bong ma/ /glang chen ri dwags byi la mo/ /ba nga/nga ma he mo rta mo/ /lce spyang mo dang bse mo 'bri/ /byi ba bong mo bhe ṭi ma/ /ra mo lug mo rim pa bzhin/ khyi mo phag mo dom mo dang / /daṇ+ḍa di ma mo dz+nyā gī/ /dred mo dang ni sgeg mo dang / /nags ma dang ni khyi chen mo/ /bya rog chen mo shar du lī/ /sprul mo khra mo rnga mong dang / /sre mong rtsang mo phug pa mo/ /grong na gnas pa ma rnams so/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog ser po'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa mchod pa dang dpal sbas nas brtsams te/ sangs rgyas tshangs pa'i tog gi bar dus sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /shar sgor tshangs ma/ byang sgor dbang phyug ma/ nub sgor gzhon nu ma/ lho sgor khyab 'jug ma/ mer phag mo/bden bral du dbang mo/ rlung du gtum mo/ dbang ldan du dpal chen mo rnams so/ /me'i 'khor lo la/ lha mo klu mo gnod spyin mo/ /'byung mo ma dang chung ma —319—

sring/ /bu mo sring mo'i bu mo dang / /pha yi sring mo de bzhin du/ /zhung po yi ni chung ma dang / /chung ma'i spun zla dang de'i ma/ /de nyid kyi ni ma yi ma/ /chung ma yi ni phyi mo dang / /ma yi ma dang gnyen mo dang / /ma'i sbun sbun zla'i bu mo dang / /rang gi phyi mo'i sbun zla dang / /spun zla'i bu mo de'i bu mo/ /pha yi ma dang phyi mo dang / khu bo yi ni chung ma dang / /bu mo'i bu yi chung ma dang / /slar yang chung ma'i sbun zla mo/ /pha yi sring dang de'i bu mo/ /de nyid kyi ni rang rigs skyes/ /sbun zla'i chung ma su nywa dang / /bu nyid kyi ni chung ma dang / /bu mo'i khyo yi ma yi ni/ /bu nyid kyi ni rgyug mo dang / /'jo byed mo dang snyu tri'o/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o/ /chu'i 'khor lo ma/ ma ka ra mo ku dhī nya/ /sbal mo kañtsi chu sram mo/ /sdig nag gag ri ma shrī li ma/ /chu yi phug ma srin bu'i gdong ma dang / /cha ga kat+na ṭa dang su ya mo/ /chu byi mo dang grog mo'i gdong ma dang / /chu yi mi mo dang ni ba ḍa bī/ /glang chen mo dang stag mo lce spyang mo/ /chu sbrul ma dang dud mo 'gron bu ma/ /mu tig ma ṇi mo dang dziX gu rī/ /li sa mo dang dud du ra ma ka rto ṭi/ /pha ṭa ka ma dā wa ka ma kri ma mo/ /dzu ṣi dzu ṣa mo dang sha sbrang ka lā mo/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar mo'o/ /ye shes kyi 'khor lo la/ thig le mchog ma shin tu bde/ /lha yi bu mo dga' chen mo/ /dga' dang dga' grags pad+ma can/ /dung can sna tshogs glang chen ma/ /gzugs can ma dang gzugs mdzes ma/ /'dod chags rnams sgeg bde ba mo/ /me tog 'dod ma kun mud da/ /ut+pal ma dang mdzes ldan ma/ /'dod chags mo dang 'dod chags che/ /rol grags ma dang rol chen mo/ /myos ma dang ni myos chen ma/ /'dod pa mo dang 'dod chen ma/ /bde 'byung ma dang bde ldan ma/ /mthun mchog ma dang byams pa mo/ /skal —32()—
