bzang ldan ma skal bzang mo/ /dma' mo zhu ma skye gzugs ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog sna tshogs bkra ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba'i gzugs dang 'od 'phro nas sangs rgyas mthu'i dpal gyi bar du sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu zhe dgu'o/ /sgo mtshams brgyad la/ shar du go rī/byang du tso rī/ nub tu be ta lī/ lho ru lha sma rī/ bsreg zar puska sī/ srin por ri khrod ma/ rlung mtshams su tsaṇ+ḍa lī/ /ཿnga bor ḍom+bhi ni rnams so/ thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ klu mo gnod spyin mo 'byung mo/ /yi dwags dmyal mo mnar med ma/ /ltung ba ma dang bar med ma/ /bum pa mo dang gzhan rje mo/ /thig nag mo dang me mdag mo/ /tsha ma ba dang rab tsha ma/ /ngu 'bod ma dang ngu 'bod che/ /mar nag du 'tshed ri gnyis 'tshir/ /sdang ma rmongs ma phrag dog ma/ /chags ma ser snas myos pa ma/ /skud pa ma dang grang ba ma/ /de bzhin ral gri'i nags ma nyid/ /ngu ma dang ni mu ge mo/ /nad dgon mtshon dgon chung dgon ma/ /ral gri'i so ma rab med ma/ /sbu gri'i so ma 'khor lo can/ /grul bum ma ste so drug go /thams cad kyang sku mdog nag mo'o/ /gsung gi 'khor lo la/ /le lo chos sems sgom pa mo/ /mchod sems bza' sems gnyid sems ma/ khyim sems bud med sems ma dang / /don sems ma dang sbyor bral ma/ /bu sems ma dang mya ngan ma/ /bsam gtan ma dang sngags zlos ma/ /ngo tsha nga rgyal gdung ba mo/ /sems can don gyi rgyur brtson ma/ /rgyal po sems ma gzhan gnod ma/ /ye shes thob ma dka' thub ma/ /rgas ma 'ching bar sems ma dang / /bde ma sdug ma mi dge ma/ /yod ma med ma nyid dang ni/ /bla ma sems ma 'gro ba mo/ /bzod ma mi bzod dal ma dang / /ngal gsos ma dang bkres sems —321—

ma/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar mo'o tsho/ /'di thams cad kyi mtshan gyi mthar sems pa ma zhes sbyor rgyu yin no/ /sku'i 'khor lo la 'khor los bsgyur ma rnams te/ rgyal chen bzhi'i rigs 'khor los bsgyur ma dang / /sum cu rtsa gsum 'thab bral dga' ldan pa/ /'phru la dga' gzhan 'phru/la dbang byed tshangs ris pa tshangs pa mdun na 'don dang tshangs chen po/ /'od chung tshad med 'od dang 'od gsal ba/ /dge chung tshad med dge dang dge rgyas dang / /sprin med bsod nams skyes dang 'bras bu che/ /mi che mi gdung shin tu mthong ba dang / /gya nom snang ba dang ni 'og min pa/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas rnam shes mtha' yas dang / /ci yang med dang 'du shes yod min zhing / /'du shes med min gyi ni skye mched dang / /dmyal ba yi dwags dur 'gro dang ni mi/ /lha min zla ba nyi ma gshin rje dang / /dbang po'i 'khor lo bsgyur ba zhes rnams so/ /thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar ba'am/ sngo dmar dkar ba'i khra bo'o/ /'di thams cad kyi mthar 'khor los bsgyur ma zhes sbyor ba yin no/ /de'i phyi rol gyi snam bu la/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'phags dgyes dang mthu stobs nas sangs rgyas snang mdzad kyi bar gyi sangs rgyas nyis brgya bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ khar sgor dkar mo chu skyes/ byang sgor gan+ta ri/ nub sgor rdo rje gar ma/ lho sgor rta rgod ma'i kha ma/ dbang ldan du rdo rje'i 'bar zhal ma/ mer rdo rje khro gnyer can ma/ bden bral du rdo rje dum bu ma/rlung du rdo rje gtum mo rnams so/ /de rnams las 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi rnal sh+lau bye bye lha shing/ sngi ༷ ༷ sni kau /phri / gas khrim / da 'dzin pa / mo sgra grol/ /dragazhing hai rdo dzom cheng rdo —322—

rje'i 'phreng ba sogs sna tshogs pas brgyan pa/ ro'i gdan la g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa/ de rnams la 'phyud pa'i dpa' bo rnams ni/ mtshan dang sku'i rnam pa yum dang 'dra ba las/ phyag rgya drug dang ral ba'i cod pan dang / mgo rlon gyi do shal dang / stag lpags kyi smad dkris can/ g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhi'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad ni/ shar phyogs pa rnams sngo ba/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang ba/ nub phyogs pa rnams dmar ba/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser ba/ me mtshams pa rnams g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ bden bral pa rnams g.yas ser g.yon dmer ba/ rlung mtshams pa rnams g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ dbang ldan pa rnams g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang zhal gcig: nas mtshungs pa'o/ /bskal bzang gi sangs rgyas rnams ni/ shar phyogs pa rnams sngon po/ byang phyogs pa rnams ljang khu/nub phyogs pa rnams dmar po/ lho phyogs pa rnams ser po/ thams cad kyang mtshan dang dpe byad rdzogs pa chags bral rab byung gi cha lugs can bzhugs tshul dang phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ /zhes bla ma snga ma rnams gsung / de dag ni dam tshig gi 'khor lo bskyed pa'o/ /gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la huX ljang sngon/ spyi bor zla ba dang 'khor lo la oX dkar po/ mgrin par zla ba dang pad+ma la āXdamar po/ thugs ka'i 'og gi cha la zla ba dang rdo rje la gnas pa'i hūX nag po/ lha thams cad kyi thugs kar nyi ma rang rang gi kha dog dang mtshungs pa'i hūX yig go /gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūX yig gnyis kyi bar du raX lasaX byungaX ba'i nyi ma'i steng du/ oX ha baX hā bāX hi bi hi bīX/ hu buX hūX byuX/ he bo hai bai/ ho bo ho bo/ haX baX haXbaX hūX hūX hū ཾ ༷ skyoX/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swāhā swāhā/ dkar po dang dmar po g.yas skor du sprul 'khyil ba —323—

ltar gnas pa/ rdo rje sems dpa' phag mo'i rang bzhin no/ go tsho sngags drug char la 'gor oX dang / 'jug tu huX bzhi phaṭa bzhi swāhā gnyis rnams gong bzhin sbyar dgos te/ mgo bo'i nang du nyi ma la/ nāX haX nā hāX/ nu huX nā huX/ ne ho nai lha/ no ho no hoX/ na haX nāXhāXser po dang sngon po rnam par snang mdzad dang gdin rje ma'i ngo bo/ spyi gtsug gi nang du nyi ma la/ swa hraX spru hāX/ sī hriX snyaX sgru/ sru hruX bhū hrūX/ swe hraX dh+wa lha/ swo hroX swo ho/swa hraX swaXhraX dmar po dang dkar po pad+ma gar dbang dang rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo/dpung paX gnyiXs kyi nang du nyi ma la/ ba hraX bā hāX/ bi tri bī sbru/ bu huX byu hūX/ be hre be+e dh+ra/ bo hro bo hro/ ba hraX baXhraX nag po dang ser po he ru ka dang skyong byed ma'i ngo bo/migaX gnyiXs kyi dbus su nyi ma la/ ha haX hu huX/ hi hiX hū huX/ hu hūX hū hūX/ he he lha lha/ho ho ho ho/ haX haX haXhaX dmar ser dang ljang khu rdo rje nyi ma dang skrag byed ma'i ngo bo/ mdzod sbu'i thad ka'i nang du/ pha pha pā phu/ phi phi bī bī/ phu phu phu phyu/ phe phe phe phi/ pho pho pho pho/ phaX phaX/ phaXphaX ljang khu dang dud kha rta mchog dang tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/'di la'ang pha phaX pā phuX sogs dgos par mngon yang sngar gyi dpe thams cad la med par mthun pas re zhig bzhag go /'di rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad sngags kyi rdul phra rab kyis gang / sku lus kyi phyi rol du snying gar oX ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad /spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug /phrag pa gnyis su bo khiṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka /mig gnyis su huX huX hoXdamar ser rdo rje nyi ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa haX ljang khu rta mchog gi ngo bo/ yum gyi nye bar oX baX dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar haX oX sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hri moX dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ /dpral par hre hriX ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūX hūX ljang khu —324—

skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi kwa' ngo bo'o/ /de rnams las yi ge'i tshogs 'phros te lus kyi phyi rol thams cad gang bar gyur/'dir yang spro na go cha'i lha rnams zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du bsgom ste/ pū yi pa'i lugs bzhin no/ /snying ga'i sa bon 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ gdod ma nas grub pa'i dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par gyur/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par skor zhing h+pha zhes brjod/ lkoX badz+ra wā ni: sogs rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ dzaXhuX baX hoX zhes pas dam ye bsre/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyis 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ dbang lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yab yum la sogs pa dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ h+pha gong bzhin rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /de bzhin gshegs rnams khrus gsol ltar/ /de bzhin bdag la khrus byed 'gyur/ /lha yi chus ni dag par mdzodi/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ rigs lnga yab yum snyoms bar zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs zhal du zhugs byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba sbyor ba mtshams nas byung nas/ bdud rtsi bde ba chen po'i rgyun gyis lha thams cad kyi spyi bo nas blugs shing dbang bskur bas/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad dag rdo rje bzhi mi phyed pa'i rang bzhin du byin gyis rlabs/spyi bo'i steng du gnas pa'i bdud rtsi'i thigs pa rnams yongs su gyur pa las/rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag por gyur pa ni/ gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ rdo rje phag mo la 'od dpag med/ rdo rje'i snyen ra lo pa dang / nam mkha'i 'khor lo pa dang /thugs 'khor pa rnams la mi bskyod pa snying po'i 'khor lo pa dang / me'i 'khor —325—

lo pa dang / gsung gi 'khor lo pa rnams la 'od dpag med/ yon tan gyi 'khor lo pa dang / chu'i snyen ra lo pa dang / sku'i 'khor lo pa rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / sa'i 'khor lo rnams la rin chen 'byung ldan/ rlung gi 'khor lo pa dang /ye shes kyi 'khor lo pa dang / sgo mtshams ma rnams la don yod grub pas dbu rgyan/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa mā ya shri ye hūX/ zhes gsungs shing dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim/ de nas mchod pa dngos su bshams yod na byin rlabs bya/ yid sprul tsam la byin rlabs mi dgos te/ gang ltar yang gong tshogs bsog gi skabs su bshad pa ltar chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rig ma bcu drug rnams kyis mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin: zhes pa nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /mtshan nyid thams cad rdzogs pa dang / /bde chen sogs dang bzang po dang / /gnyis kun rnam par spangs pa dang / /mchod pa khams gsum bdag nyid ni/ /dngos po kun 'byung rnams kyis mchod/ /de nas bstod pa ni/ cang te'u sogs rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te/ rkang pa zhe brgyad pa'i mthar/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ /rnal 'byor chen po thub chen po/ /zhes pa nas/ stong pa'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pa'i bar gyi mtshan brgyas kyang bstod/ nang mchod 'bru gsum gyis myangs la/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad na gnas pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma ma lus pa 'dus nas/ myos byed dang sha'i bye brag sna tshogs pa dang dam tshig gi rdzas thams cad kyis mchod de thams cad kyang rang gi snying gar thim/ dkyil 'khor bde ba chen po bsgom par gyis/ /rnal 'byor bcu gnyis bsod nams sdig med pa/ /thams cad zag med rang bzhin myong bar —326—

gyis/ /dkyil 'khor ngan pa de ni bde bar shes par byos/ /dbang po 'khrul pa bde ba chen por myong bar gyis/ /skad cig de la rang dang gzhan gyi ngo bo med/ /gang dang gang gi rnam pa sna tshogs gzugs can gyi/ /sa gsum gyis ni dkyil 'khor 'khor lo spro bar gyis/ /zhes dkyil 'bor gyi 'bor lo 'ja' tshon lta bu'i snang stong gnyis su med pa la mnyam par bzhag go /de dag ni dkyil 'khor rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas 'dod chags chen po'i tshul lam du byed pa kun du spyod pa la 'jug pa ni/ gtso bo yab yum mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ yas babs dang mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi rgyud la skyes par mos te/ gong bzhin/ yab kyi gsang gnas: zhes pa nas/ yab yum rjes su chags pa snyoms par zhugs pas haX yig zhu ba'i rgyun mgrin par byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/ /lte bar byon pas dga' bral/ /rdo rje nor bur byon pas lhan cig skyes dga' nyams su myong bar gyur/ slar yang gyen du gshegs te de lte bar byon pas dga' ba/ snying gar byon pas mchog dga'/mgrin par byon pas dga' bral/ spyi bor lhan cig skyes dga' mngon du gyur pa'o/ /de nas spro na kun spyod bskor bar bya'o/ /de'i rjes su lha thams cad kyi thugs kar 'od zer gyis sne la dkyil 'khor lha'i 'khor lo can spros pas don gnyis byas te/ /slar bsdus pa yang yang bsgom pa ni/ /las rgyal po mchog gi ting nge 'dzin no/ /de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa gsal btab la sngags bzla bar bya ste/ oX shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaX huX hūX phaṭa ḍā ki nī dzā la sa sba raX swāhā/ oX badz+ra be+e ro tsa nī ye huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ gtso bo dang rdo rje phag mo'i snying po'o/ /oX hri ha ha hūX huX phaṭa/ oX sarba ba dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra waṇi nī ye huX hūX phaṭa swāhā/ yab yum gyi nye ba'i snying po'o/ /yab kyi 'phreng ba'i —327—

sngags rtsa sngags su grags pa ni/ oṃ na maXshwe badz+ra ḍā ka ma tā bī ra bī re shwa rā ya/ tri bhu baX ka lpu ṇa ya/ rda sgo | ṭa snri ṣa ṇa bhe ra bā ya/ sha ta sa ha sra ne tā ya/ bi sgrosno hā ya/kaX ka la mā lā bha ra kho3 grwa ya/ ko ṭi lak+ṣa bhu dzā ya/ dz+wa lā wa lī ḍā la ghā ya/ pa ra shu pā sho du ta shā lwa ya/ ka lha n+ta dhu mru gra wa pū khyi ya/ pi ka ṭa mu kha hā hā rā bā ya/mu ༷ ga ṇa pa ri pū ri ta mar+sā ya/ sa ha dza sun+da rī ba lpa bha ga rā ya/ hūX huX kā ro tsū ra ṇa mu ji ya/ mahā shā shā na pri yā ya/ sarba bhu ta saX tru sa na ka rā ya/ ma hā ka lha nā sna te dzā ya/ dza ṭā ka lwa pa ku ku ṭā ya/ ka ṭāX ga ka pā la hūṃ la bhasno dha ri ṇi/ma hā sa mu dra me kha lwa ya/ byā gh+ra tsar+sāX ba ra dh+wa ri ṇi/ be tā la saX gha ma rna na ka rā ya/mahā sna ni pā ra ṇi/ sha tru ni suX bhā na ka rā ya/ tri pa ha sra mahā sa ha sre ka ro lwa ba lun+ta warti ne/ sha ta sa ha sra mu ji ya/ dz+nyā na sma ga ra pra dh+wa ya/ mahā pi shi ta ru dhi ra ba smaX hā ri ṇi/ sarba mā ra ba la bi dharmi ne/ sdispyi saX hā re ka ra kā ya/ sarba nā gā nāX sho ṣa ṇa nga na bi dra pa ṇa ya/ an+t+ra mā la ṅgā ri ṇi/ su ma ru ka zhi ta na dā ya/kro dha bi gra ha dh+wa ra ṇa ya/ mahā ka sha ti la ka t+pa ne/ bud+dhā ko ṭi sa ha sra klu ṇa ni spyi da nā ya/ dz+nyā nā mṛ te brna pa ṇa ya/ sarba karma pra brnya nā ya/ ban+ta ka rā ya/ sarba bi kalpa bhañdza na ka rā ya/ muṇ+ḍa ba snyi la sna sha rī rā ya/ pa ra kri ta yan+t+ra man+t+ra nā sha nā ya/ mahā rak+ṣa ka rā ya/ dus naX bi dā la ne/ dharmo da ya ka rā ya/ kro dha spa ra sla ra ṇa ya/ in+t+ra dza la sarba sa twatwa ne/ gra sta pā da swa bā da mahā ma te/ oX a ka ā kha i ga zhwa gha u nga mū tsā ṛ tsha grwa dz+wa le dzha lī nya e ṭa e ṭha e ṭa au lha aX ṇa aXta/ aXtha aX da auX dha oX na/ blo pa e pha waṃ ba waṃ bha rlo ma ṛ ya mūX ra uX la yīX wa i sha āX ṣa āX sa aXhaX.āXk+ṣa haX ka kā kha 'a ga gā gha ghā nga ngu / tsa tsā tsha tshwa dza dzā dzha dz+nyā nya nywa/ ṭa ṭā ṭha khyu ḍa ḍā bha bhā ṇa ṇa/ ta tā tha thā da dā dha dh+wa na nā/ pa pā pha —328—

phraX baX bāX bhaX ༷bhā ༷ma ༷mā/༷yaX yāX raX rāX laX lāX waX wāX/ sha shāX ṣaX khriX saX smaX haX hāX k+ṣaX nywaX/ k+ṣaX ltuX ha hā sa sma ṣa khri sha shā wa wā la lwa ra rā ya yā/ ma mā bha bhā ba bā pha pā pa pā/ na nā dhaX dh+waX daX dāX thaX thāX taX tāX/ ṇaX ṇaX lhaX bhāX ḍaX ḍāX ṭhaX khyuX ṭaX ṭāX/ nyaX nywaX dzhai dz+nyā dzaX dzāX tsho tshwaX tsaX tsāX/ daX dāX ghaX ghāX gaX gāX khaX skuX kaX kāX/ ka tsa kha tsha ga dza gha dzha nga nya/ ka ṭa kha ṭha ga ḍa gha snye nga ṇa/ ka ta kha thaX ga da gha dha nga na/ ka pa kha pha ga ba gha bha nga ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa aX.a/ ka ha ka ha/ ka sa ka sa/ ka ṣa ka lga ka sha ka sha ka wa ka wa/ka la ka la/ ka ra ka ra/ ka ya ka ya/ ka ma ka ma/ ka bha ka bha/ ka ba ka ba/ ka pha ka pha/ ka ba ka ba/ ka na ka na/ ka dha ka dha/ ka da ka da/ ka tha ka tha/ ka ta ka ta/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ka lha ka bha/ ka ḍa ka ḍa/ ka ṭha ka ṭha/ ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ka nya ka nya/ka dzha ka dzha/ ka dza ka dza/ ka tsha ka tsha/ ka tsa ka tsa/ ka nga ka nga / ka gha ka gha/ ka ga ka ga ka kha ka kha/ ku hu ku hu/ ku su ku su/ ku khu ku khu ku shu ku shu/ ku wu ku wu/ ku lu ku lu/ ku ru ku sa ku yu ku yu/ ku mu ku mu/ ku bhu ku bhu/ ku bu ku bu/ ku phu ku phu/ ku pu ku pu/ ku nu ku nu/ ku dhu ku dhu/ ku du ku du/ ku thu ku thu/ku tu ku tu/ ku ṇa ku ṇa/ ku lhu ku hu/ ku khyu ku ḍū/ ku thu ku thu/ ku ṭu ku ṭu/ ku nyu ku nyu/ ku dz+nyā ku dz+nya/ ku dzu ku rgya ku tshu ku tshu/ ku tsu ku tsu/ ku du ku du/ ku khyu ku ghu/ku gu ku gu/ ku khu ku khu/ ban+ta ya ban+ta ya/ ban+ta pa ya ban+ta pa ya/ ga rdza ga rdza/ga sna ya ga rdzo ya/ sho ṣa ya sho ṣa ya/ tardza ya tardza ya/ sgro ṭa ya h+pho ṭa ya/ bi dh+waX sa ya bi dh+waX sa ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ tā sa ya tā sa ya mā ra ya/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ kaX bā wa ya kaX bā wa ya/ du ra du ra/ khu ra khu ra/ bha ra bha ra/ dza ra dza ra/ bi sha bi sha hūX hūX hūX hūX/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ bhañdza bhalga marda ya mde ya/ hre hre/ tsa la tsa la/ mā tsa la mā tsa la/ kru ra tse tā ya phaṭa/ sha tru ni bā ra ya huX/ me gha ni wā ra —329—

ya hri/ mo tsa ya mo tsa ya/ ra ya za ya/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa/ du rbas pa ya du rbas pa ya/ghu bhā na tra mā lā ba li bi ne/ khe tsa rā ya hūX/ bhu tsa rā ya āX putā la tsa rā ya oṃ/ dza la tsa rā ya daX/ s+tha la tsa rā ya laX/ sarba ta ni bā sa ni huX/ nā gā nāX sa sta pā tā la ga ta grihā ra rnyi/ gro hā ra rnyoX/ dz+nyāX dz+nyāX dzhai dzhai/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku sa kha ra kha ra/ khu ru khu sa ga ra ga ra/ gu ru gu sa gha ra gha ra/ ghu ru ghu sa nga ra nga ra /ngu ru ngu sa tsa ra tsa ra/ tsu ru tsu sa tsha ra tsha ra/ tshu ru tshu mā dza ra dza ra/ dzu ru dzu sa dzha ra dzha ra/ dz+nyā ru dz+nyā sa nya ra nya ra/ nyu ru nyu sa ṭa ra ṭa ra/ṭu ru ṭu sa ṭha ra ṭha ra/ thu ru thu sa ḍa ra ḍa ra/ khyu ra ḍū sa bha ra khyu ra/ khyu ru lhu sa ṇa ra ṇa ra/ṇa ru ṇa sa ta ra ta ra/ tu ru tu sa tha ra tha ra/ thu ru thu sa da ra da ra/ du ru du sa dha ra dha ra/ dhu ru dhu mā na ra na ra/ nu ru nu sa pa ra pa ra/ pu ru pu mā pha ra pha ra/ phu ru phu sa ba ra ba ra/ bu ru bu sa bha ra bha ra/ bhu ru bhu sa ma ra ma ra/ mu ru mu sa ya ra ya ra/ yu ru yu sa ra ra ra ra/ ru ru ru mā la ra la ra/lu ru lu sa wa ra wa ra/ wu ru wu mā sha ra sha ra/ shu ru shu sa ṣa ra ṣa ra/ khu ru khu mā sa ra sa ra/ su ru su saX ha ra ha ra/ hu ru hu mā k+ṣa ra k+ṣa ra/ k+ṣa ru k+ṣa sahaX hāX/ hihi/ huX skyoX/ ho lha/ hoX ho/ haX haX gar+bha garnya/ dzā ti dzā ti/ de wā nāX/ dā ma ya dā ma ya/ sarba sha rī rā ya hūX/ dza ya dza ya hūX/ bi dza ya bi dza ya hūX/ sa ra sa ra skyoX/ bi sa ra bi ra sa huX/ asne skyoX/ ba ru ṇi hūX/ a ṇa la ya huX/ ba ma we huX/ ā kā shā ya hūX/ sarba ro go pa ha rā ya huX/ bi ṣa bhak+ṣa ṇa ya hūX/ yan+t+ra bā ha nā ya huX/ kā lwa gha ye hūX/ de bā ya hūX/ ya mā ya huX/ ku be rā ya hūX/ da t+yā ya hūX/ in+t+ra ya huX/ bhā tā ya hūX/ sarba sa tā ya hūX/ brta tsa grwa ya hūX/ dharma dh+wa ta we hūX/ mu ji ya huX/ nai tru ye hūX/ ka pā la mā li ne hūX/ bhu dzā ye hūX/ a sta ya huX/ tsa ra ṇa ya huX/ dza ṭā mu ku khyu —330—

ya/ ma sa ma sa/ ga sa ga sa/ ra sa ra sa/ bha ra bha ra/ ma ḍa ma ḍa/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/gha ṭa gha ṭa/ muñtsa muñtsa sto rā na dha kā ra pri mā ya/ phi phiX/ phu da phu da/ ma ra ma ra/pa ra mur+sha rū pi ṇi'i/ shwarnyi ka rā ya/ spro 〉 ba ri ḍa nā ya/ lo ka pā la rū bi ṇi/sarba sha rī ra rū pā ya/ prik+ṣa gu smo la tā ya/ sam+bha rū bī ṇi/ sarba bstu ne mā ra ṇa ya/rū pā ya/ bhak+ṣa ya/ bhak+ṣa ṇa ru pā ya/ ni ro pā mā ya/ ni ro pā ma mu kha be/ ha sa ha sa/ bi lā sa bi lā sa/ dra t+yā pa ya/ dra t+yā pa ya/ di snru ya yo gā ya/ niXswa bhā wa mahā khru ne/ shwa sta bhā ra ṇi wa ra ṇa ya/ nā nā bhi/ tsa ra ts+tsha da ni/ tsuspa tsuspa/ hu lu hu lu/ tsu lu tsu lu/ hūX ha huX hā/ hūX hiX snyiX hi/ hūX hu huX hu/ huX he huX haiX/༷huX ho huXho/ huX haX huX haX huX hūX/ hriX hiX/ dzuX hūm̐/ kro kro/ phiX bīX/ phuX phuX/ pho phre/ pho phro/ phaX phuX/ phaXphuXku tsa ku tsa/ tra ṭa tra ṭa/ ma ṭa ma ṭa/ ra ṭha ra ṭha/ da ṭha da ṭha/ dza ṭha dza ṭha/ ma da na ma da na/ huX huX huX huX/ huX huX huX huX/ huX huX huX huX/ huX huX huX huX phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa yab kyi rtsa ba'i sngags 'di nyid dang / yum gyi rtsa ba'i sngags te/ bzlas bya'i gtso bo ni 'di gnyis yin la/ de tsam bzla ba mi lcogs na rtsa sngags gnyis po tshar gcig bton nas/ yab yum gyi snying po dang nye snying gang mos pa zhig bzla bar bya'o/ /'khor gyi sngags rnams ni/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i skabs bzla mi dgos la/ dkyil 'khor mchod pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs 'ga' zhig tu dgos mod kyi gzhan du bri bar bya'o/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nye bar bsdu ba ni/ rig ma bcu drug gis mchod/ rkang brgyad dam mtshan brgya gang rung gis bstod dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyi rol gyi me'i rwa ba nas brtsams bdag nyid kyi bar du phyi ma phyi ma nang ma nang ma la thim/ rang nyid kyang snying ga'i huX ljang sngon la thim/ de yang nā da'i bar du bsdus te nā da yang dbyings su thim par gyur/ cung zad mnyam par bzhag stong pa'i ngang las bdag dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i gzugs kyis gnas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas dag pa dran pa mdor bsdus —331—

pa ni/ kun rdzob dang ni don dam pa/ /nga/kyil 'khor pa dang gtso bo'o/ khrag 'thung gnyis med dngos po sa /'di gsum gyis ni khams gsum mo/ /thams cad thig le'i gzugs bdag nyid/ /bden pa gnyis su bzung ba med/ /yod pa gzugs med bdag nyid de/ /rtog pa tsam du khyab bdag che/ /spyin pa kun rdzob gzugs bdag nyid/ /pha rol yang ni don dam pa'o/ /dang po'i sbyor ba des 'grub bo/ /tshul khrims bsnyen pa sogs su 'dod/ /phar phyin rgyu yi rdo rje 'chang / /stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid do/ /bzod pa tshangs par spyod pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor 'byin pa yang ni de/ /rgyal po bde ba kun la gnas/ /mchog ni rang gi pha rol phyin/ /brtson 'grus dga' chen thams cad las/ /mdog dang bzhugs tshul bdag nyid kyis/ /pha rol phyin rnams rang bzhin du/ /ye shes rnam par kun tu 'byung / /ye shes sems sogs bsam gtan te/ /phar phyin 'od zer spro ba'o/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor dang dbang bskur/ khres rab las kyi rgyal po mchog /rang rang mgo bor rigs kyis ni/ /rgyas btab pha rol phyin pa'o/ /stobs ni snying rje'i dpa' bo ste/ /stong pa nyid ni rnal 'byor ma/ /pha rol phyin ma gnyis med kun/ /g.yon par zhugs skyes gang bde ba/ /thabs ni thig le'i rnal 'byor te/ /pha rol phyin pa theg pa che/ /smon lam sngags kyi bzlas pa sogs/ /phar phyin phra mo'i rnal 'byor ro/ /ye shes dkyil 'khor ma lus pa/ /phag mo dang ni bsres pa las/ /bsdu ba pha rol phyin pa ste/ /'jig rten khams kyi rnam dag pa'o/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das gzugs bdag /sgyu ma snying rje las byung ba'o/ /thams cad bden min rdzun min pa'o/ /skye min mi skye min spangs pa'o/ /zhes so/ /gong du mug da pa bzhin lus kyi phyi'i go cha rnams bkod nas/ snying —332—

gar oX dkar po rdo rje sems dpa': zhes pa nas/ thams cad gang bar gyur/ oX sum+bha sogs ma a sa rngam bya/ bdag dang snang ba'i dngos po thams cad 'khor lo sdom pa'i sku'i rang bzhin/ zhes sogs pū nag dang mthun par brjod/ snang ba thams cad lhar mos bzhin du dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo'o/ /gtor ma'i cho ga la gtor ma byin rlabs ni/ oX sum+bha ni nga huX huX phaṭa/ oX spo hā gro hā hūX hūX phaṭa/ tseX( gro hā pā ya gro hā pā ya huX hūX phaṭa/ oX ā na la ho bha ga wā na badz+ra rā dza huX hūX phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oX su bhā wa shu khri sdoXsarba dharma su bhā wa shu rdzo3 haX/ zhes pas sbyangs/ stong pa'i las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raX las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du oX āXhūX las byung ba'i mi mgo'i skyed bu gsum gyi steng du a las byung ba'i thod pa dum bu gsum pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba/ de'i nang gi shar du oX dkar po las dri chen oX gyis mtshan pa/ byang du khaX ljang khu las sha chen gyi dngas ma khaX gis mtshan pa/ nub tu aX dmar po las byang chub kyi sems aX gis mtshan pa/lhor traX ser po las rak+ta traX gis mtshan pa/ dbus su huX sngon po las dri chu huX gis mtshan pa/ /mer laX dkar po las ba lang gi sha laX gis mtshan pa/ bden bral du māX sngon po las khyi'i sha māX gyis mtshan pa/ rlung du baX dmar po las glang po'i sha pāX gyis mtshan pa/ dbang ldan du tāX ljang khu las rta'i sha tāX gyis mtshan pa/dbus su bāX dmar po las sha chen bāX gyis mtshan pa/ 'og gi rlung g.yos me 'bar bas/ rdzas bcu yi ge dang bcas pa zhu ba nyi ma 'char ka'i mdog ltar dmar ser gsal la dwangs par gyur pa'i steng thad du/ huX yig las byung ba'i kha ṭaX ga dkar po byang chub kyi sems bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can mgo bo thur du lta —333—

ba/ de las bdud rtsi dkar po babs te/ der lhungs pa g.yon skor du lan gsum dkrugs shing zhu bas dngul chu'i mdog can shin tu bsil ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ de'i steng gi nam mkha' la/ oṃ a ā i yī u mū ṛ grwa '-i lī e i o au aX aX ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa tha ḍa khyu ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha pa bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa hūX hūX phaṭa rnams kha dog sna tshogs pa yongs su gyur pa las/ oṃ dkar po/ āXdamar po/ hūX sngon po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs pa/ de las 'khor lo gsum gyi lha dang bcas pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phros/rgya mtsho la sogs pa na gnas pa'i bdud rtsi dang / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo dpa' mo thams cad kyi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi bkug cing / 'gro ba rnams 'khor gsum gyi lhar byas pa rnams spyan drangs/ snyoms 'jug gi bde bas zhu/ de thams cad yig 'khru gsum la thim/ oṃ āXhuX yang rim pas bdud rtsi zhu ba gtor ma la thim pas/ kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i chen por gyur/ oX āXhuX/ lan gsum ste byin gyis sas pa'o/ /de nas mgron sbyan drangs shing gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros/ rnam pa thams cad kyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs phyi rol phyogs skyong ba dang / zhing skyong ba dang / srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral par bskor zhing / pheṭa ces brjod/ rang gi mdun gyi chos 'byung gi nang du pad+ma'i gdan la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yang dag par bzhugs shing / phyogs skyong ba la sogs pa phyi rol du 'khod par gyur/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po'i tshogs rnams skad cig gis 'od gsal du bcug nas/—334—

dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho shes rab ma dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ de nas chu gnyis nyer spyod rigs bcu drug lha mo brgyad rnams kyis mchod/ lag pa g.yon du ā li las zla ba/ g.yas su kā li las nyi ma/ dbus su huX/ nyi zla huX dang bcas pa yongs su gyur ba rdo rje thal mor gyur/ oṃ a no n+ya a nu ga tāXsarba dharmāXpa ra spa re/ a nu pra pre gi sarba dharmāX.a rlu n+ta/ a nu pra pri ni sarba dharmāXhūX/lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang nas rgyur gyur cig mgron rnams kyis ljags rdo rje'i sbu gus gtor ma drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oX badz+ra a ra snyi hoXbadz+ra ḍā ki ni sa mā ya stuX/ khro bya hoXzhes pa lan gsum dang oX bha k+ṣa bha k+ṣa sarba yo ga yo gī shwa re hūX huX hūX dzaXswāhā/ zhes pa lan lngas dkyil 'khor pa rnams la phul/ oX badz+ra tam+bha bā ya swāhā/ oX badz+ra hā sa u swāhā/ zhes pas so rtsi dang na bza' phul/ gong bzhin zhabs bsil kyang phul/ rkang pa bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa dang / rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam pa: zhes pa nas/ bdag la rjes brtser mdzad du gsol gyi bar gyis 'dod don gsol ba btab/ de nas 'jig rten pa rnams la 'bul ba ni/ rdo rje thal mo gyen du kha phye la/ oX kha kha 'a hi khyu hi/ sarba yak+ṣa/ rak+ṣa sa/ bhu ta shrī ta bi sha tsa/ u na ma du/ a pa smra ra/ ḍā ka ḍā ki rgyu da ya/ i maX bā liX snan+ta sa ma ya rak+ta skye/ ma ma sarba sirnyi sme pra ya rta snyo/ ya thi baX/ ya thigaX bhañdza tha/ pi pa tha/ dzi gh+ra tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma ma sarba ka rta ya/ sa phyi khaX/ bi bidha/ sa ha yi ka bha wastu hūX hūX phaṭa swāhā/laXn gsum gyisaX phul/ zhing skyoXng rnams la khyad par gyis 'bul ba ni/ oX ka ska dhaX naX/ baXbhan+dhaX na/ kha khru da na/ sarba dus ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ ma ma ka rla ku ru hū hū phaṭa phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum/ oX ha ho hri swāhā zhes pas nang mchod phul/ lha yi tshogs rnams ma lus dang : zhes pa nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces pas —335—

bstod cing 'dod don gsol ba btab/ dril bu rgyun dkrol du byed cing / 'gro ba kun ni mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin te/ /rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo'i rang bzhin du gnas kyi/ /a re re re gti mug phyugs kyis mi shes so/ /lhan skyes mdzes ma blangs nas bde ba che la mnos/ /sham+bha sa gsum ma lus 'gro ba sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin/ /snying rje'i gzhon nu ma dang lhan cig rol par byos/ /a re/ gang gi don dam la ni ma bsgoms pas/ /de yis sangs rgyas nyid ni thob pa ma yin no/ /a re/ nang dang phyi ni dbye ba med par shes par gyis/ /'jig rten thams cad bsgral bar nus pa'o/ /a re/ de nas yig brgya lan mang du brjod/ mig gi phyag rgya bstan la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro ba lte bar 'phyud rgya byas pa'i mthar se gol gtogs te/ o badz+ra mu dkyil 'khor pa bdag gi smin mtshams su thim/ 'jig rten pa rnams rang gnas su spru/zhegs/ skabs 'dir/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams 'dus la gus pas mchod pa dang sogs slo ka gnyis kyis smon lam gdab par bshad pa ni/ tshogs dang gtor ma lhan cig tu byed pa'i dbang du byas pa yin la/ tshogs 'khor gyi bya ba dang ma 'brel bar gtor ma rkyang pa la ni/sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad nad med par/ /sangs rgyas nyid du 'gro ba yi/ /lam de nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma sgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor gtsug lag bstan bcos la/ /da lta nyid du gnas par bgyi/ /zhes sogs smon lam ci rigs par gdab cing / bkra shis kyi glu dbyangs kyang blang bar bya'o/ /'di ni rgyun gyi nyams len gyi gtor chog ste bsdus pa yin zhing / 'byung po thams cad pa'i gtor ma'am/ phyogs skyong gi gtor ma chen po dang / zhing skyong gi gtor ma rnams ni/ lha'i bskyed chog shin tu rgyas pas/'dir ma bris te shes par 'dod na gzhan du blta bar bya'o/ /—336—

'di las dge ba gang thob pa/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /bdag kyang de ring phan chad du/ /'gro ba'i 'dren pa nyid du shog /de la dkyil 'khor de nyid kyi sgrub thabs shin tu mang po rnams phal cher tshig tshogs che ba lhur blangs pas/ deng sang phan thogs chung bar mthong zhing / tshigs bcad du sdebs pa'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa 'ga' zung yang snang mod kyi/ go dka' zhing ngag 'don dang sgom don gyi dbye ba phyed dka' ba dang /yang sgrub thabs 'ga' zhig la dgos pa'i don chad pa yang snang bas/ nyung ngu rnam gsal yang dag rdzogs/ /zhes pa'i tshul du byas pa yin no/ /dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i sgrub thabs mtha' rgyas don mtha' dag ma tshang ba med pa la tshig zor shin tu yang bar byas pa 'di yang / tā ra nā thu'i rol rtsed do/ zhu dag ma ṅga laX// //

gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba bzhugs/na mo gu ru shri he ru ka maṇ+ḍal le khyu dpal mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'ju ga gsang ba'i snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan rgyal chen he ru ka'i/ /zhabs kyi pa khror phyag 'tshal lo/ /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga mdo tsam bri/ /'dir 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi bdag nyid can/ dpal sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga'i ngag 'don 'khyer bde bar brjod na/ dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhi'i gnas su dri'i maṇ+ḍal gnas 'dzin gyi tshom bu dang dang bcas pa/ mchod yon chen po sogs mchod pa rnams kyang bshams/ rdor dril nang mchod sogs 'dus byas shrī he ru ko3 ha zhes/ bdag nyid dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'khor lo'i dbang phyug tu gyur/ sku'i rnam pa dang nga rgyal brtan po bzung / sngon 'gro gtor ma btang / gnas yo byin rlabs byas/ nang mchod yang gtor ma ltar byin gyis rlabs/ 'di thog mar byed pa'ang mi 'gal mod/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / thog ma'i gnas yo byin rlabs la/ nang mchod kyis gsang ba'ang nges par dgos pa ma yin pas skabs 'dir byed pa nyid shas che'o/ mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi zhig bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hu yig las byung ba'i srung 'khore gyi dbus su/ gzhal med khang rim pa bzhi 'khor lo rim pa bcu gnyis/ dbus su sna tshogs thig le'i 'khor lo 'dab ma bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa/ phyi nang gi lha'i gdan dang bcas pa skad cig gis grub par gyur/ rang gi snying ga'i hū las 'od —338—

zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad/ dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par h+pha/ o nga5 sogs/ ar+gha nas shasta'i bar gyis ma rdzo/ o tiṣ+ṭha ā sa na hu swāhā/ lan gsum sogs brjod/ dza / ba ho lan mang du brjod/ de yang dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la nyi ma dang / dus me/ zhes pa nas/ bzhugs tshul dang /phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar/ lha thams cad kyi zhal phyag rnams gsal gdab/ de nas spro na mchod pa rnams slar yang byin rlabs kha gsos/ mchod 'phreng dang mthun par chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo na bza'/ rig ma bcu drug rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa'i bstod pa tsam byas la/ gtor ma bshams shing byin gyis rlabs/ sgrub thabs ltar 'bul/ yig brgya dang bzod gsol byas nas/o badz+ra tha zhi spya nam mkhar bteg slar yang 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma bshams shin tu bsdu na/ gnas kyi bdag po la dmigs nas/ /mkha' 'gro spyi gtor bsdus pas kyang rung tsam yin mod kyang / nges par na/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor chen mo dang / 'byung po spyi gtor chen mo gnyis yod pa gnyis ka'am gang rung cig gal che'o/ /gtor chog rgyas bsdus ci ltar yang / 'dod gsol gyi mthar/ gnas kyi bdag po rnams la dmigs te/ gang dag 'dir gnas lha dang klu/ /nod spyin srin mo'am gzhan dag la/ /sa 'di bdag gis bslang bar bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor don du khyod kyis stsol/ /zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab/ gtor ma phyi rol du btang ngo / /bar 'dir phur btab sbyin sreg sogs bshad kyang / mdor bsdus pa'i skabs mi dgos so/ /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i lha la yid kyis gsol ba 'debs/ oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro he hu hū phaṭa/ drag tu bzlas shing yungs kar gyis gtor/ sngar gyi maṇ+ḍal gyi shul du sa'i lha mo'i tshom bu —339—

dang / mchod gtor bshams/ ṭak+ki ni hu dza oṃ ha/ zhes pa nas/ ci bde bar mdzod cig /ces pa'i bar dkyil mchog bde ba chen mo'i char yang bzhin no/ /oṃ pri thi bī de bī bh+ya.ar+gha pra rte swāhā/ sa'i lha mo steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par gyur/ tshom bu dang mchod pa bsdus/ gtor ma phyi rol du dor/ brko sbyangs kyi dus ni 'di yin kyang da lta mi dgos pas/ yung chu shing thal rnams kyis gtor/ ba byung dang / dri bzang bsres pas byugs/ oṃ bhu la/ hu la hu/oṃ me dhi ni badzi bha ba ban+ta hu/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra kro dha hū phaṭa/ o ā hū/ sho dha ya rbe( dha ya rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hu hu phaṭa/ ces pa'i sngags tshan rnams ji ltar 'os pa bzlas zhing /lag pa sa la reg stegs bu dang / gter 'jug pa'i dus de 'di yin kyang deng sang mi dgos so/ /de nas lag len 'ga' zhig la/ skabs 'dir sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas yo byin rlabs byed cing / gong du mi byed par de dus gsang chus gtor ba tsam gyis srol yod kyang / lag len dkyus ltar la the tshom mi bya'o/ /de ltar na slob dpon bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi sa gzhir 'dug la/ tse( hu/ tse( hi swāhā/ zhes pa nas brtsams te/ hū hu hu hu phaṭa swāhā/ zhes bzlas pa rdzogs pa yan chad sgrub thabs bzhin du gzhung bsrang bar bya/ de nas mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo dang rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod pa bya/ lce hu las skyes pa'i rdo rjer gyur/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge yis/ /'di ni dkyil 'khor bri bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/ /dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab/ bdag ni rang nyid rdo rje can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bdag rang nyid/ /bdag ni sangs rgyas rgyal po che/ /bdag ni stobs chen rdo rje yi/ /bdag ni rnal 'byor dbang phyug rgyal/ /phyag na rdo rje brtan pa nga / /bdag ni bdag po rdo rje —340—

che/ /byin gyis rlabs pa mi 'dor ro/ /zhes nga rgyal bzung / 'grub na phyogs bzhi'i gsol 'debs kyang bya/ o badz+ra u la dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg bdag nyid rdo rje hū mdzad kyi skur gyur/ mig g.yas g.yon ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla bar gyur/ mig 'bras hu las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ o kro dha pre sna hri o kro dha pre sna a/ rkang mthil gnyis su sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'bar ba re res mtshan par gyur/ hu hū zhes bskor ba gcig sngon du 'gro bas dbang ldan nas/ hu lus ngag sems la gnas pa yi/ /gegs kyi tshogs rnams nga la nyon/ zhes pa nas/ 'dir ni 'jigs 'gyur gzhan du min/ zhes pa'i bar lan gsum brjod cing rol mo'i sgra bya/ sa gzhi la yungs kar gtor ro/ /'gros dang btang snyoms dgos pa thams cad/ bka' bsgo 'di'i mgo gzhug tu yin mod kyang / spros pa la mi mos na/ de dag med kyang cho ga chad pa min no/ pho n+ya tus stong par sbyangs/stong pa'i ngang las hu yig las byung ba'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dra ba/ gur bla re/mda'i dra ba/ ye shes kyi me dpung dang bcas pa'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/o me dhi ni badz+ra ban+ta hū sogs/ sngags oṃ drug sdom pa'i sgrub thabs spyi dang mthun par brjod/ o shā n+ya tā: stong pa'i ngang las/ pa las pad+ma ra las nyi ma/ de'i steng du bdag nyid khro bo chen po/ 'jig rten gsum las rnam par rgyal ba/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs pa/ nag sel ljang ba'i zhal gsum phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi phyag rgyas 'dzin pa/lhag ma g.yas gnyis kyis lcags kyu dang / zhags pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod khrag dang / kha ṭa ga bsnams pa/ 6khas gnyis g.yas brkyang bas 'jigs byed dang / dus mtshan mnan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ thod skams kyi dbu —341—

rgyan/ mi mgo'i do shal/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang / klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ hū gi sgra drag po sgrog cing / zhal gdangs pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ ljags 'gril ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ sma ra smin ma/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bgegs thams cad 'joms shing za bar byed pa'o/ /phur bu wu bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/steng dang shar gyi phur bu kha gdong ma sngon mo/ byang gi phur bu lug gdong ma ljang khu/ 'og dang nub kyi phur bu khyi gdong ma dmar mo/ lho'i phur bu phag gdong ma ser mo/ shar lho'i phur bu gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba/ lho nub kyi phur bu gshin rje brtan ma g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba/ nub byang gi phur bu gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba/ byang shar gyi phur bu gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang drag mo chen mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad phur bu'i dbyibs can no/ /rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa' h+pha/ dza / ba ho/ ar+gha: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ ra: mang du bzla/ yi ge brgya pa dang / su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod/ oṃ nga sogs tshar gcig sngags kyi 'od zer las byung ba'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad spros/ yang nga: tshar gcig phyogs bcu'i bgegs thams cad tshar gcod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod cig pho nya rnams kyi bgegs kha cig ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang / byang chub kyi sems la bkod/nag po'i rigs can kha cig ni bsgral te/ bde ba can la sogs pa'i zhing du gnas spar/ bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu ni bkug ste 'ongs pa phyogs bcur 'khod/ steng gi bgegs rnams khwa gdong ma dang / 'og gi bgegs —342—

rnams khyi gdong mas tshar bcad / ༷ bcu las byung ba 'khron pa grugasum zab cing rgya che ba bcu'i nang du bcug yang huX las phur bu bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag par gtad/ bgegs kyi spyi bor btsugs/ oX gha gha ghā ta ya gha ta ya/ sarba sdospyin phaṭa/ gī la ya gī la ya sarba pā paX phaṭa/ hūX huX huX badz+ra gī ya ya/ badz+ra dha ro a dz+nyā ya ti/ sarba birnyan/ kā ya wā kā tsit+ta badz+ra gī la ya hūX huX phaṭa/ yang hūX las tho ba bcu spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yas par gtad/ phur bus spyi bor brdungs/ oX badz+ra mud ga ra badz+ra gī la'i a ko ṭa ya huX phaṭa/ bgegs rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas rkang mthil gyi bar thal phyung nas/ de dag gi lus g.yo ba med/ngag rlung rgyu ba med/ sems rnam par rtog pa thams cad bcom nas/ 'od gsal gyi ngo bor gyur zhing / smon lam gyi stobs las rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par gyur/ zhes brjod/ de nas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ smon lam dang / bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod de/ sa'i cho ga mdo tsam mo/ /gnyis pa sta gon la/ sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / gnas dang yo byad byin gyis rlabs/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas rnams kyang / sgrub thabs bde ba chen po'i char yang nas bshad pa ltar bya/ de nas tseX( hūX zhes stan byin gyis rlabs pa nas bzung / skye dang skye min spangs pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar du bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ de nas sa'i lha mo sta gon bya ste/ de yang dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga bde ba chen po'i char yang ji lta ba bzhin no/ /de nas lha sta gon ni/ /las thig tu grags pa dkar thig btab/ lha gnas thams cad du tshom bu bkod/ mchod pa la lha grangs dang mnyam pa'i mchod pa ni nges par dgos pa yin kyang / de sang gi bod pas mi 'byor bas/ ji ltar 'os pa phyogs mtshams rnams su bshams/ 'grub na gtso bo yab yum la tshar —343—

mang tsam dang / 'khor lo rim pa bcu bdun/ dur khrod rim pa bzhi ste/ nyi shu rtsa gcig la mchod pa tshar re bya/ de nas gtor ma gnyis bshams/ gzhan yang rol mo sogs yo byad rnams tshogs par byas la/ sum+bha: lan mang du brjod pas spyi khyab tu bsangs/ lha gnas kyi grangs dang mnyam par yi ge 'bru gsum brjod/ oX na mo shrī badz+ra ḍā ka: zhes pa nas/ huX bcu drug phaṭa swāhā bar du/ yab kyi rtsa sngags lan gsum/ oṃ na mo bha ga ba te nas yo gī shwa ri phaṭa/ huX hūX phaṭa/ces pa'i bar yum gyi rtsa sngags lan gsum/ de nas snying po'i rnal 'byor ma nyer bzhi dang / sgo mtshams ma brgyad tshan bzhi rnams la/ sarba bud dha'i sngags re dang / gzhan dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams la/ yab kyi nye snying yi ge bdun pa dang / yum gyi snying po be+e ro tsa na'i sngags dang / skal bzang rnams la'ang yi ge bdun pa tshar re bzla/ de rjes sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor su snas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ dbus kyi pad+ma'i lte ba la zla ba dang / nyi ma dang dus me'i steng du/ 'jigs byed chen po dang dus kyi mtshan mo'i gdan la huX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka rdo rje phag mos yang dag par khyud pa'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa grub par gyur/ yang su lhas bsangs/su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun gyi dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs kyi char/laX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon rnge6 zhes pa nas/ skal bzang gi snam bu la zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka sku mdog g.yas nag g.yon ljang ngu zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim zhes pa'i bar du bdag skyed dang 'dra/ de nas mchod pa byin rlabs bya ste/nag po pa'i dkyil chog gi mdun bskyed mchod pa byin rlabs dang 'dra/ de rjes chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga rol mo/ nam bza'/ rig ma bcu drug rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon lnga/ 'eng mchod/—344—

gsang mchod/ bstod pa/ yab yum gyi rkang brgyad/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che/ /zhes sogs mtshan brgya rnams bya/ skabs 'dir gtor ma'i cho gas gtor ma 'bul bar bya ste/ sgrub thabs su bshad pa kho na'o/ /de nas bar 'dir bum pa sta gon du gnas pa byed de/ su snas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paX paX las sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du a a las zla ba'i gdan re re/ de rnams kyi steng du bhuX bhuX las/ rin po che'i bum pa lto ba ldir zhing / mgrin pa phra ba mchu 'phyang ba/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul bcings dang / dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/nang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gang ba/ oX ta bhe ta ste/ ma hā ta ste swāhā/ lan bdun/ lha'i chu bo gang gā bkug par gyur/ oX badz+ra shi ṣa re ru ṭa/ ma ṭa sarba di shi huX/ lan gsum gyi kha rgyan du gyur/ oX āXhuX/ lan bdun/ mchod yon bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur/ dbus kyi bum pa'i nang du/ pad+ma'i lte ba la/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / dus me: zhes pa nas 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /de'i phyi rol du rnal 'byor ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi ste/ zhes pa nas/ gtso mo dang mtshungs pa'o/ /de dag gi bar bar du/ bdud rtsi lngas gang jo ces pa nas/ nyer bzhi'o/ /de'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon bskor gyis nas sngo nag phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /de bzhin du/ de'i phyi rol du/ shar nas g.yon skor gyis/ rdo rje 'chang ma mi bskyod mngu nas dmar ser phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /des rigs 'gre ste/ de'i phyi rol gyi shar nas g.yon skor du/ bram ze: nas dkar dmar phyed pa'i gzugs can no/ /de'i phyi rol du/ byams pa: nas brtsams te/ glog gi tog gi bar du/ sangs rgyas nyis brgya dang bzhi bcu rtsa dgu'o/ /de'i phyi rol du/ khra —345—

gdong ma: zhes sogs 'don pa spo/ bskyed tshul de kho nas 'og ma rnams la'ang 'don pa spo ste/de'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon skor gyi/ mi 'am ci mo: sogs nas/ sku mdog ser po'o/ /de'i phyi rol du mchod pa dang / sogs shar du tshangs mngu sogs rigs 'gre/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor gsum pa la: nas sna tshogs bkra ba'o/ /de'i phyi rol du zla ba'i gdugs: sogs dang / shar du go ri sogs so/ de bzhin du dkyil 'khor bzhi pa la yang ste/ 'khor lo tha ma'i skabs su/ de'i phyi rol du shar nas g.yon skor gyis nas/ 'khor los bsgyur ma rnams te/ zhes pa nas/ sku mdog dkar po'o/ /de'i phyi rol du 'phags skyes nas sogs dang / shar du chu skyes dkar mo1 sogs 'don pa spos nas/ bzhugs tshul dang / phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ /las bum du/ hu las byung ba'i khaṇ+ḍa ro hi/ sku mdog g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum ma/ skra skre1la ba/ phyag g.yas gri gug dang / g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis me ri 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ dur khrod kyi rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'o/ /'di ni bum pa gnyis kyi dbang du byas la/ bum pa bcu ltar na/ rnam rgyal bum pa dkyus bzhin/ phyogs mtshams brgyad kyis bum par sgo mtshams ma brgyad/ /las bum du khaṇ+ḍa ro hi bskyed/shar steng gi mtshan ma hū las he ru ka nag po/ de'i 'og gi mtshan ma ma las mkha' 'gro ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo/ byang gi mtshan ma tā las lā ma/ g.yas dmar g.yon ljang / nub kyi mtshan mar pā las khaṇ+ḍa ro ha g.yas ser g.yon dmar/ lho'i mtshan ma la las gzugs can ma g.yon ser g.yas sngo ba/ las bum gyi mtshan ma'i gnas su yang khaṇ+ḍa ro hi'o/ /lha yab yum thams cad kyi snying —346—

gar o ha dkar po rdo rje sems dpa'/ mgo bor na ma hi ser po rnam par snang mdzad/ /spyi gtsug tu swāhā hu dmar po pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug phrag pa gnyis su bo ṣa ṭa he nag po dpal he ru ka mig gnyis su hu ho dmar ser rdo rje nyi ma/tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa ha ljang khu ma rta mchog gi ngo bo/ lha mo rnams kyi lte bar o ba dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ha isngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hri mo dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ dpral bar hri hri ser mo skyong byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hu hu ljang khu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud kha tsaṇ+ḍi ka'i ngo bo/de nas lha thams cad kyi dpral par o dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/thugs kar hu sngon po/ thugs ka'i hu gi 'od zer gyis bskul nas/ zhes pa nas/rkang brgyad gnyis kyi bstod pa'i bar bsgrubs thabs bzhin byas nas/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po'i mthar o ā skyo/ sbyar ba lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ o sarba bī ra ḍā ki nī ye maṇ+ḍal de ba ta sa pa ri wa re khyu a mṛ ta pū tsa pra tī ts+tsha na ma lan bcu bdun nam/o khaṇ+ḍa ro he hu phaṭa/ lan gsum gyis nang mchod phul/ bum pa bcu'i phyogs la/ bkra shis bum pa brgyad la sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi sngags so/ yab kyi rkang pa zhe brgyad pa dang / yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod/ oṃ ā hu/ lan mang du bzla bzhin pas dung chos dang thod pa blangs/ o sarba bī ra ḍā ki ni/ maṇ+ḍal la de ba ta sa pa ri wa ra khyu ar+gha pū dza pra tisnro na ma zhes mchod yon bum par blug rnam rgyal bum pa'i lha rnams rjes su chags pa'i rkyen gyis/ byang chub kyi sems kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun du zhu bar gyur/ bum pa bcu yod na/ rnam rgyal bum pa dang / bkra shis bum pa brgyad kyi zhes 'jug las bum la ni mchod yon 'bul mod/ lha mi bzhu bar bzhugs pa nyid yin no/ /slar yang /—347—

tse( ā hū/ lan bdun bzlas pas/ me tog dkar po bum par blug de rjes gzungs thag nas bzung ste/ yab yum gyi rtsa sngags tshar re tsam bzla ba'i srol yang la lar 'dug pa ltar yang bya/ de nas gtso bo'i snying po stong dang brgyad/ las bum la khaṇ+ḍa ro he'i sngags thung brgya rtsa brgyad/ thun mong du yum gyi snying po brgya rtsa dang / oṃ badz+ra u da ka hū/ brgya rtsa bzlas yi ge brgya pa dang bzod gsol byas/ las bum la dmigs te/ ji srid dkyil 'khordo ra byas pa yi/ /bya ba ma rdzogs de srid du/ /bcom ldan 'das ma khyod kyis ni/ /bdag gi gdug pa bskrad par mdzod/ /ces gsol ba gdab bo/ /bar 'dir gtor bsngo'i cho gas dkyus kyi gtor ma de nges par 'bul dgos/ chad du mi rung ngo / /'gyung po thams cad pa'i gtor chog chen mo de/ sta gon gyi skabs kyi cho ga'i yan lag rang du med mi rung min kyang / 'di 'dra'i rigs kyi med mi rung min zer ba mthong ngam thos na/ bla chos 'ba' zhig don gnyer gyis tsam me 'jog pa de lta bu ma byed par/ cho ga de dag nges par byed pa gal che'o/ /de nas snyan gsan dbab ste/ lce hu las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa hu gis mtshan par gyur/ bcom ldan he ru ka dpal mchog /rig pa'i rgyal po khyod la 'dud/ /slob ma rnams la brtse phyir dang / khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir/ /mgon po thugs rje'i bdag nyid can/ /dkyil 'khor 'bri ba bdag 'tshal lo/ /de phyir bcom ldan bdag gus la/ /bka' drin gnas par mdzad par rigs/ /sangs rgyas 'gro 'khor bya don stsole// /byang chub sems dpa' 'bras gnas dang / /gzhan yang gang dag gsang sngags lha/ /lha dang 'jig rten skyong ba dang / /'byung po byang chub bstan gnas dang / /sems can bstan la mngon dga' ba/ /gang su rdo rje'i spyan mnga' rnams/ /bdag la yang dag dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni che ge rdo rje can/ /che —348—

ge 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /ji ltar nus pa nyer sbyor bas/ /'gro ba sbyang phyir bri bar bya/ /de phyir bdag dang slob ma la/ /rjes su brtse bar nyer bzung nas/ /dkyil 'khor dang bcas thams cad ni/ /nye bar 'byon par mdzad pa'i rigs/ /zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ slar yang mchod pa kha gsos byin gyis rlabs/tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ phyi mchod/ chu gnyis/ nyer spyod/ rig ma bcu drug rnams kyis mchod/rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang : sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag dang sems/ can thams cad la dngos grub ma lus pa thams cad stsa'/ du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ tseX( badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha zhes dkyil 'khor nam mkhar gteg /slar yang / ar+ghaXzo nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ rkang bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pas bstod/sum+bha lan gsum gyis bsrung ba bya/ bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs thams cad/ ji srid spyan ma drangs gyi bar du/ gnas 'di nyid kyi nam mkhar bzhugs la/ sems can thams cad la thugs rjes su brtse ba'i spyan ras kyis bca' ba dang / bdag dang slob mar bcas pa'i bgegs thams cad zhi zhing / slad kyis dkyil 'khor byin gyis rlabs par dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de nas dkyil 'khor zhag gi cho ga ni/ thig skud lnga tshan lnga snod gtsang ma lngar bzhag oṃ khaṇ+ḍa ro has bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/oṃ āX.oX huX las shar gyi thig skud dkar po sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad he ru ka dkar po/ 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mas 'byud pa/ oṃ āXswa huX las lho'i thig skud ser po rin chen he ru ka ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mos —349—

'khyud pa/ oṃ ā a a hu las nub kyi thig skud dmar po pad+ma he ru ka sku mdog dmar po/ pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mos 'khyud pa/ oṃ ā hā hu las byang gi thig skud ljang khu/ sna tshogs he ru ka sku mdog ljang khu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma ljang khus 'khyud pa/ o ā hu hu las dbus kyi thig skud nag po/ rdo rje he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa la/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sngon mos 'byud pa/ de ltar na dpa' bo rigs lnga rnams ni/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang / phyag rgya drug dang / stag lpags kyi sham thabs dang / g.yas brkyang gi stabs can/ yum lnga po rnams ni/ gri gug dang /thod pa 'dzin pa/ dbu skra grol ba/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan zhing / g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ thams cad kyang rigs bdag rang rigs kyis dbu rgyan can/ spyan gsum pa yab yum snyoms par sbyor ba'i sku can/ rnam snang he ru ka zla ba dang / gzhan rnams nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ nyi zla'i 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'o/ /de nas/ lha thams cad kyi dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hū/oṃ ā o hu/ sogs gong gi bskyed sngags lnga po de lan bdun sogs ci rigs pa bzlas/ar+gha: nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che: sogs kyis bstod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i thig skud lnga tshan lngar gyur/ rang gi mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba ser po/ mig 'bras hu gi mtshan pa/ oṃ di p+ta sprisno ang ku sha dzasta gon gyi lha dang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kar ye shes kyi thig skud 'od zer lnga tshan lnga'i rnam pa bzhugs par gyur/ 'khor lo'i thig skud rab tu —350—

stsol/ /bdag gi rdo rje'i srad bur shog /lan gsum/ 'bar ba'i lta stangs kyi 'od zer lcags kyu lta bus bkug ste/ dam tshig gi thig skud so so la thim/bdag nyid dpal he ru ka dang / slob ma rdo rje phag mor gyur/ rdzordzo rdzo zhes thig skud brkyang la thig sna gtad/ tse( a/ na n+ya a/ ṭa mi ga tā sarba dharmā pa ra spa ra a nu pra pri gi sarba dharmā a tun ta/ a nu pra pri spyi0sarba dharmā hu/ zhes dang / yab yum gyi nye snying bzla zhing / thig skud bsgril/ thig skud kyi sne gnyis su hū dang a gis mtshan par gyur/purmye: sogs kyis mchod/ tse( badz+ra sa ma su tra ma ti kra ma hū/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/tse( ā hu/ yang mang du brjod/ de nas sa gzhi la/ tse( sarba sa ye| dha ni hū phaṭa/ ces bzlas te/ ye thig 'debs/ 'grub na gtso bo'i zhal 'jig rten lho la gtod/ ye thig 'debs lugs g.yon skor du byed de/ nag po lugs kyi dkyil chog tu bshad pa ltar ro/ /bsdu na thig skud lha'i ngo bor bsgom pa tsam gyis kyang chog /rgyas par na ye shes spyan 'dren dang / dbang bskur rgyas gdab kyang rung ngo / /rdul tshon rnams khaṇ+ḍa ro has bsangs ba nas bzung/ dam tshig gi rdul mtshon la thim zhes pa'i bar/ thig skud ces pa rnams rdul mtshon du 'don pa spo/ rdul mtshon mang po gang gis ni/ /sems can sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir/ /sems can rjes su chags pa yi/ /bden 'dis tshon rtsi 'bar bar shog /pu tri sogs kyis mchod/o ā hu badz+ra tsi tra sa ma ya hu/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ 'di ni chos nyid dag pa ste/ /sems can khams ni sgrol byed pa/ /dpal ldan khrag 'thung rgyal po nyid/ /de bzhin gshe/gas pa kun gyi gnas/ /nyes pa kun las rnam grol ba/ /tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsams/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor 'bri ba'i skor ni/ spyi'i cho gas rigs 'gre'o/ /bzhi pa dkyil 'khor sgrub pa ni mchod pa bshams shing yo byad tshang —351—

ba na/ thog mar sngon 'gro gtor ma dang / skyabs sems dang / rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas dang /'di nyid kyi gtor ma byin rlabs ltar nang mchod byin rlabs bya/ de nas rtsa sngags tshar gcig brjod/ bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru kar gyur/ rdul wo dang / dkyil 'khor yo byad dang bcas pa dang / nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor la yang dmigs nas sbyang ba dang /khrus gsol bya ste/ de yang bgegs gtor bsangs sbyangs nas bzung/ sku phyis 'bul ba'i bar/nag po lugs kyi dkyil mchog tu bshad pa bzhin bya/ spros pa la mos na/ til sbyang gi rjes su drug bzhi ldan gyi sbyang ba yang byed de/ g.yin du shes so/ /o skyo/ zhes pa nas/ spangs pa'o zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgoms/ bzlas pa yang ci rigs bya'o/ /de nas 'di skad ces/na ma sarba ta thā ga ta sgyo : bi shwa sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum/ tse( badz+ra lha rnye ra nī ta: sogs lan gsum rol mo dang bcas par bya/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas 'khore dang bcas pa thams cad dang / nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad la/mchod pa thams cad kyi mchod par gyur/ chu gnyis nyer spyod rig ma stso drug dang bcas pa rnams kyis mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che sogs kyis bstod/ ma lus phyogs na bzhugs pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bdag la dgongs/ /bdag ni rdo rje che ge yi/ /'dir ni dkyil 'khor bri ba nyid/ /sangs rgyas la sogs kun 'byon 'tshal/ /dngos grub 'dir ni yang dag stsole// /zhes lan gsum gyis snyan mnan/ o sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi ni/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta pra ṇa me ṇa badz+ra ban+ta na ka ro mi/phyag 'tshal/ rang gi thugs ka'i ye shes rdo rje hū yig las/ 'od zer mtha' yas pa spros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs rgyud bskul —352—

nas/ thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka yab yum spyan drangs te rang gi thugs ka'i hūX yig la thim/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor khaṇ+ḍa ro has bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ sta gon du gnas pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor chen po yang bris pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng gi nam mkha'i phyogs nye ba na bzhugs par gyur/gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las yaX las rlung gi dkyil 'khor: zhes pa nas/ zla ba'i gdan rnams so/ /dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du hūX las rdo rje sngon po hūX gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad mnyes par byas/sems can gyi khams thams cad sbyangs/ 'khor ra lo bcu gsum gyis lha tshogs rnams kyi go 'phang la bkod/ slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/gzugs brnyan gyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa grub pa dang /nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor mchog tu gsal zhing 'bar bar bzhugs pa ni/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka: zhes pa nas/phyag rgya ma nges pa'o/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin 'don/ rang gi thugs ka'i huX yig las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i sta gon gyi lha ye shes dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs h+pha/ dzaXhuX baX hoX nyi shu rtsa bdun sogs mang du brjod/ oX yo ga shudha gtso bo'i thugs kar nyi ma la huX ljang sngon: nas phyi rol thams cad gang bar gyur/ gyi bar go cha dgod/ huX zhes lan gsum brjod dkyil 'khor pa thams cad gtso bo'i ye shes gcig gi ngo bor gyur/ oX badz+ra be ga kra ma skyoX/oX āXskyoX/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang du rang nyid zhugs par gyur/—353—

mchod pa byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas nas/ chu gnyis nyer spyod/ rol mo/ rig ma bcu drug rnams sngags tsam gyis phul/ rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pas bstod/ rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas me tog bzung la/ hūX zhes brjod/ bdag nyid he ru ka rdo rje huX mdzad kyi ngo bor gyur/ oX ma hā ra ta su ḍi ta/ su to rtsi/ su su kho/ badz+ra satwa/ a du sidha maX/ zhes pa lan gsum gyis/dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du bskor ba byas par gyur/ go skabs yangs na dngos su yang skor ba bya'o/ /ā khaX bī ra huX/ slar yang dkyil 'khor du zhugs/ oṃ pra tisnro badz+ra hoX.oX pra ti gri ste stuX/ i maX sa twa mahā ba la/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i drung du gnas nas/ khro bo'i lta stangs dang bcas pas sgo phye/ oX badz+ra uta gha ṭa ya sa ma ya pra be sha ya huX phaṭa/ tseX( āXhūX/ lan bzhi bdud rtsi lnga dang dri chab sbyar bas bkang ba'i dung phor ram thod pa dkyil 'khor gyi drung du bzhag oX badz+ra a mṛ te a mṛ taX pra be shā ya hūX/lan gsum/ oṃ badz+ra gā mi ni/ sarba bha k+ṣaX lha te dha ya gu phya badz+re ṇi swāhā/ bco / ma ldan 'das dpal he ru ka dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis bdag la sngags kyi dngos grub dam pa'i bka'i gnang ba stsal du gsol/ lan gsum de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /de nyid shes nas de nas ni/ /dpa' bos 'dod pa lnga spyad do/ /bdag nyid dpa' bo kun gyi dngos/ /bdag nyid lha mo kun gyi gnas/ /de phyir bdag gis thams cad bya/ /bdag nyid he ru ka dpal mchod/ /rten cing 'brel bar 'gyung chos can/ /sems can sgyu ma'i rang bzhin no/ /khams gsum de ltar shes nas ni/ /'gro ba'i don ni mnyam med byos/ /zhes bka'i gnang ba stsal bar gyur/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba/ bla ma dang dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor —354—

gyi lha tshogs thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan gsum/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i hū yig las 'od zer mtha' yas pa 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dpal he ru ka 'khor lo sdom pa/ mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor chen po ye shes kyi 'khor lo la phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pas bskor ba phe/ ma lus 'gro ba'i rang bzhin mngon sum mdzad/ /mi bzad bdud kyi dpung gis phyag byas pa/ /rang byung mtha' yas 'gro ba'i rang bzhin te/ /sems can snying po gcig gyur 'dir gshegs shig /sum+bha sogs kyis bsangs/ gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po lan mang du brjod/ ye shes 'khor lo mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor chen po'i steng gi nam mkha' la rab tu dges pas bzhugs par gyur/ mchod yon dang / nyer spyod tsam sngags kyis phul la/ he ru ka dpal ye shes che: zhes sogs mtshan brgyas bstod/ rol mo'i sgra sgrags/ dza / ba ho/ lan nyer bdun tsam dang / yo ga shurnyo: lan gsum/ dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor dang / ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor ro gcig tu gyur/ slar yang snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bskul bas/ dbang gi lha: zhes pa nas/ dbang gi lha rnams rigs bdag la thim/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhi no/ /gang 'dir rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /rjes chags kyi bde bas gang ba ni/ dam tshig gi phyag rgya'o/ /thugs ka'i hu yig ni stong nyid snying rjer gnas pa ste chos kyi phyag rgya'o/ /thugs rje chen po bskyed de sprul pas sems can gyi don mdzad pa ni las kyi phyag rgya'o/ /zhes brjod cing don bsam la/ slar yang 'di skad ces/ rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa'i/ /rang rang kha dog phyag mtshan —355—

'chang / /sprul pa'i sku yi gzugs kyis ni/ /phyag rgya chen por rab tu grags/ /dpa' bo gnyis kyi snyoms 'jug pa/ /bsgoms pa'i bdag nyid de don du/ /shes rab mi mo'i gzugs 'dzin pa/ /de ni dam tshig tu ni brjod/ /byang chub sa bon skyed byed gang / /zhing du byed pa'i bdag nyid de/ /yang dag mthar ni rnam dag pas/ /chos kyi phyag rgya zhes brjod do/ /sems can phung po ma lus pa'i/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob byed du/ /rdo rje pad+ma'i lte ba yis/ /las kyi phyag rgya zhes grags so/ /'on kyang de bzhin lha mo rnams/ /dga' rol dam tshig tu ni dran/ /rang gi 'bad rtsol skad cig pa/ /las kyi phyag rgyar de bzhin 'gyur/ /zhes brjod cing mnyam par bzhag go bar 'dir mdun bskyed kyi bzlas pa ji ltar 'os pa bya ste/ gtso bo yab yum gyi rtsa sngags nyi shu rtsa gcig tsam bzla/ de tsam mi nus na/ rtsa sngags gnyis tshar gcig gam gsum gang rigs brjod nas/ snying po brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi mtshan sngags bzla bar 'dod na'ang / tshar gcig tsam 'don par zad de/ 'on kyang spros par dgos pa ni ma yin no/ /de nas dkyil 'khor du bum pa 'god de/ rnam rgyal dkyil 'khor gtso bo'i mdun thad gzhal yas khang phyi ma'i shar sgo dang nye bar bzhag gtso bo yab yum gyi snying po ci rigs pa bzlos/ de'i byang du las bum kyang bzhag ste/ ṣaṇ+ḍa ro ha cung zad bzlas so/ /drug gi phyogs la'ang gnyis po de dang 'dra/ gzhan bzhi mtshams bzhir bzhag go /bcu'i phyogs la'ang gnyis po 'dra/ bkra shis kyi bum pa brgyad ni/ sgo bzhi dang grwa bzhi'i thad kyi phyi rol du dgod/ de nas mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa dngos ni/ mchod pa bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs spyi 'gro ltar byas pa'i mthar/ oṃ ā hu/ lan mang du bzla zhing / oṃ sarba bid pū ra pu sogs dang /o put+pa pra tisnro swāhā/ de bzhin du/ dhu pa dī pa gan+dha nai bi kyi rdzu k+ṣa rnams la'ang sbyar/ oṃ —356—

sarba ta thā ga ta ha su: la phya: ra ti: pu gi sa hū khyi ya a nut+ta ra/ pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa hū/ zhes dang / o a nut+ta ra/ sarba pū dza me gha sa mud ga te spa ra ṇa i ma ga ga na kha hu phaṭa/ sngags lan gsum gsum mo/ /de nas mchod pa 'bul ba dngos ni/ dwangs shing dri med yid 'ong ba'i: zhes pa nas/ spar+sha kā ma gu ṇa'i bar du nag po lugs kyi dkyil chog bzhin du phul/ lha mo bcu drug la tshigs bcad gzhan mang po yod pa'ang byas na legs par 'ong / nang mchod bla ma rgyud pa'i skabs/rdo rje 'chang dbang phyag na rdo rje dang / /rnal 'byor ma dpal spyan ras gzigs dbang dang / /blo gros rin chen shā bā ri pa la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog gi mchod pa 'bul/ /mai tri gu pa rgya gar phyag na dang / /ka ma la pa dza ya su na dang / /sum pa 'e1 tsā rje btsun grags rgyal la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi mchog gi sa skya paṇa chen rin chen skyob pa dpal/ /rgyal tsha chos dbang mang mkhar lo tsa ba/ /blo chen pa dang bla ma ye shes dpal/ /dar ma bzang po grags chen spang khang pa/ /slob dpon rin brtson mkhan chen byang seng pa/ /theg chen chos rje brag thog bsod bzang la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi5 kun dga' rnam rgyal rgya ston byang dbang dang / /grol mchog zhabs dang mkhas mchog byams pa'i mtshan/ /'khor lo'i dbang phyug rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ye shes bdud rtsi yang na rang cag chos nan to bya ba'i 'os su bgrang ba ni/sum pa lo tsā mkhas pa sa mu dra/ /seng ge rgyal mtshan yang klungs lo tsā ba/ /rong pa sher seng kyi ston 'jam dbyangs grags/ /kun mkhyen chen po dus gsum sangs rgyas dang / /slob dpon chos grags mkhan chen byang seng ba/ /de man chad sngar bzhin byas na/ brgyud pa shin tu bzang ba la/ rong pa sher seng yan chad kyi brgyud rim shin tu —357—

rnyed dka' bar gyur pa yun ring lon pa las/ phyis mkhan chen grub pa shes rab kyi gsan yig las rnyed pa'o/ /rgyud pa'i rnam grangs mi 'dra ba rnams gzhan du bshad zin to/ /shin tu nye brgyud ni/he ru ka dpal rdo rje phag mo dang / yā bā ri dbang rje btsun grol mchog dang / /gdod ma'i mgon po lha dbang grags pa la/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i mnyes mchod dam pa 'bul/ /gzhan yang rtsa ba'i bla ma/ brgyud pa'i bla ma: zhes pa nas/a nu rā ga ṇa'i bar 'dra ba las/ 'khor tshogs kyi skabs rnams mi dgos/ ci ste shin tu spros pa la dga' na/ dus 'khor gyi arka chen mo bzhin byas na 'ong / de rjes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te rkang brgyad gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas rkang pa bzhi bcu zhe brgyad pa dang / he ru ka dpal ye shes che:sogs mtshan brgya dang / bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba 'jigs pa'i gzugs ldan pa/sogs mtshan brgya gnyis pas kyang bstod/ bar 'dir kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal pos mdzad pa'i bstod chen kyang 'don/ de rjes/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dam pa dang / zhes pa nas gzigs shing las kun mdzad pa yin/ zhes pa'i bar yang / nag po dkyil chog gi mchod 'phreng bzhin no/ /bar 'dir phyi rol gtor ma gtong ste/ rgyas par na 'byung po thams cad pa dang / zhing skyong gi gtor ma gnyis kar byed/ 'bring du gang rung cig bya/ bsdus par na mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dkyus nyid yin pa las/ dra khyo ho zhes pa'i rjes su/ gang du bcom ldan 'das lhan cig /'ongs pa'i phyogs kyi bdag po rnams/ /gang yang rjes su 'brang zhes 'dir/ /gnas pa de dag thams cad rnams/ /bdag ni rjes su bzung ba'i phyir/ /ji ltar yod pa'i dri dang ni/ /me tog sogs dang gtor ma yang / /so sor bzhes te sems can la/ /byams pa'i sems dang slob ma la/ /gegs med par ni mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ o ā hū/ lan gsum —358—

gyis mchod yon phul/ puspro la sogs pa nyer spyod lngas mchod/ lkoX kha kha: man chad du spyi dang 'dra/ mchod pa bsdu ba/ mchod yon bsgreng ba/ mtshams bcad pa sogs kyang phyi rol gtor ma spyi 'gro'i rim pas chog 'on kyang 'dir skor ba sgo dbye/ me tog 'bul ba rnams ni mi dgos te/sngar zin pa nyid kyi phyir ro/ /ci ste spros pa la dga' ba dang / ga khyer 'dod pas byed snyam na mdzod cig /de la bdag gis ci zhig bya/ de nas bdag 'jug gi don du khrus byas te/ 'jug pa'i maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ rdo rje phag mo rab sbyor ba/ /bdag gi ston pa dga' chen khyod/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul ston pa/ /zhes pa nas/ gzhug tu gsol/ lan gsum/ oX badz+ra tsakra a dhi tiṣ+ṭha sirnyi skyoX/ bdag nyid gtso bo he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta bo dhi a lang ka ra bsta pū dza me gha sa mu dra spa ra ṇa sa ma ye skyoX/oX badz+ra rak+ṣa haX/ oX badz+ra tha(rto ṣa hūX phaṭa/ oX tsaklu ra ban+ta ba ra ma ṇa ya spruX/ ā haX sgyi ra hūX/ oX dngos grub kun gyi grong khyer nyams dga' ba/ /thar pa'i grong du dpal ldan bde chen 'jug /mchog gi bde ba dam pa'i dngos grub kyi/ / dzaXhuX baX hoXrab tu grub par mdzod/ /bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du yongs su zhugs par gyur/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza u pa sba nā ya/ asma naX nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra satwa a dhi tiṣ+ṭha maX/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta brnya pū dza u pa sba nā ya/ at+pa naX nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta be+e ro tsa na a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa ma/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza karma ṇi/ at+pa naX nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra karma ku ru maX/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza pra brta na ya/ at+pa naX nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra dharma pra brta ya mi/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza a bhi ṣe ka ya/ at+pa naX nir+ya ta ya mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra rat+na a bhi khiñtsa maX/ zhes phyogs bzhi phyag 'tshal bya/ dam tshig de nyid —359—

bdag la stsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /rdo rje'i rigs kun bsdus pa la/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i dbang bskur ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stso'i// /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas btab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /mgon po chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur pa ni rmad byung che/ /sems can kun gyi don bgyid phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /zhes lan gsum/'di dza ya gya na'i lugs so/ /tshig 'dis gsol ba 'debs phyin dum bu la bcos ka byed pa bas/gtso bo bdag la sdom pa stsole// /zhes sogs rgyud nas 'byung ba de rdzogs par byas na ka legs so/ /bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /byang chub sems ni yongs bzung la/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir 'jug cing / /dam tshig sdom pa nong par mdzod/ /lan gsum/ gsang ba chen po rigs dag pa'i/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin par ni/ /bdag nyid chen po khyod 'dod dam/ /bdag 'dod do zhes de la 'don pa spo/ de ltar na gsol gdab dang 'di dag kyang / dkyil chog gnyis kyi lugs 'di yang 'gal ba cher med dam snyam nas bkod pa yin/ spyir ni rgyud gzhung tshad ldan ltar byas na ka brling ngo / /de nas sdom pa sgrag ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song / /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs yid 'ong / /sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bar bya/ /byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ khres rab dril bu zhes sgrags so/ /slob dpon khyod kyis bzung bya ste/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la —360—

rtag tu ni/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu spyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan pa ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /de las gzhan yang bcu bzhi ni/ /phas pha par ni rab tu bshad/ /spang zhing dor bar mi bya ste/ /rtsa ba'i ltung ba zhes bshad do/ /nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re bzhin ni bslab par bya/ /gang tshe nyams gyur rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya/ /ma byin par yang blang mi bya/ /'dod la log par mi spyad cing / /rdzun du smra bar mi bya'o/ /phung khrol kun gyi rtsa ba yi/ /chang ni rnam par spangs bar bya/ /sems can don phyir ma gtogs pa/ /bya ba ma yin thams cad spangs/ /dam pa nye bar bsten bya zhing / /rnal 'byor pa rnams bsnyen bkur bya/ /lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dang / /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang / /yid kyi rnam pa gsum dag ni/ /ci nus pa ni rjes su srung / /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can don la rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang / /rtag tu mya ngan 'das mi chags/ /lha dang lha min gsang ba pa/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ /phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang / /mtshan ma 'god par mi bya'o/ /'di dag dam tshig yin par bshad/ khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /rjes mthun sdom pa rgya cher ni/ /gsang ba'i rgyud las yang dag bshad/ /ces dam tshig sgrags/ slob dpon 'dir ni —361—

bdag la gson/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de ltar du ni bdag gis bgyi/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams nas mya ngan 'das la 'god/ / lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung / rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa byang chub kyi sems kun rdzob dang don dam gnyis su med pa'o/ /lko badz+ra sku1 ga tsit+ta 5/ pa da ya mi/ /glu( sarba ta thā ga ta sku1 gi kā ya lwaka tsit+ta sdo/ ta pa ya mi/a she sha a na ba she lga satwa dha tu hi ta/ su kho t+ta ma sirnyi ā dun ta bha wa sidha ma he shwa r+ya dhi pa t+ya tsa ya/ zhes sems bskyed pa la ched du brjod pa byas/ sa ma ya stu zhes me tog slar yang bzung / bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yi/ /rdo rje slob dpon dka' thub che/ /sems can rnams la phan pa'i phyir/ /slob ma rnams ni gzhug par bya/ /zhes dkyil 'khor la gsol ba btab/ ā kha bī ra hū zhes yol ba bsal/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ khyod kyis 'di dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje ste/ khyod kyi dam tshig rdo rje 'di'o/ /gal te khyod kyis 'ga' zhig la/ /'di smras na ni mgo bo 'gems/ /oṃ de ring rdo rje sems dpa' rang / khyod kyi snying la yang dag zhugs/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /hū 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis thob/ /oṃ —362—

pañtsa a mṛ ta u ta ka ṭha ṭha ṭha hū/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyi dpal phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyis/ ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba gang yin pa de khyod kyis bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par yang ma byed cig /byas na yang de ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur ta re/ de dag ni dam la bzhag pa'o/ /ye shes dbab pa ni/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig /dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ lan gsum/ rang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa zhabs g.yas brkyang gi stabs byas bzhugs par gyur/ snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte ba la/ rtsa a wa dha ti chu shing gi me tog lta bu'i nang na/ dpyid dang thig le kha sbyor bar gnas pa ni/ dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa/ yum rdo rje phag mos 'phyud pa/ bde ba chen po rab tu 'bar ba'i 'od zer du ma 'phro ba/ phyogs bzhir lā mā pā tā yum bzhi/ mtshams bzhir oṃ yig bzhi thod pa bzhi'i ngo bo/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su/ pu dza nas ma bu khams rnams dpa' bo dang rtsa rnams dpa' mo/ bu ga brgyad la hu ring po brgyad sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi ngo bo/mdun bskyed kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad dpal he ru ka rig ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / 'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma'i rnam par spyan drangs te/ lus kyi stod kyi cha la thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams kha dog nag po'i rnam pas thim bar —363—

gyi cha la gsung rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha tshogs rnams dmar po'i rnam pas thim/smad kyi cha la sku rdo rje'i rigs rnams dkar po'i rnam pas 'jug cing / gtso bo rig mar bcas pa dang / de ma yin pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa yang / ba sbu'i bu ga nas zhugs te snying gar thim pa'i rkyen gyis snying ga'i dpa' bo yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ sbyor mtshams nas/ byang chub kyi sems kyi 'od zer 'phros pas/ lus thams cad bde ba chen pos gang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams las lha tshogs dpag tu med pa char babs pa bzhin tu byung ste/ snying gar thim/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha a be sha ya hū/ zhes rol mo'i sgra bya/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ḍi rdo me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da ya me a dhi nga sarba si lja me/ pra yasmosarba karma su tsa me tsit+ta shri ya/ ku ru hu/ ha ha ha ha ho zhes pa'i brtan par bya'o/ /dkyil chog gi gzhung gnyis las ni/ me tog mgo la bcings nas mig 'byed pa'i bar la/ bden stobs gnyis pa brjod pa dang / mig phye nas blta bar bskul ba'i bar la nam mkha'i kha dog dri ba byas pa ni/ su dang yang mi mthun pa'i lag len ar kha mar 'dug cing / skye bo mang po la dbang phyogs gcig tu bskur na/ shin tu byed stabs mi bde'o/ /des na/ ces sa rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /zhes pa nas/ kun gyis sgrib med mthong bar shog /ces bden stobs dang po de brjod nas/ rang gi las dang rjes su mthun pa'i nam mkha'i kha dog mthong bar gyur/ yang dag pa dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /lha rnams rigs kyi rim pa dang / /bsod nams ci 'dra de 'drar shog /de yi dngos grub ci 'drar 'gyur/ /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /bsod nams mthu yang ci 'dra ba/ /de 'dra dkyil 'khor du gyur —364—

cig /ces bden stobs gnyis pa brjod/ oX pra tismo badz+ra hoX oX pra ti gro hā stuX/ be sha ku laX shi bya mahā ba la/ oX rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oX dz+nyā na tsak+ṣu hūX a/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skye/ khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang / /dngos grub thams cad mngon du 'gyur/ /dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang / /sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /dpal 'khor lo sdom pa mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mngon sum du mthong bar gyur/ slob ma dbang bskur gyi dus yin na dkyil 'khor mtha' dag rgyas par bstan no/ /bdag 'jug la yang de bzhin byas na bzang mod kyi/ byed pa'i srol med do/ /lkoX rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oX rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /sa ma ya ho ho ho/ /zhes ched du brjod do/ /de nas 'khor lo'i lha'i dag pa ༅da pa ni/ shrī ni gnyis med ye shes te/ /he ni rgyu sogs stong pa nyid/ /ru ni tshogs dang bral ba ste/ /ka ni gang du'ang mi gnas pa/ /dpal ni he ru ka zhes bya/ /rdo rje ye shes dbyer med phyir/ /rtag tu sgrib pa las sgrib dang / /'dod chags dman pa'i sbyor ba gang / /rdo rje sngon song can phag mo/ /mchog tu 'gro ba'i ngang tshul ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma dang / de'i rigs lnga/ rtag tu bdug pa za bas lwa ma dang /de'i rigs lnga/ dum bur byed cing skyed pas dum skyes ma dang / de'i rigs lnga/—365—

sna tshogs pa'i gzugs 'dzin pas gzugs can ma dang de'i rigs lnga/ gtso bos ni/ rgyud rnams dag pas phyag bdun cu don gnyis/ rgod pa sogs dag pas phyag dang po bzhi/ dga' ba bcu drug ye shes dang bcas pa ni zhal bcu bdun/ 'khor 'das mnan pas zhabs gnyis sam/ stong nyid bco brgyad dag pas zhabs bco brgyad/ gnas bcu gnyis dang / sa bcu gnyis dag pas 'khor lo bcu gnyis/ ye shes dang chos dang longs spyod rdzogs pa kun nas mnyam pas pho brang nang ma gsum po zlum po/ mtha' bzhi spyod cing sprul pa kun tu rgyas pas phyi ma gru bzhi pa/ rlud gnyis dbu mar 'dus pa dang / sku gsum dang dga' bzhi dang ye shes lnga dag pas/ de dag gi rtsig pa'i rim pa'o/ /bzhi pa kun gyi thun mong du/ /byin gyis brlabs pa'i thig yin phyir/ /mnyam pa tshad med la sogs so/ /tshul khrims sdom pa bla med pa/ /rgyan gang yin par yang dag bshad/ /dad pa'i dbang po sogs can sems/ /rtsig pa lnga ru 'byung ba yin/ /rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi/ /gang zhig sgor ni yang dag bshad/ /yang dag rab tu spong ba bzhi/ /rta babs kyi ni ka bar 'byung / /dran pa'i ye shes bzhi rnams ni/ kha khyor bzhi ru dran par bya/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi ni rkang pa bzhi/ /sgo 'khyud rnam pa bzhi yin no/ /byang chub yan lag bdun 'phreng ba/ /ba dan me tog 'phreng bar brjod/ /rnam kun mkhyen nyid ye shes ni/ /ting 'dzin gnyis su btags pa yin/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni brjod pa'o/ /nyon mongs thams cad zad byed pas/ /de bzhin dra ba zhes brjod do/ /yang dag gcod pa'i rab 'phrog dang / /rnam par sel ba'i rab 'phrog —366—

pas/ /tshogs gnyis kyi ni sbyor ba ste/ /nyon mongs rnams kyi phyed 'phrog phyir/ /dra ba phyed pa zhes brjod do/ /'phags pa'i lam ni ka ba brgyad/ /de yi dbus kyi pad+ma gang / /skyon gyis ma gos par bston no/ /snye bor lo bcu gnyis bshad pa rnams/ /sa yi mi mthun phyogs spang ba/ /yang dag bshad pa'i rtsibs 'di rnams/ /nyon mongs nye ba'i nyon mongs sel/ /rdo rje 'phreng ba la sogs gang / /glo bur ba yi dri ma sel/ /cha shas bcu drug rnams kyi bar/ /dur khrod dag par shes par bya/ /mdor na yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rnam par rol ba mtha' dag rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba'o/ /de dag gi 'jug pa'i cho ga bshad zin to/ /de nas rdo rje'i slob ma'i dbang gi don du ma rdzo phul/ /byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal pa ltar/ /bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /snying po'i dkyil 'khor gyi nang du/shar phyogs kyi lha snam la dbang stegs kyi gdan la rang nyid phyag gnyis pa'i rnam pas gnas par gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phyag gnyis pa zhig chad/ sbyang ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ lkoX sarba pā paX da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra sa stu phya sarba pā paX da ha na swāhā/ oX huX ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ oX sarba saX rtse( dha ni swāhā/ oX sarba ma la a ba ra ṇa bi kho dha ni swāhā/ oX pu rgya dz+nyā na dha ra sam+bha ra ṇ+ḍi pa kā ya swāhā/oX bha ra bha ra sam+bha ra sam+bha ra swāhā/ bden pa bdar ba'i mthar/ bdag cag rnams kyi phung po drug khams drug dbang po drug la sogs pa la gnas te/dbang gi ye shes skye ba la bar du gcod cing / mi mthun par gyur pa byur dang —367—
