skal ba ngan pa dang / bkra mi shis par 'gyur ba/ bgegs dang log 'dren gnod byed thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du songs shigaces rol mo'i sgra sgrogs so/ /oṃ badz+ra pā du swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pro k+ṣa ma ṇa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra añtsa ma na snyu hā/ o badz+ra ar+gha pra tisnro hu swāhā/ o badz+ra ga rnye ā hu swāhā/ sdi'u ṣi ā lo ke: hu lan bdun brjod/ bdag cag rnams kyi byur dang / skal ba ngan pa dang /bkra mi shis pa thams cad shwan ting ku ru swāhā/ khaṇ+ḍa ro his bsangs/ swa bha was sbyangs/ dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las pa las pad+ma dang / ra las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hu las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro he ru ka sku mdog sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang /g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i phreng ba dang / rus pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing /spyan gsum po khro zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ yum rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin zhing phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ dpral par o/ mgrin par ā thugs kar hu/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par h+pha/ dza : ba ho dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus la phog pas 'od kyi gong bur gyur/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i zhal du zhugs/ gzhir gnas kyi byang chub sems dang 'dres/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkha' nang ri—368—

du babs/ hu las rdo rje hū gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje mkha' 'dre sto nas thugs kar hū gi: bar rnam rgyal bum pa'i skabs bzhi/ yang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hu las 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu mtha' yas par nam mkha' gang bar bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ rig pa'i lha mo sras dang bcas pa thams cad nam mkha'i dbyings su badz+ra sa mā dza o badz+ra ar+gha swāhā/ o badz+ra pu spre ā hu/ sogs nyer spyod lnga/ sha lta dang bcas pas phul/ rdo rje can gyis sangs rgyas la/ /'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang / /yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal/ /de bzhin 'di la gnang ba mdzod/ /ces gsol ba btab pas/ nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha thams cad rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems su zhu bar gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ thugs kar byang chub kyi sems su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas shes rab kyi chu skyes dbus su byon pa'i byang chub kyi sems kyis rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi skur gsal ba la dbang bskur zhing / dri ma mtha' dag sbyangs te dag pa'i shel ltar gyur/ byang chub kyi sems kyi rdul phra rab las/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum/ byang chub sems dpa' yab yum/ khro bo'i dbang po rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa dang / dbang gi lha tshogs mtha' yas par sprul te/ gsang ba'i chu skyes las phyi rol du byon/ mkha' dbyings thams cad gang bar bzhugs te/ hu zhes bya bas rang nyid 'khor lo'i dbang phyug ma'i gsang ba'i mtha' nas phyir spros te/ dbang stegs kyi steng du 'khod par gyur/de'i tshe rdo rje phag mo dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa rig ma rnams kyis/—369—

bum pa byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba/ phyag gis cung zad yo bar 'dzin zhing /yal 'dab kyis 'thor ba dang / phyogs thams cad nas sna tshogs pa'i mchod pas bstibs shing / gur gum dang me tog la sogs pa'i char phab rnga bo che'i sgra sgrags/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis shis pa brjod par gyur/ o bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ /kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /sems can ma lus skyed byed bde ba chen po ste/ /des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog /de nas spro na/bkra shis gang zhig mtha' dag rdo rje'i rigs dang ldan/ /zhes sogs bya zhing / bsdu na/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis tsam brjod/ dung chos sam rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu thogs te/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka na twa a bhi khri ldo4 mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa dhi tī na ḍi rdo me bha wa/ zhes pa'i mthar/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni/khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje gsang ba gsum byung ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sbyin par bya/ /oṃ ā badz+ra u da ka a bhi khri nyu hu su ra ta stu a ha/zhes gsungs zhing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad gang / sdig sgrib thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra purdze ā hu/ sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ de lhar na chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa'i phung po gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten gnyis dho lto dhi/gas rnyi/rnyi / pa/'i/ rdo ḍi ༵ wa/ ༵sdu smri ༵bye ༵gi sam wo —370—

pa las 'od 'phros/ 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnyis ka'ang rin chen he ru ka sku mdog ser po/ g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'byud pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang / phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing / spyan gsum pa/ khro zhing sgeg pa'i nyams can/ yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma ser mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āX thugs kar huX/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūX las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par h+pha/ dzaXhūX baX hoX lan gnyis/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen 'byung ldan zhu ba las/ dbus su me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi lha'am/dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa mtha' bskor du rgyal ba rigs lnga'i sku gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i dbang rdzas dbu rgyan du gyur/ lkoX badz+ra bhā tī shwa rī a bhi ṣañtsa hūX/ oX sarba ta thā ga ta satwa badz+re ṇi a bhi sa ṣañtsa skyoX/ oX rat+na badz+re a bhi ti spya t+yāX/ oX pad+ma badz+re a bhi khiñtsa hi/ oX karma badz+ra a bhi ṣañtsa aX zhes rang rang gi phyag rgya gnas lngar ni mu/sapa'am/ bsdu na dbu rgyan byin gyis rlobs pa'i sngags su byas kyang rung ngo / /de nas dbang bskur rdo rje chen po rna sogs/ mthar/ oṃ āXbadz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi shiñtsa huX/ su ra ta stuX a haX/zhes brjod cing / oX badz+ra tu rtsi hoX oX huX hraX hriX.aX dar dpyangs bcings/ oX badz+ra u ta ka a bhi ṣañtsa hūX su ra ta stuX/ a haX/ zhes gsungs shing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ las kyi nang thams cad gang / nyes skyon thams cad dag chu'i lhag ma —371—

spyi bor 'khyil pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan nyid kyis dbu brgyan/ oX badz+ra pulpecasogs/ de ltar na cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba'i phung po gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa yin no/ /cod pan gyi dbang des rigs bsgres te/ bdag dang dbang rdzas rdo rje gnyis ka mi: dzi las pad dzi gis pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku mdog dmar po g.yas pad+ma: yum pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ thams cad pad+ma mkha' 'gro ma yab yum gyi rnam par:pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum zhu ba las/ dbang rdzas rdo rje: dbang bskur rdo rje chen po sogs kyi rjes la/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis rdo rje yi/ /dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur/ /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje rab tu grub phyir bzung / /oṃ āXm hā badz+ra hūX huX/ oṃ badz+ra u ta ka: sogs/ spyi bor 'khu/la ba las 'od dpag med kyis dbu rgyan/ oX badz+ra puṅge de ltar na rdo rje 'dod chags:'du shes kyi: so sor rtog pa'i: 'od dpag med kyi: spyo 'don pa spo/ rdo rje'i dbang ngo / /de bzhin du/ bdag dbang rdzas dril bu: khaX las ral gri khaX gis: sna tshogs mkha' 'gro sku mdog ljang khu: g.yas ral gri yum sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma yang sku mdog ljang khu thams cad sna tshogs mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par dbang rdzas kyi sna tshogs mkha' 'gro dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/dbang bskur rdo rje: sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti stuX/ a bhi khiñtsa mi/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya stuX/ zhes dril bu gtad/ oṃ badz+ra lha rje a a/ bco pa ma ldan bzung ngo bdag la ni/ /yang dag nye bar gyur par mdzode/ badz+ra u ta ka 'khyil ba las —372—

don yod grub pas/ badz+ra pur+sha dril bu'i dbang : phrag dog: 'du byed kyi bya ba sgrub pa'i: don yod grub pa'i: dril bu'i dbang ngo / /bdag dang dbang rdzas dril bu gnyis ka: pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bhuX las 'khor lo bhuX gyis mtshan pa:sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro1 sku mdog dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang / yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo thams cad sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par: dbang rdzas kyi sangs rgyas kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum/ dbang rdzas rdo rje dril bur gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje/ oṃ badz+ra satwa stuX/ a bhi ṣañtsa mi/ badz+ra na maX.a bhi ṣe ka ta/ dpal rdo rje he ru ka khyod yin no/ /badz+ra u da ka5 rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbu rgyan/ badz+ra pukhre ming gi dbang : gti mug: gzugs kyi phung po chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rnam par snang mdzad kyi go 'phang : de ltar rig pa'i dbang lnga po 'di dag la/ spros pa la dga' na/ re re bzhin du mgor byang chub rdo rje sogs kyi gsol btab dang / dbang lha spyan drangs/ mchod bstod gsol ba btab/ chu dbang gi skabs bzhin dbang rdzas sngon la lhar bskyed de/ ye shes pa bstim/ bar der dbang rdzas la mchod bstod/ rigs lnga so so'i sngags lan bdun nam/ nyer gcig tsam bzla/ de rjes slob ma sngon bzhin nang chog gis bskyed/ mchod cing gsol ba btang/ nang dbang bskur nas phyir spros/ dbang stegs kyi steng du ba kod pa la/ re re bzhin shis brjod byed de/ rigs lnga'i bkra shis so sor bkram/ gzhan kha 'gengs ji ltar 'os pa bya/ slob ma'i kyang / tseX( a bhi khri yeñtsa sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de nas dbang dngos gzhi so sor bskur/ rigs bdag gis dbu rgyan pa'i rjes su/ shā dbang gi lha rnams ye shes pa'i tshul du bstim/ de nas mchod pa dang dag dran bya/dbang lha dang / dbang rdzas dang / slob ma mchod pa la mchod yon dang / rol mo byed mi byed kyi khyad —373—

dang / dbang rdzas dang slob ma la bstod pa byed pa'ang yod de/ cho ga spros pa la mos na/ de ltar byas pas/ lhag pa'i skyon med cing gzhung don dang mthun pas legs par 'gyur gyi/ thob thang med pa'i bskyed chog dang / lhad kyi tshig mang po 'jug pa sogs ni mi bya'o/ /rig dbang 'di rnams dbang thams cad kyi gzhi rten du 'dug pas/ spros pa cung zad skyed kyang mi legs pa ni ma yin no/ /slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ gang gis bdag gi khyod drin las/ /rang dang gas don nus gyur pa/ /rdo rje slob dpon gyi ni dbang / /thugs rje'i gter gyis bdag la stsol/ /dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su khrus kyi khang pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du/ rang nyid dpal rdo rje 'chang chen po he ru ka phyag g.yas rdo rje dang / g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas thugs kar bsnol ba/ ral ba'i thor tshugs dang / thod pa'i 'phreng ba dang /2sa pa'i phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris can/g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs shing spyan gsum pa/ khro zhing sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa'i skur gyur/ dpral par o/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hū/rgyas pa la dga' bas/ 'di nang chog gis bskyed kyang rung ngo / /yang na bsgom bya'i lha dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo yab yum gnyis du bskyed na'ang shin tu legs so/ /de nas bum pa'i thod pa thogs te/dbang bskur rdo rje chen po: sogs kyi mthar/ oṃ ā badz+ra a bhi khris rtsa sngags gnyasakyi mthar/ badz+ra a bhi khri phu / hu/ zhes chu dbang bskur/ bsdu na yab yum gyi snying pos byas rung tsam yin/ he ru ka rigs lngas rdo rje'i 'phreng bas mtshan pa'i con ༵nab ljo ༵ hūṃ ṭa : nas / /rnyi/ ༵ ༵ snro shā /༵ //rtag ༵ dī/dod chags la dī byung —374—

khro/ /rdo rje me yi phung po'i sku/ /'bar ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor che/ /mkha' 'gro ma kun 'bar ba'o/ /thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu la'o/ /hi las byung ba'i dril bu bcom ldan 'das ma'i ngo bo gtad de/ o a kā ro mu kha sogs dang /hi thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang mnyam sbyor ba yi/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pas sems dpa' mchog /dam pa'i srid pa byed par 'gyur/ /dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar/ kye dpal che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /rig ma rdo rje phag mo'am/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa/ sku mdog dkar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i skur gyur/ bzhad pa dang / 'byud pa'i bde ba sku nyams su bstar/shin tu bla bas bde 'gyur dang / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ khren tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni khyod kyis long / /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad ni/ /ci 'dod par ni brtan bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lhar sbyor bar/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig zhes su brjod/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /ji srid 'khor ba'i gnas mchog tu/ /mkhas mchog bzhugs par gyur gyi bar/ /de srid mnyam med sems can —375—

don/ /mya ngan mi 'da' byed par nus/ /yid kyi lus su brtan pa'i phyir/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig rab tu brjod/ /gang gi lus ni thams cad brtan/ /des na phyag rgyar rab tu sgrags/ /de nas brtan byed du bum pa'i chus dbang bskur nga/gos te/ dbang bskur rdo rje: nas yar lud pa las rdo rje 'chang chen pos dbu rgyan/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ ye shes kyi lha dpal he ru ka /mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad spyan drangs shing / phyogs bcu'i nam mkha'i khams gang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams dang lhan cig rang la thim/ dza : ba ho ar+gha/ nas/ shasta'i bar gyis mchod/ rol mo dang bcas te/ bstod pa ji ltar 'os pas bstod/ slob ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bor bskyed pa yin na rkang brgyad dang / rdo rje 'chang du bsgom pa yin na de nyid lnga pas bstod zer ro/ /o su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye khyu hā/ brtan bzhugs bya/ de nas brtsams te rnal 'byor pas/ /rgyud kun las ni gsungs pa yi/ /ma lus lus pa med 'gyur ba'i/ /cho ga yis ni dkyi'/ 'khor bris/ /ji ltar rnam par 'dod pa yis/ /rang 'dod lha yi 'jug pa nyid/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub gang / /mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma ni/ /ji ltar dmigs pa'i yid kyis su/ /ji ltar nus pa gzhan du sgrub/ /phran tshegs la sogs pa yi las/ /de yis dngos grub sgrub pa la/ /rang dang gzhan la grags pa yi/ /de 'grub pa la the tshom med/ /ces brjod de/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi cho ga'o/ /skabs 'dir rjes gnang la sogs pa'i mtha' rten rnams byas kyang legs so/ /de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dam tshig —376—

nyi shu rtsa gnyis srungs/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel legs par bsgrigs pa yin no/ /gsang dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin gyis/ /bdag gis bla med byang chub thob/ /de phyir gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /mgon pos bdag la thugs brtser mdzod/ /lan gsum/snyu gsum gyis mig dar bcings/ rdo rje slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'khor lo'i dbang phyug dpal he ru ka dbyer ma mchis pa nyid/ rig ma rigs thams cad kyi 'khor lo'i bdag mo/ bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje phag mos yang dag par 'khyud pa'i sku can du gyur/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āthugs kar hu/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes pa nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i sgras/ zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin/phyogs bcu nam mkha'i mthas gshugs pa na bzhugs pa'i/ de bzhin gshegs pa yab yum sras dang btsun mor bcas pa thams cad spyan drangs/ steng gi nam mkhar bzhugs pa thams cad kyang / thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis rjes chags byang chub kyi sems su zhu ste/ 'khor lo'i dbang phyug yab yum gyi zhal du zhugs/ gzhir gnas kyi byang chub kyi sems dang ro gcig tu 'dres/rtsa 'khor lo bzhir dga' bzhi'i ye shes brtan par byas/ rdo rje nor bu dang / nā ra nā si kar/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes ring du sku nyams su bstar ba'i rten byang chub kyi sems yang dag par blang ste lce thog tu bzhag par gyur/ dbang bskur rdo rje sogs kyi mthar/ /ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun —377—

gyis dbang bskur ro/ /'di ste dpa' bo lha mo rnams/ /dam tshig rmad byung chen po ste/ khams lnga ldan pa'i ror rtogs byed/ /bde ba gang de myong bar byos/ /oṃ ā hu/ bdag 'jug gi skabs su de tsam gyis chog la/ rgyal bde'i dkyil chog nas/ byang chub kyi sems/ bsgrubs zin nas slob pa la sbyin pa'i bar du/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas/ zhes sogs shis brjod byed gsungs te/ shis brjod de ltar byed na lugs gsum yod de/ gsang dbang gi mig dar bcings ma thag tu/ dbang lha spyan drangs shis brjod byed/ spro na chu dbang bskur ba ni lugs gcig dang / gsang dbang dngos bskur grub mtshams su shis brjod sngon du 'gro bas/ byang chub kyi sems dang / bum chu bsres te dbang bskur ba ni lugs gnyis pa dang / sangs rgyas rnams nam mkhar spyan drangs pa'i shis brjod sngon du song nas/ chags la 'dod chags bdag nyid sbyor/ /zhes sogs ched du brjod pa dang lhan cig zhu bar byed pa ni gsum pa yin no/ /'di gsum gang dang yang mi mthun par/ byang chub kyi sems sgrubs zin pa'i rjes la byed pa tsam la ni/ khungs med cing rig pas kyang mi 'thad pa'o/ /o ā hu/ mig dar bsal/ gang de dga' ba'i rang bzhin snying la bde byed de yang btags pa tsam/ /gang yang chags bral yang ni rgyu'am gnyis ka srid pa'i rtse mo'i rgyu/ /ji srid rgya la yid kyi rnam par rtog pa 'phro ba spangs pa'i gzugs/ /de srid mya ngan 'das pa gzhan la yod min yul ni rtogs pa'i bdag /'di ni de nyid mi shes pa'i/ /slob ma rnams la bshad mi bya/ /blo ldan rtog pa med pa la/ khren tu gsang ba 'di ni sbyin/ /de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam rang lus thabs ldan gyi rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang / dam tshig tu bza' ba rnams kyi —378—

sbas don la spyod/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs pa yin no/ /de nas slob mas slob dpon dang dkyil 'khor la mchod par mos/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya brjod par yang 'dod de/ /'gal ba ni med do/ sher dbang gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ bdag ming rdo rje che ge mo/ /byang chub sems ni sgom byed pa/ /slob dpon zhabs kyi chu skyes la/ /dbang bskur don du gsol ba 'debs/ /slob dpon go 'phang che rang bzhin/ /skal pa chen po bdag la stsol/ /bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa/ /brtul zhugs mchog ni khyod drin gyis/ /bdag la nges par stsal nas kyang / /des ni sems can dpag med don/ /ji ltar 'dul bzhin bdag bgyid do/ /lan gsum/ oX āXhūX/ mig dar bcings/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ dbang gi lha dpal he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo la/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba h+pha/ ar+ghaX/ nas sha lta'i bar gyis mchod/phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba/ /zhes sogs bkra shis brjod/ oX mahā su kha badz+ra satwa a bhi ṣe ka stuX a bhi ṣañtsa mi sarba ta thā ga ta a dhi pa ti tī no ḍi rnyo me bha wa/ ju na ma ste bha ga bān badz+ra dha ra su ra ta stuX a haX badz+ra satwa oX āXskyoX/ badz+ra a bhi khri thu/zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ gzungs ma yid 'ongs 'di khyod kyis/ /bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis brtags/ /rdo rje rjes chags sbyor ba yi/ /bde ba dam pa myong bar gyis/ /thabs gzhan gyis ni sangs rgyas min/ /'gro ba gsum 'di dag pa yin/ /de phyir 'di dang bral bar ni/ khyod kyis nam yang ma byed cig /'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na —379—

med/ /rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed pa/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces rig ma gtad/ dpa' bo byang chub sems bza' bar/ /khyod ni spro ba yin nam ci/ /rigs lnga las ni byung ba yi/ /rig ma mchod par rtag gus sam/ /bshang ba gci ba stob dang khrag /sogs bza' da lta yid ches sam/ /rjes su mthun smros dam tshig bzang / /ji ltar bde bar bu smros shig /ces dris pa la/de la sogs pa'i dam tshig rnams/ /lha mo ci phyir bdag mi spro/ /bud med rtag gus cis ma bgyid/ /bha ga nyid la tsum pa ni/ /zhes lan btab/ e ma bdag gi pad+ma ni/ /bde ba kun dang yang dag ldan/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste/ /sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba thams cad pad+ma ra gyis/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /mo k+ṣa ho/bdag dang rig ma mi dmigs te/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho 'gyung ba dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog la yum rdo rje phag mos yang dag par 'byud pa'i sku can du gyur/ yab kyi gsang gnasanguzhes pa nas/ yab yum rjes su chags pas snyoms par zhugs par gyur/ rjes chags kyi mes bdun khri nyis stong gi rtsa'i tshogs pa byang chub kyi sems rnams bde ba chen po'i gnas spyi bor 'dus/ de las byang chub kyi sems mgrin par byon pa dga' ba/ snying gar byon pa mchog tu dga' ba/ lte bar byon pas dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ gsang bar byon pa lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba/ de rjes rdo rje nor bur lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes rdzogs par gyur/ shes rab sbyor bas —380—

dpal ldan ni/ /'di nyid yang dag mtsho ni par bya/ /rdo rje skyil krung dag gi sems/ /nor bu'i nang du son lta bas/ /nor bu'i gnas de nyid du de kho na nyid mngon du byas te/ slar yang rnal 'byor gyi stobs kyis/ lugs zlog gi dga' ba bzhi'i rim pas/ mas brtan pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bde stong gnyis su med pa mngon du byas par gyur/ o ā hu/ mig dar phye/ de ltar na bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang bskur ba thob/ lam gzhan lus shes rab kyi rdzogs rim bsgom pa la dbang/ dam tshig tu/ las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya sgrub/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel sgrigs pa'o/ /dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul/ kun mkhyen ye shes phung po can/ /sogs blo ka gnyis kyis gsol ba btab/ rtogs par bya ba bzhi pa ni/ zung 'jag lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dngos yin la/ de nyid gang gi rtogs pa'i shes pa de yang kho na nyid kyi mtshan nyid can no/ /ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/ /rdul bral mthar ster zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /de ltar na don dam pa byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dag lam phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa'i ye shes bsgom pa la dbang / 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel bsgrigs pa'o/ /da ni dbang gi mtha' rten rnams bshad de/ slob ma la dbang bzhi po ji tsam bskur ba/ de'i mthar 'di rnams byed pa yin mod kyang / dbang bzhi ka sdebs gcig la byed na/ skabs 'di'am bum dbang gi mthar byed pa gtso che ste/ gnyis po gang byas kyang 'dra'o/ /de yang 'di ltar/ chos —381—

rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /srid pa'i mtsho las mngon par rgal/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bur ni/ /sems can kun la bstan par bgyi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /sgra yi rjes su 'gro ba yi/ khres rab mngon du rtogs gyur cig /gang gi 'jig rten thams cad du/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /kun tu sgra bsnyan lta bu yi/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi/ /skye med lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gi sangs rgyas gang kun dang / /'jig rten pa yi khams kun du/ /bla med bsam mi khyab pa'i dri/ /rang gi lus las spro bar bya/ /ro kun gcig gi rnam par ni/ /rang bzhin med pa'i gzugs kyi su/ /lhag pa ru ni rtogs gyur cig /gang gi sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /srog chags gyur pa thams cad la/ /lha rdzas dpe med ro yi mchog /sprul nas su ni spyin par byos/ /reg byas rjes su ma gos par/ khyod kyis lhag par rtogs gyur cig /gang gi reg bya'i khyad par rnams/ /rang gi sems las byung zhes pa/ /lhag par mos byas sna tshogs pa'i/ /bla med reg bya'i khyad par rnams/ /rang gi sems ni yongs gyur pa'i/ /lha rnams dag ni thams cad dang / /de bzhin gshegs pa kun dang yang / /byang chub sems dpa' sogs kun la/ /yang dag sbyor ba reg bya'i bde/ /nges par sbyar bar bya ba yin/ /lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /thur ldan sman pa'i rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams kyis bu khyod kyi/ /mi shes pa yi rab rib bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hri ṭā/ mig thur ro/ /a a/ cho se rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /zhes pa nas/—382—

'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /me long ngo / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu ra ga ya ho/o nas/ rwa ga ya ma/ mda' gzhu'o/ /hū rdo rje sems dpa' me long bzhin/ /gsal zhing dwangs la rnyogs pa med/ /bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso/ /gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub sems ni 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig /me long gnyis pa'o/ /oṃ badz+ra he tu ma/ o badz+ra bha ga ra/ oṃ badz+ra lha rnye ā a thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /thams cad mchog gi mnyam nyid gsal/ /deng nas brtsams te dam bcas pa'i/ /sems ni bskyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /de ring phan chad 'jig rten la/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /kun nas yongs su bkang nas ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /chos bshad do/ zhes rab thabs kyi sems kyis ni/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /rtag tu dogs pa med byas nas/ /'dod pa lnga la longs spyod bya/ /ngo bo nyid kyi sems can don/ /ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /chags sogs dag pas sgrub par gyis/ /gang gzhan dam tshig la sdang ba/ /skye bo dam tshig nyams pa dag /sangs rgyas bstan pa skyong ba yi/ /'bad pa yis ni bsad par bya/ /sems can kun la phan don du/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sbyor ba yis/ /pha rol nor ni phrogs gyur kyang / /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags lta bu'i bde ba med/ /skye bo rnams la de rtag spyin/ /sems can don du gzhan bud med/ /bsten pas bsod nams thob —383—

par 'gyur/ /sangs rgyas la sogs smod pa la/ /rin chen 'byung ldan rnal 'byor gyis/ /tshig rtsub sbyor ba byas na ni/ /bla med dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ /'od dpag med pa'i rdzun tshig smra/ /don yod grub pa'i ting 'dzin mchog /rgyud gsungs cho gas blo ldan kun/ /dam tshig dag pa brtan par bya/ /chos rnams kun la ser sna dang / /sems can rnams la mi phan dag /nyams nga shin tu che na yang / /bu khyod kyis ni de mi bya/ /sems can gyi don byed pa'i rjes gnang ngo / /'jig rten khams ni thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /de bzhi du/ rdo rje/ rin chen/ pad+ma/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ dkyil chog las/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rgyal/ /kun gyi bdag po zhes bya ba'i/ /rdo rje 'khor lo khyod kyi bskor/ /lko brjod par yang 'dod do/ /de ltar na rgyal ba rgyal zhes pa'i thad du/ rat+na dhi ga dang / a ro li ka dang / pra dz+nyā lha ga dang /badz+ra dha ga rnams 'don pa spo bar yang bya'o/ /'on kyang 'di ni sngags cig gi gung nas dum bur bsgyur bar mngon no/ /rigs lnga'i sprul bshad kyi rjes gnang ngo / /de nas 'grub na rtsa sngags lan gsum/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ /bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum/ sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol/ /rdo rje slob ma 'di nyid kyi rgyud la dpal he ru ka 'khor lo bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi gsung rig sngags kyi nus —384—

mthu ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig /de ltar na sngags kyi rjes gnang ste/ de dag ni rjes gnang ngo / /dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te/ stong pa'i ngang las hūX las rdo rje huX gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po/ g.yas rdo rje dang pad+ma/ yum rdo rje snyem ma dkar mo/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa nas mnyam par sbyor ba dpral par oX nas/ hūX/ thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs thams cad/ rdo rje sems dpa' he ru ka'i rnam par h+pha/ dzaXhuX baX hoX de zhu ba las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga par gyur/ rang gi snying gar yang rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcangs/ /phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sirnyi badz+ra sa ma ya/ tiṣ+ṭha e ka tā/ dha ra ya mi/ badz+ra satwa hi hi hi hi huX/ rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /bdag nyid dpal he ru ka yab yum zhal phyag rgyan gos mtsho ni cha thams cad rdzogs par gyur/ hūX las byung ba'i cang te lā a las byung ba'i thod pa/ oṃ las byung ba'i tshangs pa'i skud pa rnams su gyur/ yab yum gyi snying po tshar bzhi/ he ru ka dpal phyag rgya 'di/ /phyi dang nang du yang dag gnas/ kha ṭāX cang te'u lhung bzed snod/ /byin pa dpa' bos bzung bar gyis/ kha ṭāX ga dang ḍa ma sa /he ru ka dpal kha ṭāX ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma sa /rdo rje kha ṭāX rdo rje bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs pa/ /tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor dag kha ṭāX ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen pos blang bar gyis/ / spyod pa'i brtul zhugs so/ /sngags kyi rjes gnang dang / brtul zhugs rnam pa gnyis po 'di/ /ming —385—

dbang dang / slob dpon gyi bar du byas kyang legs so/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las bton nas/ /srid pa shin tu zhi ba'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/bdag gis khyod ni lung bstan no/ /kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje sarba ta thā ta ga si rgya sa ma ya stuX/ sgru rgyu wa swa/gang yang 'di ltar lung bstan pa de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston to/ /mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bcug pa dang ni mthong bas kyang / /sdig pa kun las rnam grol nas/ /de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas/ bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /phyin chad 'chi ba yod yin te/ /mi thub tshugs pa yod min pas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /dngos grub dam tshig sdom pa 'di/ khyod kyis rtag tu srung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /rdo rje zhes bya'i phyag rgya ni/ /gang zhig skyed pa tsam gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid du dogs med pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni spangs mi bya/ /dam pa'i chos ni mi spang zhing / /nam yang dor bar mi bya'o/ /mi shes pa'am rmongs pa yis/ /tshul chen bstan pa mi bya'o/ /rang gis bdag nyid yongs spangs nas/ /dka' thub kyis ni mi gdung zhing / /ci bde bar ni bde ba bzung / /'di ni ma byon rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams/ / nam yang yongs su dor mi bya/ /slob dpon smad par mi bya ste/ /'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /bla ma sangs —386—

rgyas kun mtshungs pas/ /slob dpon la ni gang smod pa/ /de ni sangs rgyas kun smad pas/ /rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur te/ /rims dang dug dang dbyig dug dang / /mkha' 'gro rnams kyis gtses pa dang / /bgegs dang log 'dren gtum po yis/ /bsad nas dmyal bar lhung bar 'gyur/ /de bas nan tan thams cad kyis/ /rdo rje slob dpon blo gros che/ /dge la rab tu mi spyoms pa/ / nam yang smad par mi bya'o/ /bla ma la ni gus bcas yon/ /rjes mthun khyod kyis dbul bar bya/ /des ni rims sogs gnod pa rnams/ /phyir zhing 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro/ /rtag tu rang gi dam tshig srungs/ /rtag tu de bzhin gshegs pa mchod//rtag tu bla ma la yang dbul/ / 'di ni sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /de byin sangs rgyas thams cad la/ /rtag tu byin pa nyid du 'gyur/ /de byin bsod nams tshogs yin te/ / tshogs las dngos grub mchog tu 'gyur/ /deng khyed skye ba 'bras bur bcas/ / gang phyir 'di la legs gnas pas/ /dam tshig lha rnams kun mnyam par/ / gnas par 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin bcas pas/ /de ring tshe ldan de dbang bskur/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa yin/ /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing / /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /de ring khyod kyis sangs rgyas nyid/ /thob pa 'di la the tshom med/ /de ltar yid ni rab dwangs rdo rje nyid du kyis/ /rang gi dam tshig mi zad bde ster bsten par gyis/ /de ring 'gro ba bde myur rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /mtshungs pa'i rtag pa nyid du khyed rnams bsten —387—

par 'gyur/ /de nas spyi bor gdugs bzung bskor ba byas par mos la/sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa'i/ / slob ma 'di ni 'bul ba lags/ /zhes dang / sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang / /lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhi/ rab tu 'bad de bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po rnams rgyud la sbyor/ sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/ /phan 'dogs drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / khyod la rtag tu srung bar mdzad/ /ces slob dpon gyi gnas la dbugs phyung / dkyil 'khor kun gyis yongs su bskor ba yi/ /mnga' bdag sku mdog sngon po rgyal gyur cig /dmar bas ji ltar mdzes byas rgyal gyur cig /dam tshig gis brgyan mdzes pa rgyal gyur cig /zla phyed mgo bor brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /lha mo'i 'khor gyis brgyan pa rgyal gyur cig /e ma ho/ dang po'i sangs rgyas don dam sku can rgyal/ /chos 'dod nor dang thar pa ster mdzad rgyal/ /ye shes lnga ldan dga' ldan rang bzhin rgyal/ /mgon po bde chen phyag na rdo rje rgyal/ /lko me mā gtor/ gtso bos ji ltar: sogs gto rag gi maṇ+ḍal phul/ deng nas brtsams te: sogs/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /zhes sogs/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu bden stobs brjod pa dang bcas pa spyi dang mthun par brjod/ rjes chog ni/ su lhas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ mchod yon nyer spyod rol mo rig ma bcu drug rnams sngags dang phyag rgya'i 'bul/ rtsa sngags gnyis sam/snying po gnyis kyi mthar 'bru gsum btanas pas nang mchod phul/ rkang brgyad gnyis dang / rkang pa —388—

bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pas bstod/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams/ bdag cag rnams la dgongs su gsol/ khyed rnams la mkhyen pa'i ye shes nas/byin gyis rlobs kyi: bar/ dngos grub blang / yig brgya bzlas/ ma 'byor: sogs dang /ma rnyed: sogs/ bzod par gsol/ bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag: sogs dang / rten rnams la brtan bzhugs bya/ sgrub mchod zhug sbrel byed na/ nyi ma snga ma rnams la/ rdul mtsho ni gyi dkyil 'khor la yang brtan bzhugs bya/ nyi ma tha ma la rdul mtsho ni gshegs su gsol ba sogs spyi dang 'dra ste/ bde ba chen po'i char yang du blta'o/ /sgrub mchod zhag sbrel byed pa'i nyi ma phyi ma rnams la/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i dam tshig gi skabs/'khor lo bcu gnyis kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi go 'phang la bkod slar 'dus te thim pa yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal he ru ka zhes sbrel/ rang gi snying ga'i hū yig las: zhes pa nas/ yo ga shudha'i bar sta gon dang bsre ba de bor ba tsam gyis chog go /slob ma sta gon gyi bya ba ni/ dpal mkha' 'gro'i dbang chog gi tho yig go don dpyad pa dang bcas pa zhig bris zin par shes la cho ga ma 'dus pa rnams ni/ gsang ba spyi'i cho ga 'phreng ba sogs las shes par bya'o/ /de ltar bshad pa 'di ni tshad ldan gyi gzhung rnams kyi rgya las ma 'das pa yang yin la/ deng sang brgyud pa'i rim pa rgyal ba'i sde la 'ded par snang bas/ de'i gzhung gi legs pa'i cha rnams ma bor bar blangs pa'ang yin no// //'dir smras pa/ rmad byung rgyud kyi rgyal po bla med 'di'i/ /dbang bskur nye brgyud byin rlabs tshan ka can/ /gzhan la ma ltos rang la yod pa'i phyir/ /rgyal sde sogs la brten dgos nam yang med/ /'on kyang da lta'i 'gro kun rtog pas bcings/ /skur pa spong phyir rang brgyud tshol bar mdzad/ /skye bo rnams kyi blo ngor 'di tsam bsgrigs/ /zab don gzhan du 'chad 'gyur gsang ba che/ /'di tsam byas pa'i dge bas —389—

gzhan don bya/ /zhes pa rgyud kyi rgyal po mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho las byung ba'i/ /rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi bdag 'jug 'khyer bde ba gsang ba'i snying po 'di yang / rgyal khams pa twa ra nā tha'i blo gros kyi zer ma tsam mo/ /maṅgalaX// //

dpe sgrog 'gan 'khur pa/ tshangs po/mdun shog ma rjes 'god pa/ 'gro 'dul rdo rje/spe5 gu'i//dzo / la 'an ni la5/deb nga lnga pa/༄༅/ /jo nang tā ra na tha'i gsung 'bum/( 13(45)dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsgrigs/:krung go'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang gis bskrun te bkram/pe cin spyi lo/ tsho/lo 'i rdo~X ra par gzhi dang sis po bsgri sna/ ra btab/spre lo 2008lo'i zla 4par par thengs dang po btabadapar grangs/ 0001———1500152smo978——7——80253——013——3mo2 51gsung 'bum cha tshang (deb 1—45yod )la rin sgor/ 910 00

thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas nas//skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khru/gas pa yi//srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog/'khu ske༈ 4tsho41lko zi 4 cha cho〉za lo4ra byu rnge sne po mi min mi mi’ 4 lko 3so4skeX2skya༈smo1ci‘zhwa0go༈‘ge'i snga tshi1'i༈༈tshi1smo0spya01115010smo0'u khe4tshi〉1༈sku0rtokhu tshi༈༈khyi'u0smo3pa15spo smo0sa tha sku0sa tha stu10pa1༈smo0ci/0khatwa/〉5/tshi50bya0(6pa khri0sku'i tha0ci0smos0bya bya'i sa sku sku0tshi༈smostu10bge༈smo'u000tshis0rto bya'i ba1ci'i1tshib1tshi 〉 16khukhu tshi16khus pyi bya

nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gi las sgrub mi snar lo bstud mar 'tsho ba'i yon spyor gnang mkhan mchog sprul pad+ma dbang rgyal rin po che la snying thag pa nas thugs rje zhu ba dang /krung rga'i bod rig pa dpe skrun khang nas rje btsun tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum dpe bsdur ma par skrun thad la rgyab skyor dang mnyam las gnang bar snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu ba yin/dpar yon zhal 'debs gnang mkhan/rang re'i sbun zla rnams kyi mtshan tho/ ka mad kyi go rim ltar lags/gdung sras phrin las nor bu rin po che/ bla ma mthar phyin rin po che/ bla ma yon tan/sman pa rig 'dzin lags/ las rab gling pa rin po che/ bsod nams bde skyid/
